reviews.author: pankaj
reviews.title: Great location and view but needs improvement with pricing and customer service
reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐ 7/10

We stayed at Khyber Resort & Spa with our family for one night during Eid and had a mixed but generally enjoyable experience.

The highlight of the resort is undoubtedly the accommodation and location. The rooms are exceptionally spacious, beautifully designed, well-lit, and offer spectacular views. The swimming pool is absolutely stunning—temperature-controlled, impeccably maintained, and surrounded by breathtaking scenery. It is easily one of the most memorable features of the property.

However, there are a few areas where the experience fell short of expectations.

The biggest disappointment was the in-room dining. While we expected premium pricing at a luxury resort, the value for money was difficult to justify. We paid approximately ₹2,000 for a pizza and another ₹2,000 for a club sandwich. Unfortunately, the club sandwich that arrived was more like a basic chicken-and-mayonnaise sandwich rather than the classic club sandwich we expected. The pizza was equally underwhelming—flat, ordinary, and more reminiscent of a commercial pizza than a premium resort offering. The food presentation and overall dining experience did not match the pricing.

Room service was also slower than expected and could certainly be more responsive.

As we stayed during Eid and our package included both breakfast and dinner, we were hoping for a special festive dining experience showcasing local Kashmiri cuisine or Eid specialties. Instead, the dinner buffet felt fairly standard and lacked the festive touch we had anticipated.

Another point worth mentioning is the cost of the extra bed. We requested an additional bed for our child and were charged approximately ₹13,000, including breakfast and dinner. While we understand that Khyber is positioned as a luxury resort, this felt excessive when compared with other premium properties we stayed at during the same trip. At Pine & Peak, Pahalgam, we paid around ₹4,500 for an extra bed, and at Taj Dal View, Srinagar, approximately ₹5,000. Khyber’s charge was therefore more than two-and-a-half times higher. Premium pricing is expected, but the differential felt difficult to justify.

What disappointed me most, however, was the handling of guest feedback at checkout. Before leaving, I wanted to share my observations directly with the Front Office or Operations Manager so that the feedback could be used constructively. The receptionist kindly offered to contact the manager, but I was informed that the manager was busy in a meeting and that I should simply post my feedback online instead. For a property of this stature, I found this response disappointing. Guest feedback—whether positive or negative—is valuable, and taking a few moments to acknowledge a departing guest’s concerns would have demonstrated a stronger commitment to customer service and continuous improvement.

To be fair, Khyber is a beautiful luxury property with world-class views, spacious rooms, and excellent facilities. However, the pricing of ancillary services, dining experience, and responsiveness to guest feedback are areas where the resort can improve.

Overall, I would rate the experience 7/10. Had the pricing of add-on services been more reasonable and the service experience more polished, it could easily have been a 9/10 stay.

— Pankaj

reviews.author: AndyPeter2016
reviews.title: Its a great location.... Some services leave a lot to be desired.....
reviews.text:
We were quite excited about our stay at the Khyber. Especially after everything we had heard about it. And it lived upto the expectations or atleast for the most parts it did.
The good:
1- Location location location --- this is one thing this hotel has going for itself. Its located in the lap of the snow capped mountains. You simpy can not beat the view. From our room (1021) it was unobstructed even sitting on the couch or from the bed --- straight mountain views. I hear room 1017 and 1014 have the best views
2- Saba and Khushbu who work at the restaurants are the sweetest. Absolute angels. So caring -- they really took great care of our old parents and our group overall. 
3- Spa - good spa - good service -- (wish they could take advantage of the views and design the spa room/windows accordingly)
4- Size of the rooms, Bathrooms are incredible. Fantastic.
5- Rashida and Imtiaz (?) in housekeeping were so sweet. 
6- the quality of linen and pillows is awesome. 
7- the musicial play Santoor and Rabad is awesome (perhaps lower the volume on the speaker).

What could be better:
a- Courtesy - I was VERY disappointed with the lack of courtesy from the reception staff and many of the guys at the restaurant. Maybe because we were coming from an amazing service at the ITC in Pehalgam and going to the Taj in Srinagar both with amazing service, the Khyber left a lot to be desired
b- Not to overgeneralize, but my friends who travelled with us had the same unaided view - The MEN that worked the front desk area and at the restaurants, coffeeshop just seemed to have an attitude about something. It was very weird. They would make eye contact but not acknowledge that you needed help. Things as simple as moving a couch so we could sit together as a group, started with a no, they would see you needed water but wouldnt bring it.  I'd highly suggest this crowd either go train at a Taj or let Saba and Khushbu lead this team - they can set the gold standard
c- The corridor can be noisy. We had a hard time sleeping just because how noisy the corridor was.  Maybe because our location was on the way to the pool.. but still....
d- Would love for the conceirge to be more knowledgable about the local surroundings. Especially about the outdoors and the local hikes etc. 
e- The hotel staff gets overwhlemed when large groups check in together. They have been around long enough that they should be able to manage these crowds well

Personally, if Taj or ITC were to open a hotel in Gulmarg with a similar view, I'd definitely stay there for their hospitality.

reviews.author: NorthStar819518
reviews.title: Though good, no value for money
reviews.text:
Location: fantastic, but you cannot move around, as the area is near gandola and full with tour guides and other sellers, who don’t let you move. 
Rooms : rooms are spacious, well decorated, with what they claim as Gulmarg view rooms have only tree and shed view. 
Value: it’s over priced. Not value of money. 
Service : good 
Noise level : the corridors and lounges are crowdy and noicy.

reviews.author: Duja M
reviews.title: Great food .
reviews.text:
We had come to gulmarg for a sking trip and stayed at khyber for 3 nights .Paid a premium as it is one of the top resorts in gulmarg .
The hotel is good .Value for money ?not really it is a bit steep for the kind of service .I mean nothing really wrong with their service but when u pay a price like taj you do expect service like that .for eg when we checked in we were not given the welcome kahwa drink which was given to most guests.
Then next day when I raised it they took an hour to oblige us with the same.
This was our second time visiting khyber after 12 years and we felt the food was an upgrade especially the chaat and the indian dessert .On enquiring we did find out that they have a new chef Mr.Rajeshkumar Guptaji and his chaat was such a refreshing change from the same food we had been eating on our 7 day trip combined with other hotels.The RAS MALAI and garam gajjar halwa was to die for .
The resort had tooo many families with loud kids all around us which obviously is not their fault but the vibe is just tooo noisy.
The heated pool a plus but changing room not great.
So all in all a mixed after taste.Though would definitely come back for Guptajis chaat and Mithai.

reviews.author: Charu
reviews.title: Hyped
reviews.text:
During my vacation to Kashmir, many friends told me that Khyber was overhyped. I always disagreed  it was on my bucket list, and I truly believed it would live up to its reputation. But when I finally arrived, I was deeply disappointed.

The rooms are in urgent need of refurbishment. The plumbing clearly requires attention, and the overall condition feels tired. The lift system is confusing  at one point you take one lift, at another level you need to change to a different one. Given that it’s built on a hilly terrain, some structural complexity may be unavoidable, but poor maintenance and lack of clarity are not. Cleanliness was another concern; certain areas felt dingy rather than luxurious.

To their credit, they upgraded us to a suite with a balcony, which was a relief and certainly better than the initial room allotted. The food was good, and the live santoor playing was honestly the biggest highlight of the stay  it added a beautiful Kashmiri touch to the ambiance. The spa experience with therapist Islary was excellent as well. Varun and Abhishek genuinely tried their best to make our stay comfortable, and their effort is appreciated.

However, good staff efforts and cultural touches cannot compensate for the pressing need to invest in upkeep and room maintenance. Unfortunately, I now have to agree with what I once dismissed — this property does feel overhyped.

reviews.author: Rahulphysio04
reviews.title: Overpriced and over hipped property
reviews.text:
Well so much heard about this prime property in Kashmir specially in Gulmarg. So planned our 2 night stay there. To our expectation we were not at all impressed by the hospitality we expect from such a over priced amd a prime property.  Mr. Mohammad,  Mr Imran from front desk and Arif and there Fnb manager Junaid.(i missed the name) , all of them tried there best at the end to make our experience and stay better and memorable.
I will write whsta we found best and not good.
Pros:
Wonderful views, great bf buffet, elite Bravo Italian restaurant,  steam n sauna along with heated pool when its chilly outside. Wonderful Santoor playing guy at lobby during bf and dinner.
Good ambience and very traditional decor, good room size with decent amenities.
Cons:
Really over priced, no liquor serving though u can get ur own booz, in a premium property where u r supposed to cater international clients why its not allowed. Specially if u can charge 1500 for peanut masala or other appetizers in Shisha lounge . I don't understand that logic behind .
Hotel really need to work on there guest reception/ welcome/ departure.
I mean whensomeone pay so much for a room and still does not get any special welcome or departure its not worth it. What make a property memorable is specially how they receive there guests or see off them...in our case nothing happened mean nothing. Small reception on the left cornet, straight taken to lounge and served kahwa.thats it.
Well thats not the expectation from Khyber...need to learn from other brands like Taj, Itc or oberoi specially when u have charges like that.
One more thing, hotel is at steep location from main road. Coming down should not be a big issue but while going up to hotel walking van be challenging for many,  they should b having a shuttle for this, they gave excuses like union issue and all but I don't agree , they can handle that for sure. Its a very big inconvenience.

There were many other hiccups but as I mentions fee gems in Hotel, they quickly got in them and rectified quickly.

Would love coming back if these things are taken care well else there r much better other property in less then half the money from here to go in Gulmarg.

reviews.author: GrandTour09919684821
reviews.title: Not worth the stay….staff was good, management needs to be trained
reviews.text:
The property was good, staff also good but it seemed like a very commercial property……it was our 25th anniversary and my daughter requested for some flowers…she was told she will be charged…they couldn’t be bothered that we had come to celebrate a milestone occasion

reviews.author: shiv s
reviews.title: Gorgeous view, average experience.
reviews.text:
Gorgeous view, average experience.

The coffee shop at The Khyber offers stunning mountain views, but beyond that, the resort feels overcrowded and overpriced. Service is just okay, and it’s noisy with large families and kids everywhere—not the peaceful Himalayan escape we expected.

If you’re curious, drop by for a coffee and the view, but skip the overnight stay. Better value and serenity elsewhere!

reviews.author: chintukapadia
reviews.title: Highly overrated & over priced
reviews.text:
Highly overrated and over priced for the services provided 
It’s the only star category hotel in area hence the demand. If you want to go to pool from one side you have to walk and climb almost of mile & atleast 4 floors. There are no lifts. For youngster it’s ok, but what about senior citizens
Breakfast spread was one of best but Ala carte is highly over priced 
Can visit once but not value for money

reviews.author: Sagar
reviews.title: Winter family vacation
reviews.text: The thing which impressed us was the lavish interiors. But the resort lacks in terms of some amenities which should be a necessity for a top notch property. As the ambient temperature gets extremely cold in the winter time, there’s no hot water facility in the bidet which is really inconvenient & m really surprised that the celebrities staying in the resort aren’t highlighting this. Also the areas outside the rooms aren’t air proof leading to cold air entering everywhere. The resort food quality is good but very costly ( which has become very common in all five star properties in Kashmir valley for whatever reasons). Mr. Waseem of housekeeping is the brightest star as he is attending to each & everyone’s needs & ensuring that the resort’s high standards are maintained. The heated swimming pool is a good one but there should be a life guard available & there should be time allotted to families & couples as the couples get really cosy in the pool which sometimes becomes inconvenient for the families.

reviews.author: Jey R
reviews.title: Overrated!!
reviews.text: We were originally booked to spend 5 nights. This booking was made months prior. About a month prior to our stay the travel agent called to say the the Khyber had canceled one nights accommodation due to a private function. In hindsight, I am glad that our stay was reduced as the last two nights of our stay was horrendous. Both nights were interrupted by external noise and I finally confronted the GM and sought a refund of a nights accommodation which was granted. I will not recommend this hotel as I think it is overrated.

reviews.author: Jagdish B
reviews.title: Good but service excellent
reviews.text:
Hotel is very good. What let us down were the poor views from our room and a very average breakfast. 
Service was near perfect and staff extremely caring and courteous.  Special mention of Chef Gupta and Chef. Muneesh.  Also Ishfaq ( In Dining )..can't remember other names but truly awesome service.  Expensive hotel and dinner meals in dining extremely highly priced ( but good quality ).

reviews.author: unnati_divecha
reviews.title: Good Hotel but not worth the hype and money
reviews.text:
We spent three nights here (18th to 21st August) and had the following experience:

Positives:
- The location is great and a 2 min walk from the Gandola (cablecar). The hotel is nice and well maintained and views are beautiful.
- The L'Occitane spa was amazing.

Negatives:
- The hotel does NOT have AC and only has heating. Therefore, if you visit during any season besides Winter, the lack of AC is a problem. The room was hot and still!
- The swimming pool was very underwhelming and the water was torrid! 
- The jacuzzi in both the men and women spa bathrooms were half broken and not working.
- The food was average at best and extremely expensive for what they serve! Expected much better food and was disappointed. The Italian restaurant was still better but the main restaurant was sub-par.
- The housekeeping was not at all of a 5 Star Hotel - everyday they would mess up something or the other. 

Overall, the stay was decent but given how expensive the hotel is, we were fairly disappointed and do not think it was worth the hype! The hotel needs to improve and up their game!

reviews.author: dIE_wIth_mEmOrIEs_nOt_DrEAms
reviews.title: Beautiful property but better deals with agents!
reviews.text:
Loved the location of the property and warmth of the place. The experience was let down by the check in staff - Ishfaq. We had our booking through and agent and wanted to upgrade it to the Himalayan view rooms. Ishfaq conveyed to us that hotel will give the best upgrade deal and hence we proceeded for 3 rooms. However, we came to know later that agent was able to offer same deal at half the price. We felt duped and surprised that inspite of such an upscale hotel, client  satisfaction was not important to the staff.

Otherwise, we were happy with the service and FnB quality. Suggest always use an agent when doing your bookings.

reviews.author: Afreen S
reviews.title: Amazing food with amazing view.
reviews.text: I had lunch at pan asian restaurant and it was delicious. Soup and fish both were super fresh and delicious. Chef Adil was a treat to meet. He was very friendly as respectful and the food he made was awesome. Staff was also very amicable. Overall the experience of food, staff and ambience was great. Thumbs up from me!!!!

reviews.author: Shalini Bhasin
reviews.title: Khyber Gulmarg
reviews.text:
Not trying to burst anyone's bubble, but stayed at Khyber for 3 nights, and felt that it is quite overhyped.
The rooms are similar to standard hotel rooms ( our room's safety box & TV remote was not working) The resort itself does not have any activities. The staff, though courteous, lacked the basic information about their own property and not that hospitable (  not because they were not service oriented but more likely coz they have not been properly trained)
My take- visit the place maybe for a meal, but skip paying the exorbitant pricing  for the rooms.
PS- You let the cabbies and the guides know that you are putting up at Khyber, and they quote much higher, thinking that if you can afford Khyber- you can afford their over priced services too:)

reviews.author: Pawan Khatri
reviews.title: Average Stay
reviews.text:
My recent visit to Khyber Hotels and Resorts in Gulmarg left me utterly disappointed and questioning the hype surrounding this place. It is rated as the number one hotel in Gulmarg. It certainly is not good value for money. 
Its location is very good and scenic. The rooms are old but give a luxe vibe. The food was fine but The service was not attentive. No personal attention was given. There was no one to welcome us at the property. We had to call the person ourself. 
The property is really beautiful but need more efforts to justify its cost.

reviews.author: AA
reviews.title: Over rated
reviews.text: It’s rated as the number one hotel in Gulmarg. It certainly is not good value for money. Its location is very good and scenic. Service is excellent. We felt that their food was not up to the mark. Unless you must stay here, it’s not worth the money they charge.

reviews.author: Amitolive
reviews.title: Hotel in a Box feeling
reviews.text:
ROOMS  DONT HAVE VENTILATION .ONLY HEATING CAN HAPPEN .ONE FEELS SUFFOCATED IN THE ROOM AND WE HAD TO OPEN WINDOWS FOR AIR. WINDOWS DONT HAVE GRILL SO CANNOT OPEN BECAUSE OF SAFETY AND INSECTS.

YOU FEEL YOU ARE IN A CLOSED BOX AND CANNOT TAKE THE FEEL OF FRESH AIR WITH COFFEEE.

reviews.author: Sumayya K
reviews.title: terrible food, some wonderful staff
reviews.text: Mixed reviews -- the spa was amazing and a highlight. The rooms are beautiful but for the price, the service is extremely lacking. The food was the worst I've had in years, including at hotels that are 1/4th the price. Everything we ate was disappointing except for some daal and rice at dinner once -- the Italian restaurant is something people should avoid. There are many illogical decisions with decor (too dark) and music (terrible). Many of the Indian guests are extremely rude and bad mannered and it ruins your experience to see them treating servers that way. In general, although I was delighted to visit Khyber after having heard so much about it, it was definitely not worth the outrageously exorbitant price (most I've ever paid for a hotel in my life!). The only consolation is I hope this money goes to support the economy of Kashmir at this time. Two of the female staff (Nusrat at reception; Hameeda at the pool downstairs) went out of their way for us and made us feel really comfortable.

reviews.author: Anurag A
reviews.title: Good hotel BAD housekeeping
reviews.text: Although hotel is good, but the service level of house keeping is extremely bad. They don’t come to your help for almost 20-25 mins and unless you call 2-3 times. Bad experience in that regards. Otherwise good.

reviews.author: Indraneil t
reviews.title: Disappointing Experience at Khyber Hotels and Resorts, Gulmarg: Beware!
reviews.text:
My recent visit to Khyber Hotels and Resorts in Gulmarg left me utterly disappointed and questioning the hype surrounding this place. Despite the exorbitant tariffs, my wife and I decided to give it a try for lunch. Little did we know that we were about to experience a series of letdowns.

Right from the start, we were discouraged by the bell desk, claiming that the restaurant, "Clove," was exclusively reserved for in-house guests. However, upon entering, we discovered a nearly empty restaurant, with only three occupied tables, none of which were occupied by in-house guests as we were led to believe. It became evident that they were simply trying to deter walk-in customers like ourselves.

To add insult to injury, my camera bag was confiscated due to their strict policy against professional photography. While I understand the need for regulations, it felt unwelcoming and intrusive.

Our request for a tour of the property was met with a dismissive response from the receptionist, stating that it would take an hour to complete. We suggested doing the tour after lunch, but it seemed they were more interested in rushing us through our experience.

As for the food itself, it was a major letdown. The Mutton Seekh Kebab, a dish I had enjoyed in various places across the country, was shockingly mediocre. The taste lacked any uniqueness or memorable flavours, leaving me longing for the authentic versions available at a fraction of the cost in Delhi.

The real disappointment came with the Kashmiri Dum Aloo, a dish we were eager to try for the first time in Kashmir. The potatoes served were rock hard, almost inedible. When I inquired about this, the server seemed unaware and uninterested in addressing the issue. They later brought a fresh portion when we were almost done with our meal, rendering it redundant and offering no remedy for our unpleasant experience.

The lacklustre service continued during the property tour. An intern, with minimal knowledge about the hotel, was assigned to guide us. Her inability to answer basic questions about the amenities and evasiveness regarding room availability raised serious doubts about the competence of the staff.

Throughout our visit, it became evident that the hotel staff had little interest in accommodating walk-in guests. They seemed more focused on catering exclusively to their in-house guests, despite the absence of any in-house guests in the restaurant or utilising the amenities.

I cannot help but compare my experience at Khyber Hotels and Resorts with a roadside restaurant in Pahalgam. The stark contrast in taste, quality, and hospitality left me deeply disappointed.

In conclusion, I must warn fellow travellers to approach Khyber Hotels and Resorts with caution. The lack of warmth, subpar food quality, and unprofessional conduct of the staff do not justify the exorbitant prices they charge. Save your hard-earned money and explore alternative options in Gulmarg that offer better value and genuine hospitality.

Rating: 5.5 out of 10.

reviews.author: jin89k
reviews.title: Good
reviews.text:
The property is super and one of the best in Gulmarg. The restaurant staff is super and the food is excellent. They have the best view

However, we were given room the passage to the room smelled so bad. The washroom also had faul smell. On requesting change of rooms there didn’t have rooms and didn’t bother to check. Also, the bathtub clog was broken and we couldn’t use the bathtub as water drained out. The water in swimming pool and jacuzzi was dirty. 
It’s an amazing property but needs maintenance.
 Overall good experience.

reviews.author: viraj s
reviews.title: Average hospitality with lacking infrastructure but really good food.
reviews.text:
For the longest time, Gulmarg meant Khyber to me. We visited the resort on 17th March with an intention of staying within the property only for the full day. We were 4 couples with 2 children. 

So we checked in on 17th March at around 3.30 PM. The usual check-in is at 2 PM. We were informed that 1 of the rooms is still not ready. Not sure why as we were already checking in 90 mins later than usual. The checkin process at their end is super clumsy and took about 45 mins in total. Not sure why.

Since we had arrived after traveling for 5 hours, we were hungry and none of their restaurants were ready to serve us. The only place where the food was available was their cafe- Chaikash which honestly is supremely understaffed. Hence the basic sandwich and pizza took about an hour.

Coming to the rooms, we were on the 5th floor. They have an issue with the plumbing and hence the bathrooms were smelling. In one of the rooms suddenly at 4 AM, AC started making weird noises and hence it had to be switched off. When complained to the management team about it with video proof, they offered an extended stay till  evening. We declined since we already had activities planned after the check out. 

Food is really good.

If honestly asked, I wouldn't recommend the property to anyone. With the amount that they charge they really lack the warmth in the hospitality and infrastructural amenities.

We stayed at Taj in Srinagar and everyone could feel the difference in the hospitality.

reviews.author: KT
reviews.title: An over-rated luxury experience!
reviews.text:
They do have all the amenities, the rooms are clean and the food is decent.
However, if you are paying 50K per night for a normal room category, you naturally expect a certain level of luxury with respect to service, food and experience that unfortunately, Khyber is not able to live upto!
The housekeeping service was extremely slow and in some cases negligent.
The entire hotel needs a makeover as it is not

reviews.author: AKT
reviews.title: Average, overrated and overpriced.
reviews.text:
We stayed here for 3 nights during our 8 night Kashmir trip but unfortunately this was the most disappointing hotel of the trip. 

The hotel has amazing lobby and there are great food options at all their restaurants. The newly opened Italian restaurant is great too and perhaps serves the best of Italian food. 

The main restaurant staff is great but too busy to take care of some hygiene issues. What is lacking in the hotel is the quality and warmth of staff. The housekeeping takes too long to provide basic necessities like pillows or blankets in the room. The swimming pool is not in the best condition with some plastic sheet blocking the view and the jacuzzi and other areas are not maintained well.

Special mention for restaurant staff Saiba, Anurag and Irfan who are excellent at their jobs.

reviews.author: Vipul J
reviews.title: Excellent property with below average service
reviews.text:
Excellent property with below average service
The location and amenities are best in class but maximum staff are untrained local guys having lack of motivation and training as per the 5 star standards. They should have more of IHM trained staff to make it a wonderful  service experience also. Better if they give this gem  to Oberoi’s or Taj.

reviews.author: Sacraforda
reviews.title: Off season stay at Khyber
reviews.text: First thing- I went in the off season. So the views were average and the place was average. Without the snow, it looked just like any random hotel( where you don't know the price). But the service was impeccable. Each and every member of the staff was absolutely good at their job-which was a rarity. Their staff was just the most pleasant and nice I have ever encountered! Kudos to Firdous and Owais and everyone there.

reviews.author: Gargi Sen
reviews.title: Nice property with average service
reviews.text:
Just checked out from this hotel after 3 nights of stay and honestly speaking I felt it is bit over-rated.
We were in Luxury Double Room Gulmarg view.

Positive highlights: The location is good, a property of this size and all the amenities at this location is commendable. Some of the staffs particularly in the restaurant were professional.

Negative highlights: The housekeeping was below expectation and that ruined our mood. The flush in the toilet was not working properly and though we complained a few times there was no permanent solution. Everyday after room cleaning they did not replenish the commonly used items like toiletries and towels which even in a standard hotel is done. We have to dial them to ask for new shower gel bottles or towels. The curtain came out and they fixed it after two days. The chairs in the balcony have no cushions. 

Individually each issue may not be a big concern but all of them together gave us the impression that this hotel is not guest friendly in-spite of the fact that the charge is premium and is considered to be a luxury hotel.

reviews.author: j d
reviews.title: Very expensive, does NOT live upto the prices charged
reviews.text:
Good Hotel, good location, however prices charged are excessively higher than service and facilities
Spa area is good but needs urgent maintenance. NOT clean, some facilities work intermittently
Pool is good and heated which is a plus point
Food is average
Staff are good and ready to go the extra mile

reviews.author: Darshant1975
reviews.title: Stay away and save your money! Worst service at extremely high prices. Ritz Carlton prices & highway motel service.
reviews.text:
Khyber Hotel stays true to the Gulmarg culture or looting and duping. Minimal value for money. Save your money and stay somewhere else! Over all I would say stay in Gulmarg no more than one night anyways. 

- I had confirmed booking with my international credit card in April. One day before my flight in a June, they email me that they cannot process my card and my booking will be cancelled in 12 hours. I had to spend multiple hours calling back and forth to finally get someone to respond and give me a payu link. 
- extremely bad service and they make you feel like you should be thankful for being there.  From checkin to checkout , the staff had a constant air of attitude.  
- Dirty rooms, clogged showers. We had to stand in the clogged showers just to take a bath. 
- the elevator stopped working for 1 day and my old mother who has challenges to go up the stairs has to go through immense pain and suffering just to go to her room and back. 
- there is no AC and their thermostat doesn’t work right. Even their technicians can’t get that working right. As a result, my family slept in extreme heat and had to open up the windows which led mosquitoes inside.  When I shared this with the manager and front desk, they were like “there is thermostat and you don’t know how to work it”. 
- food is sometimes ok and most times extremely bad. The worst Palak paneer in the entire world is found here. And I have eaten Palak paneer from Greece to Toronto to New Delhi to New York and beyond. 
- beware and check your booking twice. I booked through booking.com for triple occupancy and when I reached the hotel, I was told that the booking was only for 2 people and I had to pay 10,000 RS extra.  
- no hotel cars and the taxis they call  will charge you 800 RS just to get to the market and back. 
- Cloves restaurant dinner and breakfast are average. But extremely expensive.  Dinner for 4 was 7000 RS. 

I have stayed at Taj, Hilton, Ritz, Welcome group, Marriott, Westin including cabins in Yosemite/Tahoe and many others but never had this bad service in my entire life. 
The only good thing is the location and the cabin like feel as well as the grounds. 
-

reviews.author: maneesh
reviews.title: Expensive hotel - very average for the price
reviews.text:
Stayed at Khyber with family and friends. The hotel is rated 5 star and charges USD 600 plus plus..for a room..

Positives : location near the gondola/ cable ride and that’s it..

For the price, we got a room facing the grass fences to start with. The room sizes are quite average and are designed for couples and not families.. 

The food is super expensive and probably the worst I have had in years…on the last day, for example the chef made me a special Kashmiri dish ( I appreciated the gesture because they had already goofed up) and I vomited the entire night. My family are all down with gastro issues as well..

It’s such a large hotel but there is literally nothing for the kids..a heated but dirty swimming pool…

Loud local music and dance till 1030 pm in the lobby area..didn’t understand this at all.. 

The staff are polite and helpful so will commend them for that. For the gastro issues, the staff helped me with the medicine as well. 

Will never go back to Khyber for sure…

reviews.author: anonymous835
reviews.title: Lovely hotel and views but…..
reviews.text: This is a lovely hotel in a beautiful location.  Staff are friendly and helpful.  The Food and Beverage Manager and Chef worked very hard to look after me and I appreciated this very much.  That being said, when I checked in I was given a room that had two big problems - the view was of the car park and garbage-strewn slope.   I asked for another room and was told the hotel was fully booked.  So I unpacked and tried to rest.  The room was anything but soundproof.  There was so much noise I couldn’t rest and finally told the front desk that if they didn’t move me I would put a bad review on Trip Advisor.  They moved me to a room that had a lovey view and was very quiet.  They even admitted there was a problem with the soundproofing in my original room.  With the price of rooms at this hotel, I’m surprised that room isn’t heavily discounted.  It should be.  I appreciate the effort staff went through to fix the problem (and they did), the problem shouldn’t have happened in the first place.  Upon check out I attempted to use my Visa card and it was declined 3 times.  I paid the small outstanding account in cash (I was trying to preserve my supply of rupees which is why I wanted to use Visa).  When I got to my next hotel in Srinagar, staff charged 1 rupee to my card and it worked.  So clearly the Khyber hotel was trying to avoid the use of credit cards which is very tacky given the price of this hotel.  So all in all…a relatively nice experience but a few very unnecessary hassled (which seems to be common throughout Indian so-called 5-star hotels).  They charge international prices and often deliver very inconsistent and ordinary service.

reviews.author: vipul
reviews.title: Excellent view. Very good rooms. However only one restaurant like a coffee shop. Service is slow n unprofessional.
reviews.text: For the exhorbitant rates service and food are average. Rooms r excellent. View is what u pay for. They charge like oberoi Vilas property. They jack up price due to monopoly. Even one year advance rates r too high. But then if service and food is not improved it won’t sustain. This is a fair balanced opinion.

reviews.author: Souvik S
reviews.title: Beautiful but misses out on customer experience!
reviews.text:
To start with the highs - the upkeep of the hotel is brilliant and luxurious. I loved the corridors and the rooms as well. The property is centrally temperature controlled and hence interiors are very comfortable. Rooms are opulent with all moder luxuries thar one can expect. 

The food is very good, and I will say that the breakfast spread is one of the best I have had in hotels/ resorts of this league. 

Now why would I still rate this place a 3 / 5. That's because of the service, and that too when I compare it with properties of this league. Clearly the speed and care for service towards its guests is far from expected. We had to ask multiple times for water, the water kettle was not clean and getting it exchanged took time !

Frankly, the hotel is definitely worth a stay, but will I go back for more given the level of service? - I am not sure

reviews.author: Vsk1420
reviews.title: Khyber resort
reviews.text:
@Mohmad Rafi was very helpful and assisted out of the way to make ouratay. Comfortable, 

Premiere rooms are not worth for money lot of work should be done here to make up to latest standards 

Room service was below level taking too much time a d also forgot many times tired of reminder 

Resort is over hyped considering pricing of premier rooms

We were upgraded by Rafi adsiatnceto Himalyan. Room nice and comfortable room 

Avoid premier rooms 

Breakfast was below par level 

View is excellent along with location 

My credit card was charged 3 times discussed with hotel and re assured by them they will assist looks like it say network issue but still charged go through. 

Please careful for credit Card as unnecessary it creates issue 

Require make up for hotel rooms are outdated and requiremajor work bathroom tap water for shower was not shutting 

The charges are too High more than my Switzerland 5 starresorts I think this is due to Covid 19 as people are more domestic 

Rafi thank you very much for ur assistance

reviews.author: Venture823410
reviews.title: Ashok
reviews.text:
Exhorbitant in pricing against quality . Not worth for that . 90% staff new & unprofessional . Food very very pricey against quality of food . Resort location is superb . Room size great however lobby is grand but appears haunted with old classic wooden furniture with worn out tapestry & carpets . 

Care to be taken while booking to avoid disappointment . All rooms do not have balcony & May be you get fascinated to see photos of balcony side rooms as displayed but land into a west facing room with out balcony .  Read fine prints while booking . 

Lastly Resort is excellent but poorly maintained & serviced though tariffs are sky high to its popularity

reviews.author: san_flier
reviews.title: Over-rated and expensive, did not live up to its promise
reviews.text: We planned our trip around the room availability of this hotel. Did not realize that they have deals with travel agents, so should book with them rather than hotel directly. Steps all around the property, not good for elderly for people with disabilities, staff very friendly, overcommits but falls short of delivering to the promise. One of the nights, there was a private party with blaring music in the lawns, kept going till almost 11 PM, had to call them to shut down the music, very unprofessional and not an attitude of a luxury hotel.

reviews.author: Gursherbhatia
reviews.title: Roller coaster ride
reviews.text: Well I went there on 19th June 2021 for 2 nights.. it was a horrible experience while booking for this property due to some agents involved but then I had a help from the front desk from Mr. Manzoor and Mr. Muzammil which made it a lot better.. it was a great experience and even had the best house keeping attendant Mr. Rashid Hussain Itoo who gave us the best service all through our stay

reviews.author: Sohil
reviews.title: Over rated Property
reviews.text:
Excellent Location
Good Food
Moderate Rooms. In fact the room mattress is very uncomfortable and gave severe back ache. Informed the Managers but they were unable to do much for resolution.
Not worth the cost that is being charged for the rooms
Rooms décor is heavy and too heritage

reviews.author: Pawan R
reviews.title: Harrasment from local govt authorities
reviews.text:
Police has no mercy on tourist. They made us walk for 1 km from gandola station to hotel. As there were some VIP at hotel. The temperature was -3° and I walked 1 km with my 3 yr old child.
If they have Vip at hotel, will they trouble amd harrash all other occupants and tourists staying at hotel ?
When asked to hotel management they gave flying answers.
This happened with me on 22nd January 2021.
Management shall ask local govt authorities to allow guests vehicles to the hotels. Or you have to walk 1km on steep mountain in very cold temperature.

I also felt hotel is more interested in Vip guests staying with them rather than other citizens

Think before you book.

reviews.author: Sumit_Sarawgi
reviews.title: Mixed Emotions
reviews.text:
This review can be little long.

Khyber is a beautiful dream which you will always like to come true. The same thing happened with me. I got lucky to get a room here during my anniversary.

But, the starting of my trip was little upsetting. A small issue happened which could had been handled more professionally and in a more sincere manner which is expected from a star hotel like Khyber. But I think sometimes, you take it lightly and think you can get away with it. But I had to let it go and compromise as I didn't want to spoily 4 nights stay here. I had asked the reception that I wanted to meet the General Manager just to share my feelings but that never happened. I don't know what it was, ego or miscommunication

Secondly, for two consecutive nights, the hotel has blocked their restaurant "Calabash" for VIPs. This was the place where you can relax and have a great evening time when you have nothing to do in Gulmarg. Just think, guests who had come to stay here for 2 nights had no options to relax anywhere else except the lobby which was packed to the brim. Sorry but it felt like a marketplace there with no service as all the help was busy with the VIPs. This feels wrong when your other restaurant "Nouf" and other facilities like the swimming pool is closed due to covid.

Now the good part. The rooms are excellent and brilliant. The people helping you out in the restaurant and other places always have a smile. Special mention to Mr Raees and Mr Firdos who were commendable. The food here is amazing.

I think I will have to come back to experience the real Khyber which I have heard and dreamt of. Hopefully things change for the better..

reviews.author: gargtwinkle
reviews.title: Hyped property
reviews.text: hotel is not as picturesque as advertised,front office staff is polite but not warm or welcoming,intially  the rooms we were given had horrible view of fence surrounding the property.it was heart breaking to spend so much and land up like this.requested junior staff to change our room,but were told that hotel is fully booked.then after 2 hours we tried again n thanks n few senior guys changed our room ,thankfully.overall the hotel is just hyped ,its definitely not a five star by any standard and not worth the price they are charging

reviews.author: Bob A
reviews.title: Not 5 Star
reviews.text:
The vista from this hotel is exceptional with snow covered peaks from our balcony. And the food at the hotel restaurant during dinner (night) is very good.
But the place is quite dark and dingy and the hot water in the shower in the room wasn’t hot enough. The insulation between rooms is poor as we were annoyed by the constant screaming of a young child next door. The bainne maree food at breakfast times is like many other hotels in India in that it is not served hot and the choices are poor unless you like Indian breads - to make matters worse breakfast is not served until 8.00 am in the morning which is too late for those travelling to new destinations. All in all disappointing for such a lovely and pristine area

reviews.author: Mahomed M
reviews.title: Not a good weekend for me. Selective politeness by front desk and poor restaurant service
reviews.text: For the price we paid we were told we were 'upgraded': don't know what that meant because we didn't get a room with a view and when the heating failed to work, despite 'intensive work' by 3 persons it never really worked properly and I had to wrap myself up with whatever extra warm clothing I had, just to keep warm. At evening tea we were served by a waiter who was obviously not trained in hospitality. Breakfast had a lot of variety but was basic. BTW, doesn't anyone give guests fried eggs? Does it always have to be omelette? The whole experience was unpleasant and so we left soon after breakfast.

reviews.author: Trip400959
reviews.title: Hyped up property
reviews.text:
Always had a different vision of Kashmir and it just puts me off how the tourism is here with the safety and many many things. It's a dirty place though it looks good in pictures one has to really think twice to spend a holiday here. We paid 4000 for each ATV to go to phase 2 gondola as phase 1 was closed  but actualy it was working and they shut it off for the pony rides and atv's as its an additional income. The people here try to rip you off further if you stay in Khyber.

Now the good things about Khyber so far.. they have an amazing view for the rooms with balcony. The food is amazing and yes it is very expensive each dish starts wth 800rs and goes upto 1800 plus. They have a nice indoor heated pool and jaccuzi and a gym. 

Except the view of the room there is nothn much to this property and its fairly small and old decor. Showers have no adjustment to the force of water and its very very hard to take a shower with either too hot or too cold water gushing. We are a group of 10people staying here and we all feel it's just a hyped up property !!!

At the end I feel 5days at Khyber all the excitement i had just fell flat and I shudve taken a holiday elsewhere out of the country.

reviews.author: sanjaychawla740
reviews.title: Location is not that Pictureisque what as shown on the website
reviews.text: Average Hotel especially comppared to the price they charge,high minded staff and ordinary food,had asked for a copy of bill thrice to be sent through the mail but nobody has bothered so far,looks very different from what its shown on the website

reviews.author: HMS
reviews.title: Solid property with service flaws
reviews.text: We stayed 6 nights at Khyber in early March while skiing. The hotel is the most solid and luxurious hotel in Gulmarg. Rooms are sufficiently spacious and have all the usual amenities. The spa, pool and gym area is generous although it can get noisy in the late afternoon. Breakfast and dinner is served buffet style. Food quality and variety is quite satisfying. It could be a 4 star property if the service would match. Staff at reception is polite but if you need something from them you probably have to ask twice or thrice. Housekeeping is also lacking. I wasn't able to get more than 2 small towels throughout our stay despite numerous reminders. Nevertheless, I would likely return to the Khyber as other hotels do not have the same infrastructure.

reviews.author: GyanVerma
reviews.title: Average stay, poor hospitality and over hyped
reviews.text:
I booked my stay through MMT with Booking ID: NH2003371406165
I feel Khyber is an overhyped resort due to absence of the other 5 star resorts in Gulmarg.
Location wise: It is good but what I noticed that you get similar views from other hotels in the Gulmarg also.
Room: Wooden work was nicely done, so rooms are good.
Check-in experience:  It seemed ok however what I despise is the fake accent of people, It does not go well with me anyways no major issues with this.I am thankful they allowed early check-in around 10:30 AM.
Food: Dinner buffet for 2.5K+Taxes was not at all worth , it did not taste well at all.
Breakfast: There was an incident regarding breakfast, the hot milk they were serving had gone bad and none of the staff seemed to notice that, I went to fetch some milk for my daughter and realised it had gone bad, I had brought this issue to their notice but did not get any apology for this oblivion behaviour and suddenly the manager was hard to locate, did not expect this kind of behaviour from so called "5 start resort".
Amenities: Swimming pool was good as generally you would not get swimming pool next to snow or mountains. Full marks in that front.
Checkout: The day we checked out It was our anniversary and I had communicated that at the time of check-in also but nobody cared to wish us. Anyways there was another thing that really made me feel embarrassed and I never got treated this way ever, it goes like this :During checkout the housekeeping guy came in to room to take feedback , I filled the feedback form, At reception while I was settling the bills ,the front office guy “Burhaan” asked me did I take any item from the minibar, “I said No” , so even after me saying No he called somebody and asked him to go and check in the room , this really made me feel bad, I had stayed in many luxury hotels but never ever somebody was so blatant in verifying the minibar items, I am not saying he should not have checked , what I feel is that either he should have done that surreptitiously  or should not have even asked me, When you would like to verify it by sending some person (it is done in lower grade hotels) then do not ask the guest you should do it with secrecy. I suggest Front office to be little careful in these situations anyways apart from this "Burhaan" did ask to give us a complimentary cake at midnight for our Anniversary, which we refused as we were very much tired that day, although I did ask for room decoration which he said would not be possible as they need to be informed 1 week before about this and also it was chargeable 2.5K+takes.

Anyways after average stay at Khyber we checked-in to Vivanta ByTaj-Srinagar and what an awesome treatment and service they had delivered, at least 7-8 staff members had greeted us, gave us complimentary upgrade, cake and nicely decorated our room with flowers and balloons.
I hope soon any other 5 star resort gets opened in Gulmarg, maybe then over hyped Khyber improves their service.
Advice to management: Good resorts/hotels are not only made up with  fancy architecture or building but also with cordial and smart staff also with good service.
Invest in your staff and get them trained well as I felt most of the staff is local and lack global exposure.

reviews.author: shoeman015
reviews.title: Could have been great
reviews.text: A  great building definitely the most luxurious in Gulmarg but it lacks any character. There always seemed to be lots of staff but when you wanted one they were nowhere to be seen. if you wanted something out of the ordinary like a booking for dinner in an alternative location the concierge refused to help. We had already paid for dinner but ate out 3 nights for a bit of a change. Breakfast was very good and the masala dhosa was the best i have had. The spa was good but the pool and steam room looked like they could do with a good clean. Gulmarg was great and the Khyber could have been.

reviews.author: Bhavita C
reviews.title: Not worth of the money
reviews.text:
It is the best property in Gulmarg. But for the money it costs - one expects more. Below average service experience. 

Pros- The property itself is beautiful. Take the Himalayan facing rooms if u can. The swimming pool has awesome views n so does their coffee shop. Location is very close to the cable car starting point. Lots of place to play in the balconies if it snows. Our daughter was not well - they called a doctor promptly who even provided the medicine n we didn’t have to go hunting for it. Appreciate this a lot. 

Cons - Not worth the money if it doesn’t snow. Food is ok. Rooms r ok. Service is average bordering on below average. They didn’t even have snow shoes we could rent / buy to play in snow. When u pay this amount of money - you expect a wow factor in the service which was absent. They were clearly understaffed considering the crowd. 

There was only one staff member in the restaurant named Junaid who always had a smile on his face n would care of all my daughter’s demands. If he was not around - The rest of the staff was too busy to even care forget smile. 

Breakfast was included in our rate. Since we were checking out early we asked for two portions of bread n paratha to be parcelled. But they parcelled only one portion - for a total of 3 people! This when we have paid for a buffet breakfast! Unfortunately we came to know of the less portions only when we opened the packaging to have breakfast at the airport. 

We were staying here for our anniversary. My parents called to ask them to deliver a cake for us. The hotel had assured them they would. When we reached here we were asked when we wanted the cake. We told them. But the cake never came. Not a single person bothered to wish us. This when we told them we r staying for our anniversary and my parents had specially booked a cake. 

As I said if u pay a freaking 33k per night for a room - you expect more. This is not 5 star service experience. 

Overall not worth the money.

reviews.author: Aditi1613
reviews.title: Beautiful Property but poor hospitality
reviews.text:
Pros: 
Extremely Beautiful property
Great View
Covered with Snow in winters
Warm water pool with great view  (it is maintained at 28-10 degree Temp)
Food is ok
They even gave 1 room for early checkin (we booked 2 rooms)

Cons:
Poor in terms of hospitability

They charged us for a mini bar item that we did not use, it was barely priced at 60 Rs, we told them that we did not eat it, so they kept enquiring about it like CID for a 60 Rupee item, nevertheless we asked them to keep the change, this reflected bad hospitality 

Our driver got stuck 3 km from the resort, we asked them to provide cab to that point to which they refused stating various reasons, like unavailability of cabs (how is that even possible) etc etc we got really worried coz we had a flight to catch

this left bad taste while leaving the property

reviews.author: Sachin G
reviews.title: Food not good
reviews.text: Very nice resort &rooms but food quality is very poor   doesn't have taste in any of it's dishes ....tried North Indian food which was absolutely tasteless ...even the breads were not freshly served...stayed for 3days from 4th Jan 2018 to 7th Jan 2018 ...didn't find the perfect taste in d food in all the 3days ...our 3 days stay made me realize that the restaurant is comparatively smaller keeping in mind the resort ..we tried dal makhni, Yellow dal, Hari mirch paneer, kashmiri dum aloo , methi paneer makhni , & kashmiri lotus stem ...all below average ..also the breakfast buffet was pathetic .

reviews.author: Praneet
reviews.title: Not worth the price, not value for money
reviews.text:
Sure the property is beautiful, no doubt about that. We paid roughly INR 16000 per night for the premium deluxe room (lowest category) inclusive wifi, breakfast and taxes. We stayed at Khyber for 2 nights. In terms of the way it is made, the property is really good.

The view from the hotel from every angle is great. The cafe is a good place to hangout as they serve shisha (starting INR 600) and allow you to sit with your own bottle. The spa here costs about INR 3900+taxes which will go upto almost 5000 per person. Dinner buffet prices are INR 2500+taxes. The breakfast spread was good. We only ordered an appetizer once. Dishes generally cost INR 700-1000 per item + taxes.

What we did not like were 2 things, 1. the negligent service towards guests and 2. the differentiation between the room categories.

The heated indoor pool with the amazing view was not actually heated to the right temperature. We complained both the days at the pool reception and at the main reception. There were other guests also who we spoke to, who had the same issue. Both days, we changed, got in and immediately got out feeling cold. The water was not cold, but it was not even warm. It was just moderate and the outside temperature was rather cold so overall, it was not comfortable being there. It was supposed to be a heated pool. The person came and manually checked the temperature to be 29 degrees, but it was really not even lukewarm, honestly. Hence, this for us was a complete waste, both the days. It was practically the only amenity which we could have enjoyed free of cost.

Ours was a premium deluxe room. The other 2 upper category rooms are the Luxury Gulmarg view and Luxury Himalayan view. Both these upper categories have balconies. The differentiation we did not like was the interiors in the premium room, where we stayed. It was very blah and not really made up to the mark. It does not give you a feel of any luxury at all having spent INR 16000 per night on it. It's a very basic room which otherwise in 5 star hotels would cost around INR 6000-8000, very ordinary interiors. What we very much disliked was that, these premium rooms are in a separate wing which is not centrally heated. Both the upper category rooms are in the same wing (away from the premium rooms) and that wing is completely centrally heated. We complained about this as well to the front desk, but they did nothing for it, at least in our 2 day period.

Overall, we had a very dissatisfying experience at Khyber and understood and realised well that only if you opt for the higher category luxury rooms, will you really enjoy the property and feel worth for the money you paid. Cannot comment on the massages as we did not take them. Swimming pool for us was a disappointment with the temperature not being actually 'heated'.

reviews.author: Sukhmani W
reviews.title: Love the place but faced a few issues this time
reviews.text:
My husband and I love Khyber. We came here for our first anniversary two years ago and thought it best to be back here for our third. However, this time we faced a few issues with the hotel. 

The AC in our room stopped working at 3am and while we could’ve called someone about it, the thought didn’t strike us at that time of the night. So we had to open the door and sleep to reduce the stuffiness in the room. 

The food was strictly average as well. In fact, something reacted with me and I had a tough time the whole day after the dinner. The food was much better on our first trip here. 

But not all was bad. They surprised us with a cake for our anniversary and made sure we got a room with a fantastic view. 

The facilities are still quite amazing in the hotel including the spa. 

Best visited when it snows.

reviews.author: PGHG
reviews.title: Over-hyped!! Overall not bad, but left wondering why did we pay so much for this experience
reviews.text:
It is a nice place, but for a luxury hotel, we were truly left wanting more. 

We had gone there for a short break in search of peace and quiet. So we took a Mountain view room with a balcony, the best room possible. The room had broadly the things one would expect in a good hotel, but then the bed was two small for two of us, mattress too soft and the duvet just about adequate. We stayed there for 3 nights of bad sleep. Seating inside the room was not quite comfortable.

Rooms are on two sides of a long corridor, and the corridor appeared a bit dark. Rooms are not sound proof and one could hear loud voices all through the day, and that disturbed the afternoon siesta. Very little open spaces to roam around inside the hotel, especially given that there is nothing outside of the hotel in Gulmarg. The limited seating area was just too noisy with two large groups with children talking very loudly, littering here and there, and making too much of ruckus. Unfortunately none from the hotel requested them to conduct themselves otherwise.

Hotel allows two devices per room for free connectivity. That in itself is too little in today's connected world. But even allowing for that, you can't even disconnect a device and connect another. So it's not 'two devices at a time'. It's only 'the first two devices that you connect after checking in'. To be fair, they did allow me to connect another device free of charge, but that needed me to speak to the manager in charge.

Food is very good though and the service very courteous. Spa was another highlight. Really liked the message there.

On the whole, while we truly enjoyed the view, the food, and the spa, were left wondering did we make go for the best option for our 3 days short break, especially for the very high price we paid.

reviews.author: arenski
reviews.title: A mixed feeling - AGAIN
reviews.text:
Stayed with family during the week of Holi for 5 nights for a ski holiday.
Visited last year during the same time as well.
Nothing has changed from our last visit.
Getting to and fro to the hotel is a nightmare! After a long day of skiing this is extremely stressful.
The ski storage room has been made much smaller than the previous year.
Service still seems to be very hit and miss.
i doubt if the food served at the buffet is freshly made. the fruits on display at the buffet looks very good but one bite and you know its just frozen fruit which is being served again. Similarly, most of the food just didnt taste right. Maybe it must have been frozen and de-frozen on a number of occasions. Our two kids and myself threw up one evening on the dinner table. 3 days after eating the buffet we decided to order from the menu and paid the high rates. we requested them to prepare the meals fresh and finally we got something decent to eat.
The reason for our repeat visit is that there is no other hotel in Gulmarg with so much space. it is a beautiful set-up.
Unless the oberoi comes up soon.. we have no option but to visit this place for our annual ski trip. the owners are aware of this.
The normal routine revert will be given by the manager once this is posted asking me why i did not bring up these topics during my stay.
Sir, getting to and fro to the hotel - spoke to so many people about this. Front Desk, lobby manager and also to the people who wear long black coats and suited and are always hanging around near the reception area. None of them could give any answer.
With regards to the food - Time and again spoke to the person who manages the buffet.. The only response we got was that the food is freshly prepared and that they are sorry that we did not like the buffet spread or it was not upto our expectations. Finally, we ordered a-la carte and pai for the meals.
We also brought up the topic of hearing of TV from the next room. This happened last year and this year as well. We were politely told that they cannot change the structure of the rooms.
The hotel was at 35% occupancy utmost, but they kept mentioning that they are sold out whenever we requested for a change of rooms.
Owners, please improve your service before its too late. i hear the Oberoi will be functional in a years time!

reviews.author: Razoski
reviews.title: Beautiful Hotel Ruined by Bad Service
reviews.text: The hotel is outstanding, with great facilities and an incomparable view of the mountains. The decor is tastefully done up. The big let down is the service. From room service to the cafeteria to the kids room, everything requires multiple reminders and follow-ups from guests. Else the staff just doesn't seem bothered. This is in stark contrast to the warm service you would receive from almost ANY other hotel in Gulmarg. A big tragedy - so much potential ruined by apathetic staff. I  did fill up a feedback form, but am almost sure it would never reach the proper people.

reviews.author: Tara M
reviews.title: Decent stay for a luxury hotel
reviews.text: Best part of the hotel - the heated pool and spa. The breakfast was average, the a la Carter menu was good only if you orders the Indian food. Stay away from the pizzas. The rooms are centrally heated so at times it would get really hot and stuffy. The room service menu was highly overpriced hence I suggest you eat in the restaurant. The staff and service was below average. If it wasn't for the spa and pool the rating would have been far lower.

reviews.author: rathi_star
reviews.title: Best place with poor management
reviews.text:
We booked 3 room as we r 3 couple with kids . They alloted rooms 6001 , 6002 n 6004.
 1. which r far 4m all amenities as we r with children they have no sense of it. 
2. In Egloo  (play area) they cannot afford  360 box cd  , as we stayed 3 day and done wonderfull  billing but in many request management have machine answer. They r fail to maintain it.
3. Sofa of 2 rooms is damaged .
4. Very slow services in restaurant. 
5. Poor staff training 
6.plz keep surprise audit with mistry guests  (for owners)

reviews.author: Priteshdel
reviews.title: Property is Good , Claimed 5 Star , but servicing below average
reviews.text:
WE have visited Gulmarg and stayed in Khyber for 2 nights. The Property is good, ambiance and surrounding is fabulous but when it come to the servicing is is below average. The price what they charge is so high and very expensive as compare to similar properties in any other (other then J&K) , they Claim they are 5 star but the quality of Servicing Housekeeping, F&B , in room dining, Front office is below average.
And worst part  is no one is bothered about this. I have already told the Front office of the hotel about my feedback, but i dont think they are bothered..

The quality of food is also average and worst part they dont have items to serve , which they have in there menu card and in in room dining .'

I have to think twice now  before I book this property for my next trip to Gulmarg, in coming winters.

reviews.author: HIMALAYAS0904
reviews.title: LUXURY IN THE LAP OF HIMALAYAS
reviews.text:
Luxury in the lap of Himalayas
 
We visited Khyber during may end 2015 with two young kids. The check in was pretty smooth but It took about 20 minutes till when we were asked the sit in the lobby which has nice views of the snow capped mountains .Since the entire hotel  is centrally airconditioned except for a few areas hence one doesn’t feel the chill of gulmarg once inside. Since we all were very tired hence the checkin executive offered to discuss things in the room itself.The balcony was simply amazing with the best views one can have of the Himalayas in any resort in the hills.the luxury himalayan view room was what we expected it to be , quite nicely decorated with touches of Kashmir yet modern overall with a sunken bath with a huge window offering the snow capped mountain view.We were given the traditional kashmiri tea called the kawah which was nice.However, thereafter there was no voluntary interaction from the management to help the guests chalk out their stay plan .The kids play room was quite a disappointment as the only thing good was  the xbox and table tennis which we could not play both the times we visited the playroom as it was preoccupied by another family both times. I was also expecting some swings and slides and hammocks in the outdoors but found none .
The swimming pool was one high point during the stay as we all enjoyed it a lot but the tiles need a lot of maintenance as my daughter cut her foot with the small broken tiles . The attendant was prompt enough to get the first aid kit and tried to help my daughter . We then requested the staff to ensure repair of the broken tiles as anybody could get hurt and we ourselves were walking cautiously thereafter in the pool as we found many broken small pieces on the pool floor. The kids pool was nice and my son enjoyed it a lot.however the walk from the pool the the rooms is very long and cold as the entire passage is not heated .
The snack menu and the main menu both have very limited choice and need more variety.The staff otherwise courteous was reluctant to warm the amul taaza I was carrying the for kids and infact one of them advised to heat it in the room in the water kettle and the  kettle got spoilt because of this wrong advice.The staff was not very quick in clearing the mess and I had to pitch in to help them.
On the day of check out we had to check out early as our flight was at 10.30 am from Srinagar , hence we requested the staff to pack some breakfast stuff from the buffet breakfast but they were very reluctant and said that there will be extra charges on the sameFurther , no one from the hotel is there to inform you on the Srinagar traffic on weekdays and we got stuck for an hour in the traffic jam and missed our flight. 
Overall the hotel scores high on the location but needs to work towards making the stay more memorable by offering to help  guests plan their days in gulmarg and also be more helpful and supportive as is expected of any five star like TAJ or Oberois.

reviews.author: kochhardelhi
reviews.title: Good hotel with average views and service
reviews.text: khyber gulmarg is new resort hotel in quaint lol town of Gulmarg. The hotel is nicely made with local kashmiri architecture and memrobilia. What lacks in khyber is open views of gulmarg bowl and average service. The service is slow snd sluggish and even running orders take them good 35/40 minutes to deliver. At the charges you are paying this kind of service is totally unacceptable. We went for meal to Highlands park and really liked the gulmarg valley views from their lounge.

reviews.author: sangeetakarwall
reviews.title: Arrogant staff
reviews.text: Khyber Gulmarg no doubt is a good new hotel in Gulmarg but what takes away the charm of the place is its arrogant staff. To start with the reception and dinning staff only care about large groups and totally neglect FIT customers, one has to wait in dinning till they serve large groups making you wonder as if you haven't paid to enough to get similar treatment. The house keeping staff is also not attentive and calous in their attitude. Don't expect this kind of service after paying through your nose.

reviews.author: Karishma88
reviews.title: Service needs a major overhaul!
reviews.text:
Stayed here for 2 nights.

Positives:
1. Good location - Close to main attraction (Phase 1 and 2/Gondola ride) and great view of snow capped mountains
2. Spacious rooms and good amenities
3. Good spa experience 
4. Beautiful pool
5. Amazing breakfast spread

Negatives:
1. Wifi is on chargeable basis. Even their main competitor Hotel Highlands provides free wifi!
2. Service is very slow. Took them ages to clear the used dishes we placed outside our room. Took them ages to send someone over to collect the luggage for check out. The receptionist hung up on us abruptly in the middle of an enquiry. They were aware that an elderly person was travelling with us but still gave us rooms in the far end of the hotel which were quite a walk from the main lobby and 2 floors at the bottom! This was a major inconvenience.
3. The women's jacuzzi looked worn out with a big rusted nail lying loose in the tub and parts of the surface peeling out. 
4. The pool area is beautiful no doubt, but a huge piece of shattered glass remained on the glass wall just above the pool. This is a major hazard and it only takes a small bird or a twig or a huge gush of wind to send it crashing down and seriously injure someone in the area. 
5. The restaurants are terribly overpriced.

When we pay so much for our stay, we expect good service. It is for these reasons that Khyber was not our most preferred hotel during our entire trip to Kashmir, although it was the most expensive!

reviews.author: MD-qwerty
reviews.title: Great views, but leaves a lot to be desired. Not luxurious....
reviews.text:
Awesome location, Lovely views.
But for the price, not worth it.
No free wifi.

There is a general sense of stuffiness in the entire hotel. Many places you feel that you can smell sh**. Suddenly from somewhere you can smell this funny thing. It is all prevalent. From the toilets in rooms, to the lobbies, in the spa, everywhere.

The rooms are smallish. But well appointed. Again circulation of fresh air is not there. We had to keep the windows open, but at same time, close it every some while, because it got too cold.

The hotel has only one restaurant, and it gets really crowded. While service was very good, the food taste left a lot yo be desired. The hotel needs multiple dining options and definitely needs more covers. 

I think hotel realizes this and has placed about 15 covers just outside the restaurant to manage this, but 
A. It feels like you are eating on the street.
B. There is no service here.

The spa-pool area, also needs changes.
The swimming pool water looked dirty. I am not sure whether it looks dirty or is it actually dirty. But inspite of excellent setting, I didn't want to go in because of this.

The Spa by L'Occitane was ok. The area did not give a feeling of occasion. The room decor was not luxurious. The steam was not working properly inspite of changing the room.
While the massage itself was good, again the feeling of luxury was absent.

reviews.author: jitendram2014
reviews.title: Beautiful Hotel, Service is Mediocre
reviews.text:
We stayed for a Night at Khyber after hearing very good things about the place. The Hotel is located at one of the best spots offering beautiful view of Mountain clad with snow, There is snow in the property also
Service: Very mediocre considering the overall offering, Five star positioning and the cost. 
Cost: The cost is very high for the services. The Menu is heavily overpriced.
Location: Beautiful. 
Food Options: Good options for food. There are interesting options like a dedicated Cigar Bar and a Chai Bar.

A better service and a fair pricing would definitely move it a notch up

reviews.author: SherryMerchant
reviews.title: Nice hotel poor service
reviews.text:
Lovely location and views from the room, lovely rooms. Large and comfortable. Staff generally very nice and try to please but we found the service a bit sloppy: first night we reached the restaurant just before the last order time and by the time we were shown the table and given menus it was 4 minutes past. We were told the cook had left. Later we discovered that two staff wanted to leave so we were asked to eat the buffet I stared at a discount. After making some noise, we them were served dinner but a bit of a sour taste. Next day at breakfast we were refused brown toast because it was over. In a top class hotel? After noise was provided to us. This was random few staff, others generally good. Other thing is that in the room they are miserly with tea and sugar and mild, also I could not understand having cups and no saucers in the room.
The cost of two regular rooms gets you a two bedroom villa that has an extra maids room and kitchenette and extra loo, so actually five people can sleep comfortably. Just a tip.
On the down side, passages are chilly, not heated so that's not very comfortable. Service not as good as you expect for that kind of hotel. No free wifi at such a high room rate is unacceptable.

reviews.author: Rajiv M
reviews.title: Less than advertised
reviews.text: It's the best hotel in the area. However, not close to a 5 star. The food is average. The service tries but needs more training. The spa is good but it is too far from the rooms.  The buildings are drafty and the room gets cold. I'm not likely to come back.

reviews.author: arenski
reviews.title: A mixed feeling
reviews.text:
We booked our rooms 6 months in advance through the hotel portal. You maybe surprised as the moment you put in your credit card details it will charge your card immediately without asking your pin or any other details. Looked like a off shore account transaction. Scary for a moment.
We traveled in a large group during the 3rd week of March. Its during this time Gulmarg received the highest snowfall of the season. The result was the drive way to the Khyber had snow and cars could not travel up or down resulting in a nightmare to get to the hotel.
We took nearly 2 hours to reach the hotel from the bottom of the drive way. It was very chaotic and Khyber management had no clue as a large number of guests were stuck down. Calls to the hotel would just end up to an answering machine.
We finally walked up with young children and there was no one at the door to greet us. We had to beg the reception to send a car down to pick other guests and our baggage. Overall it was total CHAOS.

Once in the room, we had to wait for an hour for our bags to arrive.

Without doubt the resort is very well located and is very picturesque. The rooms are comfortable and ours had a very good view of the valley.

We were on a 5 day ski holiday. However, we wasted more than an hour everyday to get our ski's etc. from the storage room. Our gear was marked but yet its a task finding your gear.
The major let down was the task to get to and fro Khyber. Most of the taxis would not make the journey up the slope and the hotel cars were not allowed to drop the guests to baby slope. Often cars would get stuck in the narrow drive way and there would be a massive jam. Every day we were fleeced just to go up and down the drive way. Anything from Rs. 600 - 1000 per ride per car. ATV's would charge anything around 600 from the bottom of the hill.
After a long day on the slopes it was a let down to deal with this on a daily basis.
The hotel concierge has no answer or a way out of this. They said they were having issues with the taxi union of Gulmarg and they could not help it. Also, they did not have enough cars incase you wanted to hire a hotel car for the day.

The room was very comfortable. However, the wall where the TV console is placed is made up of  particle board. The adjacent room's TV console is on the same wall as ours. It means that one could very clearly hear TV from the adjoining room. How BIZZARE!!! We would retire to bed early but could not sleep as the TV in the adjoining room would not shut till late in the night. We checked this in all our rooms and it was the same story. Every evening we had to politely ask the hotel staff to ask our neighbours to reduce the TV volume.

The food is decent but the buffet breakfast is pretty average.

The heated swimming pool and jacuzzi is super. We were warned about some tiles being chipped in the pool. 

Its a mixed feeling for us as the resort is beautiful and the rooms are comfortable but there is a lot of stress related with the stay. We are unsure if we will stay again unless there is a huge improvement. 

As of now we are left disappointed!

reviews.author: Michael C
reviews.title: Expensive
reviews.text:
Khyber is a nice resort, but not worth the money.
We booked directly for 3 persons, accepted the rate, but when we arrived we were told we had to pay additional 3000 rs for extra bed as the rate was only for double room even I think we already had paid enough.
We raised it to the reservation manager, but no help here.
Our room on the ground floor was extreme noisy, both from the neighbouring room as well from the corridor, so we contacted the reception first day, but they weren't able to help. Same the next day after very limited sleep, but were again told, they had only a small basement room available, which would be too small for 3 of us.
3rd day, we were pretty tired after 2 nights with little sleep, we asked to meet the Hotel Manager. He wasn't available, but would come in later. 
Eventually we met, and he was fully aware about the problem with noise in the rooms as so many are complaining !!
He would try to sort something out. Which he actually did later in the evening, so we shifted to a 2nd floor room.
Food is basic indian, taste fine, but not exciting,  not up to 4 or 5 * standard.
