Not cheap :say 950 rs for a Club sandwich., but when you stay at khyber, you better be prepared to pay for everything : bed 3000 rs, soft drink 250 rs., tea and cake 650 rs, internet 750 rs per day, all plus taxes 
The 500 meter taxi ride down or up the steep hill side to the road from the hotel can be negotiated down to 3-400 rs.  
 .

reviews.author: Ashir
reviews.title: Short stay
reviews.text: We visited Khyber recently. We were there for one night. Superb hotel, nice interiors and surrounded by snow. Can't get better than this. But once we checked in the difference between taj n Khyber started. No warm welcome. The room 6003 were we stayed didn't have hot water it had only warm water. With -7 degrees outside and paying almost 24 k per night without food u at least expect hot water 24 hrs. After complaining thrice nothing happened. Even in breakfast while I was still having food they rudely closed all the counters even without informing. Inshort they have that attitude that in gulmarg it's their monopoly. Whether u are satisfied or not u have to stay there. Beautiful hotel no doubt about it.

reviews.author: BombayNomad
reviews.title: Lot of potential. Major improvements needed.
reviews.text:
When you enter the hotel, you are in awe of the architecture, design and the views. Unparalleled, I should say. Rooms are brilliant. Swimming pool and spa area are astounding. 

But the hotel lacks Kashmiri hospitality and warmth. Food is average and overpriced. Breakfast, though, is really nice. In some ways, it lacks soul. Too 5 star-ish for my liking. 

Stayed there for 3 nights during honeymoon. Glad we chose it. With the corrections suggested, this could be among the best hotels in India.

reviews.author: doshiketan
reviews.title: "FIVE STAR HOTEL WITHOUT HOSPITALITY"
reviews.text:
Stayed at khyber from 5 to 9 feb with my son. My bad experience started even before i checked in. After booking long back, i tried to contact them by telephone atleast 30-40 times for requesting twin bed room but either no one picks up phone or line is busy or told to wait n then line gets disconnected . Finally i wrote mail request n then instead of checking content of mail, i was sent quote for room rate so again i sent mail informing that i already have booking n i need twin bed room. Then i got very rude reply .
At the time of check in i told mr Bilal that i had sent mail for twin bed room n he said he doesn't have any information about my request but kindly agreed for providing extra bed but it was very uncomfortable n I couldn't sleep for first two nights .
Check in was done at counter itself instead of lounge n no welcome drink was provided to us for reasons unknown to us. 
After reaching room waited a long for my bags to arrive but after many calls also it didn't arrived n finally i told them that i m coming to reception personally n then it came after more than an hour .
Same day went to spa n was given locker key which was already occupied by someone else n had to change the keys. 
Next day morning while at breakfast table no one was ready to attend for tea/coffee n finally caught hold of one of the server n got tea.
Next day room was cleaned but tea cups were not changed n replenishment was not done. Called housekeeping many times but it didn't came.as a last resort went to reception n talked to Mr.Manzoor informing about all above mentioned problem n still after reaching room nothing happened inspite of promise made by mr Manzoor, finally shouted at housekeeping n then cups n tea replenishment came .  
Next day evening when returned to room, electronic key was not working so opened room with the help of housekeeping staff n then requested him to replace key but it didn't came for hour. Called reception still it didn't came n then again went to reception n fortunately met Mr.Sujith Herbert GM of property n explained him all above facts. Things turn around after talking to Mr Sujith . He is the man n Mr.Shyam from restaurant because of whom i rated khyber 3 stars otherwise i would have given them 1 star rating only. As a very kind gesture mr Sujith offered us complimentary dinner n also took very special care even at the time of check out by sending bell boy immediately n confirming if all luggage came or not?
Same day morning at breakfast table after ordering tea/coffee three times to different servers it didn't came n finally when it came only coffee was served n again v had to talked to manager on duty n then it came properly.
Apart from above issues, cleanliness of general area needs lot of improvement.
As far as rooms are concerned, its well done with very good view. Also their spa/swimming pool was best amongst all hotels i have visited world over. 
Overall its very good property but needs more people like Mr Sujith /shyam to run it better to meet expectations of any five star grade hotel.

reviews.author: akhilbhansali
reviews.title: Amazing location, good service average food
reviews.text: This resort is an amazing place for family outing. Right in the heart of Gulmarg. Very good view. The food however seems to be very average and expensive. The indoor pool seems to be an unique feature which is hard to find in a place with -4 C temp. Hot water is available round the clock, you will know the importance of this when you compare this feature to the other hotels in Kashmir. I enjoyed my stay there. Better food could have made the trip five star.

reviews.author: Idris E
reviews.title: Not upto the expectation.
reviews.text:
I have nothing new to add as my experience was more or less same on the line of other reviews rating the experience terrible,poor or average. Just one heads up to all going for premier rooms. 
1. Avoid Odd no rooms.(View sucks, I had a nice car parking view. needless to say curtain remained shut all the time)
2 Avoid corner rooms near the staircase. you will be unwilling party to every conversation other guests walking past by are having(rooms are not sound proof)
3. Don't go for the non refundable payment option. keep your options open if you don't like the allotted room.

Positives.

1.Excellent room service.
2. Excellent Dining area with beautiful view.
3. Beautiful Beautiful Beautiful property.

I just wish that front office staff was less condescending, subtly rude. 
I did feel that had I gone for more expensive room, I would have been treated better.
but it is not that horrible either. Just stand up for yourself & don't get intimidated. 

Tips for other traverllers.

1. In house restaurant is expensive so go for  plan inclusive of breakfast & Dinner.
2. Don't go for non refundable payment option, you end up saving some money but you are left with no option if you do not like the allotted room.
3. If you have booked premier room, go for even numbered rooms. they have better view.
4. Incoming calls  in your rooms fixed line are allowed don't trust the front office guy who introduces & welcomes you to the property. and tells you otherwise.

reviews.author: ploytenkate
reviews.title: Hotel with a view
reviews.text:
Khyber arguably offers the best view of the Himalayas among hotels in Gulmarg. The property is centrally located with a few steps away from a Gondola ride, shops and ski slopes. 

We just came back from a three-night stay in February which is also one of the busiest months for Gulmarg. Indians and foreigners staying here mostly come to ski or snowboard. 

You can book a hotel car pickup from the Srinagar airport for 4,000 Rupees and it would take you 1.5 hours to get to the hotel. Local cars, however, are cheaper.

Upsides:

1.) Loccitane Spa is a must. Lives up to its name. Would recommend its Signature Lemon Balm massage. Treat yourself for 90 minutes after a long-day of skiing or walking up and down the hills.

2.) Heated swimming pool, fitness and wellness facility: The mountain view from the pool is stunning. The fitness is well-equipped w/ treadmills and weights. The locker room has well-maintained sauna, steam rooms and jacuzzis. The staff is polite.

3.) Rooms offer great views and spacious.

4.) Most of the staff (the spa, the fitness and an IT lady) are responsive and polite.

Downsides:

1.) The Internet here is chargeable at 750
Rupee/day with relatively slow speed and frequent disruptions.

2.) No shuttles or golf carts available from the hotel going up and down to the main road. This makes it inconvenient for the guest, especially the elders or tiring skiers. Be prepared to walk up and down yourself.

3.) Empty minibar. Or the staff failed to stock it up otherwise.

4.) Unreliable power system. Frequent blackout.

5.) We enjoyed local Indian food but international menu isn't quite up to par. The breakfast spread was ok but served Nescafé (not freshly brewed coffee until we asked for new ones). Room service needs improvement with slow pre- and post- services. Certain food on the menu can't be ordered until after 7.30 pm. 

6.) Amenities aren't quite 5-star standards. No shaving cream. No qtips.

7.) No information from staff about the gondola or ski shops. They basically refer you to touts outside the hotel.

reviews.author: binalv
reviews.title: Overrated
reviews.text:
Only 2 thing which is good.. comfort stay and scenic beauty. Except these two it's OVERRATED. Services and food is pathetic. In buffet as well as in room service they serve ice cold food and when you complaint they don't even bother to rectify or apologise.
There's not a single service which u can say is 5 star quality whether you take in room dining or housekeeping or laundry service or any service.
There are few staff to whom if you tell that this is the mistake instead of accepting they keep on arguing unless you shut up or complaint to manager.
A big disappointment.

reviews.author: SKM
reviews.title: Highly overrated
reviews.text:
I would have rated the property poor if not for the scenic setting and the property itself... Service and Food @TheKhyber were a disappointment especially at the price tag it comes with. When every request is first met with a 'no' it does get a little frustrating. Food was insipid at best! If not for the stunning views from the hotel and the well kept property there wouldn't have been much to redeem the property. Recommend the Himalayan view luxury rooms for their brilliant view.

Keep in mind Gulmarg is a dry city and you may want to byob as there's nothing available nearby - a fact you won't hear a whisper of till you get there :)

reviews.author: srldelhi
reviews.title: Views not as good as Highlands park
reviews.text: We stayed in mid june in khyber gulmarg. The hotel is quite new with good rooms and facilities but iam afaid the views from the hotel are not as good as highlands park where we had stayed during our last visit. khyber does not offer open views to gulmarg but i believe it would be much better in winters as it is close to gandola lifts.

reviews.author: runumehtakesarker
reviews.title: Lovely hotel with bad service
reviews.text: A beautiful hotel property in gulmarg ! Good rooms , though we did not get a room with a ovine of the snow capped mountains . Bad service in terms of food . For an ala crate we were served food one very late , two cold food . They can up their service to make it a brilliant experience . Also paid wifi hurts !!

reviews.author: neerajhardik
reviews.title: Good hotel limited views
reviews.text: Khyber resorts Gulmarg is a recently opened good hotel with modern facilities however the views from the hotels are very limited. The hotel does not open up to views of Gulmarg bowl. We went to highlands park and founds the views to be much better. Overall average because of limited views.

reviews.author: jaiswal2015
reviews.title: Hotel is average
reviews.text: we visited this place in winter this year our main motive was to ski from the the peak of affarwat only problem we faced was heating system in hotel was not working peoperly otherwise food is gud , rooms are nice ...

reviews.author: MeghaMawandia
reviews.title: mixed bag.. read carefully
reviews.text:
Rooms and location is fantastic. However there are lots of stairs! There are stairs to go to rooms to go to the lawns along each layer of lawn. When we asked them for a ball to play in the lawn they said the lawns were not for children. Only place children to play was a closed room with no windows called the igloo. I don’t fancy the idea of taking my children to a beautiful location like Gulmarg and cooping them in a  room to play the xbox. To cap it the ‘Igloo’ was 2 stories down with the toilet- you guessed it 2 stories up! 
Their famed heated pool decked with bisazza tiles had tiles popping off and their changing room was wet and worse then a roadside toilet.

All this apart, the food was excellent! Their chef is adept at Italian as well as Indian and their service staff is courteous and polite. I would go again but restrict myself to the rooms and the restaurants.

reviews.author: Nareshjindal
reviews.title: Good hotel, good location but bad in services
reviews.text: Hotel location superb, rooms and facilities excellent but when it comes to services, they are not good. Any order on room service may take even 2-3 hours usually. House keeping staff still more worse in their behavior.   At time of checkout, i informed the reception at 9:45 am but luggage didn't come down even by 11 am.

reviews.author: Umang D
reviews.title: too good, over priced
reviews.text:
The stay and property is first class, you cannot get a better stay in whole state
Over prriced thats the only problem, but as i said, its the number one, so price is high

one star less because in our stay of 4 nights, temperature controlled swimming pool was under maintenance and as its almost like a dry state, no liquor the serve, but its officially to carry our own drinks and enjoy it anywhere in the club

view is just too good , had visited in full snow climate all side. 
Wifi is too expensive

saw one fight between a customer and management due to some swimming tile broken issue,
no apologies from the management, and they were not at all kind in replying, the customer said i dont like your attitude to response in complain, i think i would check out, the management guys instead of stopping and calming things down, said ok sir, should i start your billing , and as soon as the guest turned over, they started laughing amongst, worst thing expected from a hotel of this level and beauty. 
must visit

reviews.author: samirtrip
reviews.title: overhyped resort in the hands of unprofessional managers
reviews.text:
Khyber is a good property given its location and decent size. There aren't better option in and around Gulmarg either. However, it does lack the quality levels of other bigger players like Taj Vivanta and Lalit in Srinagar.

The worst experience I had was about its non-transparent policy. We had booked our rooms online through hotel about 45 days in advance and we were offered Rs. 21,000 for their premier category on EP which we found was being offered at Rs.19,000 by the hotel. When we inquired about this, one of the managers at the reception suggested we must book through a travel agent in order to get  the discount. The other said the hotel changes rates daily. They had no justification for the variation and were only trying to avoid the conversation. The desk manager was unfriendly and uncooperative. 

Moreover, considering the tariff the rooms were too small and stinking. For someone who  does not want to go hiking/skiing or do any outdoor activities there is no point in staying at Gulmarg and/or Khyber. If one is only interested in experiencing the Gondola ride and visit the highest point, it is better to make a day trip from Srinagar which has better hotels and packages than Khyber for sure. Both Vivanta and Lalit are a lot better options than Khyber. It would be criminal to spend more than Vivanta at Khyber.

Even while visiting the level 1 & 2 by Gondola, be careful about the full on cheating by the ski taxies (They transfer you to a short distance 400/500 mtrs on ski) which demand absurd amounts like Rs. 4000 per person. It is not worth spending more than Rs. 400 (four hundred). They try hard to scare you by talking about the adversities of the place, but one can easily walk down this distance. Please do not spend more than Rs. 500 on ski transfers.

reviews.author: A.k
reviews.title: Great property, but lacks personalised service.
reviews.text:
Brilliant property in a brilliant  location...has every comfort imaginable...and a fantastic spa. However, the hotel lacks personal touch that you find in most other five star hotels.

Sample this...  due to certain dietary restrictions we asked to speak with the chef (in the only restaurant that they have). We were told that he was too busy to even come out for 2 minutes. We asked again as the waiter could not understand our requirements. Again the same reply... 
I've made similar requests in most other hotels, and have never been refused! In fact, the chefs are usually really understanding and eager to cook something that I can eat. And of course, the waiters are better trained!

When I pay 18,000 for a hotel room, and upwards of 3000 per meal, I surely expect more personalised service, especially when it's related to dietary restrictions. 

May I add that the food in their only restaurant is fairly average and needs improvement and the dinner buffet is quite unpalatable.

reviews.author: Komalika
reviews.title: Something's don't stay the same
reviews.text: Last year we visited Khyber at the same time and had the most beautiful experience,not only because of the view and the gorgeousness of the place but more so because of the hospitality of the people in the hotel!!! The warmth with which the staff used to meet us everyday was more than over whelming !!! The general manager than was Mr Aditya and he made sure everyone there was made to feel at home!!! What warmth affection and care he showed for every single person in the hotel was unbelievable but unfortunately this time it didn't feel the same!!! Mr Aditya was not working with them anymore and I believe the management had changed and nthg felt the same it was all about talking business!!! It was a sad feeling to see such a huge difference in just one year!!! Right in between the mountains the feeling of being at home was lost and that's what u need in a place like that but unfortunately that couldn't be retained by them!!! I'm sure everyone who's been there before would know the difference I'm talking about.. That one man was the pillar of the hotel is what we realised on our this visit as his absence shook the entire effect around the full place!!!

reviews.author: Shilpa N
reviews.title: Great property but at an exorbitant price & very unprofessional front desk staff
reviews.text:
Our bad experience with the Khyber service started even before we reached. Booked this place through booking.com but got a message closer to our stay saying that there was some issue with the card details. I contacted one Mr Mashood from the hotel and he suggested I either use another card or do a bank transfer. I confirmed on email that I shall execute the transfer from my bank acc and promptly did the bank transfer the same day. In a few days I get a message from booking.com saying the transaction has failed and my booking stands cancelled. On contacting Mr Mashood again, he arrogantly replied that I did not email the transaction details post the transaction, hence the booking stands cancelled. If the transaction details were required, couldn't Mr Mashood do a quick call back post my confirmation email and ask for the same? Anyway, here's what he had to say: "you are lucky there is a room still available. Send me the details soon now." I did that and got an email from him giving the date of transaction, amount & my bank acc details. Soon got a confirmation voucher from him.

We arrived at Khyber on a snowy February day. 

And then the wait to check in began: almost half an hour and then the front desk staff tells me I will need to swipe my card before check in as they can't trace my payment. I was livid since I'd already done the transfer in full. When I showed the confirmation voucher, they claimed it's not enough and they need the transaction id.  I had already given my bank acc details and date of transfer, so couldn't understand why it was rocket science for them to check their with accounts instead of making me wait so long and insisting that I log into my bank acc and give them the transaction id right then. This was after a 3 hour long journey and I had a toddler in tow.
None the less, I offered to check into my acc and give them the details if I had access to the internet, but there was no 3G connectivity on my phone/laptop in this remote location. They promptly suggested that I BUY a premium wifi package!! I was astonished at the audacity!! Finally, managed to get hold of their desktop and fish out the details. On speaking to the manager about my experience, I did get a customary apology which neither meant much nor changed my opinion about the service.

As a parallel, when I compare this experience to the experiences we had at other luxury hotels like the Taj, Khyber doesn't stand a chance. No special surprises or personal touches by any staff member. Khyber comes across as mercenary and cold.

However, while the service was disappointing, here are the pluses
-The place was opulent and we immediately fell in love with the property. Warm wooden interiors, rich furnishings and full length glass walls offering magnificent views of the snowy landscape outside.
- The food at the restaurant is quite nice
- The L'Occitane spa is out of the world. The staff at the spa is very professional & well trained

This place costs over 17k INR(close to 300 USD) per night with no inclusions other than breakfast. Even the wifi comes at a price tag(very, very regressive). One expects great service when it is THE most expensive hotel one has ever stayed at. Not meant for travelers who spend hard earned money and expect a once in a lifetime experience.

reviews.author: mughal13
reviews.title: Could have been better
reviews.text: We stayed at newly opened resort in gulmarg khyber as previously we used to saty in hotel highlands park. The hotel is located next to gandola nad does not have spectacular views as probably highlands park does but the rooms, heating are good. The food needs improvemnt as their kashmiri food is very mediocre. Also a la carte rates are exorbitant and do not justify as per portion size and taste. Khyber can be better with improvement in food quality.

reviews.author: anubhavbindraa
reviews.title: Could have been much better
reviews.text: Hotel Khyber in gulmarg is a relatively new hotel and best in its class in gulmarg. The rooms are a mix and match of everything but workable. The lobby looks lika a museum with loads of memorabilia. The food is not that tasty as it should have been and service is slow. Spa though is good. For the price should have been much better.

reviews.author: Dutchie_in_Delhi
reviews.title: At this price point, should do better!
reviews.text:
We went to the Khyber to spend Christmas on the roof of the world.
Although our overall experience was pleasant, the mountains beautiful, the hotel nicely decorated and the company splendid (3 best friends!), there were some disappointments which at this price point are nearly unacceptable.
Kashmir is a wonderful but conflicted area, and the existence of this resort is a good sign for its development and economic growth. Being owned by a local, the love for the valley is to be seen throughout the resort, beautiful handicrafts and traditional furniture are applied with care.
The spa is gorgeous and wonderful, all three of us got a treatment there which deeply relaxed us.
Now, for the disappointments:
- tea served was Tetley.... Seriously? In India? In a luxury resort? A supermarket brand tea bag? 
- our (standard) room had view over the parking lot.
- even though we had had several email exchanges with the resort, check in was confused and staff nervous.
- only one restaurant was open. It was OK but nothing exceptional. Actually there was a second restaurant open. Specializing in grilled meats. But it served outdoors, with temperatures below zero.... Even the gas heaters couldn't make up for the cold.
- the hotel has a snooker table, but in that room you can neither eat nor drink.
- no alcohol. I understand it's Kashmir, but still.
- slow service, at breakfast we had to wait upwards of 10 minutes to get our coffee/tea
-diesel fumes from heating system wafting their way into the hotel.

So overall I would, unfortunately, not go back here.

reviews.author: tinadelhi2014
reviews.title: Not good without snow
reviews.text: We booked Khyber Gulamrg based on tripadvisor reviews. The hotel is newly built but it is already showing signs of some wear and tear. The rooms are nicely done up but expensive, we almost paid 20k for a balcony room with 1 child. The food is very rich and heavy and in spite of requesting they added lods of cream and dry fruits. The service is ok but room service is slow. Basically Gulmarg is boring as there is hardly anything one can do without snow and paying so much without snow does not make sense.

reviews.author: Jeevan_Talwar
reviews.title: Good Hotel But Pathetic Service
reviews.text: Khyber is one of the Best and only 5 star Hotel in Gulmarg. Its one of the most recent constructed hotel in Gulmarg having activities for almost every age group . The Hotel Luxury Rooms are very nicely done and so are the washrooms . The rooms with balcony are very airy and welcoming giving warm feeling to the guest . But the story on the service part is most unexpected or unacceptable . We checked in in the hotel around 2.30 PM . The rooms which were provided were 1 Himalayan view and other was Gulmarg View . We refused to accept Gulmarg view as it had hopeless view and  looked very dull compared to the Himalayan view rooms . The  Hotel blocked the ( Himalayan View rooms ) rooms for the guests who didn't even checked in . On our request the manager agreed to give 2 Adjoining rooms with same view . Although both the rooms weren't ready and we were told to enjoy lunch in the meanwhile our ( 2 rooms ) will be ready . We entered in the Restaurant and the buffet was going on but we decided to go for Ala cart  order .The order was placed at 3 PM . The food wasn't served to us uptill 3.45 PM . On asking the waiter the repply was blunt and shocking that the staff was busy dealing with room service and buffet thats why we weren't served the food . Finally we had to call manager and FnB Head for our rescue and provide food at 4.00 PM . A 5 star hotel takes 1 hour to serve food . There is no denial that food served was HOT and tasty . The Hotel has a very nice kids play area equipped with all facilities like XBOX air hockey carom-board blocks etc . There is nice heated swimming pool too. Overall all our experience was good . This hotel is meant to stay for atleast 2 Nights . The Gondola Ride is just walking distance from the hotel . The surroundings are lush green and a Nature loving person would love to be here . You can also see Top of Gondola from balcony view rooms .

reviews.author: Suket Bhatia
reviews.title: Great Property - Service needs urgent attention
reviews.text:
The property is well located and well done up. We stayed here as part of a large group and felt it was grossly understaffed to provide service levels expected of 5 star properties. Breakfast tables were not ready, dishes from earlier guests were still not cleared on all tables... we had to wait for 10 minutes for a table and still had to make do with clearing the tables ourselves... Definitely not expected when you're paying as much as the hotel charges. Also even upon making a request to open the pool early one day in advance, and getting confirmation that it would be ready, the pool was not ready the next day.
Attention to such small things from the staff would really have made our stay a memorable one.
ROOM TIP: Try to get the rooms having windows on the eastern side otherwise all you would be able to see from your room would be a barbed fence.

reviews.author: Global-Citizen
reviews.title: Excellent view and poor service
reviews.text:
This hotel has an ideal location facing the Aparwat peak , the rooms are large with balconies. It is a new hotel however the services are far from five star!
Housekeeping is poor, they forgot to put towels in the bathroom, the water was Luke warm and there were water patches leaking from the shower. The staff are very slow to respond. There is only one restaurant with average food and slow service. In short apart from the size of the rooms and the view this is by no means five star.

reviews.author: Suhail A
reviews.title: 5_star property with 2-3 star service and 7-Start charges
reviews.text:
I was very excited to stay at this Hotel as this was my first time at this hotel.
Hotel is in a very good location. The buildings and the rooms are very well done and nicely decorated.
However, everything good about this hotel , unfortunately stops there.
The hotel claims to be 5-star, however, the service and amenities are barely 3-star.
Right from the check-in, service is poor.
There is only one check-in desk which is not even properly marked. Guest are just standing around to check-in.
The staff at the check -in desk is not fully trained which makes check-in an arduous process.
There is only one resturant in the hotel which has to serve all the guests staying in the hotel. This makes for crowded tables and poor , slow service. The food choices are very limited.
The buffet is over priced with very poor voices. Plates and utensils are dirty and not up to par for a so called 5 Star hotel.
Room service leaves a lot to be desired. Out of 4 dishes that we ordered, 3 were made wrong despite us walking to the restart and talking to the person taking the order personally.
Prices for everything are exorbitant. Even to open the sofa bed in our room for our kids, we were charged 9000 rupees. I paid 9000 rupees to stay in JW Marriott in Delhi for a full room with excellent breakfast buffet and to and fro airport transfers. 
There were only two bath towels in the bathroom of the premium room for which the charge was 20,000 rupees per night. The staff was very reluctant to provide us with more towels. They wanted to charge us even for that.

Overall, I had a very bad experience at this hotel and will not ever again stay here. It saddens me that such a beautiful hotel is going to go waste because of poor management.
Being a Kashmiri, it saddens me more that we cannot provide service to our visitors that would be at par with any 5 tar hotel in the country.
I would request the management and the owners to visit JW Marriot in Aerocity, New Delhi, to see what good customer service means and how guests are treated in a dignified manner.

reviews.author: Prasad Shriyan
reviews.title: Excellent location, good property. Poor service though!!
reviews.text:
The location is just amazing.. Everything else you would want to do in Gulmarg is about a stone's throw away.. The view from the property is amazing and its well maintained.. 
The service at each touch point was a sore experience for me.. be it check in experience, food quality, speed of service, restaurant timings, housekeeping, etc. were all let downs... Rooms do not have cooling so those visiting in summer months beware... This hotel doesn't have a bar.. So for the dough that you would shell out for room reservations & other services at the property, the value is what you will miss...

reviews.author: sps100
reviews.title: All bell 🔔 and whistles
reviews.text:
The property is palatial in looks, the similarities end here, reception was lukewarm nothing like Lalit Srinagar 
Very poor service, a glass of fresh lime soda took them an hour and 3 calls, the telephone was out of order, it took them 3-4 hrs and when I summoned the duty manager that it was done, just about, as the handset was still not working 
Another word of caution ⚠ 
BSNL and idea 💡 do not work in the rooms 
Food is average

reviews.author: BAhuja
reviews.title: Beautiful locale
reviews.text: Hotel was probably the best option available in gulmarg, rooms we good, but d service generally was sloppy especially d kitchen . Food was ok, but service in d restraunt as well as room service was bad.had to wait long for d food n specification were not taken care of. Staff was a bit callous ( may b raw) as also no help from reception vis-a-vis guidance for travel/ sight seeing.

reviews.author: capetown7848
reviews.title: Misleading pictures and missing descriptions ….
reviews.text:
hi,

We recently booked for a forthcoming trip, the Luxury Balcony Rooms agh this hotel. The website shows pictures (obviously the best) but while booking they palm off rooms in this category which do not have the view as shown in the website gallery pictures. The guest is either up for a surprise or fight on arrival or the more alert ones notice on the bookings itself additions such as Gulmarg View or Golf Course View while describing the Luxury Balcony rooms. Whatever they are, rest assured, they are not Mountain or Forest Views as shown in all the pictures used to describe this category of rooms. If you want more, you pay more …… Can't we stop this nonsense in our country so that domestic & international tourists can take things at face value and relax when planning a holiday ??

reviews.author: Mav1109
reviews.title: Maybe the Best Resort in the world,,, with very average service
reviews.text:
We stayed at khyber in Dec 2013 for three nights... the location, rooms etc are fascinating but when it comes to customer service( don't think that they understand it).. in the three days they managed to confuse our pick up, managed to loose our confirmed booking, charged for Xmas eve dinner( which was already paid for),,,, and above all, there is no resolution ,, it seems that the reservations guy holds all the decisions but he is never found in the hotel..... 

But cant help but praise the place ,, location and hotel is AWESOME... just go there for the place.....

reviews.author: Lata K
reviews.title: Service could be better
reviews.text:
I had heard a lot of Khyber. So when we planned a trip to Kashmir, we made it a point to book a room at the Khyber. We visited in the month of December and let me tell you! you have to book welllll in advance to get a room as we came across many people who couldn't get a booking. Now, why the rush? Coz that's the only five star hotel in Gulmarg! It's a beautiful hotel. The drive to the hotel is awesome! The hotel's lobby is exquisitely designed n spacious. You have a sit down arrangement there, where you can have a card game or just gossip with your family. The check in took some time but they made it up by serving a delicious hot kahwa! Yes, there are too many exclamation marks, but that is how you feel. After waiting for a while, we were checked into a room on the lower ground floor, numbering 600 something. Why am I telling this? So that if you are allotted this number n believe in room service, say an emphatic NO to them. These rooms are the farthest from the pantry n housekeeping and if you order anything, it's going to take at least 1/2 an hour. Even a towel! My husband fractured his hand and there was no first aid and getting a hot water bag was Phew! The water was not hot n it came damn too late! 
This was the only negative point in this otherwise exquisite hotel. The swimming pool was not operational but it is now. It's a beautiful indoor pool. The gym is well equipped. 
Now, the food! The manager at the restaurant was very courteous n gave us some awesome deals as he saw that we were more interested in la carte while my son wanted a couple of things from buffet. The food was tasty. Everything from soups to desserts. Pizza to Chinese to tandoori! 
We stayed for two days. And don't forget to dip your hands in the candy jars strategically placed in the lobby. For the hookah lovers, there is an exotic cigar n hookah lounge. All in all, a good stay soured by bad room service. 
PS: I had mentioned this lacuna in their service in my feedback and I hope they have done something about it. :))

reviews.author: Manun Thakur
reviews.title: Good hotel Horrible Service
reviews.text:
If you're coming to kashmir and specifically to Gulmarg then is the best place to stay...perhaps why they take their guests for granted. 

Make sure you stay in the odd numbered rooms facing the mountains with balconies. We had luxury rooms and that's the minimum I would recommend. 

It is advisable to book your own transport and preferably an Innova to the hotel as the hotel sent us a shabby van with a driver who often held the steering wheel with his elbow while changing gears over the edge of the mountains as he was busy talking to his friends about clothes. 

The food is good but they are awfully slow at serving and when we brought that up the waiter actually said "I don't think so" hahahaha...

Still it's a good property with the best views.

reviews.author: Vishal D
reviews.title: Luxurious but ......
reviews.text: We stayed for 3 nights from 23rd May 2014 onwards.  We were allotted room no 4001 which opens up into the parking lot.  The first view was a scorpio jeep  staring at my face . Mr Bilal shifted us to another room on the next morning after we complaint about drivers standing outside our room window. PLEASE DON'T STAY IN ROOM NO 4001. After all we didn't pay a bomb to have a room in the parking lot.  The service was average when it came to room service because everyone seemed to be confused. The property is fabulous and extremely beautiful. Their temperature controlled pool was very good. The Mediterranean food at cabalash (cigar lounge) was very nice where you can carry your own bottles of alcohol.  The food is good but highly priced. A dal costs 500 plus tax. The hotel is excellent but the management needs to improve.  Very few options in gulmarg of this class.

reviews.author: monica j
reviews.title: Luxury without deliverance!
reviews.text:
I came back last month from an enthralling & rejuvenating holiday with my husband, in Kashmir. It was on our list for quite sometime, so we booked everything including accommodation, transport, tickets & some sightseeing, in advance. Though it was just the beginning of the tourist season, we were witness to traffic jams, queues, stampedes & cacophony all around us! God save those who plan on visiting in the high tourist season(may to july)! 

Lets talk about the great Khyber Himalayan Resort & Spa, Gulmarg, which claims itself to be the only 5 star property in the whole of Jammu & Kashmir state! 

Nestled in the Himalayan mountain ranges with striking views of the Affarwat Peaks in Gulmarg, India, it is no doubt a luxury property. It lies 65 kilometres away from Srinagar Airport ( 3 hour drive ) on top of a hill with views to die for(specially in winters)! The resort has eighty rooms, four luxury cottages and a Presidential Suite each with breath-taking views of the Affarwat Peaks and of the valley. Out of the 3 categories of rooms, the premier, premier mountain view & the luxury balcony rooms, we stayed in the luxury room with a grand balcony. There are several dining options like their restaurant called Cloves with splendid views, Nouf a covered deck to enjoy cosy meals besieged by breath-taking sights of the snow covered mountains, Chaikash a tea lounge with myriad flavours of teas to choose from & Calabash the cigar & Sheesha lounge. The Khyber Spa by L’Occitane is one of India’s most luxurious and holistic well-being spas, again with magnificent view. One cannot spend a dull moment in this imposing environment as a whole lot of recreational activities awaits you such as a fully dedicated area for children called the Igloo, a stupendous heated indoor swimming pool, gymnasium, game area for adults so on so forth. But for me everything ceases to importance if one fails to deliver!

They might have been recognised for their outstanding service delivery by the World Luxury Hotels, but I doubt it was the opinion of the guest or the staff itself! On this wise, in all humility & complete fairness, I express my analysis of the Khyber Himalayan Resort as follows: 

1. There were security screening machines installed at the entrance without people to operate them. My husband & I were not greeted upon arrival nor was there an inspection for security of persons, only for the baggage. I saw used overcoats just lying on the ground at the entry steps without being taken care off or noticed! I asked one of the guards if mine will be treated similarly! When we entered the resort, we were asked to identify the luggage, which my husband did. Then while we were waiting for the room, another person came & asked to identify the luggage, so I went & did so. It was the height of patience when another of the staff asked us a third time to identify the baggage! It shows the lack of communication among the staff! They seriously need training!!

2. The check-in time was 2:00 pm but we arrived an hour prior. Understanding the scenario we calmly waited, had buffet lunch & approached at the reception after an hour. While I was clicking pictures of the entrance I noticed that they are a part of the SLH group so I asked the reservations guy to upgrade my room. This took another 45-50mins & we were escorted by Ms.Shivangi to our room. This waiting for 2 hours killed us & wasted more than half of our day! Nevertheless, we checked in our luxurious room with a balcony & found it super comfortable & welcoming with respect to the freezing cold outside!

3. We took wi-fi for 24 hrs by paying INR.750, which we later realised didn't work for most of the time. Also, the sliding door between the dressing area & bathroom was completely broken! 

4. When we went to the restaurant to eat lunch where I met a family from Mumbai who were guests there as well. We immediately struck a conversation & they told me about the menu being repeated everyday. Like the manchow soup was served a day before & was repeated the day after. There was less choice for vegetarians for the outrageous price. Also, I did not find the food to the standard of a luxury class hotel. I went & informed this to Mr.Manzoor, who was at the front office & asked to be spoken to someone responsible. He said he will send someone to speak to me regarding the same, but in vain. I asked twice, but no one bothered to attend to me. In my opinion, he is seriously in need of proper training from a branded corporate organisation. This is absolutely not expected of this kind of a property. If it was Taj or Oberoi....immediate action would have been taken with the staff personally taking responsibility. 

5. I usually work on my machine in the night where I require to use the internet. I tried to connect several times but it was futile. Hence I called the reception, who transferred me to the IT department. After explaining the problem, he informed me that he cannot help me as everything seems to be alright at his end! I wonder why they charge for something they cannot deliver!

6. In the morning we looked forward to the breakfast, only to experience a bolt from the blue! It was pathetic! I ordered a masala dosa( a south Indian pancake made from rice batter), which was not even close to be called a dosa....very chewy with bland chutney! Then I tried my hands on parantha( an Indian shallow fried bread), it was hard as a rock! The food was cold, tasteless & disgusting! I again called the staff to make them aware of the situation....but no one was suited to handle the situation. 

7. We wanted to enjoy a swim in the inviting pool but as we didn't carry our costumes we couldn't. But I observed a couple of children & adults swimming in the pool without costumes. I asked for explanation but they just cleared the air saying we cannot do anything, as they do not listen to us! That was very convincing!!!

8. I am a traveller & a photographer who want to bring back places, people, destinations, cultures & a profusion of elements to the less travelled, confined at home. So I approached Mr.Manzoor again to let me have a person escort me, show around the property & photograph it. Apparently that didn't happen either. 

9. A warning for those taking for granted that this property being a 5 star luxurious one would serve alcohol....let me speak loud & clear, " this property does not have a bar or a liquor license ", so be prepared! 

10. Another letdown which came as shock to us later was the situation of transportation once we reached the hotel in Gulmarg. We were not informed of the fact that one cannot move in & around Gulmarg in an vehicle which is registered outside of Gulmarg. Even the hotel people cannot let their vehicle for travel within Gulmarg. So we either need to walk, take an ATV(all terrain vehicle, super expensive!) or hire a local car. 

11. This, what I am about to tell is rather unusual. Everytime a member of the staff went pass us in the hotel grounds, they acknowledged the presence of my husband only greeting him, hello sir, good morning sir...blah, blah & NOT ME! I don't understand why? I have noticed this for the first time in my life! 

Overall, it is a great option to stay in Gulmarg during winters for the location, view, snow, heating & indoor recreational activities, ONLY IF THEY IMPROVE UPON THEIR SERVICE, COMPETENCY, ATTITUDE & STAFF!

reviews.author: nandini1571
reviews.title: Felt duped
reviews.text: As for most travellers, booking was done personally. During booking thru mail, the reservation team insisted that we have to take an extra room since room size being small, extra bed cannot be accomodated. We agreed, but on arriving, realised that room size was fine. On speaking to the manager on duty, a mass of denials and false assurances like "enjoy your stay, we will take care of this next time, Yes, extra bed could have been accomodated etc" were made. We felt duped as the money involved was appreciable. One does not expect this kind of cheap tactics from places like these. Pl always verify before booking specially couples travelling with kids.We lost an appreciable amount of money.

reviews.author: CFerns
reviews.title: Perfect Hotel, best location in Gulmarg but lacking service
reviews.text: I and my family really loved the hotel. The entire hotel surroundings were covered with snow during out stay and you wake up to a beautiful view of the Afarwat mountains from the hotel windows. The overall service wasn't up to my expectation compared to the hotel star status and room rates. The hotel climate control seemed to have some problem with some kind of bad stench at times. To make matters worse, the elevators were not working. I also had a problem with their reservation. My reservation included 2 adults and 2 kids but they charged me extra for a child citing problems with their reservation system when I didn't even ask for extra bed. Maybe they were right but from my perspective it's unethical practice not to show accurate charges at reservation time. The restaurant staff were the only saving grace. Overall the hotel is good value for money with the view, proximity to the cable car, the heated pool and enough entertainment for kids.

reviews.author: Aarti Sethi
reviews.title: It's Average
reviews.text:
We were super excited about this trip-we were going back to Kashmir after almost 30 years! And we had heard good things about this new hotel-the Khyber.

It was nice. Like any hotel anywhere in the world. A nice spa, central heating, Heated swimming pool et al. 

The service as far as the waiters were concerned was great. But the management really needs to have a long, hard look at itself. There is a serious attitude problem at the Khyber and we fail to understand why. With the exception of Mr Amir at the coffee shop (he was very good) we could not understand why all the guys in the black suits were surly, unhelpful and just-plain stuck up. In the hospitality industry, it is baffling….because our stay is not free, we are paying for our rooms.

Having said that, the view from our balcony was spectacular. It was snowing when we were there and we loved every moment of that. The view from the coffee shop was also great (there is no other restaurant) and we really liked that, but be prepared for average food, and do not talk to any manager. 

At the 'Cigar Room' were told that we can smoke cigars but cigarettes are not allowed. Really?

There's a nice cappuccino machine at their pastry shop but they will not serve you the coffee at breakfast unless you go to the pastry shop and pay for it. (as we were told rudely by someone called Rajiv).

On the other hand, the hotel is located very well near the Gondolas, and is a very short walk from there. 

Please arrange taxis for anywhere before hand, because the hotel will not help you with this.

reviews.author: Sajeev S
reviews.title: Good location, bad staff
reviews.text: This is in a great location with stunning views and very close to the gondola. The room service is horrible. It takes ages for staff response. We had dinner in our room on both days we stayed there and after dinner we asked to remove the plates but were never taken despite twice reminding them and finally had to leave it outside our room. The same happened on the next day also and in the morning at 8 AM we asked for a bottle of water to prepare tea. This bottle never came until we checked out at 9.45 !!! so much for room service.

reviews.author: Travelbuff_A
reviews.title: Lovely Hotel, Pathetic Service!
reviews.text:
We were a group of 4 who stayed here in for three nights. The property is beautiful, and the rooms have a breathtaking view of the mountains. 

I would rate the hotel high on all parameters such as the rooms, ambience, spa and even the food. We received a very warm welcome from the staff when we arrived. When I stayed here the hotel was full, with only one restaurant serving food, you can imagine what a chaos would occur during breakfast and dinner time! The service was pathetic, you had to wait for a long time for tables, they refused to take reservations. they could not even offer the roti/paratha of our choice, and when they did it took them over 30 mins to serve. We saw guests even getting water for themselves. At no point was all the dishes in the buffet, they took forever to refill them.By far the worst service I have ever experienced. A huge disappointment. 

If you go to Khyber go the the fabulous property, the location, the view and the amazing ambience and rooms. The staff at the reception and concierge are extremely helpful.

reviews.author: salil
reviews.title: 5 star property, 2 star service
reviews.text:
The property is lovely. Beautiful setting and lovely facilities. 5 minute walk to the Gondola. The pool is one of the best I have ever seen, the the spa is lovely and the food is decent.  

The service levels are simply unacceptable for a hotel that is charging premium prices.  Wait times for  specialty coffee drinks during breakfast is upwards of 20 minutes possibly because they have maybe 1 expresso machine for the whole hotel. 

One of the hotel staff was rude to my friend and upon complaining to the hotel management was rude again in front of hotel management (in fact yelling at him for no fault of his). The situation was so bad that hotel management called security was called to handle their own staff member. We saw the same person an hour back on duty later serving coffee to hotel guests suggesting no action was taken by management and that they do not really care about how the staff talk to the guests. Very disappointing about the service and management handling of customer service given this incident.

Our  room came equipped with a sofa cum bed but apparently there is  a 3000 INR charge PER DAY for using the opening up the sofa bed and you using it  as an extra bed for a 4 year old child . There is no mention of this charge in the reservation or anywhere else so be aware of hidden charges. 

Awesome hotel location but service / policies need a ton of  work.  

Stayed in March 2014

reviews.author: sachinvividtraveller
reviews.title: Good hotel but average food
reviews.text: By far hotel Khyber in gulmarg is the best property in town but we being pure vegetarians cannot echo the same about their food. We stayed for four nights and found the vegetarian food lackingin taste, variety. They only know how to cook Kashmiri & little bit of mughlai food but beyond that there's nothing much to rave about. They must improve on vegetarian food for a better rating.

reviews.author: Dinesh B
reviews.title: Holidays in Gulmarg
reviews.text: Extremely great location near the Gondola (for skiers) with well furnished and comfortable rooms.Excellent food but service can be very patchy and takes time. Stayed in December 2013/Jan 2014 for peak season and not all restaurants were opened apart from a central buffet. Room service was very slow.The dedicated shuttle service into Gulmarg can be non-existent during high occupancies. Rafi at the Front Desk was excellent sorting out our issues. I was not told that alcohol was not served when i made my reservations,

reviews.author: Samrat
reviews.title: Good Resort
reviews.text:
We visited Gulmarg from 19th Dec for 3 nights and stayed at Khyber. The staff is cordial and the food is good... The interiors have been done well only considering the fact that it opened on 21st Dec 2012.. but the wear and tear have started... e,g the room numbers have started falling off and they have darkened them with ball point pen.. it is a good property but definately not 5* as the lifts dont work. Elderly and people with special needs will have major challenges with 4-5 levels of the hotel...e,g, IGLOO - the place where kids can play xbox360 and indoor games is 2 levels below common area..  the spa was not functional till 21st Dec and they denied taking any booking till 21st Morning.. The Spa was smelling on 21st as work was still going on.. No Sauna facility, the passage to the spa did not have centralised heating. The Swimming pool was also not functional.. 
Their website name says it is a hotel www.khyberhotels.com and they say that it is himalayan resort...Generally good resorts are theme based and there is no activites/attractions to call it a resort... So what is it still needs to be dtermined.. They have to work hard for ranking in SLH..Like any other hotel it has a snooker table, playing area for kids and igloo for indoor games.....
No iron and ironing board.. Available on request but not as they write..
They have a open area on the first floor called the NOUF where you can sit and admire natures beauty but the barbeque was not functional as there were not enough guests.... Closed as per their convenience
Also they cancelled dinner buffet as there were not enough guests.. does not happen in 5*.

An eighty room property in which is 80% occupied canceling buffet without prior notice is astonishing.

Gondola is about 5 mins walk and you get pick up & drop from/to the market but they have a challenge in answering phone calls everytime..

Overall average experience... have good views from premier mountain and balcony rooms which is an advantage.. The property is new, and the staff is cordial but is overhyped. We went to see Highland Park which has better scenic views and they have renovated this year..

reviews.author: creatice_circles
reviews.title: Khyber Gulmarg
reviews.text: We stayed in Khyber for two nights in November & found our experience as average. Thought the hotel is newly built & good but there is nothing much to do either in the hotel or the place so ideally one night stay is more than enough as besides the gondola ride there nothing to do. The hotel was having low occupancy but the food & service were ok. The pool, spa & bar are not operational. Khyber gulmarg is recommended for a one night stay.

reviews.author: 78avidtraveller
reviews.title: New good hotel but disappointed
reviews.text: We were told that this is a super deluxe 5 star new hotel in gulmarg but we had a mixed opinion. Hotel is good & has local architecture and rooms are also nice but inspite of the hotel being a resort & a spa it neither offers a spa/ swimming spool or a bar, they do not have a mini bar in the rooms. Food overall is good but some of the items are exorbitantly priced. We went to see highlands park & the views from there are much better. Overall good  for a a overnight stay only.

reviews.author: Pavan G
reviews.title: Bitter sweet experience at Khyber
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Khyber Resort at Gulmarg along with four friends on the night of 29th September. The weather was perfect with just a little chill as we drove into Gulmarg. The property is strikingly beautiful to say the least and is built like a fortress cocooning you in a world of beauty, peace and tranquility.  It is unlike most properties that one typically sees at the hill stations- it is very luxurious and tastefully done. The lobby, the tea lounge, the restaurants every thing is very warm and comfortable. The food is quite nice with a fair amount of variety for the breakfast and dinner buffet. The rooms are spacious, very well appointed and comfortable. The staff is courteous and helpful.
The only problem- but that is a big one is the lack of functioning elevators at a '7 star' place which is built over multiple levels in separate blocks that are not inter connected. We were in rooms two levels below the lobby level and each floor had 3 flights of stairs. In spite of the place having a soft launch over a year ago; the lack of a spa,proper gym etc. may not matter but the absence of elevators at a place more than 8500 feet above sea level is a serious issue. In fact, it made us curtail our vacation plan by a day due to the effect of the numerous steps augmenting the high altitude effect.
We found Khyber as one of the most amazing properties at a hill station in India. The presence of functioning elevators will go a long way in elevating the guest experience further.

reviews.author: sunil d
reviews.title: Stay only for Rooms
reviews.text: When we visited this hotel in June it has no spa, no swimming pool, no bar so basically you are paying so much only for the rooms. It is a brand new property & rooms are decent so is the food but the name is very deceptive as it is neither a resort nor a spa. Maximum 01 night stay in more than enough in this hotel & gulmarg only for the cable car ride.

reviews.author: virender j
reviews.title: Good new hotel with average views
reviews.text: This is a good new hotel in gulmarg with very average views. The problem in gulmarg is that old hotel like highlands & nedous command the best views but are very average now as they have not upgraded their properties & new hotel like Khyber & vintage are no doubt mucg better but with very average views. Otherwise the food served in Khyber is good but exorbitantly priced where an average meal per pax without drinks is approx 2000/- per head. Do try this hotel in winters for the snow experience!

reviews.author: Rahil R
reviews.title: Great property, but a work in progress
reviews.text:
Khyber seems to sit atop the rest of Gulmarg and commands beautiful views. The hotel is contemporary but with definite Kashmiri touches that help the hotel stand out from the rest of the luxury resorts that you might have stayed at. But the hotel is definitely a work in progress - the spa is not compete (odd since they have the word Spa in their name) and they haven't really worked out all their operational kinks yet. For example, they offer a helpful car pickup and drop off service to the town and back, but the number they gave me to call for the car pickup was either incorrect or no one picked up my call. Luckily I had the number of the driver who had dropped me the previous day and I was able to get a car to come pick me up, but had to wait in the rain for 10 mins. On our 2nd day there they didn't have a lunch buffet because there were too few guests (made me feel like I should have checked out with the other departing guests) and when I enquired about dining options at the time of check-in they forgot to mention that Nouf needed prior reservations. These all are fairly trivial in the big scheme of things, but they do add up especially when you're expecting luxury. 

The rooms though were beautiful and given how close the hotel is to the gondola's I think it would be a great place to stay for skiers. 

All in all, I'd probably stay here again because I think by the time of my next visit they would have worked out all these details.  

PS: The beds and pillows were terrible. They were so soft that I kept sinking in and the pillows barely gave my head any support. I actually napped on the couch in the room.

is really close to the Gondola's.

reviews.author: SiddharthVasudevan
reviews.title: Excellent property, many improvements needed
reviews.text: The check in was painfully slow, we were offered some kahwa and then totally forgotten about. The rooms are nice and well appointed. As this hotel is still under construction, be prepared to hear a lot of drilling and hammering noises. The spa is also not functional yet. the business center is also lacking in many aspects. No newspapers delivered to the rooms in the morning. Quality of food is very good and the service in the restaurant is good. Housekeeping also did not attend to the room despite the make my room sign being on. The location is very good. The management really needs to pull up their socks to bring it to the level of other SLH hotels. Not many activities to keep you occupied through the day.

reviews.author: Maneet99
reviews.title: Good going.
reviews.text:
This is just less then 2 hours away from Srinagar Airport. The staff was welcoming & helpful. We had a premier room with a very modern bathroom. The hotel is yet to finish its pool, fitness & spa facilities. I would say to them, with such wonderful property & location, they should brace themselves to give some world-class services. The staff at front desk works fine, but still got to do more in terms of english language & most importantly to have a hold on the neighbour-gondola rides. Breakfast was not bad, they should change the menu on daily or alternate basis. I would definitely recommend to stay in this beautiful Hotel with family.
My request to the management of this hotel, to do their extra bit to make this a class hotel, rather then run-of-the-mill hotel. It deserves to be in a league of its own due to its location & architecture. You have won the first round but still long way to go.

reviews.author: raj
reviews.title: need to work hard
reviews.text: fanatastic location....well designed public and private spaces...good facilities.....good food but very heavily priced should stress on serving local cuisines also...rather than the regular punjabis cusine.........all staff appeared new thats way services and other managerial affairs not upto the mark.....housekeeping staff on floor was good and hard working.....staff response overall ok...but courteous staff....sometimes appeared confused and could not take decesions.....well dressed and mannnered staff at all levels........ good concept to have doctor inhouse but he charged us rs200 for his visit had no idea regarding this..................now are bad expirences.....in our two day stay our rooms mcb must have tripped at least ten times and the last one was at twelvepm at night...though th estaff was sincerely working on no issues regarding that but the issue is that with all the technicalities available they could not understand and control the sitituation....which was really very irritaating we had asked teh manager to change our rooms but they were not willing to do so and they continued our stay despite not resolvingthe problem fully that was a bad gesture on teh part of management...and also no compilimentaries were served to us in form of compensations................and no elevators were there.....no floor phones to connect to reception was available.........corridors were stinking whenever it was raining outside....informed teh managers and floor house keeping concerns...........wooden floor in toilets an d wet corridor was very slippery and would lead to major maintanance in future for teh hotel management.....the glass concept was a poor thought......and several minor issues related to planning an d maintenence must be seriously seen by the hotel managements.......

reviews.author: asifwani21
reviews.title: just for lunch
reviews.text:
Slow service ...confused staff ...Restaurant is absolutely hopeless. Food is slow ... doesn't taste good. cold!Takes hours for everything. 
I was pissed off by their Food & Beverage service...and hell you are on top of a mountain so where else can u eat!
The staff is pretty new and the concept of service is not at par with other five stars in the state or elsewhere. 
Mobiles do not work in the hotel due to lack of network. 
Though the hotel has an excellent location and provides a great view of the afarwat mountain, 
the service was not good. The staff had to be reminded many times before they could serve us. 
The restaurant staff were not knowledgeable about the menu. 
Sadly, they did not provide us with the service and courtesy.
EXCELLENT VIEW!! Certainly the best in the gulmarg for the view.

reviews.author: Vinay290
reviews.title: not good experience.
reviews.text:
The hotel would have great potential they have Big beautiful rooms with stunning mountain view.

the hotel is near to Gondola but far from the market.

no bar, indoor pool, gym, spa are not in a working state & they are showing it on the internet, this was very disappointing and the room rates are high.

problem with the local people they are not allowing to take a cab to roam around which is disturbing & irritating because the hotel & Govt authorities seems to be doing nothing about it, they literally fought with us after we came back from gondola & spoiled our trip.

food is ok

Restaurant is overpriced.

service people seems to be confusing.

reviews.author: Vinay S
reviews.title: World Class facilities but still some rough edges
reviews.text:
Had prebooked this hotel a long time before the actual check in date. Started from Sonamarg early in the day, went directly to the Gondola and after a tiring day went to the resort looking for a hot bath. However found that the reservation desk had messed up my reservation and inspite of having paid the full amount in advance there was no room for me. The matter was sorted out after an irritatingly long wait and I was taken to my room.
The room is magnificient & luxurious by any standard. Decorated in the most elegant and aesthetic way, the balcony rooms were delightful. Everything, the decor, the presentation, the luxury, the service, the food was top notch. But inspite of all of this I did not carry back fond memories. The reasons are as under:
1) There was an argument at the entrance of Gulmarg with the people manning the barrier. Outside cars are not allowed inside Gulmarg unless the traveller has a booking for night stay. I was told that the mail of the reservation desk was not clear regarding booking.
2) As already mentioned my reservation was all messed up. I had modified my reservation dates and had obtained a confirmation from the hotel but it seemed that the changes were not made at the hotel database. Luckily I had carried print out of the entire emails and so was able to make my point. However precious time was lost in this.
3) At the time of check out I was presented with the bill with tarriff different from the promised one. Moreover my advance was also not being given credit. This again caused long delay and was sorted out after going through my emails. Surprisingly the hotel has till date not been able to trace out the payment inspite of me having providing the snap shot of all slips and bank account. This was however was not a good experience.
So once the sharp edges are softened Im sure it would be wonderful to go back.

reviews.author: eltoxtli
reviews.title: Best hotel in Gulmarg but not up to the marks
reviews.text:
Likes
Nice hotel with great potential. Beautiful rooms with stunning mountain view. Nice coffee bar.
Friendly stuff.
Good location near to Gondola.
Disturbing
Hotel page at booking.com was showing bar, indoor pool, gym. Non of this is existing or working, this was very disapointing especially considering the fact that full room rate is charged. 
Breakfast buffet ok but some food items where looking like the had been placed the day before.
Restaurant completely overpriced.
Drop to Srinagar airport overpriced (6000INR).
Safety issues for small kids at the stairs.
No new years celebration.
I would have preferred to give all this comments directly to the hotel manager but there seem to be no interest to get direct feedback from international travellers. Despite the fact that we spent 4 nights here nobody was approaching us to get our opinion.
Check out procedure took 40 minutes!

reviews.author: Hardeep Singh B
reviews.title: Overpriced and bad food wuality
reviews.text:
Food not good as all family members stomach got upset. Found hair in Dal and complained to the manager of Resturant. 

Room ac not working properly. Hangers of room number 5006 broken.

reviews.author: Pk M
reviews.title: Good property only for views but staff is not polite and rude
reviews.text:
Currently staying in Khyber hotel Gulmarg property is very good only for scenic views but the most important thing staying in a 5star property is staff respect how they make your stay remembrance.. If my message is being read by the management please train your staff and teach them to treat your guests like God that after checkout they only say wow what a  stay. 

Most important the dinner buffet..  staying in kashmir we expect to taste local kashmiri food but here you get the same food what you get in a normal hotel.. buffet  experience for dinner I would rate 1/10..

Even outside the hotel you get local kashmiri food which is far better than the hyped created by *Khyber*

reviews.author: Saurabh Jain
reviews.title: It’s a sham
reviews.text: So, just be wary of the sham this place has in coordination with the local cab people. They will not clean the roads of snow & not even drop you till the lane below. It’s a clear sham. The problem is that the owners have a monopoly here with the help of the local government. Rather go to Sonmarg than come here. It’s not about the money, it’s about their attitude when you check out.

reviews.author: divechadimple
reviews.title: Elegance needed
reviews.text:
The hotel staff especially managers need much more elegance, need to interact with customers politely.Theyvare always on the phone with jacket buttons opened which itself looks shabby .
There is no communication amongst the staff .
The workers spit in the garden in front of me today 1230.
My jet couldn’t work inspite of informing multiple times that my check out time is at 130.
The staff keeps talking loudly at all times .
Sarveeda housekeeper was nice enough to dress up room lovingly.
shabir was a warm host in Pan asian

reviews.author: sahil Narang
reviews.title: Best service
reviews.text: Too expensive we booked for kashmir only because of khyber good experiance with hotel and nice staff but too expensive , hotel is good but Gulmarg as a destination is brautifull but lot of people try to charge lot of money for simple rides govt sgould take action against pony riders for misbehaving with everyone for money

reviews.author: Saima Q
reviews.title: Food not up to mark
reviews.text: We went there a few days before and had lunch. The ambience was beautiful, the service was good but were disappointed with the food. We ordered Rogan Josh and Biryani but was not up to the mark as it should have been. Quite ordinary. Food 2 stars only

reviews.author: Lokamitra
reviews.title: Fancy hotel, fancy pricing poor culinary hygiene.
reviews.text:
The place is very high brow with an astronomic pricing so it was full of well-heeled guests. The architecture is beautiful and the service very responsive. 

Food:  We only ordered two ala carte  items. It took some time to come but the food was well prepared. The mutton and rotis were excellent.  They brought us some sweet items complimentary but we found them unappealing.

Ambience: It was pleasant with a local musician playing the famous Kashmiri instrument the Rabab.  The traditional music was nice but it didn’t last and one of the staff wanted the artist to pluck out some filmy songs to sing too.  it was sad to hear such a fine instrument plucking out Bollywood songs for the entertainment of the employees who obviously didn’t care for their own traditional music.  The overall effect was that the place was attempting “classy” without the staff having a real understanding of what entails.

The only thing that kind of clashed with the ambience was the serving of water in plastic bottles.  Glass decanters would have been more aesthetic.

Disaster:  The sad thing is both of us fell ill after the meal.  Neither of us had eaten early in the day since breakfast and we ate the same dishes at this hotel.  The difference was that I ate much more of the lotus stem starter my partner had very little.  Within two hours I was vomiting and having loose motions.  Violently sick.  The whole night I had to continuously go to the bathroom for 10 times until in the morning the only thing returning was the water I was drinking in-between the bouts.  I am pretty sure that the lotus stem dish was the culprit though it could have been the side salad of carrot,radish and tomatoes or  even the complimentary sweet items.

I had heard such great things about the hotel and the food was very tasty and well presented.  Something went wrong with the food hygiene.

reviews.author: Siddhartha
reviews.title: HORRIBLE KHYBER, WASTE OF MONEY
reviews.text:
Extremely extremely disappointed with the quality of service of Khyber, have heard a lot before booking so went with the booking but to be very true it’s a waste of money to book such a luxurious hotel, the dinner buffet was horrible with no taste of food and neither they were interested to adjust with any other item, breakfast was just ok, no service at all and they were not at all interested in customer service I think, in breakfast Chef himself came to ask how’s everything we just said the Tea given by them is not at all good, he told I am looking at it and that’s it he or neither anyone came again asking for anything, they just don’t care about customer service
Guys seriously don’t waste money booking it

reviews.author: Getaway221987
reviews.title: Disappointing Experience
reviews.text:
Check in process was very unpleasant. There is no coordination between their internal Team. 
Property is very overhyped and overpriced.
Games are not in kids games room.
Housekeeping services was very pathetic. Front desk team is not welcoming.

At the time of Breakfast also there is lack of coordination with guest and restaurant team. 
Food is average. 

However swimming pool  team is very good and  helpful.

reviews.author: manvirgupta@gmail.com
reviews.title: avoid khyber
reviews.text: highly overrated and priced hotel, had a terrible time there. leaving aside its pool rest everything else is below average, the room is dungy with no air--windows were locked. bedding had hairs from the previous occupant. the glass partition between the bath area and the commode is narrow--anyone can hit and get injured, buffet breakfast and dinner were horrible, avoid this hotel. it is 3-star property.

reviews.author: Manish
reviews.title: Over rated luxury stay
reviews.text:
An over rated luxury property 
High price with low quality service , food , hospitality & they treats guests for granted , stay for celebration but disappointed with Standard by paying premium prices , rooms are far , cafeteria is open for all so it’s very rush overall an overrated price for room & foods & service ⭐️⭐️

reviews.author: SNATH
reviews.title: Overrated paradise!
reviews.text:
Location - 5/5 
Mesmerizing view of the valley 

Food- 3.5/5 
Flavourful kasimiri wazwan served cold. 
Breakfast spread was good but most dishes served at the buffet were again cold.

Service & Hospitality-2/5 - 
Check in & check out experience below average. The staff their seem to have a very casual attitude. 

Cleanliness- 1/5
we booked a Himalayan view luxury room for 2 nights.
We found a bunch of hair in our bathroom at the time of check in. Bathroom was flooded on both days due plumbing issues. 

Swimming Pool -2/5
 The swimming pool is supposed to be their USP. The view from the pool area is spectacular and perfect for creating a great photo album. The hotel claims the water is heated but the water was not even luke warm. With snowfall and minus temperatures outside we were expecting to enjoy a swim in the heated pool. BIG DISAPPOINTMENT!!!

Overall, the property is great to stay at for just 1 night. Enjoy the views and multiple  photo ops. The hotel felt like a prison on day 2 as there is not too much to do at the property itself. The hotel has no in house activities or music night planned for their guests for entertainment. There is no alcohol served at the hotel. They have no contract with vendors for guests to enjoy ATV rides or other activities. Even an evening with bonfire and heaters at their Cafe is on chargeable basis which is to be booked in advance. Rooms are extremely noisy, we could hear people talking in the room opposite to ours. 

This group of hotels has a lot to learn in terms of  hospitality, customer service and satisfaction from its contemporaries like Taj and Oberoi.

reviews.author: AnkitBaid
reviews.title: Beautiful property but absolutely poor service and customer service attitude does not exist.
reviews.text:

Room Service:

b. Tea Not refilled.

reviews.author: docamybaba
reviews.title: terrible service, worst 5 star experience. rooms and location are perfect. i wont visit again
