reviews.text: hotel carrying on with old legacy, now rotting away with bad service and worse food. fabulous property, great location. amazing rooms. great infrastructure. very very good room housekeeping team. some people at reception are good. it ends here. we faced shockingly bad service and no body has the will to make things right for us. sadly this is the worst 5 star experience i have seen. whenever i had a issue ,someone would come to us to solve it. here nothing. its as if nobody cares. at the tea lounge, we got served a cold burger. we asked the server to check , he admonished us, saying this is how it is. and nobody else is complaining and that sometimes guest feel that things get cold too fast. shocking. he had zero remorse or even had zero inclination to correct it. he only  reheated on requesting again. at breakfast we are told by the server, that he is night duty person, its not his job to serve water and the morning team has not come, and that they are very busy. with reluctance he served water to my wife, and ignored my glass . 5 minutes later, he walks up to a European / American, i dont know, but foreigner, to ask if he can get anything for them . racism???  we kept asking for fresh tea, nothing happened for 30 mts. fruits were cut at night, and had a skin of dryness on them,  please be careful when you eat fruits that are cut all night. we have been having loosies since morning. i try to tell the Front desk manager. he is on his system , saying he will check, what ?? fruits which are eaten, the staff that has left. in the steam, sauna area, not a single staff. at 10 am, i had to swtch on jacuzzi myself. the only person in the room was a guard. Khyber will be run by security guards now. not a single staff. the steam room was cold, the sauna room was room temp. why are u amking fools of us. why are we paying so much to you. please look at the system. trust me it is rotting away

reviews.author: Dhruv Kumar
reviews.title: Highly over-hyped. Very bad experience.
reviews.text:
Surprising that I'm compelled to write such a review for such a highly rated property.

The overall experience, to our surprise, was way below our expectations and way way below the hype.

1. Their famous heated pool is not really 'heated' - It is just lukewarm water.

2. All amenities and F&B in the property are exhorbitantly priced. Even the taste or quantity doesn't make up for that price.

3. Personal experience - we had a Jain family with us and they ended up eating non vegetarian! Yes, only because the hotel kitchen - UNAPOLOGETICALLY - messed up the order. Highly unexpected from such a reputed property. Vegetarians please beware and double-check your meals. For the icing on the cake - All this happened after an incomplete order was sent to the room.

4. Staff isn't really very hospitable and not even well trained. Co-ordination between their teams is also surprisingly very poor - to the extent that while placing an order at the coffee shop when we asked if it could be sent to our room - we were told to call IRD and talk to them and that the coffee shop team would be of no help.

5. Their lounge serves only Hookah and the atmosphere is rather dull with small sittings. So in case you're travelling in a big group it would be difficult to find a place where you can all enjoy together. Not to miss - their premier rooms are just moderately sized without any balconies.

6. Not all the amenities mentioned in their service list are functional at all times - best to call the front desk and check for each and everything. During our visit, their mini-theatre was not operational (without any logical explanation from their team).

7. The location is undoubtedly unlike any you would have seen before. Best time to enjoy the view would be when its time for snow. The interiors of the room are average.

BUT hospitality and service - UNEXPECTEDLY HIGHLY DISAPPOINTING

reviews.author: ravi p
reviews.title: Over hyped - very poor service
reviews.text:
Khyber is one of the most expensive hotel in that region and one would expect if not great, acceptable service. The rooms and the hotel location is outstanding but the upkeep and service requires major overhaul. The ladies jazzuzi was dirty with moss growing on it. The breakfast usually was full, till 1030am and when we went to the counters at 1031am, not a single food item was there. You would also expect them to 'ask' if anything is needed and that did not happen even once. 
It is worth the price - only if you are ok with sub standard service. 
Meeting the GM, Vineet was only assurance and nothing changed.

reviews.author: hitenge
reviews.title: Very disappointed with hygiene and arrogant staff attitude
reviews.text:
We stayed for 2 nights from 02/05/22 to 04/05/22. The most shocking thing was cockroach at the buffet table. I immediately reported this to the staff and restaurant manager.  Also spoke to GM Mr. Chabbra. They promised that they will look into this and get is pest controlled immediately. This I am sure must have been done by them but to find cockroaches in buffet table for such an expensive high class hotel is unbelievable.

The next day my wife stayed home as she was not feeling well. She even skipped her breakfast. She requested housekeeping to clean the room so that she could sleep. Inspite of 3 calls, noone attended the room. At the end at 3 pm she went to reception to complain and then the rooms were cleaned. 

What I realised was that there is lot of arrogance set in the staff. The Hotel is fully packed for next 6 months. They have increased the rates to crazy levels and still the demand is very high so they do not seem to be bothered about customers.

I made a written complaint to the owner from the Hotel but am yet to receive reply.

Mr. Gautam, restaurant manager and Mr. Mohammad Rafi Bhat Duty Manger did try their best to pacify us and correct the mistakes. Even GM called my wife but all this after two unpleasant experiences. It was more of a fire fighting after blunders. 

The best thing for them is to bring new people who are humble. Ideally, they should give the Hotel to someone like Taj to manage. I have been to several Taj luxury properties and nowhere arrogance is seen. If a mistake happens they go all the way to correct it and the system ensures that it is not repeated with other guests.

I found many small maintenance issues like balcony handles not fully functional and dustbin covers are not operational which all are due to lack of supervision and the attitude.

Well now the good thing. The Hotel is located at beautiful place with very good view. It has heated swimming pool and spa. The gym has lot of Equipments. It is just 5 minute walk from the Gondola. The rooms are spacious. The buffet spread is good (minus the cockroach). They need another restaurant as people have to wait to get place for dinner.

I hope my views are taken in right spirit. I usually never criticise publicly but a genuine feedback is a must so that other guests do not suffer.

reviews.author: Abha J
reviews.title: Much hyped, claustrophobic and exhorbitant
reviews.text: Since we entered the hotel didn’t feel the warmth or hospitality. The hotel rooms are really expensive and not worth the price. It was crowded and we felt as if we were in some amusement park accommodation. Don’t waste your money!! The room we got was 2 levels down with claustrophobic view. Much hyped and advertised by influencers! Instead choose the hotel that is being run since 1965.  Very open and full of warmth by the staff!

reviews.author: Parag Chitale
reviews.title: Too much hype about Khyber
reviews.text:
We visited Khyber in a group of 10 (5 couples) and realised that Khyber is one of the most over rated hotels. While the location is excellent and the indoor heated swimming pool is a great facility to have, the hospitality and service is pathetic. We found the staff to be very arrogant, not at all warm. We experienced absolutely horrible service - order something and keep waiting whether it is in restaurant or in room dining. Any request at Khyber is met with a response - its not part of our policy. In spite of having a dinner included package, a waiter chased us after dinner asking us to pay. And this is after 3 different people checking our room number while entering the restaurant. 

For the amount they charge, their service and hospitality is absolutely rubbish. We would not recommend this hotel to anyone.

reviews.author: Nj
reviews.title: Overrated hotel with rude staff
reviews.text:
We were very excited to stay at the overhyped  The Khyber.
But we were very disappointed with the very basic and unmaintained rooms and the rude staff. The housekeeping staff entered in our room even after we directed them to do up our room after we come back from breakfast. But to our surprise we found 4 technicians along with 1 staff member in our room installing a new telivision and they made us wait outside for 15 mins. When we called the manager to complain rather than apologising he said they have the authority to enter the room sometimes without any prior notice to the guest and they can come in at emergencies ONLY. But is replacing a Television an emergency?? After calling several times all that the GM did was say that he will look into the matter.We are actually questioning are selves if it was worth waiting for the stay in this property where everyone is so disrespectful towards their guests? Is it worth staying in a place where you are spending an exorbitant amount and there is no respect to guest privacy?? Very disappointing stay and not recommended at all.

reviews.author: Shiksha
reviews.title: Disappointing Honeymoon Stay
reviews.text:
When you think of luxury stays in India, The Khyber Himalayan Resort tops the list. We went their on our honeymoon for 3 days and were heavily disappointed with the hospitality and food served there. We had all our meals at the hotel itself thanks to the lockdown, and to my surprise the staff behavior wasn’t warm at all. However, I would definitely like to give a special mention to the chef who after listening to our food reviews did curate a special dinner for us which wasn’t great either but we appreciate the effort.
When call yourself the only luxury five star in Gulmarg its not just the property and the view but what stands out for me is the hospitality, which was completely missing during our stay along with the food.

For my husband and I khyber really needs to up its game when they charge a bomb!!!

reviews.author: Anshul Sahni
reviews.title: Not worth the price
reviews.text:
We were travelling as one couple and an infant (10 months).

We had a very ok ok experience at khyber despite paying a hefty amount . Although location is excellent ,hospitality staff is good but needs to be more polished . 

Front desk staff is super busy to listen to your complaints . 
From the very beginning,when the room was allotted(in second or third basement) ,i personally told the staff that the room had a foul /stinking smell ,but no one listened .

To my SURPRISE 
On the second day ,after taking the bath we got to know the path holes of the wash room are fully blocked thats why the smell was coming 

DESPITE SHOWING THEM(staff) THE VEDIO WE CAPTURED ,nothing great was done .(only Technichian visited) and again on the third day 
After taking bath it was blocked . 

Booked this resort after seeing the reviews on fb and other social media platforms. 

My room no was 6001 booked for 21-23 march2021. I have all captured vedios to share .

reviews.author: RajatParakh
reviews.title: Poor Service.
reviews.text: Great place and superb ambience. Wish the service was as good . Our room had a heating issue and nobody seemed to know how to fix it . Had come with some great expectations,  but was completely let down. Maybe coz the hotel was completely sold out. Would not want to come back for sure .

reviews.author: Pankit C
reviews.title: One of the best properties with the most most disappointing service
reviews.text:
We stayed at Khyber during the COVID era for the New Years. We had the Himalayan view room for 4 nights. It is one of the best properties with an amazing location. The view from the hotel is to die for. The property has been well maintained as well. A 5 on 5 for the property is a no brainer.

When it comes to service, it was purely disastrous. Overall, to get anything from the front desk, in-room dining to housekeeping, it took a minimum of 2 calls. Nothing was addressed in one go. I understand there might be a shortage of staff due to covid. But thee needs to be some customer empathy. It's the most important thing in this industry. There was zero customer empathy. The staff was least bothered. It was a disappointing experience overall.

A special mention for the new year con. There was no new year gala dinner when I booked. They introduced this later. They were charging a mind-boggling INR 10,000 per person for just food and music. Obviously, I opted out. But what they did was, they shut everything down in the hotel - restaurant, lounge, etc. The only thing available was the in-room dining. This was shocking. It was almost like being held on gun-point to attend the gala dinner for an unreasonable price. A ton of other guests around were pissed about this as well.

Overall, it's a great property which is not run by professional hoteliers. 2 points are purely for the property and the view and it's a 0 for everything else.

reviews.author: Bhavik S
reviews.title: Not worthy to spend money
reviews.text: I m still staying today (2/6/19) and posting this as I didn’t found it best in terms of hospitality . Lots of complaints & regression there for this property . Room was not upto the mark & fully suffocated atmosphere inside room . My kids cudnt slept whole night due to this .

reviews.author: MrinalSinha
reviews.title: Don't expect the reservations staff to share local information
reviews.text:
Called the Kyber to book a stay and inquired about skiing options. The experience was contrary to a lot of the reviews. The reservations person told me that once we are checking into the hotel then they can give us information. 

I requested him again asking for advice and told him I should be able to plan it. His response? Sir, you can google it. 

I am sure the hotel is pretty good - given all the reviews. That being said, the first impression is that the staff can do with some training in hospitality.

reviews.author: Shabar M
reviews.title: Quality of food not good.
reviews.text: I visited there along with my family. Although the Ambience is good but the quality of food and drinks is not good. The bakery in the coffee shop is stale and from the taste it is clear the is no fresh. By the name and desfription of the drinks on the menu it seems that it is something exclusive but the drinks are pretty ordinary and nothing more than just a fruit mixed with milk. Certainly it a waste of money for the amount they charge. I would think thrice before visiting them.

reviews.author: daud r
reviews.title: Visit to coffee shop with friends
reviews.text: I visited Khyber resort Gulmarg to day for the first time along with my family. I had heard a lot about the place but was really upset after visiting. We order nutrition smoothie which the suggested is quite good, but after having it was as if having medicine such as cough syrup. Ordered cold coffee with ice cream that also was average and not as good as one would expect at such a luxurious place. Ordered pastry which was not fresh at all. We get fresh and much bigger pastry at any bakery in Srinagar which is 10 times cheaper. Also as we were sitting on the open balcony of the coffee shop while waiting for our order we started taking photos on the staircase leading to the garden, but to our surprise the staff told us we are not allowed to take photos as we are non resident guests. Really a bad experience from such a costly hotel. No value for money and don't recommend the place. You have much better and cheaper places available at Gulmarg instead.

reviews.author: PrashantSanghvi
reviews.title: 25000 per night is it WORTH ?
reviews.text:
The moment we say Gulmarg two things come to our mind GANDOLA which is World's highest and longest cable car  and the most sought after resort Khyber!!! Gandola I will definitely recommend but Khyber I would say is a waste of money as they don't have proper view for base category of rooms as evident from the pictures our room was too close to parking lot even after a complaint to the duty manager they were not able to give us a better room as for this amount of money you can stay at Taj Srinagar which has definitely a better view further they just provide 4 bottles of water in a day any additional is chargeable also as informed to us even the tea coffee will be replenished only to the extent of 20% of the stock They provide just two Twinings tea  and some open Tetley bags which is evidenced from the pic uploaded we are not theives or beggars which management should understand even no complimentary fruit basket and they don't even consider your anniversary or birthdays which other hotels do consider and makes some arrangements to make the guest feel special,  staff needs to be trained on customer relationship inspite of rooms going empty they have a policy to keep it vacant. 
Over all it was a disappointment to end our holidays at Khyber

reviews.author: MomTravels
reviews.title: Staff unpleasant
reviews.text:
Price: is way too much for the food offered. For 2 adult it came up to about ₹5000 

Staff: We were only getting used to the courteous nature of people in Kashmir and this came along and left a bitter taste for us. Hmmm 

The ambience is great. The view from Tea lounge is simply breathtaking. 

Overall, it’s a great climb from Gulmarg but not worth the trouble.

reviews.author: Punit Gadhia
reviews.title: Good property!! Rooms with MOUSE
reviews.text:
Check in: Quick n easy. Were upgraded to a luxury himalayan view room 

Food: 
breakfast not as per 5 star standards. It was brief and similar to a 3 star offerings. We have been to Hyatt and Taj. And nothing compares to the spread that they offer. Surprisingly, Kashmir being a state offering abundant dry fruits, we didnt see any of the dry fruit being served during the breakfast. 

Lunch and dinner: overpriced as compared to the portions that were offered. 

Room ambience: 
Good view of the Himalayan range from the balcony. Decent ambience. 

Good toiletries. Spacious bathroom 

Now coming to the most horrifying and depressing part of our stay:

WE SPOTTED A MOUSE INSIDE OUR ROOM (2021). OH MY GOD!!!! Yes u read it right. A MOUSE.....

Does this sound familiar to anyone else... 

after spending a BOMB and hoping to receive the best of luxury services. Its indeed horrifying to have rodent infested rooms. On questioning we get a response that since its winter time, thats why maybe the rodent must have ventured in. 

Seriously!!!! 

Staff’s reaction on the MOUSE issue:
Housekeeping staff tried his best to assist but in vain

No Manager came inspite of us asking for one to come and meet us. I agree to one of the travellers review that the staff at Khyber are taking their guests for Granted. 

The Manager came to meet us only after we settled our bills. This was just Ridiculous on his part being a Manager. Shame on you Mr. Manzoor. By the look of it we understand that this was not taken seriously by any of the staff. 

Highly disappointed!!

reviews.author: Kaushik D
reviews.title: A huge property with zero hospitality!!
reviews.text:
We visit Gulmarg/Kashmir almost every year in different seasons. Wanted to try out Khyber after all the reviews. Overall, supremely disappointed!!!

Location : Thats an advantage, closest to the Gulmarg Gondola counter. Amazing views of the Aphrawat ranges, (only from high end rooms)

Ambience/Common Areas : It's a wonderful building. Well spread out property and well maintained.

Room : Moderately spacious. But the décor is pathetic. Neither traditional nor chic, just a hybrid, confused mess.

Food : Bad.!The breakfast assortment was sub optimal and didn't justify the "Luxury" tag. Variety was totally missing. Obscenely high priced for the taste and portion size. Hashbrowns and Croissants never tasted so dull and rubbery. The omelettes were good though!

Staff : That's the worst part of Khyber. They just don't care. Stayed for 3 nights and 4 days, there wasn't a single soul who reached out to check in if the stay was comfortable, no occasional "hellos". No greeting in the breakfast table. No hint of recognition as you pass by. As if you don't exist. Surprisingly it wasn't for all guests. Some groups did receive good dose of attention, so does it come with the room type. May be our experience would have been different if we stayed in the Presidential Suite ? How ridiculous!!

Being a Taj Inner Circle and La Cirque/Connoiseur Club member, and a Luxury Hotel expert, my understanding of a baseline expectation from a 5Star property is very realistic. Khyber, fails to meet that basic expectation - the warmth!!

Its not the property but the staff and their warmth who make those 5 Stars - anyone with a Taj experience would agree for sure. The staff in Khyber is as cold as the snow in the backdrop. Their cold and indifferent attitude stinks of arrogance at times.The supervisors exude that more than others. 
Check In experience was very messed up. The guy had no clue of the booking (made via Booking.Com) and made us wait for close to 2 hrs.

Best part - During check out, after 3N/4Ds, there was a customary question from the lady at the reception (Khaleda, if I recall correctly) - "How was the stay". I responded - "It was good, could have been lot lot better". That was the end of conversation, no further look/enquiry from the lady, no check in on what can be better, she just handed me the envelope with an arrogant indifference which screamed "Whatever..we don't care!!
And this was just one example.

The best and most warm acknowledgement we received was from the security at the gate - rest of the staff, and management should learn from him!!

One unsolicited advice to Khyber - You're in the hospitality business, its not your property but how you treat your guests will make them loyal and keep you in business. Don't take your guests for granted. 

Not recommended unless you have money to waste!

reviews.author: Amal A
reviews.title: Nice hotel
reviews.text:
Although the hotel is good though the staff was untrained ,bad English and cannot solve problems even though the supervisor
Was very rude
The swimming pool was dirty 
And smile bad 
Bad reception staff
I was very upset

reviews.author: INDIA_DEEPAK
reviews.title: Beautiful property but bad hospitality towards the guest
reviews.text:
After our 2 days stay @ Hotel Vintage we had booked other 2 days @ Hotel Khyber which is 1.5 Kms away from it.

Due to heavy snowfall we called Khyber to get us transfered from Vintage but the duty manager Mr. Sakibh refused saying that the cars had stucked up.  We managed to hire a cab with the help of Vintage staff. The cab driver refused to drive till reception of Khyber  due to steep slope.

We again called up at Khyber to help us but Mr. Sakibh again refused using harsh words, saying that the ATV was not working. We saw the ATV  making rounds to and fro from the hotel till the Gandola side which was just  150m away.

 After watching all this we had to use hard words.We had booking in their hotel and if some problem was arising to get upto there they should have helped  in that scenario.

Latter ATV person showing courtesy carried us alongwith the luggage. In all this more than half of our day was spoiled.

All that was not  expected from such a big resort.

All that behaviour of the duty Manager Mr. Sakibh on that day spoiled our holiday mood.

Overall the property is awesome and really beautiful. The other staff members  at dining, reception or housekeeping  were really nice and polite. Mr.  Manzoor   & Mr. Pervez at front desk were really very nice and helpful for rest of our stay. Tahir and  Mudasir @ Swimming pool were too nice & helpful.

The property is undoubtedly very beautiful,comfortable and awesome. The food is also fine.

reviews.author: Himesh Shah
reviews.title: Khyber Review
reviews.text:
Unbelievable location, Amazing Property but a very below average hospitality! Very disappointing experience! Unfriendly staff, they seem to be least bothered about the comfort and requirements of hotel guests.
The location is very close to Gondola but do not expect any kind of service or assistance from the hotel for the Gondola ride. Food is very average! Special Jain request was intimated to the hotel well in advance but no arrangements were made for the same on both the days of my stay. Very limited options were offered to me upon request and that too as if they were doing a favor to me! It is time these hotels start realising the fact that we pay the same tariff what others are paying and still they do not take any care of us. In fact one of the waiters had the audacity to back answer that we are giving you some Jain food on request! Overhyped Hotel, Jain community pls avoid this Hotel!

reviews.author: pallabeem
reviews.title: Not worth the value
reviews.text:
If it's only the view you are looking for then go for it , you could also request a tour of the hotel - that is wonderful and very beautiful right from the entrance to pool and the deck view of mountain.

But their service is terrible. 

I stayed in classic room and it's beds were so hard and the room partitions is nil, you can here even the whispers from the other room so imagine what must have been our condition when someone is watching tv and the people walking about in the corridors late at night. You can hear it all, no sleep and stiff back in the morning.

And the restaurant is below average, i ordered special Kashmiri dish tabak maaj, it was so very deep fried one cannot even take a bite. And in dinner I started with creamy mushrooms soup which I felt it tasted like lumpy knorr soup , no cream whatsoever.

By the price rate it goes , it's extremely over rated.

reviews.author: ariajainxx
reviews.title: INSUFFICIENT SERVICE
reviews.text:
The hotel is marvelous and grand, the rooms too are very comfortable. We however went at a time when the whole hotel was empty. We had paid for all the services but since the place was empty most things were difunctional. The television wasn't working. 
Everyday they made the guests walk down the slippery snow slope for 5 minutes in the snow because they had no ATVs. 
 The cafe didn't have most of the things on the menu. Service at the Khyber is poor, but if you go there expecting less, that shouldn't affect the comfort level.

reviews.author: Amit B
reviews.title: Hospitality is very poor
reviews.text: The hospitality is very poor, the room sofas are broken, Wi-Fi is not free which is available at every hotel today which was embarassing, door lock also not in the upright condition, playroom equipments are not working, Infact the pricing which they had kept when compared to the services are not up to the mark or not value for money. Vintage would be the best property at Gulmarg.

reviews.author: Puneesh P
reviews.title: Good property but poor management
reviews.text: I have stayed in the property for 2 nights along with the family in the month of june 2015 & the management is below average as compared to the beautiful property. The pool was under maintainance at the time of visit & the management was not compensating. They were filling the pool with a 1 inch plastic pipe & it was going to take 3 days to fill.

reviews.author: creativecircle80
reviews.title: Good but not best
reviews.text: Khmer in gulmarg is a good hotel with modern rooms and facilities but service and staff attitude is lacking as the management seems to be complacent and non receptive to complaints. During our stay almost all our small requests were ignored making you realise the hotel's management requires a course in hospitality. Small requests like fresh milk with chocolate for our child was not adhered to even after several reminders, we had pre ordered kichdi for dinner but it wasn't made as they told us the waiter who took that order is off duty now! Khyber is exorbitantly priced and such excuses at those prices are in acceptable.

reviews.author: Ashish A
reviews.title: Overhyped
reviews.text:
Stayed for 2 nights. 
Positives : location, facilities (heated pool, games room).  

Issues :
1) Air - conditioning /room ventilation. As a winter ski resort, designed for central heating but no ventilation /cooling for the summer. Whats worse they have a promising panel in the room which gives the sense of individual temp control.  
Uncomfortable sleep while paying 5 star rates is unbecoming. 

2) F&B: Quality of food is average. The service is unfortunately sub-par. Waiters needed to be reminded multiple times before you got what you needed.  

I should mention that when the feedback was escalated to Mr.  Basheer and Nawaz, they reacted very well and made best attempt to make amends.  

Overall, we had a reasonable stay at the hotel and it is probably the best property in gulmarg - but there does seem to be a complacency in service in knowing they will have a good stream of business regardless.

reviews.author: 254saurabh
reviews.title: Over hyped and over rated
reviews.text:
the rooms are nice.
rest is average. food options not that great.
they have a cigar bar but they don't sell cigars.
i asked them if i could smoke my own cigars but they said smoking cigars is not allowed in the cigar bar??
only shisha is allowed in the cigar bar and that also in the evenings only.
weird and overhyped resort.

reviews.author: Surbhi C
reviews.title: Poor Hospitality
reviews.text: FOR A 5+ star hotel i would rate the property 9/10 but for service i wish i cld hv an option of negative rating. We had been der last week a bunch of 13 out of which 5 were kids. So to start with we stayed der for 2 nights paying a 45k plus for those two nights only with complimentary breakfast. A 5 star property denied us a free wifi connection n we were asked to take a paid option...made us wonder which 5* hotel does that. With kids being with us age 4 n half yrs refuse to sit at one place n complete a meal of course for thier mood swings..due to which we requested d hotel for us to pack some breakfast for them...v were to our surprise denied! We had to literally beg for 2 days to lets us pack some breafast for our toddlers...n yes i repeat it made us beg!! post which we were allowed with a very ltd choice n no. of food items( say just about 2/3 idlis e.g). I mean which hotel denies food for toddlers????? On the day of our checkout whr we needed to leave by 8am for our further excursions...the breakfast wasnt ready till 8am..v reached der by 7:30/45am dey refused to even switch on the lights in d breafast area till it was 8am...der were so many other quests who were as zapped as us to know a 5* hotel not serving breakfast b4 8!!!! At that very tym der was a gas leakage in the live food counter which was  unattended by staff memebers...they were completely unaware about this...some guest waiting for the breakfast to start had to personally go in the kitchen area to inform them about this...surprise surprise...none of them seem to b bothered about the same...after repeated calling only then d staff came to d location of gas leakage.Then wen it was tym for checkout in one of our rooms v had used this small handsize towels to wipe some dust on children shoes...n to our biggest surprise we were asked to pay for that dirty napkin.....after a lot of arguements the hotel agreed to not charge for that small dirty towel...i mean v din understand then wat were we paying that 45k plus amount for???? The 45k didnt include free wifi...it didnt include some breakfast to b packed for our toddlers...it didnt include breakfast to b ready by 7....to top it ignorant staff over d gas leak...n icicng on d cake 45 thousand cldnt take care of an used towel??????? Y shld one visit an hotel like this is the question....n ya lastly to top it...the hotel manager comes back arguing that our hotel is a luxury hotel and thats y it cant gives us free wifi???? my question then wat are Taj/ Leela/Hyatt etc hotels?? arent dey luxury hotels??? just for the information of this hotel...we all have been members n customers to these top notch 7* hotels...so plz dnt try to explain us as to wat is a luxury hotel!!!!!! A completely disgusted customer with your poor service n for your so called luxury hotel!!!!!

reviews.author: Ashish S
reviews.title: Excellent property with a poor service
reviews.text:
No doubt the property is itself a part to get explored like gulmarg.
Very beautiful property with such a brilliant view of the interior lounge, lobby, and many antiques wodden crafted things much more.
But thats a part of a 5 star property at the same time it's more important how the guest are treated we felt like the management head were in too much of attitude.
Staying here was a like a prison with many rules to be followed likewise had to go long way for smoking secondly the connectivity doors from swimming pool to the rooms are closed had to walk as if we are on tracking.
We complained of some chemical solution sprayed on wooden furniture  ( as of the entire property is made of wooden things and great wooden carving) but the person denied and even dint changed the rooms.
No doubt the food is excellent I rate it 5 star.

But after all dissatisfaction is more.

Remember it's a business promoted by word of mouth I was recommended by my cousin who visited in 2015 but I don't feel like advising any one.

reviews.author: Somnath S
reviews.title: Not a typical hill station hotel
reviews.text: Hotel khyber gulmarg us a new hotel in gulmarg, during our last visit we had stayed in hotel highlands park which has much better views and service. Khyber might be ok for skiers in winters but for tourists who want to enjoy huge lawns with landscape, typical cottage type rooms with local feel and service then I'm afraid khyber is not the place. We recommend highlands park in summers as we again went for lunch and were mesmerized with the beauty all around it.

reviews.author: Anurup M
reviews.title: Great Property, Bad Service!
reviews.text: The resort is beautiful! The huge lobby welcomes you in, and the view of the Himalayan mountains and forests is awe inspiring. We sat down for some tea at the lobby cafe. Unfortunately, the service was a disappointment. The staff was unfriendly, unhelpful and in general just not very pleasant. For a resort this expensive, I would like to be treated well. I was hoping to return with my entire extended family for a big vacation. I changed my mind after my first visit, only because of the staff. Else, the resort truly is beautiful.

reviews.author: Shwetasree
reviews.title: Does not live up to the hype
reviews.text:
When we were driving up to Khyber I was skeptical. The steep cobblestone driveway covered with black ice was treacherous to say the least and our Toyota Innova was not equipped to do the climb. We called the hotel who asked us to essentially go figure. Disappointing for a property of this nature. Taxis just below were making a killing charging guests Rs. 600 to take them up 300 metres.
The entrance was impressive and the lobby is awe inspiring. Check in was smooth and the staff (both at the reception and the restaurant) were super nice to us throughout our stay - attentive, polite, friendly and helpful.
We spent the initial hour or so soaking in the stunning views and then eventually it hit me - the noise. I will not be exaggerating if I say that this is the noisiest mountain resort that I've ever been to. At nearly 400 USD a night (for a basic room - mine!) that's a big shocker and an immediate thumbs down for the place. The lobby is a veritable fish market - the place seems to attract (and unfortunately encourage) loud patrons. The bar opens into the lobby and the raucousness wafts into the resto as well which is a chaotic melee of loud folks and running children. They appear to have kept all the staff hanging around the lobby to service the steady stream of guests (with the late snowfall this year, the place seems full even in March) with the result that housekeeping completely sucks. For every little thing much follow up was needed.
But the worst is yet to come...paper thin room walls. I am writing this at midnight - second midnight in a row when I am waiting for my neighboring room to get done with their film watching so I can sleep. After a long day at the slopes I have resigned myself to less than 7 hours of sleep AGAIN! I knocked on their door and requested a reduction of TV volume but realised that it wasn't that high in the first place. 
Safety concerns - swimming pool had a broken tile and a kid cut her finger badly in front of me...
The L'Occitane Spa was very average - the therapists didn't do such a great job - yes I gave them positive reviews at the time but came back to the room to a lower back pain that aggravated over the course of the night.
They're killing it because of the lack of competition but honestly the place needs to do more about "the experience".

reviews.author: SURAJ S
reviews.title: Suraj
reviews.text:
I stayed for 5 days, about the experience not that great. We paid under our nose.. Food quantity was less, for WiFi you guys have to pay ₹750 for two device for 24 hour where else in other Hotels you get  free Wi-Fi, Service is not up to the mark. Housekeeping boy came 15min late, when I asked him why so late.. He says..! I'm alone here to help that's why.. . From 5 star Resort we don't expect. Isn't it..!
No doubt, the Khyber has very good property in Gulmarg, good ambience but when it doesn't complement, it's a waste.. if they don't maintain the standard. 
Overall view from my end is do not blow your money in this resort and spa. Save your hard earned money and spend on productive work. 
Not happy at all 😕
Thanks

reviews.author: Krishan S
reviews.title: Below average stay
reviews.text: Poor service and response to complaints made our stay average in khyber resorts gurnard.  The check in took us good hour and a half as we were told the check in time is 2pm which wasn't told to us at time of booking. The service staff was always busy in service large groups leaving individual guests unattended many a times. The hotel had no bar & that came as a huge shock. Overall disappointed.

reviews.author: JADE-NY0079
reviews.title: Beautiful Hotel but NO BAR OR ALCOHOL!
reviews.text: The hotel setting is really idyllic and the rooms are very nice and spa excellent. The staff were friendly but seem more geared for domestic than international guests though and generally had only very rudimentary english language skills - with all due respect, as I have no Hindi or Urdu!  Notably, the hotel has NO BAR and NO ALCOHOL on the premises. It isn't a particularly festive or lively place, although the premises are lovely.  This came as a bit of shock.  The food was acceptable, especially given the very remote location. Wifi was reasonably reliable but not very fast - but that's not necessarily a bad thing in a place so remote and beautiful.  Very comfortable bed and room was warm when it was sub-zero outside!

reviews.author: sjaveri
reviews.title: Terrible service ruins a potentially magical stay in Gulmarg!
reviews.text:
Pros :

Stunning views, fantastic location near the Gulmarg gondola.
Exceptional health club and heated swimming pool
Very spacious and well decorated rooms with great central heating
Large breakfast and dinner buffet spread

Cons : 
Abysmal service, the worst i have experienced in a luxury hotel
Poorly maintained games room, no staff nearby to help and equipment missing or broken
No free WiFi
No taxi service unless you want to visit the airport only

This place could easily have been one of the best places to stay at all over India, there is an incredible amount of potential. However, the facilities (aside from the health club) are not well maintained at all. The snooker table has places where the cloth has torn, the table tennis table didn't have a ball that we could use. Their is a foosball table as well with a ball missing, and the air hockey table didn't have running electricity. They have some console games as well but those didn't work either. Upon calling someone to help us, we waited nearly 20 minutes and finally left. The staff was not particularly warm in general, we stayed in other places in Kashmir at half the cost and the staff was much nicer. The worst was when we wanted a taxi to take us down the mountain from Gulmarg to Tanmarg. The hotel informed us the only taxi available is to the airport and we cannot go anywhere else due to union issues. We had a flight to catch at Srinagar and we already had a car waiting to take us there, all we had to do was take a car from the hotel and descend down the mountain. After refusing to give us a taxi, we requested them to offer us a taxi to the gondola atleast where we could perhaps find another tourist taxi willing to take us down. Even that option was not entertained by their staff. Despite the poor weather conditions (-8 and snowing heavily), they probably expected us to walk on our own with our luggage down their hotel slope for 10-15 minutes and hope to get a taxi ourselves. Either that or pay 4000 for a taxi to the airport. When you stay at a luxury hotel, you don't expect to ever have to worry about these things, yet when something as basic as transportation cannot be provided, it's a real shame. Will not come here again.

reviews.author: ajay_satija7
reviews.title: Good hotel but need better staff trainning
reviews.text: We stayed in hotel khyber gulmarg. It a a new resort and good during winters. The attitude of the staff however is not nice. We were not allotted room for good one hour in spite of having a confirmed reservation and there was no apology. The rooms got too hot & in spite of several complaints the fault was not rectified. The room service is very slow and they took almost 1 hour for a sandwich to arrive. Better staff training required if they want to improve services.

reviews.author: ashisinghchd
reviews.title: Good hotel but highly overpriced
reviews.text: Khyber in gulmarg is good hotel in proximity with gandola. The rooms are nicely done up but the prices are very steep both for rooms and food. We almost paid close to 500$ per night with breakfast and dinner per couple. The hotel does not have a bar in spite of charging such steep rates therefore carry your own liquor. We went to see highlands park on our friends reccomendation and it has much better views as compared to khyber so yu can try that as it was resonably priced around 10k per night.

reviews.author: rohitgurgaonguy
reviews.title: Could have been much better
reviews.text: We recently stayed in Khyber resorts gulmarg and we rate our stay as average. The hotel is new & has god rooms but same cannot be said about their food and service. The food is very rich and in spite of putting a special request for light food we had lots of cream and rich gravies. The service also is slow. The views from the hotel could have been better. Overall average.

reviews.author: ASarkar
reviews.title: Discourteous Staff!
reviews.text:
I went to Khyber for afternoon tea. My plan was to return and stay at the hotel with my family in Dec 2015, during snow season. The infrastructure and decor of this hotel deserves a 5 star! Everything looks splendid. However, like mentioned in many of the other reviews, the behaviour of the staff really falls short of expectations. There are no clear instructions written about which areas/lounges are only for residents and what are their opening-closing timings. So we went to lounges, without being stopped by anyone (security or staff), only to be told very rudely later that we weren't suppose to do so. I understand that all hotels have their own rules, but if they don't let the guests know, how are we to guess? 

I have stayed in many hotels across different countries in the last 20 years. However, I haven't seen such discourteous staff before. If it wasn't for my friend, I don't think I would have stayed for my cup of tea (Kashmir khawa priced at INR 300 a cup). In hindsight, I shouldn't have. We were served without a smile. We paid with our credit cards, and there too the cashier was impolite. The only friendly person was the doorman at the main entrance. 

I don't think I want to come back to stay in a hotel that charges like INR 20,000 for a night, and yet treats its guests like it's doing us a favour!

reviews.author: navneetmaheshwari
reviews.title: Poor service and bad management
reviews.text:
no one gives information. Ordered coffee in the tea lounge and got after 45 mins.
This is the worst experience and hospitality i have received in the longest time.

Highly over rated hotel. Absolute lack of hospitality and service . Arrogant staff

reviews.author: IanP-SGP
reviews.title: Great hardware, weak software
reviews.text:
We spent 3 nights at this property in mid March.  Looks were deceiving.  We were delighted by the greeting at the grand, top of the hill entrance and swept into a comfortable lobby with a registration desk and an activities desk.  Perfect!  We wanted to ski, hike wander the area... so after check in, presented ourselves to the Activities desk.  We outlined our hopes enthusiastically.  Response: There are ski shops in the valley.  Gondola tickets? You'll need to queue.  Hiking choices?  Talk to a guide in the village.  And so on.  Disappointed, we weren't going to let the hands off approach cramp our holiday and did indeed manage to find, with much effort, the right stuff.  Why the hotel was unequipped to help was perplexing.

However, as we were now negotiating and settling directly with providers we were running through rupees at an alarming rate.  No problem.  Let's change some US$ or Euros at the desk.  Nope.  Response:  Too much paperwork.  You go to the bank in the village.  Doubly perplexed, we asked to see the manager on duty to understand if this was really the right answer for a hotel with aspirations.  Nope.  Response:  He's too busy.  Leave your room number.  We did.  He never called.

So the conclusion: Great location, brilliant surroundings, incompetent and indifferent staff.

reviews.author: Chandana S
reviews.title: A luxury resort with the most rude enviroment
reviews.text:
We stayed here for 3 days the staff right from booking the rooms and the spa and the room service... I couldn't understand how can they be so cold and arrogant.
We paid what they asked us and i guess we over payed for the service we got.
Its got the best location comfortable rooms comfortable approach and everything gets ruled out if the hospitality is worst. 
I wish they seriously look into this matter and do something about it.
We wish we could come back again but not for the same arrogance for sure

reviews.author: rksharmadelhi2015
reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: We stayed in Khybwer in Gulamrg but we wre disappointed with our stay. The hotel calls itsel;f a 5* deluxe property but does not have a Bar, the breakfast spread in average with no pork or ham. The views premier rooms are also average as compared to Highlands park which we happened to see during our visit. Overall a disappointing experience considering the amount they charge.

reviews.author: kalebjohn
reviews.title: Only a snow resort
reviews.text: Khyber gulmarg is a snow resort typically suited to skiers while we were there it did not snow and may be because of that we d not enjoy our stay. The hotel has average views infact we liked the views of Highlands park as much better. The food also is typical 5* food and heavy. We do not recommend khyber without snow.

reviews.author: amritadelhi
reviews.title: Khyber only if you a foreigner
reviews.text: We stayed in hotel Khyber resorts Gulmarg and during our stay we experienced that you are not treated equitant to what foreigners are. While we were in dinning there were 2 foreign groups, one from Europe and another far eastern, & all focus was on them and consequently our service was delayed and staff was not attentive to us. We want to remind the management that we probably paid as much as those foreign groups pay so why the discrimination. Be aware specially if you are going in winters when foreign groups come for skiing.

reviews.author: djlovestravel
reviews.title: Need train reservations staff better
reviews.text:
On the onset I must say that Khyber has been one of the places I have been desperately waiting to go to from the time it opened. Having found a 3 day window to do the same, I called the reservations no. that is mentioned on their website. A person called Masood spoke to me. I asked him for a 3 night package from the coming Monday onwards. He said its Rs 45,000. I asked if there has been any snow fall, he said not yet. So I asked (only once) if this is the best rate they can offer as its during weekdays & its not snowed yet (so skiing enthusiasts would be coming a bit later I presume) - his reply was a rudely stated line - "we are selling a property, not snow".
This was an extremely rude remark to hear from the representative of a SLH hotel. Asking for the best offer is a customers call; the hotel can provide the best rates they can. But in this process, basic decorum of speech & conduct should be maintained by the guest as well as the hotel's management. I would have even made a booking at the rate he had already quoted, had his reply been anything but what he said. You can just say that these are the best rates we have. 
And I must also state, that in properties like the Khyber - the natural surroundings is what people come for. You charge for the luxury & comfort you offer - which is fine - but I can get that in Wildflower Hall, Ananda or numerous other luxury hotels around India. I am not saying that your rate should be lower if it hasn't snowed - but the people selling it should remember that the guest who is coming is there as much for the nature as for the hotel. So in that regard - yes, you are selling the snow, the meadows, the fresh air - all of it! To my mind, this made his statement even more inappropriate.
I urge you to look into this as a management & training issue - please train him better is all I have to say. Don't reprimand his on basis of this, make him do better.
However, for right now - I will just stick to the Wildflower Hall or Ananda.

reviews.author: DelhiTraveller1979
reviews.title: Not as expected
reviews.text:
We went to gulmarg on a family vacation, and everyone in delhi was talking about this property called Khyber. Everyone we spoke to said we should stay in this property. With very high hopes we arrived at this grand looking building, and loved the scale. But soon we realised the various problems this property had. The luxury that the building expresses is not translated into the service or the management. While we were there, everyday there were fights at the reception about poor service, many guests complained about poor management. Food at the restaurant was average and basic beverages like coke took twenty minutes to arrive on the table. The staff seemed to be untrained but very courteous. The food was very very average and the Kashmiri food wasn't good.

We stayed in the base category rooms, and we had to change rooms do to could smell and lack of cleanliness. The rooms are a decent siZe and the bathrooms luxurious but the servicing of the room was poor. The toilets floor was dirty, one day there was no hot water and the guy who came to check put on the shower and walked in dirty wet shoes all over my room, the housekeeping guy who came to clean had a stinky mop making the whole room unliveable. After several complaints and me visiting the reception since no one on the phone seemed to be understanding the issue,  over two hours, I finally got hot water and managed the night but wet cleaning the floors myself to get rid of the foul smell.

Also ever time we opened our window since they didn't that there Ac plant running and it would get hot and stuffy in the room, we got a foul smell into the room. Also the entire hotel seems to have a lot of damp while the lifts and the staircases were dirty and not cleaned. But on the bright side, the spa services were fantastic. The spa staff is very good and my experience was relaxing .

Even if I disregard this experience as a bad experience anyone can have, the hotel is poorly located. The real charm of gulmarg is the rolling hills which can't be seen or experienced from Khyber. Also Khyber is planned in away that you are always looking inwards into the hotel grounds rather than out into gulmarg. 

If you really want to experience the heaven like beauty of gulmarg, Khyber isn't the place to stay until you want to climb down a very steep slope and go on a pony to the other side everyday to experience it. If you want to take a cab it's three hundred rupees just to get dropped one way. The hotel does not provide this service and they ask you to go to the parking and take a local cab.

Khyber as a hotel could be on any hill station and does not do justice to being located in gulmarg. 
If this property isn't managed well, it will start looking very run down in a few years, which is sad because the owner seems to have made it with a lot of passion and love.

reviews.author: RahulRampuria1977
reviews.title: Khyber - Not an enjoyable hotel
reviews.text:
I am currently staying at the hotel, and saddened with my stay, I am prompted to write a review on this property. 

There is an absolute lack of attention to service in the hotel, particularly in restaurant.

The buffet served here is average and I was surprised to find the same food being served in the afternoon and evening buffets. 

The lobbies stink and the wooden panelling around the staircase and corridors look worn down and archaic even though the hotel is barely 2  years old. 

The small coffee shop in the hotel closes at 8 pm, leaving no option for guests to sit down, relax and have something to drink at night.

I was also told by localites that the hotels flushes all it's waste into the river, which finds it's way through the villages. This has caused health problems among localities, I was informed. If this is true then the management should take a serious view on this matter.

Overall I would rate this hotel to be of 4 star grade with little attention to service and would request the management to improve the quality of service.

reviews.author: Qazi N
reviews.title: Naqeed
reviews.text: I went there is May , there was no valet parking, had to park self, no security, washroom was not clean, they don't serve good after 3 pm , just drinks n snacks,what if guests reach late to hotel, do they have to go out for food? It's a 5 star hotel so you need to provide all facilities

reviews.author: biswasss
reviews.title: Nice new hotel in bad location
reviews.text: Hotel khyber in Gulmarg is a new resort hotel with modern amenities though the hotel and is good but it has average service and below average location .The hotel is situation on one side of gandola and there is no where one can go for walk. There is hardly any views of gulmarg bowl. The hotel does not serve any liquor which was not informed to us at the time of booking. Overall a good hotel but in a place like gulmarg to need good views which hotels like Highland Park or Nedous hotel offer.

reviews.author: eskay1103
reviews.title: Poor service and extremely confused and grossly overpriced
reviews.text: Housekeeping gets done and towels are not replaced, one day you order tea it costs 340 Rs with two cups the next day it becomes 680 Rs ! Linen is not changed even though we stayed for 4 nights  - had to really push hard for getting a room with the mountain view - they take complete advantage of a monopoly like situation. Best to stay in Srinagar and do a day trip to Gulmarg. Easily Qualifies as the poorest hotel in terms of service, bathroom quality and fixtures, no air-conditioning and pathetic service.

reviews.author: Koolguy27
reviews.title: New hotel in average location
reviews.text: We recently stayed in Khyber Gulmarg based on tripadvisor reviews & our experience of the property is average mainly for it's location & vegetarian food which leaves a lot to be desired. The hotel is situated close to gondola but lacks views of Gulmarg basin, vegetarian food also lacks the variety & taste specially for Jains. The hotel is new but keeping into consideration the exorbitant rates they charge the hotel does not fulfil its promise of being a best resort in every respect.

reviews.author: Ferozgandhi
reviews.title: No views from hotel
reviews.text: We recently stayed in khyber gulmarg , though the hotel is new and good but the views from the hotel are average as you cannot see the gulmarg bowl open views. Highlands park which we went to check out offers the best views in town. Food specially for vegetarians is pretty average but service is god. Overall not recommended because of limited views the hotel offers.

reviews.author: jaidelhicantt
reviews.title: Best hotel in Gulmarg but with average views
reviews.text: Khyber gulmarg is probably the best hotel in gulmarg but the biggest drawback is that it offers very limited views as compared to highlands or nedous.hotel. We stayed in standard room and we payed 12k per night and the room offered view of trees and hotel compound and no view of gulmarg bowl. The hotel however has good heating facility and decent food but the food rates are on the higher side. There is no bar in the hotel which is not mentioned on their website.

reviews.author: rajatwal
reviews.title: New hotel in average location
reviews.text: Hotel khyber in gulmarg is a new property and we stayed after booking through our travel agent. We had a breakfast plan and we ordered a la carte for the main course, the food was good but exorbitantly priced specialty the vegetarian meals. The hotel and rooms are nice but the location is very average as some of the other hotels in gulmarg like nedous & highlands offer much better views. We were not informed by our agent that the hotel did not have a bar, that too after paying 17k per room, which ruined our holiday as besides gondola there's nothing else to do in gulmarg. An advice to management is either to open a bar or write that they do not have one on their website so that at least people can carry their own booze.

reviews.author: Shabnamgupta
reviews.title: Expensive for what it offers
reviews.text: We had heard great things about this new so called resort in gulmarg but we were disappointed for several reasons. Firstly they call themselves a mountain resort & spa but neither they are a resort nor they have a spa, there's not even a heated swimming pool. The hotel offers very average views of gulmarg bowl. The rooms though are nice and food is decent but overall they are too expensive for what they have to offer.

reviews.author: Stormsurgeon
reviews.title: Not so great Khyber Experience- it's a Tourist Trap!
reviews.text:
After a lovely stay at the Gurkha houseboats in Srinagar we headed to Gulmarg and checked into the Khyber and had reservations for 2 rooms - 5003 and 5005. The reservations were made a month in advance and Mr. Wajid was handling it for us. He also assured us that he would include one meal along with breakfast as part of our plan.  When we reached the hotel it was lunch time and we headed straight for the buffet area which is not in the restaurants but in a hall below with round tables that makes u feel that u are eating at someone's wedding reception. As soon as we picked up our plates (we were starving) we were told that ours was a CP plan and not an MAP as Wajid had promised us. We went to the Guest relations desk and spoke with Bilal and explained him the situation. He told us that Wajid had left the hotel for good and whatever commitment he had made could not be carried out by them. We asked him to clarify this with Wajid at his end, but he told us that he will get back to us. ( he never did - we had to call and ask him what was the update- which was negative) A commitment made by a hotel employee is the hotel's commitment as well. They should take responsibility and get things clarified at their end rather than make the Guest call the Reservations office and explain the whole scenario there and send mails etc of the communication. After all this they don't even have the courtesy of atleast informing us what the status is. The problem is a lunch / dinner buffet is a steep 1600 plus taxes. I feel it's extremely overpriced considering the limited buffet spread, ambience and service is concerned. For 6 of us it works out to be quite an amount ( especially when your mentally prepared that the deal includes breakfast and a meal) 
2. We asked the person who handled our check in if he could arrange our Gondola tickets ( he never got back to us ) - we met him the next day after we completed the ride and got only cold stares from him. 
3. The lifts do not work. Considering this is a 5 star property and a luxury hotel - this is the least that one can expect. I was with 2 kids and  I saw a lot of elderly guests having trouble climbing the innumerable stairs. 
4. We booked khyber with the hope that we could enjoy the spa and the indoor heated swimming pool. Their website prominently displays these facilities. However when we check in they tell us that the construction etc is complete but it will be commissioned in 15 days ( another disappointment )
5. The bars in both the rooms were empty - we called them to stock the bars - they never did. 
6. The flush in the toilet of 5005 didn't work - had to call them to rectify it. 
7. The drainage of the shower area was blocked and dirty, and water used to pool while taking a shower. (See pic) 
8. The shower apparatus was faulty and while taking a shower caused injury to my thumb. (See pic)
9. The fittings of the tub are so bad that they come out ( see pic ) 
10. The brown ball on the snooker table is missing - brought it to the notice - again - no response. ( it's not a big issue but I lost a close snooker game with another guest because of that ) 
11. Avoid the cold meats at the buffet - I had a glass particle in one of them and they look very stale and unappetizing. 

All in all, the khyber is the only 5 star in Gulmarg. So anyone who would like reasonable luxury and comfort would have no option but to book the khyber at its steep rates. However I feel that they need to improve on many aspects otherwise they would not do as well as they hope to do considering the poor service and customer feedback is concerned. On the plus side - the food is amazingly good and amazingly over priced as well. The steep climb to the property from the road below would make u struggle for breath no matter how fit u are and it would have been nice if there was a shuttle service ( I didn't ask them to provide me one - knowing the way they charge I would have had to pay more than a one way road trip to Srinagar !! 
Basically if u have the money to throw and can ignore the shortcomings - it's a good place to stay. Otherwise I hope that Koshy and his team buck up and improve otherwise a lot of prospective guests would be left disgruntled.

reviews.author: ajay35
reviews.title: Wasted effort
reviews.text:
We just returned back from Kashmir. We stayed at Khyber - Gulmarg for 1 night. The hotel has very tastefully done interiors my compliments to the interior designers. However other than this nothing is right with the place. The central heating in my room was not working. On complaining the service dept worked on it and was able to rectify the fault only after repeated attempts which meant service people moving into & out of my room repeatedly also showing that they don't have any SOP of regular maintenance. The room heater provided in lieu of central heating was of blower type and was noisy instead of noiseless oil filled radiator type.
Restaurant serves food of very ordinary grade compared to exorbitant prices
In spite of having informed that I was there for celebrating my Anniversary they made no attempt to make the day special for me instead I was given a room with lousy view instead of mountain view.
Mr Deepak who is in charge is a sweet man however seems to be bogged down with operational issues hence cannot devote time to take care of extras like doing something extra for a guest if he is there on a special occasion.
Would not like to stay there again until & unless they really improve.

reviews.author: kawalnain
reviews.title: Average
reviews.text: Thsi newly built property in Gulmarg certainly didn't live upto the hype it has created as it lacked in overall open views of Gulmarg bowl, service & food specially for our vegetarians frndz & their guest apprach which sems to be quite unfriendly. The spa was not operational & to top it all even after paying 20k a room they did not have a bar which a great let down for a so called 5 star resort hotel!

reviews.author: ms14_delhi
reviews.title: Avoid
reviews.text: When I entered the hotel, I was greeted by a lousy guard who was not willing to pull out the luggage from the boot of my car. This just set the tone of the entire experience at this hotel. The front desk staff conveniently told me that I should have given them a call from the toll point for them to arrange for someone to pull out the luggage. I had a taken the basic room that costed 20k. No airport transfers or breakfast is included in the room fares. The room was small, I would say congested for the price I was paying. The bathroom was cluttered as well with a really small bath tub. The only positive about the hotel was the interiors. The carpets, woodwork, blanket seemed to be authentic kashmiri stuff. The view from the hotel is pretty average. All you can see from the room is a few pine trees. All in all, a below average room size and outside room view for a luxury 5* tourist hotel. The service is even worse. The phone in my room was not working, so was the DTH connection, the mini-bar was empty and the safe locked. I asked for a toothbrush in the morning that arrived after 45minutes. A DVD player which is available in the hotel never arrived in my 3 days of stay even after I asked for it repeatedly. The service was really poor with the staff taking 40minutes to make up the room when they came 30 minutes after being called. In short, the service is disappointing to the say the least. The hotel is absolutely not worth the pice. Avoid if you dont want to spoil your holiday.

reviews.author: Gauri407
reviews.title: Unforgettable location, forgettable service
reviews.text:
The Khyber at Gulmarg is a beautifully designed hotel located most ideally facing the snow capped mountains on one side and the valley the other. The hotel itself is well designed in harmony with its surroundings. The rooms with a balcony over unparalleled views and should not be missed. Alas, if only the service was a match for the building.
We booked a room online through the hotel website for a two day stay. There are no options on the site for inclusion of meals or breakfast in the package so we thought we would get the details on arrival. Upon arrival, we were asked to pay for our first day of stay before we entered the room. 
So the plus points were the amazing location ( magnificent views) and the breakfast spread is both wide and scrumptious. 
On the desperately seeking improvement areas are the service and the infrastructure. 
Most importantly, on learning that there is a package which includes breakfast we went to the reception to request for it. Then we learned that the only people who knew about the packages were the ‘reservation people’ who were unavailable on phone but were on their way to speak to us. We waited for 10-15 mins after which we were told to go out and that they would call us. Upon our return in the evening, the same discussion took place. In the evening again we requested and again we were told that they were busy and that they had come to meet us when we had left. (This is the same person who told us to go and that the reservation person would call us). The details of the packages are available only to these people and the conditions on which you can switch from one to another depends on a ‘variety of reasons including mode of booking, time of booking, etc’. No apology was ever given for this behaviour. 
Also, while bathing, the water can move from warm to cool even without the power cuts. In a place like Gulmarg, this can be a bit problematic. The heating in the room on the first day took a good 3 hours to kick in. The turn down service which included water replenishments, etc. was offered only on the second day. The bathtub though beautifully designed was not cleaned during our two day stay. The food during lunch is okay and not a patch on breakfast. Even the traditional Kashmiri drink served on arrival is better at the market downstairs.
Given that the Khyber has positioned itself as a luxury hotel such quality of service was mildly shocking and even more so since it was running on 20-25% occupany during our stay.
Try and negotiate good rates for yourself if you plan to go sine the hotel is new and occupany is quite low.

reviews.author: Lucky Rana
reviews.title: Was a Loyal Returning Guest — Wasim from the Front Desk Staff & Poor Service Ended That Forever
reviews.text:
Our family has stayed at The Khyber Himalayan Resort & Spa several times over the years, and until now we had always considered it one of our favorite properties. We have previously left 5-star reviews and recommended it to friends and family. That is why our stay on June 18–19, 2026 (Room 4006) was particularly disappointing.

The first issue occurred during check-in. I arrived at 12:30 PM and was informed that my room would be ready within 30 minutes. Instead, I waited until 2:00 PM. During that time, I watched several guests who arrived after me receive their rooms much sooner. What was most disappointing was the complete lack of communication, explanation, or apology.

The restaurant experience was equally frustrating. Staff appeared focused almost entirely on large groups while individual tables received very little attention. Our food took approximately one hour to arrive, and after the initial order, nobody returned to take any additional requests. We had to actively search for staff ourselves.

The most disappointing interaction occurred at checkout with Wasim from the Front Desk Staff. When I provided honest feedback regarding the stay, there was no acknowledgment, concern, or attempt to understand the issues. Immediately afterward, I was informed that a glass water bottle from the room would incur a ₹500 charge. While I understand that hotel property may be chargeable, the fact that this was raised only after I voiced criticism created a very poor impression and made the interaction feel unnecessarily confrontational.

As a returning guest, I expected better service recovery, better communication, and greater professionalism. The property itself remains beautiful, but hospitality is defined by people, and unfortunately this stay fell far below the standards we had experienced in the past.

For verification purposes, I have attached my booking confirmation with this review.

reviews.author: Sunshine44237212705
reviews.title: How Was This Room Ever Cleared for Check-In?
reviews.text:
I rarely leave negative reviews, but this experience deserves to be highlighted.

We stayed at Khyber Resort, Gulmarg for two nights in March, expecting the standards one would associate with a luxury property. Unfortunately, our stay ended with a discovery that completely overshadowed the experience.

During checkout, we found a used condom underneath our bed. It clearly belonged to a previous guest and certainly not to us. The fact that it remained there throughout our stay indicates that the room had either not been properly cleaned or not properly inspected before being allocated to new guests.

This is not a minor housekeeping lapse. It is a serious hygiene failure that should never occur at any hotel, let alone one that positions itself as one of the finest luxury resorts in the region.

What is even more disappointing is the lack of accountability. We reported the matter, documented it with photographs, and expected at the very least an explanation or acknowledgement from the management. To date, no meaningful communication has been received regarding how such an incident could have occurred.

Luxury hospitality is built on trust. Guests trust that their room has been cleaned thoroughly and prepared to the highest standards. In our case, that trust was broken.

The views of Gulmarg were beautiful, but unfortunately the most memorable part of our stay was discovering something that should never have been present in a guest room in the first place.

reviews.author: S16A
reviews.title: Ultra poor experience
reviews.text:
It’s unfortunate that honest experiences quietly disappear while only the polished side remains visible. Reviews are meant to help people understand the full picture — both the good and the disappointing.

The property undeniably has breathtaking views, but luxury is not just about scenery. Service, professionalism, hygiene, and how guests are treated matter equally.

Sadly, it seems difficult to share an honest experience here without it being buried.

reviews.author: VishalDugar
reviews.title: Khyber You Gave Kashmir A Bad Name.     WISH THERE WAS AN OPTION TO GIVE A MINUS RATING.
reviews.text:
I would like to narrate the Horrifying Travel Experience i had with The Khyber (Gulmarg) with the timeline, so that all of you who are Reading the said review are able to Take an informed Decision on spending a lot of your hard earned money for which the arrogance of the Khyber Management  has no Value.  

Its me today who went through this Insinuation But It Could be You Tomorrow. 

Every Luxury  Property has to understand the importance of being Super Diligent and Not Negligent, its in the Hospitality, Service orientation is and should be the untold law and most basic factor expected  unlike treating their Paying Patrons as Guinea Pigs, and to make you understand that such Negligence is the last thing that was expected which resulted in the catastrophe for me, a ruined vacation on a special occasion, a permanent loss of business for the Property, due to such Bad vibes that i would probably never visit or if consulted would never recommend any informed Traveller   to visit the Khyber Ever  

The reason for the late review though my travel dates were 28th September 2025 to 1st October 2025 is that i was immediately taken unwell in Gulmarg after check in itself, the reason  was due to the extremely potent varnish used on the wood all through the property,  and it got lot worse later and i was  diagnosed for sever Macula Edema in the eye all due to the Chemical varnish that was applied to wood all through the property, the same led me to administer Heavy Oral Steroids along with an injection of steroid called Ozurdex in the eye and i sill haven’t completely recovered yet.  And the shame is that when i brought it to the  Management's notice, they accepted and said that it was a planned renovation, and  though i made the booking directly with the Property i was never informed about the same.  Its a mandate that if there is any planned renovation happening in the property all who are making a booking are duly informed and if the said renovation bothers the guest he or she can back out if its an inconvenience to them.   Which was not the case here at all.    

Time Line:

The One experience that had been on my bucket list as an Avid traveller who has experienced almost every Continent was  to visit (The Khyber at Gulmarg)since the day it came to existence, the lure of the location, the property, the  thought of Kashmiri Hospitality was much higher then visiting any European destination even and in a way WAS proud to think so. 

Our whole Visit was completely Khyber Centric and neither we had any plans nor did we venture out to any other place it was Airport to Khyber and Vice Versa, unfortunately my excitement was short lived.  

First the Positives:

Location:		Gulmarg and Khyber are Un Separable and no visitor ever visiting Gulmarg would not want to glimpse the Khyber if He or She isnt  staying there would and infact  Wish to be staying sometime in their lifespan as a Bucket list, such is the Aura of the property which offers Style, Brio, its Monolithic and Magnificent at the same time like no other property in Kashmir, wins your heart immediately.   Surrounded by the  The Imposing mountains of the Pir Panjal Range in the Himalayas, and nestled right in between  coniferous fir-laden forests, the Magical  property looks right out of a fairy tail book, much like a quaint Austrian or Swiss village Abit even better.  

Property: As mentioned place looks like a Fantasy, everything is superbly well laid out from the temperature controlled Swimming Pool, the well spread and amazingly well curated gardens, thoughtfully placed swings (facing the forests), seating areas, everything is perfect if the intent is to relax, detox and destress.

The Human Factor:	A little bit of a mixed bag but the people who were good need to be appreciated for the salvage they could try to do with the Broken Trip and the unwanted mess created during the stay:

Mr. Mohammed Rafi (who acted diligently and was humble all through my stay)
Mr. Owais (front desk, who tried to be as calm and welcoming he could be)
Mr. Arif (who on noticing the fiasco that happened the first night at dinner tried to make sure the breakfast was spot on, and its the only meal we had at the property, only breakfast for 2 nights)
Mr. Abdul (Our Driver for pick up and drop was actually the person who needs to be most appraised and appreciated  if i didn’t go by the hierarchy) he was a true saviour during the trip, mild mannered gentlemen to the core, who made sure that we could understand Kashmir through a very different lens, from a locals perspective)  

Everthing was down hill apart from the postives that i have mentioned above:

1.	Reservations:  I was coordinating with Mr. Goofran who asured me that sir the occupancy on the days of your  travel are really low and that if i booked the mid category room directly with the Hotel, the next  higher balcony category would be made available and that i cannot document this on email as others are in cc but rest be assured it will be done, i went on his word and transferred the said advance as asked by him directly to the Hotel and not through any online portal (who were offering a substantial discount of @ 7000 further more to what i paid the hotel directly, but i still chose to make the reservation directly with the property).  A few  days post making the reservations i called the property again and asked if i could make the balance payments at the hotel, Goofran  rudely told me No and instead asked me Why hasn’t the balance payments been made by yourself”, i reminded him that it was his duty to tell me when the balance payments need to be made and that too by text or call and not just email as emails tend to go to junk box, which was the case with me.
