Post making the payments i called the hotel a couple of times to speak to him i was only told that he has gone to the property and that he would call me back, but the truth was he had left the organization, the whole experience was very bizarre. 

2.	  No Point of time was i told there is NO AIR CONDITIONING by anyone including their  website, Khyber may be a ski resort (which i presume is but you have a good 6 months of warm weather and being on a higher altitude as cool as it gets in winters the sun rays come as hard and temperature of 24 degrees could easily feel like 30 plus  degrees (and im sure you guys dont shut down during summers right ??).  Which is what we experienced while check in, when our room was allocated, its only while in the Room Owais told us Sir there is no air conditioning and also the windows don’t open. We were getting baked in the room at @ 4.00 pm when we checked in.

3.	Brazen and Arrogant Attitude in The Human Factor:  Apart from the people i mentioned and appreciated above, people seemed cold and disinterested even, which in-fact should be Opposite to Kashmir as the hospitality here is legendary, this became most evident when alteast 4 different staff members whom i was interacted with, told me something that was shocking and each tried to be very obvious when they said “Sir what we are charging you for your stay is actually our per night rate” HOW DARE anyone say this to a Paying Guest?Patron, thats the most embarrassing thing i have heard in my years of travel experience India and Abroad and its Insinuating , i would rank this as the worst thing ever told to any guest and Kyber  should be embarrassed to the core, any business is about Demand and Supply and the economics of the price are based on that.   Its you who is offering the said price right and you are advertising the same with the intent to have guest back (and Rs 69000 for 3 nights is still not cheap), Today when a guest comes to Kashmir there is a sense of risk He or She associates and when they brave it given the innumerable options available in India even for hills (from Himachal Pradesh to Uttrakhand to the Beauty of North East) its the travelers way of saying to every one is Kashmir “We are with you as one and here to explain to the world that its Safe and the valley of Beauty, Wisdom is Open for all to experience with NO FEAR ….

4.	Something as simple as a Tax Invoice had to be followed for,  Its supposed to be a default thing right ? Its only when i wrote the email i was given the same (that too after more then a month) 

5.	Food is an Absolute Disaster barring Breakfast and more so if you are a Vegetarian:   The one paid meal we had was dinner on 28th September 2025 post which me and my wife  didn’t have a single meal in the Hotel cause of the bad  experience, cause the food was such a disaster, we were super exited for-the meal the first night presuming that atleast  the food wouldn’t go wrong in Kyber, we being vegetarians went on the staff recommendation and ordered Kashmiri Dum Aloo as a vegetable what was served was like piece of stone with gravy, Arif who was around understood the same and immediately acted and said sir leave it and he did take good care of us during breakfast the next 2 days. But just imagine this that a in-house guest did not have a single meal cause of the bad experience, the food was still billed to me and i still paid it.   

6.	NO Proper Information:  since check in no one would administer any information about what the property has to offer unless asked, this is a Resort and a Spa right ??  isn’t it as basic that when a guest is staying for 3 nights be informed about the property and more so when the guest has expressed a desire to host 20 couples later in the year and that this trip was more like a Recee (the same was mentioned in the email to the property and Goofran before i arrived), wouldn’t that be incentive enough for future business. I eventually landed up signing up another Luxury property in Himachal Pradesh the said Gm of the property  not only hosted me for 2 nights but also was Courteous enough to help me understand in person how the event could be held along with with Options such as a Picnic, Hike, special meals in different venues  and How the guests could be made to feel Special, thats what true Hospitality and leadership is all bout, understanding and valuing the Business of a guest.  Khyber has miles to go in that regards.  You could still proclaim to be the best but in my eyes and with my experience it would be sheer Arrogance.   Cause Khyber doest care and thats arrogance

6.	Treating your Paying Customers LIke Guinea Pigs:   If you have your property under renovation of any sort  its a mandate and your duty to inform the guest and more so if you are using any kind of a potent chemical like a varnish which can create major Pulmonary issues for your guests, i dont even know if thats legally permitted to so when you have resident guests, i had immediately documented the same the very next morning  as i had taken ill, and it got a lot worse to a point its only almost after a month that im recovering, and shuffling from mumbai to Chennai (multiple visits)  to see my Dr and get my self treated.

I Had  never asked for any Refund (which given my situation was my right to do so) and more so it would have been dignified from the properties end to do so, but instead i  am offered to come back to the same  place (at my cost of Airlines,cab etc) all at a special rate to a self proclaimed  “heaven on earth”

reviews.author: Divya Lenin
reviews.title: Extremely Misleading Property – Not Worth the Money!!!
reviews.text:
We booked the Luxury Balcony Gulmarg View Room at The Khyber for our 5th anniversary, and the experience was extremely disappointing. The so-called “Gulmarg view” is completely fake and misleading. Instead of the beautiful valley view shown on their website and travel platforms, all you actually get is a hut view. They have conveniently erased or hidden the real images everywhere, which clearly amounts to misrepresentation and cheating customers.

The hospitality is equally poor. The staff and management seem least bothered about guest concerns, offering no proper assistance or care. For a property that claims to be luxury, the service was far below basic expectations.

Another major disappointment is the swimming pool, which they overhype in every advertisement. Shockingly, it is only accessible from 12 pm to 9 pm, and guests are not allowed to use it in the morning. This is the first hotel we’ve ever seen with such pathetic and restrictive rules, making the whole facility pointless.

Overall, this property is not worth the money. Please look for better hotels in Gulmarg—don’t fall for the misleading pictures and promises. We truly regret choosing this place for our special occasion.

reviews.title: The So hyped Khyber
reviews.text: Most disgusting service, Poor Food quality and service. Hotel needs maintenance, badly needs to improve on food menu & Service.

reviews.author: Sowmith r
reviews.title: Khyber should allow booking amendments for medical situations
reviews.text:
Booking Dates
7-11 October 2024

I recently had a disappointing experience with Khyber. While I understand their policies, I felt let down by their lack of flexibility. Due to an unexpected health emergency, we had to request a cancellation or, at the very least, change of dates. But despite explaining the situation and providing all necessary documentation, the hotel refused to accommodate our request.

I am well aware of the non-refundable nature of the booking, but given the large sum of money involved, I had hoped for some level of understanding. Emergencies happen, and it’s unfortunate that in such a situation, the hotel’s response was strictly policy-driven, with no consideration for the circumstances.

It’s disappointing to see that a business prioritizes policy over the genuine difficulties of its guests, especially when significant amounts of money are at stake. I hope Khyber reevaluates how they handle such cases in the future, as a little empathy could go a long way.

We lost about 2.5 lakhs on this booking.

reviews.author: Inspire52831243043
reviews.title: Terrible - Avoid - Rude
reviews.text:
Terrible Experience at Khyber Himalayan Resort

Our stay at Khyber Himalayan Resort in Gulmarg on July 30-31, 2024, was nothing short of a disaster. The Chicken Biryani was excessively oily, overly spicy, and barely edible. The noodles were dry, lacking any vegetables, and equally disappointing. Despite our feedback, the manager dismissed our concerns with an indifferent attitude.

The issues didn’t end there. The resort’s indoor areas were unbearably hot due to the lack of air conditioning, and they refused to let us use the outdoor seating, which was covered despite the sunny weather. The staff's rudeness was palpable.

The situation worsened when my husband used the soaker tub in our room. The water was muddy and yellowish, and after draining, the room was flooded with dirty water. We were informed that the drainage was backing into the tub. Instead of taking responsibility, the staff and manager tried to cover up the issue. They offered us a neighbouring room, but with our original room filled with sewage water, that was the least they could do.

Although the Brava Restaurant provided improved service later in the evening, it felt like a superficial attempt to compensate for the day’s many failures. Overall, the experience was unacceptable, rude, and disappointing. I strongly advise against staying at this resort.

reviews.author: Deepak S
reviews.title: Overpriced, 3-star service
reviews.text:
Pretty bad experience

1. In restaurant, they don’t bring orders even after reminding them multiple times.

2. There is no way to adjust temperature as thermostats are locked. So you have no option to adjust them per your liking.

3. Staff is inattentive in general.

4. They don’t care about your comfort, we went there with an infant and requested a room asap. They allotted the room after taking their own time.

reviews.author: Hetal C
reviews.title: Watch out!! Appearance can b very deceptive
reviews.text:
Imagine walking into the only 5* property in Gulmarg & getting a cold welcome!! 

We entered the property wit 2 senior citizens - an infant 6 months old - a child 4.5 yrs old + 3 out of the 4 adults unwell - all of them struggling wit travel sickness, tired as hell Frm the 4 hr road travel Frm Pahalgam only to see a fully busy lobby & no one to even bother about ur presence there 
Versus the other properties where u r so warmly welcomed wit some associate help u settle down while they help u thru the checkin 

Post all the formalities, we were definitely given a table where they served the kawah while they handed over the rooms.. But also, We were just abt 20 mins late for Hi tea - but were outright refused the service. 

The rooms we got were @ ground level called level 5 wit a decent view - but the first thing u would see r the green Bob wires n not the scenic beauty as they r so in ur face . 
Also, u just cannot keep the curtains open to enjoy the views at any point of time as ppl walk around n there is zero privacy!! 
It was just another room wit zero view now. 

The hotel is so overbooked wit limited staff & Resturant space that it feels like a fish market. The tables r so close to each other tht u r literally looking into ur neighbours food & hearing their conversations - the waiters have to come so close to u n take ur order coz they can barely hear u.. 
plus since they r so under equipped to handle this kind of a crowd, beware if u order al-a-cart, the quality of food is just abt edible incase u r lucky!! 
We got unlucky wit undercooked rice & super spicy salad, dal wit barely a tadka flavour & buns that were dry & hard.. 

We also requested for an empty soup bowl to make the infant porridge- but they were so busy taking other orders tht I had to personally go and get the bowl while my child was crying wit hunger. 

The people in Kashmir in general r very sweet & helpful.. All the hotels we stayed in so far whether it was the Lalit in Srinagar or Radisson in Pehalgam, we were really welcomed n well taken care of .. it was like we must make a visit to Kashmir often not just for its beauty but also for its people, love & service.
But unfortunately Khyber can really change ur opinion, 

It’s our first day here n we can’t really wait to get outta this property!! 

I would think better to try another property - this is only over hyped as it’s the only available 5 start here.

reviews.author: Jyoti B
reviews.title: Very disappointed with Khyber & booking.com. Due to unforeseen medical condition I was unable to travel to the property
reviews.text: Very disappointed with Khyber & booking.com. Due to unforeseen medical condition I was unable to travel to the property. Had submitted due medical certificates and prescriptions to prove authenticity of my circumstance. despite that I received no support from the property. All we requested for was credit so we could travel at a later stage once recovered. We were well aware of the no refund policy and hence we requested for credit. When the amount is this high hotels/ booking portals should show some consideration towards their clients specially in circumstances like these

reviews.author: Relax64967420644

reviews.text: It's every shamefully behavior  I deal with last evening with me and with my colleagues  in Gulmarg at your property  that the security  saw me wearing pheran and they felt this will disturb them in restaurant  I was so upset at that same tike I was laughing  peoples judge my their clothes my colleagues  who were studying with me in London  were so surprised  like why I was stopped and they came halfway back thanks dear team khyberresort

reviews.author: Sightseer12546368284
reviews.title: Over Hyped Hotel, Terrible experience
reviews.text: This is an over hyped hotel. Over priced. Service is horrible to say the least. Food is terrible. Rude, totally unfriendly staff.  Chef does not know how to make an omelette also. There are many more properties in Gulmarg better than this place. Please avoid.

reviews.author: Farhat
reviews.title: Disgusting Experience
reviews.text: My recent visit to Hotel Khyber with my friends was highly disappointing. The staff's response to our inquiry about the bill charges was utterly unacceptable. Rather than providing a simple explanation, they astonishingly directed us to the high court, implying that the prices were dictated by a legal authority. This was not only frustrating but also bizarre. To make matters worse, the manager's (Shakir) behavior was completely absurd and unprofessional. Additionally, the food quality left much to be desired. The most egregious example was the exorbitant charge of 325 rupees for a single bottle of water that should have was priced at 125 rupees. This pricing discrepancy was unjustified and added to our overall negative experience

reviews.author: NorthStar56757419011
reviews.title: Poor Experience at Khyber
reviews.text:
Book For 2 nights
Checking in on 03/09/2023
Rooms are not maintained well, our room is #3005 housekeeping service is very poor, hair on bath tub, use water in tea kettle previous guest, tea cups dirty inside we shown housekeeping staff after that he clean, after that going for dinner at "Clove" no taste of foods, we informed your restaurant manager about the same, after having dinner we come back to room then saw in bathroom the face towels is from Radisson hotel really I shoked, what type of service Khyber give to the guest..till now this is my experience

reviews.author: jashankpohani
reviews.title: Summertime Sadness @ Khyber
reviews.text:
I've stayed in some bad hotels in my time, but the Khyber Hotel takes the cake. The rooms need AC or fans in the summers because Gulmarg gets hot in summers, but they didn't have any.

The food was overpriced and tasted like it had been microwaved. The service was slow and unfriendly, and the staff kept bringing us the wrong dishes. In fact, we would ask for things 5 times, and then someone would randomly ask “can I get you something else, sir?”. 

I would feel ripped off even if I paid half for the room. I would not recommend it to anyone, especially not in the summer.

reviews.author: Escorted Holidays
reviews.title: Very Bad experience
reviews.text:
I as a local travel agent registered by J&K tourism today try to visit the Khyber gulmarg with my business partner from Mumbai. I was not allowed by the security of the hotel to visit the hotel. They told me we were instructed by by their management not to allow local person. So, i waite outside hotel till my business partner came out. In the mean time I deleted the hotel publicity from my foreign clientele platform. It is useless to do the publicity of such hotel whose laws are different as compared to all over India hotels.

Thank you🙏

reviews.author: Brijesh V
reviews.title: Unapologetic / Arrogant = Khyber Managers
reviews.text:
Unapologetic / Arrogant = Khyber Managers

We recently stayed at Khyber. We had booked 2 nights at Khyber. But since same category of room wasnt available on MMT. We had to book 2 different room categories for 2 nights. Upon arrival we were told by the check in person (who's name I dont wish to add here) that you guys will be fine and you dont need to change the room tomorrow. We were either ways fine- as we had booked different room category and we didn't care much about it. 

Next day morning we went for Gondola level 1 and 2. Must add location of Khyber is great. So we left early at 9 am after our breakfast. After a long and hectic morning at gondola we returned back to our room to find that our room keys wouldn't work. So we had to walk back to reception to be told by another arrogant staff that they have changed our room. This was shocking and disappointing at same time not because room was changed but because for the first time in history of all travel we have done in indis and abroad, we had a hotel staff who had moved our open luggage to another room including some very important medicines without informing us. Had they had informed is a night in advance that they had made an error and indeed we did need to move room. We would have just kept our stuff packed & would have happily moved. The real issue was managers arrogance / unapologetic behaviour. He was not only arrogant but also pressurised his staff to lie about the fact that the person had indeed informed us that we will not need to change the room.  
Anyways- long story short. Great location, great property. Ofcourse exhobitant rates for same. But do not expect service/ hospitality of a 5 star standards of the likes of Vivanta Dal Lake or ITC at Pahalgam. This is a great hotel with below average managers running it. 

Sir, Umar Tramboo (@utramboo). Request you to look into this mismanagement and make Khyber service great again

reviews.author: charuratra
reviews.title: Awful Stay Experience!!
reviews.text:
Apparently wanted to write to GM. But you guys have not even put his email address on the site.

Started with a bad check-in experience where an hour before coming when I called the lady who answered, confirmed there is a hi-tea being served and will be there till 6pm. We reached at 5.40, asked where can we go for the hi-tea, the guy said there is no hi-tea and we must be mistaken, when told him that the female on the phone confirmed they said we can go and check the hi-tea area if we don’t believe. Kind of shocking how you guys talk to guests. Rather than apologising or arranging something you are saying go and check.

Next blunder was going for the Steam and Sauna. Area was not even clean and for the first time I couldn’t even take a shower and came to the room to take a shower as it was so dirty and wet everywhere. Steam was not even working even though temperature was 99 but it wasn’t effective at all. When told the lady she went inside the steam with her footwear’s. 

there were not even towels or bathrobes. The lady on the reception of Steam Sauna didn’t even bother to check or arrange. After asking for it she arranged it. 

Next was from the live pasta counter asked for a white sauce pasta and it came all cold, probably chef didn’t had enough time to cook it well. 

All in all doesn’t seems like this is one of the highest rated hotels in India. Probably just the location is the reason.

After staying with the best of the hotels in India, came with very high expectations but this is definitely not the place where customer service and quality of service exist.

Room No - 5004

all my friends were really dissatisfied & thought Money wasted @ this property.

reviews.author: Divyank
reviews.title: Unprofessional behaviour.

reviews.author: Manisha
reviews.title: Horrofic
reviews.text: Worst place ever - i tried to call to take a reservation in advance and they slammed the phone on my face saying I'm from a travel company. Just because you are highly rated, it doesn't mean that you treat people like crap! Never looking to be here. This is my first worst review - the way you treat people will get back at your hotel for sure!

reviews.author: priyankakandoi
reviews.title: Overpriced, overhyped & simply not worth it
reviews.text:
The thing about this infamous resort which is certainly overhyped is that they’ve managed to use the beautiful Gulmarg view of the snow-capped mountains and the pine & fir trees to their advantage. Take that away, and you’re left with any other mountain resort. In fact, I have stayed at better ones. 

During our check-in, we were told that we’d paid only for 2 guests whereas we were 3 adults. I assured them I’d paid for 3 guests and had to search for the email sent by MakeMyTrip to make them believe me. That was just a minor inconvenience and they more than made up for it by giving us a complimentary room upgrade for which we’re very thankful. But it made me wonder what the room I’d actually booked was like for around 30,000 + taxes because even the upgraded one wasn’t really out of the world. They are literally fleecing guests. Trust me, it’s not worth the money. 

If you’ve heard of the great Kashmiri hospitality, be prepared NOT to witness it here because the staff clearly isn’t bothered. During the breakfast buffet, it’s a maddening rush and they simply have no clue how to handle it. 
Suggestion: Assign one or two tables to one waiter. 
We asked around 5 different waiters for masala tea and still didn’t get a single cup for another twenty minutes or so. I saw a few guests quietly thrust a 100 rupee note into one of the waiter’s hands. Oh so maybe that is why we weren’t served properly because after paying a fortune, are we still expected to tip (or rather bribe) the waiters so that we are served well during our stay. The staff has this high and mighty air about themselves which is clearly not appealing at all. The only person worthy of praise is the ‘Big-Man’ as I’d like to call him since I forgot to make a note of his name. He’s the security in charge and extremely nice & friendly. 

The staff in the pool area were behaving quite strange. They didn’t seem too pleased to see us and nor were they very friendly or helpful in any way. All in all, I’d like to tell you that Khyber certainly is not worth the exorbitant amount they charge. So be careful before you go there all because of social media (which is totally a hoax) and fall prey to this overcharged mess, just the way we did.

-- 
Regards,
Priyanka Kandoi
+91 9800015069

reviews.author: Saurabh Agarwal R
reviews.title: 3 star
reviews.text:
Over rated hotel
Never stay
Staff is very rude
Restaurant staff is not trained , they not serve water after requesting 3 to 4 times
Staff dont know ,how to serve the food

Swimming area is very dirty 
Changing area is very dirty

I personally suggest dont pay, so many for this 3 star hotel

reviews.author: Akanksha
reviews.title: PATHETIC EXPERIENCE
reviews.text: My parents checked in on the 22nd of April and they booked a Gulmarg view room which was INR 50k per night.The stay was for 3nights and the view from the room was atrocious. All they could see was broken fence and garbage! For which they had to fight and argue and then they were upgraded to a Himalayan view room. And then the problem was still not resolved as the mattress wasn’t very comfortable,and the reason given was the rooms weren’t renovated since a long time. The breakfast was terrible and the hotel Khyber is OVER RATED and HYPED unnecessarily. My parents being senior citizen (50+) faced a lot of inconvenience shifting rooms..I expect compensation as the trip got more stressful rather than leisure. Would never ever recommend this hotel to anybody around me !!!! NOT WORTH IT !!!

reviews.author: Vicky G
reviews.title: Worst experience in the Leh-Kashmir trip.
reviews.text: Over Rated Property  and with the staffcwas very rude and not professional in there services.The resturant was very un-managed but one thing I can appreciate that after getting the complaint the GM and the head chef looked after that the remaining of our stay goes smoothly.The Male Changing Room near the pool needs lot of renovation.

reviews.author: Abhishek C
reviews.title: Horrible service
reviews.text:
My husband and I went for our anniversary. After much trying we got a reservation at the hotel and we were very excited to stay. The hotel indeed is beautiful but we were disappointed with our stay. Probably the hotel is overbooked but hospitality, cleanliness was horrid. 

1. The room heating was adjusted at 31 degrees. After feeling suffocated I called the reception and the man came after 3 hours to adjust it after repeatedly calling. We literally had to freeze to death as we were suffocated in our room. 

2. I came back after ski-ing and our room was apparently done but dirty wine glasses remained. Creamer was spilled and the bathroom was dirty. 

3. We booked a spa and they cancelled our reservation without informing us! This was ridiculous as we rushed back for the appointment from skiing. 

4. We requested for a private hot fire dinner and they kept diverting us from one person to the other.the dining restaurant get like a dorm mess during dinner with too many people and no COVID protocols. Food is over priced and takes long to come. I also waited for 30 mins for my dosa at breakfast, which ultimately didn’t come.

5. Next e come to the Shisha lounge and they tell us that Shisha’s are all over when again we had messaged and requested for it ! Again another one.. 

I kept trying to get kn touch with the manager but they kept diverting us from one perosn to the other. 

Why is the hotel overbooked if they can’t accommodate guests? If I’m paying this amount I would like the hotel to accommodate us on experiences. Otherwise I would have just stayed at Highland Park ! The hotel is overhyped and is monopolising being the only 5 star here. 

The best part of our Gulmarg experience was the 2 day skiing and the gondola. The local instructors and the tour guides are very sweet and click a lot of pictures for you. Yes amaing ones ! And there is Yaseen bhai who has a shop outside highland park hotel - he is an awesome tour guide. Do yourself a favour, save 35K a night and stay at Highland Park.

reviews.author: P_1015
reviews.title: Terrible experience, avoid at all costs!
reviews.text:
We had a really bad experience at The Khyber Resort. We paid an enormous amount and were treated so badly.

When we arrived at the hotel, there was a literary festival in progress. The hotel staff and the management were clearly differentiating between the VIP festival guests and ordinary guests like us - this poor experience continued throughout the day where we were just not treated well. 

The hotel guests were not wearing masks, and the hotel staff was not insisting on it. No COVID protocol was being followed because the entire lobby was packed with VIP Security and staff. 

The hotel did not inform us that of the 4 restaurants onsite, only one was available for the ‘non-festival’ guests. Absolutely no information was provided about this along with the booking. 

Further, though the pool is closed due to covid, the hotels Instagram account continuously advertises their pool facilities, misleading guests. And while they claim that this is due to COVID, no other COVID protocol is being followed here. Gym and spa are fully open - how is this safe? 

When we checked in, there were dirty dishes outside our room, which were only removed after three hours and that too when we called housekeeping. This is an appalling experience for guests. No one wants to see dirty dishes outside their room upon checkin! The staff were clearly not interested in anybody who wasn’t part of the VIP entourage. 

When we reached out to the hotel manager, he was dismissive rather than addressing our concerns. His response was - you should’ve told me sooner. Another manager called us on the phone and told us that he can’t do anything either. 

This is a terrible experience, there’s simply no point in staying in this hotel. They’re looting their guests. Good luck to you if you’re an ordinary guest and not a VIP.

reviews.author: Ashutosh Singh
reviews.title: Kyber the Crap resort
reviews.text:
There breakfast starts at 8 AM in the morning . However we wanted our breakfast at 7 AM because we had a flight to catch. We had informed the management about this in the night itself and they had promised us breakfast at 7 AM. However, once we went to the restaurant at 7:15 AM for breakfast, some lower staff behaved very rudely and asked us not to have breakfast before 8 AM. He said he has no information about early breakfast. Highly disappointed with Kyber.
Food is also mediocre , not a class like other 5 star resort spas. Guys working here are inexperienced and highly unprofessional , low in their behaviour . Not a Kashmiri pride at all. Please stay in some other resorts in Gulmarg . This kyber resort is not worth the money and connect. It is absolute crap.

reviews.author: Sahaj
reviews.title: Khyber is just overrated
reviews.text:
Myself Sahaj banthia, We have stated in your property on 20th august 2021 we have been to our honeymoon and we’re so excited to come to your property as we had heard Khyber is an experience itself, but unfortunately, we had the worst day in our 10 day trip at your premise. 
There was food concern twice, hair in paneer both in lunch and dinner. 
There were mosquito issues in the room in spite of requesting them twice no action was taken, then I have to write a complaint then was allotted a new room that was also having mosquito issues, despite having so much concern the person attending was saying “ sir yhea to Hoga, we can’t do anything “ 
We have paid a huge amount for the booking and mostly it was important as it was our honeymoon, and we were having so many hopes for your hospitality. 
But the fault is ours as we should not come with so many expectations.
Attaching you some videos and the compliant letter, please go through it. 
With a heavy heart, I have to post it to social media so that other couple who are coming for they honeymoon should not come with high hopes. 
Attaching you videos of two different rooms.

reviews.author: Sridhar
reviews.title: Bad hotel
reviews.text:
Highly over rated and defenetly not worth the price. Old fashioned hotel rooms need a serious make over and most importantly the food options are not in line with a hotel of this class.

Very disappointed poor service

reviews.author: Kalyan Reddy
reviews.title: Worst hospitality I have ever see
reviews.text: Worst hospitality ever till date I have seen , my 2 years old kid was taking a bath in tub the blind was about to fall on him my sister put her hand to stop the accident, I have called the manager name Mohammed to see what happened he was really arrogant and was blaming our 2 year old kid that he might have pulled it and I got angry then he started lying that he dint say that he blamed the baby , the whole experience was worst and accidents happens I understand by the the manager who behaved so was not the right thing, I will surely take an action on this and do what what so I can do. We came for my wife’s birthday which was totally disturbed and upset due to him ..

reviews.author: Akshata Patil
reviews.title: Worst experience!!!
reviews.text:
My husband and I had the misfortune of staying here on our honeymoon. During our stay, we encountered a number of unsatisfactory service.

First, it took more than an hour to check us in even though we had a confirmed reservation. Also, my friend sent an email to the hotel for timely checkin and we received confirmation for the same.
We waited from 2 PM to 3PM to get a room but we were just ignored.
There was no changing room available and we had to literally change in the lobby as we had to attend the skiing session.
Our luggage was simply thrown in the corner.
Second, after our tiring snow activity when we returned to the hotel, we went to the hot water pool.
We were informed that there was no swim wear available and that they were not sure if it will be available the next day too.
The changing room adjacent to the pool was all wet and messy.
No one available to clean the place.
We informed about the unsatisfactory service during checkout and the person attending us simply ignored it.

reviews.author: zorbathetraveller
reviews.title: Not worth you money at all - Pls read it before booking
reviews.text: The customer service is pathetic. The staff is very rude and not customer friendly. Food is also below average. Even street food in gulmurg is better than the food served in Khyber. In restaurants also services are very poor. You may find good reviews of this property but the problem is Khyber is taking advantage of no other big hotel in this area. If Hyatt Oberoi and Marriott are allowed to open their hotels here - no one will go and stay in this property. I contacted front desk staff Mr. Vishwas for the bill and he spoke in so rudely manner. Have stayed in so many 5 stars in India as well as abroad but never experienced such pathetic cuatomer service ever. The force of showed was dead slow - we complained at the front desk but no one bothered to come and check. There was a continuous bad smell outside room and told the room service staff also many a times but no one did anything. Food taste was the worst. Pls avoid booking this property if u want to have a memorable experience of your trip.

reviews.author: jaswinder s
reviews.title: Not worth
reviews.text:
Worst experience in ever had in any hotel. 
Gulmarg is a beautiful place and if u want to book a hotel book any hotel other than Khyber. Don't go for the scenic beauty around the hotel. It's every where in Gulmarg. i would request to book any hotel for 2-3K instead of wasting ur 17K just for the scenic beauty because the food tastes very bad. Seriously guys worst food I have ever tasted. I stayed in Khyber for 3 days and I would like to mention the menu
1. Noodles ( breakfast, lunch and dinner)
2. Dosa ( breakfast, everyday)
3. Pasta( breakfast, lunch and dinner) 
4. Idly (breakfast, everyday)
Worst food and worst services.
I requested the staff to clear the path which was blocked due to heavy snow fall however even after 45 mins the path was not cleared and then I went to the parking lot myself and tried  to clear the snow but failed since it was too much. Then I had to request the manager.
When I checked into the hotel I was told that hot swimming pool and the pool table r open but when u went to use the services I was told they r not.
I wanted to rate the hotel ZERO but I have to give atleast a star.It's the most pethetic hotel I have ever been to.

reviews.author: Ronald H
reviews.title: Overcharged my credit card
reviews.text:
This hotel has a terrible customer service. They overcharged my credit card and it has been 6 months now that I’m fighting hard to get the money they took from me. I saw I’m not the only one, few clients are also waiting for refund from them since many months. No customers should ever experienced this kind of issue. 
They’re avoiding my emails and any communication.
It’s such a disgrace.

reviews.author: Prem
reviews.title: Absolutely appalling customer service
reviews.text:
I’d book a stay for 3 nights in JAN and due to excess snow we had to cancel our trip since the flights were cancelled to Srinagar. 
I requested for a refund and it’s been two months to date the hotel staff including the accounting team has been giving vague reasons for not refunding the amount. The latest one being, they’re short of cash as they had to pay other vendors. It’s been two months+ and am still chasing them.

reviews.author: Mohit B
reviews.title: Ignorant, rude and disrespectful Mr......!!
reviews.text:
We contacted khyber Himalayan resort for a two day visit on 27 and 28 dec 2019 for 6 pax , 3 rooms and asked if they can offer us some discounts on their base online price! We were shocked with the rude behavior of the sales manager who rudely refused any discounts and rather hung up the phone saying # I have something more productive than talking to you at the moment#!! 

The hotel industry runs on the courtesy extended to their guests or prospective guests and they should treat all of them equally! But this man representing khyber is making everyone hate this place! This attitude shall shatter the business of the hotel completely slowly and steadily! 

Such individuals should be demoted of their jobs because their attitude is highly unprofessional demeaning attitude!

reviews.author: Maria K
reviews.title: Pretentious and unfriendly
reviews.text: The hotel interior and setting is nice but the service is not good and watch out for out of date food. It took 3 attempts to find jam that was not out of date! Also, if you are not resident they ask for 2500 rupees extra to get a massage, that is on the top of the massage price.

reviews.author: Ro P
reviews.title: Unreasonable
reviews.text:
We had booked this hotel when we were visiting India.  About 4 days before we were suppose to visit - there was a terrorist attack in the area where 40+ people died.  With this place being on the no visit list - we tried to cancel our reservations.  The hotel was so unreasonable that they used the no-refund policy on us at that point.  I understand if we were trying to cancel a reservation for personal reasons but this is something that was out of our control.  The hotel won’t acknowledge that there is a curfew there with 350,000 active troops there.  What kind of social self awareness is this?? They want us to still come to the war zone and stay at their hotel?? 

The ridiculousness of this is that when we were calling their employees weren’t in at work at times due to the curfew and military in town!! I just had high expections from a hotel like this.

I don’t think I would ever stay here again!

reviews.author: KS Madhusudan
reviews.title: Poor Service.
reviews.text: I tried booking this Hotel over phone / email from Bangalore 6 months ago.  Literally no one in the hotel responds properly & it is EXTREMELY EXPENSIVE; more than any other Hotel in Srinagar - I cross-checked tariff and service of other Star Hotels and this was my worst experience - DO NOT RECOMMEND IT TO ANYONE; as no person in reservations or front office wish to take any responsibility for guest booking - they were literally dodging each time I made a phone call to them; hence I stayed @ Radisson, Srinagar for 3 nights, which was value for money.

reviews.author: tusharcool20
reviews.title: Rude behaviour
reviews.text: I'll keep it small just like their shallow  personalities & mentality. The staff is Extremely high headed, very rude & full of attitude. DO NOT MAKE THE MISTAKE OF COMING HERE LIKE I DID. Now let me finish the minimum characters required for this post.

reviews.author: Sheikh M
reviews.title: Highly highly overrated utterly disappointed
reviews.text:
At first let me humbly apologise to those who thinks it’s a great property and worth spending 400-500 usd per night in this hotel.
To my opinion it’s a sheer wastage of money. When we step in to a expensive resort we expect service we expect facility we expect good food and good location.
I didn’t see any of these in this hotel apart from a very good location. Only good thing about this hotel is location but if you add on sloppy and slow service poor buffet spread and poor service the upside of a good location flows through your window.
At first let me tell you one by one my experience :
1. Check in. It took an hour to check in .... it’s not that our room was not ready ( we were not informed on that as a cause of delay in check in) we were in the lobby for more than an house before we came to know our room number .
2. Room TV connection was not there when we check in. We had to call few times the service man to fix TV connection.
3. WiFi is poor and slow and it also took more than an hour to fix the WiFi for me . Initially the way I was explained with pass word and ID , I could not log in to my WiFi devise with that password .
3. After paying that huge amount of money per night if you are advised that only two devises are free to use WiFi and more than two device is chargeable then you got a shock. In a family you have multiple device that needs WiFi and surely that more than two.
4. When I booked I mentioned in my booking on booking.com that we will stay with our 10 years old daughter but don’t need any extra bed. This hotel charged us 
USD 60 for my daughter irrespective whether I take any extra bed or not . Trust me no where I faced such and I am sure by now my trip advisor friends noticed that I do Travel a lot and I have never faced this else where.
5. Next morning we went to buffet bfast and the spread was very poor and the only non veg item in that buffet is chicken nuggets and egg which to my expense is poor and when I mentioned this to one of the restaurant guy he seem very reluctant to listen to his and acted like this is it .... take or leave it :(

My opinion is if anyone wants to waste money can surely pick this hotel or else with one night price of this hotel you can have a fantastic stay in gulmarg one night with a good hotel .... food in top rated trip advisor restaurants .... gondola ride with ATR for a family of 4 :)

So it’s your pick whether you spend that money in this hotel for one night or spend that money t have fun in gulmarg for a day with all inclusive.

My rating is based on the return against the price we paid for our stay.

reviews.author: Sharad99
reviews.title: Naysayers
reviews.text:
When I entered the resort I was full of expectations about it. As far as creation of physical infrastructure is concerned undoubtedly they have done a marvelous job. However service and attitude mars every thing. Since we were carrying two suitcases I asked for a stand in the room so that my wife who is suffering from back pain can manage. But the person keeping the luggage didn't turn up with any yes or no. I liked Rajma Rice of a dhaba on the way so I carried it. I requested them to heat it they refused. I went to swimming pool there I asked a person sitting on chair to take mine and my wife's photo he said they are not allowed. In the evening I was interested in having hukka and
 paneer tikka along with some mock tails while my  son was interested in having pizza. I asked them to serve pizza in the lounge as restaurants were about to close in an hour and all of us can sit in one place and have food of our choice but again to my horror and surprise they refused. Both the restaurants were only a few metres away. My son wanted to play with Xbox console but they were having only one unpopular CD. Overall entire staff is anti guest and specialises in saying no. After paying hefty prices this was not what we expected as we have stayed in some of the finest properties of the world including some Oberoi group properties where they go out of the way to pamper the guests.

reviews.author: Abhishekduta
reviews.title: Service is appaling
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Khyber for 2 nights. The property is beautiful especially the heated pool. Its get crowded at time but you can still enjoy. the location of the hotel is also good, only 5 minutes walk from the hotel is the Gandola. However everything is a let down due to the poor service offered by the staff (only at restaurant). They are extremely rude. 
The food is also average and overly priced.

reviews.author: abdullahs682
reviews.title: Totally not worth it 😔
reviews.text:
Overrated 
Overpriced 
Pathetic food
No value for money 
Thermostats were not synchronised 
The room didn’t have a proper view, it was mostly blocked wen asked for a change they didn’t cooperate and asked for more money lol..
Very disappointed 
Felt like a waste of a hefty amount of money
Won’t advise at all
Gulmarg is beautiful though 🙂

reviews.author: Rajesh Mohan 68
reviews.title: Too expensive
reviews.text:
They say “Get enchanted by the Heaven in Heaven. The Khyber is one of the best luxury resort in Gulmarg, Srinagar” They must add its most expensive too ! 
Dined @ Chaikash a space for chais, coffees, tisanes and kahwah. Ordered finger food, and tea & the bill was astronomical. The ambience was great though

reviews.author: Panks_29
reviews.title: Quality deteriorated from what heard and expected
reviews.text:
I was with my family and friends with small kids when i visited Khyber in April 2017. At the very outset, they gave us rooms which were far off the reception and dining area. We had to use elevators twice and we (especially our kids) had a hard time to go to room and come to dining area at regular frequency. Swimming pool was even far and it took ages to reach there. When requested, they informed us that all the rooms are booked which was not the case.

On the next day, room was not cleaned properly at all. 
(1) Towels were lying on the chair.
(2) Dust bin was not emptied.
(3) Drinking water was not kept.
(4) Glasses and spoons were not washed.
(5) Soap, shampoo conditioner were not replaced.

On issuing a feedback form, they informed us that it will not happen the next time when we come. As if, we will travel again, the next time.

reviews.author: Vrinda G
reviews.title: It's a tourist trap. Avoid
reviews.text:
Value for money - not worth Rs 23,000 per night. This is what I paid in April 2017. This is a 5 star hotel but they do not operate by the ethos of a 5 star property. It would be better stay at a 2-3 star hotel and not expect any service than staying here and paying more than 5x and still not having your expectations met. The hotel operates 'by its rule book' which has no mention of giving a 'wow experience' and therefore the hotel staff is totally unaware of it. For everything else they will point to their website or other sources for not accommodating you.

Food - Most of it is pre-cooked stuff that they source from outside. So they can't customize a lot of things. A 5 star usually gets everything made in house. Second, I asked for a Kashmiri dish to be served in my room. They refused to do so because it was not in their in-room menu. Other 5 star hotels would routinely do this for you. However they did serve me a masala chai free of charge on the last morning. Thank u for that. 

Alcohol - only 1 hotel serves alcohol in gulmarg. The hotel did not inform me. I spoke to a person (Irshad Ahmad and his colleague Rasheed) to find out about setting up a private dinner for us few days before traveling to Kashmir. We spoke about wine etc, but he didn't mention this even once. Upon reaching when I found out that this hotel doesn't sell alcohol, I asked him that why didn't he inform me about this? His reply was that it's written on our website. I haven't been able to locate where on the website do they mention this. 

Customer service - at the time of check out, they pointed out that one of the towels has henna stains. I put herbal henna in my hair, which sometimes leaves stains. These stains are 100% removable. They charged me extra 1500 rupees for that towel. I paid it but my problem with this behavior is when they charge Rs 23,000 a night, wouldn't such wear and tear be built into their rates? Do they charge other guests when some one drops a glass or a plate? It's just as simple as looking for an opportunity to fleece another Rs 1500. I have stayed at many 5 star properties but no one ever in my life has done this. 

Mr Abhishek (the manager) hung up on me when I told him this. I accept that I was agitated with this entire episode. But hanging up on a customer shows that they don't care about what you have to say. The hotel is doing well and they don't need repeat customers. I wouldn't be surprised to see a defensive response to this review telling me how they did everything right and I was an over demanding customer.

I paid close Rs 100,000 for 3 days including food etc at this hotel. I deserved better treatment.

reviews.author: Deepika1973
reviews.title: Disgusting
reviews.text: Since we had good experience at Khyber,,we decided to go there again but we came back deciding,,never again to khyber after such a bitter experience,, the most disgusting policy of not dropping back their customers to gulmarg city since they are located on a height,,we came down carrying our suitcases after a heavy snowfall with our daughter also bearing the grunt..most discourteous and horrible experience ever.. Friends go there only if you are ready to carry your own baggages in a property like KHYBER..

reviews.author: Rashi R
reviews.title: Disappointing ! Annoying ! Waste of money !
reviews.text:
When I made my booking for KHYBER resort, I was extremely hopeful and looking foward to an experience of a lifetime. Needless to say the 2day stay costed us a whopping amount, yet even receiving an advance warning from my friends and relatives I continued to take my chances.
At the time of check in i was extremely delighted to know that we had been upgraded to the Himalayan balcony view room, and I was very thankful to the reception staff for this gesture.It was only later that I got to know the upgrade was the effort of our dear family friend Mushtaq Bhat, who continues to recieve 'best performance award' as a travel agent from the hotel during every assisment. Contrary to this, the extremely arrogant and disrespectful manager had the audacity to stop Mushtaq Bhai from entering the hotel premises. My mother was very upset by this behaviour recieved from the reception manager and even threatened to cancel our entire booking at that moment. The reception staff assumed that we were escorting our guest Mushtaq Bhai to our room and they objected due to this reason. This was very absurd and totally non acceptable. We had booked our entire trip through Mushtaq Bhai and are extremely thankful to him.From this point on followed a series thorough disappointments.
1. After paying 60,000 for 2 night stay at the property , we are charged 700 rs / day for wifi ! Are you kidding me ! Such a shame on the hotel !
2. The pool overlooking the Himalayas , proclaimed to be one of the countries best , is not function due to some unending repair activity ! Disappointing once again.
3. On my second day at KHYBER , I decided to use the Gymnasium. I enthusiastically put on my gym wear and headed to the gymnasium which looked well equipped in terms of the machines , only to discover that I would choke to death if I continued to work out in the presence of the hot air pumped into the gym, and a temperature of 24degrees being maintained by the staff of the spa! I repeatedly requested the staff to switch On the A/C, and they kept assuring me that they were in the process of doing the same all through my work out!
Agitated this time ! 
4. These guys should set a record for the worst room service ever ! Period !
5. The F&B staff was very arrogant and cold. The seemed to be extremely disinterested except for one girl from the staff, who was more diligent as compared to the entire hotel staff put together. 
Special service was provided to the big groups, I guess they are ones who leave behind a whooping tip as well. The F&B staff did not even care to refill servings that were finished, even after we repeatidly requested. I don't think the staff understands the meaning of a 5 star hotel in the first case !
6. We visited the hotel in July and needless to say there was no provision for ventilation in the rooms. It was hot in the days, and warm in the nights ( pleasant outside )
Now this is really mysterious whether the hotel has air conditioning services of not! At the time of check in we asked at the reception and were turned down saying tha hotel doesn't offer this service get! However the room service staff offered to switch on the same upon on a special request , but I guess he was later thrashed by the staff to revealing this secret! We continued to suffer in the heat. In the remaining 2 days, we were utterly confused as half of the staff proclaimed that the AC was deliberately switched off by the hotel authorities and the other half said that this service was yet not available at the hotel.
We felt extremely cheated!
If I am asked to summarise my stay at KHYBER resort , I would simply compare it to that fancy gift wrapped box, which is stuffed which newspaper from the inside!
Guys if you think you have too much money to make a booking with this resort I think you rather make a donation instead , atleast that would earn you some blessings!

reviews.author: sharan1988
reviews.title: Complete let down
reviews.text: I spent 3 days (june 23-26 2016) at Kyber and for all its hype its a complete let down. The day we took our room the heaters wasn't working had to make couple of calls for them to rectify it , the paint from the bathroom ceiling was flaking off, cracked marble at many places,loose hand shower that kept falling and when my wife got here toe cut when she went for a swim there was a piece of glass in the swimming pool (took pictures for record) and the hotel staff nor the useless General Manager of the hotel had the courtesy to ask how she was. I had a word with the General Manager - Vinit Kumar Chhabra was not very helpful and was the most useless of the GM i have seen. After having been paid so much of money just to experience the hotel which has been by far the worst in hospitality. And i don't even want to start talking about the breakfast which was tasteless and insipid .

reviews.author: hakothari
reviews.title: Most pathetic 5 star property ever witnessed, deserves to be called one star property
reviews.text:
We booked 3 premier rooms through agent(Dastan Travels) for check in on 29th June 16 and check out on 30th June 16 (3 couples and one infant). I would like to take all the readers through disaster experience at so called 5 star property Khyber so that you will think twice before emptying your pockets for their pathetic services.

We were highly disappointed to know on 28th june evening that we will not be able to use heated pool(highlight of the property) as the same has undergone maintenance w.e.f 29th June till 10th July. To be noted they did not give any prior intimation to agent/ us about the same and we got to know through their website.

Check in experience was even worse than a 1 star property. We reached hotel lobby at 11.45 am and infant traveling with us was quite unwell and restless because of health issue.They assured us of best rooms asap. At 2.30 pm after almost all the guests got their check in done, they took us to the left over rooms which they allotted to us(room no. 5011, 5012, 5014). To our surprise, they allotted room with twin size beds to 2 couples and when we objected, they simply said they did not realise it and apologised. 
Next they gave us room 4001, 4003 and 4006. Room 4001 and 4003 had car parking of the hotel as room view. We had no choice as all other rooms were given to their preferred customers. We were utterly depressed to realise we have paid approx INR 20,000 for such a room. Obviously there was zero privacy level and trespassers could easily peep in the room so you cannot pull off the curtains at any point of time. Room 4006 had no view at all and all one could see was hotel property and adjacent cottages so we denied taking that room. 

They again shifted 3rd couple back to room 5011 and said this is all we can give you so we compromised with a room view of iron wires and wooden rods and cursed ourselves to waste INR 20,000 on such a property. There was only a slight glimpse of Himalayas which is the USP of the khyber property. By the time we got settled, it was 3.30 pm(took more than 3 hrs just to check in) and lunch time was over for us so we dint had lunch because of all the hassles faced.
Finally at 6 pm we could have first meal of the day and it seemed really delicious as we all were hungry to the core.
We had a one to one meeting with Mr. Vineet Chhabra(Hotel manager in charge) and explained him about each and everything we faced. He just nodded to us and accepted everything and kept apologising. He offered us complementary dinner and assured us that we will not face any further trouble. Dinner experience was good enough and food was the only good thing about Khyber.
Next day we checked out at 11.30 and asked them to keep our luggage in cloak room as we were proceeding to Gondola. When we came back to take our luggage, we were shocked and taken aback to see the way our luggage was literally thrown out of the hotel and they justified they have no empty space in cloak room. They placed a 20 kg suitcase over my hat and another 15kg bag over eatables.In addition we also experienced below mentioned issues:
 - Since the rooms had no AC, because of suffocation, we ultimately had to ask hotel guys to put a fan in our room at night 1.30 am
 - There was water leakage in room 4003. 
 - Phone provided in room 5011 was not working and had to be repaired.
 - Whenever any housekeeping/ cleaning/any other assistance was required, it was not a very prompt one, it took atleast 20 mins for someone to come and do the needful may be because rooms are very widely spread across the property.
 - There was absolutely no co ordination among the people representing the hotel.

So all in all it was a total money waste for us and we had the worst stay ever at any 5 star property. Not at all recommended.Pathetic service and below average room views.

If inspite of all the above issues, one still wishes to stay at Khyber, do so at your own risk as hotel guys are not trained to make your stay memorable.

reviews.author: AmanDayal
reviews.title: Good Property, Poor Managment
reviews.text:
The property is nice but suffers in service and extremely poor management. The staff and management lack the drive to make your stay comfortable. For the room tariff, the experience is a couple of notches lower. The stay is as good as a budget hotel, but for the location and infrastructure. The property has central heating only in rooms and becomes stuffy and suffocating to dwell in the summer months.

The reception staff is no better than of a travel lodge and the senior management is pretty impotent in getting anything done or at the least have decency to respond to a resident guest for any discomfort. Any requests/complaints go down a rabbit hole.

The Restaurant staff is amateur too. They are disorganized and all over the place. The buffet will cost a good $25-$30 (Rs. 1600) but the food selection is worth $2 (Rs. 100-120). If only anyone cared to review any suggestions/feedback.

The Chaikaksh (Coffee shop) is a decent place to hang around for a cup of tea/coffee and enjoy the Himalayan view. The server/manager there may be the cordial staff at the Khyber Gulmarg property.

This property enjoys the monopoly advantage in Gulmarg, since there are no other hotels in vicinity that offer so many amenities. But it is a real disappointment if you are looking for luxury and fun. The staff and service is just too unpleasant an experience. A real let down by the renowned Khyber Group.

Go stay there since you don't really have a choice of place in Gulmarg but the experience is no better than that of a clean Budget Hotel.

reviews.author: DELHIGURU
reviews.title: OVER RATED BUT NO OTHER CHOICE
reviews.text: Ok, I stay in the best hotels of the world but I am not at all fussy. I take most hotels in good stride. Being a road warrior, I am in hotels across the globe more than 150 nights a year. I was very excited about my first trip to Kashmir and my initial stay was at the Taj Vivanta in Srinagr which was excellent (would hopefully write a separate review abt that). Anyway, expectations were high about Khyber. Excellent, mind boggling, wow were some of the superlatives which I heard from people about this property. Well, anything but that. Heaven forbid you are not in their deluxe wing but in the premium wing. Congrats if you are because you can hear everything what your neighbors are talking about, from going to the loo to what time does breakfast end. Every word. We saw "comedy nights with Kapil" without even switching on our own TV. So, what these guys have done is build a brick wall of one brick and ensured you can hear every word, every loud f&&& which happens in both the corridor outside your room and in your neighbor's room. Ok, given they have built a hotel in one of the world's most beautiful places which would have been rough terrain to build a hotel but still, no excuses for the rates they were charging us. If hearing your neighbors talk about their loo habits was not bad enough, the nauseating smell in the corridors would kill you. Seriously. Bad bad bad smell in all corridors and attempted to cover it  up with "Ittar" fragrance, especially again in the lower premium room corridors. It was the worst smell and that is what will hit you the moment you enter the hotel. The third aspect of my review is the funniest and most dangerous. I twist the knob of my rain shower and boom, I get an electric shock through the handle. I thought I imagined it. I turn down the water pressure and boom again, another mild electric shock. Yes it was fixed after my complaint but still that was quite a first. Couple of other peculiar points :- the hotel does not have enough cars of its own to cater to all the guests. In the cigar room, cigars and sheeshas are allowed but no ciggies!!!!!!!! Breakfast buffets was bad. Bad in taste and bland.  Very claustrophobic hotel. The problem is there is no other hotel in Gulmarg, with Highland park gone down the drain over time (the old Kashmir travelers still speak so nostalgically about it but alas, it's finished... Went there for a drink and promptly walked out... It seemed they had not changed the curtains in 50 years)..... So, for all delhiites and bombayiites used to the luxuries of their Oberoi and taj hotels, you will find this property very very disappointing....at most a 3 star property... In my books, not even that... Oh yes, some of the staff was very helpful and that was a plus....gulmarg was amazing and it snowed when we ushered in 2014.... So the electric shocks, smells, bad breakfast buffets were all forgotten in the chill and thrill of awesome snow falling from the heavens :). Forgot to mention, no bar in the hotel and it does not serve any alcohol so BYOB people and there is no liquor shop in Gulmarg

reviews.author: Ramesh Hemrajani
reviews.title: PATHETIC,DISASTROUS & A HORRIBLE EXPERIENCE
reviews.text:
I am a travel agent from Delhi who has been running the Travel agency for the past 14 years servicing high end customers and dealing with the best 5 star hotels. Luxury is our forte.
Here under is the description of the biggest mistake of booking a self proclaimed 5 star hotel called THE KHYBER GULMARG
 
We have been to the best 5 stars hotels and resorts worldwide and have an idea of the service standards, maintenance and the hospitality that a 5 star hotel should be. The Management and Staff at Khyber should really be ashamed of themselves, and we as travel agents need to make sure that we don’t sell such pathetic properties.
 
We arrived at Khyber Gulmarg on 16th October 2013 at around 1300 hours and then began series of disasters and the most disturbing experiences me and my family had. 
 
The hotel being a part of the SLH group, we had expected that it would atleast stand upto the standards of being a good basic 5 star, but by the time we checked out next day , we had realized that calling Khyber even a 3 star hotel would be an insult to the other 3 star hotels. 
 
The basic amenities like the swimming pool and gym were closed, and we were not advised of the same at the time of booking. All the lifts in the property were either shut or were under maintenance.  The kids room which they boast about so much of, was merely a joke ! It had nothing more than 2 incomplete sets of ludo and snakes and ladder and some pink wallpaper.
The main restaurant on the lobby level was closed. The entire arrangement thus had been shifted to the basement in the banquet hall , with typical wedding
type of décor. Upon checking on this , we were told that due to full occupancy , the hotel could not accommodate all the in house guests in the main restaurant.
 
Nevertheless keeping this aside here is what all happened with us at the hotel
 
Day 1:  we ordered a mutton dish in the restaurant for lunch and we were served some uncooked pieces of meat, that could be even impossible to chew
by animals.  At the same moment this was brought to the Restaurant Managers and chef’s notice both of them accepted that the meat was uncooked and Unedible... So much so for a SLH hotel claiming to be a 5 star.

This just does not end here, there were rusted nails in the balcony that pierced into one of our family member’s feet.  The level of maintenance was such that the shower holder along with a heavy rod  fell upon one of us during shower, causing a cut on left hand which was  bleeding. The para-medicos were summoned and the first aid was provided. As if this was not enough we even had a CFL that blasted in the room around early morning 2 am, and then there were pieces of glass lying all over on the floor.
The most seemingly unbelievable part is that all the above HAS happened in the duration of just 24 hrs, but that friends is the TRUTH !!!

Ramesh Hemrajani
Blue Ocean Travels Pvt Ltd.

Breakfast and dinner at the hotel restaurants offered a lot of variety and the food was delicious…although service was slow. Staff members were all nice. Although I did encounter a few annoyances during my visit, I do recommend this hotel and would stay here again!

reviews.text:
The in room dining staff are really friendly 
Tanzeel Ahmed & Muzamil , the food is very tasty and the hotel services are just amazing . They also offer a wide range of services and activities their in door pool is very good and also temperature controlled

reviews.author: Mr Dubey
reviews.title: Great service by housekeeping
reviews.text: Wow what a place . It totally janat of the earth . I had expend excellent experience at the Khyber Himalayan resort and spa. Great service by housekeeping Mr Rayees & Mr Subzar . Both of them had given excellent service and feel much more comfortable and also been guided about the local attractions . Highly recommended

reviews.author: NicklasNavin
reviews.title: Superb resort but average food. No alcohol but BYO is fine
reviews.text:
I would agree with most reviewers here that the resort is truly amazing, and am not going to repeat what most have said about all the good things.
Instead, I will highlight some other things:

- The food isn't top notch.  Not what is expected from a 5 star resort this expensive. Also lacking local dishes.   Main restaurant Clove, where breakfast is also served, is very family oriented.  All tables are minimum 4 seaters, which was akward for me as a solo traveller, to occupy so much space when the place is busy and other guests are waiting for a table.  The breakfast itself again nowhere 5 star resort worthy, not enough variety, and the pastries/cakes were very dray on both my days.

-No alcohol served at the property.  But I knew this and came prepared :). At check-in they tell you it's totally fine to have your own liquor in your room or at the Hookah lounge in the evenings, where you can order your mixers and snacks as well.  This was one of my highlights.

-The massage at the Spa was a heaven and highly recommend.  Totally worth every penny.

Lastly, Mubashir at the Front Desk was a real superstar.

reviews.author: Angelica K
reviews.title: Absolutely wonderful experience; thank you!
reviews.text: The most wonderful hotel with the most attentive accommodating staff 🙏🏼 Had an incredible experience during my stay— everything was perfection. Highly, highly recommend. The spa in particular is exceptional; I had such a wonderful time that I extended my stay in the area, and (unsurprisingly) the hotel was sold out so sadly I had to stay elsewhere for the extra few days I added to my trip, and the hotel was kind enough to accommodate me at the spa and I received the most wonderful treatment and hospitality. 10/10 experience on every level. Thank you so very much, to everyone 💕🙏🏼 Looking forward to coming back and booking a longer stay now that I know what an incredible place Gulmarg (& the Khyber) is.

reviews.author: DK Singh
reviews.title: Superb experience
reviews.text: The service was the best ever received anywhere, the attached pho shows the extremes ALL staff go to to make your stay the very best. A huge thanks to everyone at reception who helped book and recommend restaurants, the bar staff and manager for their hospitality, the housekeeping staff is so polite and hepfull Like Mr. Rohit Housekeeping Supervisor are soo Nice God bless you buddy and thanks alot for always prompt response

reviews.author: Saral G
reviews.title: Khyber spa
reviews.text: The massage was very relaxing and Dr. Gaurai was very helpful in guiding me through the whole process. Anita, my healer was a great professional and did a great job! The staff as a whole was very kind and polite! Will definitely recommend to my friends and family!

reviews.author: Kiran V
reviews.title: Excellent massage
reviews.text:
Dr gaurai the manager was understanding to needs. The masseuse Deveshwar was fantastic just right amount of pressure! Perfect
Property beautiful & clean.
I would definitely come back to the Spa… great location in Gulmarg.

reviews.author: Mandy
reviews.title: Gorgeous property!!!
reviews.text: I couldn’t have asked for a better stay. Stayed in many 5 stars. This was beyond. Firstly, location is epic. In the midst of natural beauty. So calm! Secondly, such approachable staff! Especially, Waseem has been courteous and helpful in every way possible. Amazing stay. ☺️

reviews.author: Vaibhav M
reviews.title: Khyber - the best way to see Kashmir
reviews.text:
Khyber resort in Gulmarg is the best way to see Kashmir and the Himalayas. The place is scenic and the food is amazing. Rooms are comfortable and well done up, giving a mountain cabin feel.

Mr Irfan Hussain and Mr Manzoor treated me like family and their guidance and help made my trip superb. Thank you team Khyber!

reviews.author: anonymous835
reviews.title: Lovely hotel and views but…..
reviews.text: This is a lovely hotel in a beautiful location.  Staff are friendly and helpful.  The Food and Beverage Manager and Chef worked very hard to look after me and I appreciated this very much.  That being said, when I checked in I was given a room that had two big problems - the view was of the car park and garbage-strewn slope.   I asked for another room and was told the hotel was fully booked.  So I unpacked and tried to rest.  The room was anything but soundproof.  There was so much noise I couldn’t rest and finally told the front desk that if they didn’t move me I would put a bad review on Trip Advisor.  They moved me to a room that had a lovey view and was very quiet.  They even admitted there was a problem with the soundproofing in my original room.  With the price of rooms at this hotel, I’m surprised that room isn’t heavily discounted.  It should be.  I appreciate the effort staff went through to fix the problem (and they did), the problem shouldn’t have happened in the first place.  Upon check out I attempted to use my Visa card and it was declined 3 times.  I paid the small outstanding account in cash (I was trying to preserve my supply of rupees which is why I wanted to use Visa).  When I got to my next hotel in Srinagar, staff charged 1 rupee to my card and it worked.  So clearly the Khyber hotel was trying to avoid the use of credit cards which is very tacky given the price of this hotel.  So all in all…a relatively nice experience but a few very unnecessary hassled (which seems to be common throughout Indian so-called 5-star hotels).  They charge international prices and often deliver very inconsistent and ordinary service.

reviews.author: AiM Hunter
reviews.title: #Khyberjannat
reviews.text:
Great location good views. We really loved the character of the hotel*. The restaurant was fantastic and staff (Amit Kumar Dubey HK manager) was friendly and helpful.Best experience.... thanks to all staff.

*The Khyber himalayan resorts and spa

Hotel Experience was awesome,Good behaving staffs,all departments were helpful.khyber hotel is located near gondala where we can visit phase one and phase 2.along with that shopping in gulmarg market.

     I would give 5 stars overall rating.best resort in kashmir.

reviews.title: Excellent Stay!!
reviews.text:
Beautiful hotel and amazing location. No. 1 choice in Gulmarg for getaway. Delicious food and excellent service. Very friendly and helpful staff. I have visited twice in past couple of years for solo business trip and made good friends in property. Mr Manzur at front office is very humble person and his team take-care of things very nicely.

I hope this review will help to choose the right option for memorable trip to Gulmarg.

reviews.author: Syed Rooh
reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.text: When you see anything beautiful or with an good ambience we speak about  Kashmir , There are many places and many resorts  but for us we can implement this only for Khyber resort in Gulmarg especially in winter season   amazing food, amazing ambience and worth of everything beautiful landscape , beautiful snow covered mountains and gigiving a feeling of comfort, warmth, and relaxation. Most of all the staff members are so cooperative  and humbled

reviews.author: Venture823410
reviews.title: Ashok
reviews.text:
Exhorbitant in pricing against quality . Not worth for that . 90% staff new & unprofessional . Food very very pricey against quality of food . Resort location is superb . Room size great however lobby is grand but appears haunted with old classic wooden furniture with worn out tapestry & carpets . 

Care to be taken while booking to avoid disappointment . All rooms do not have balcony & May be you get fascinated to see photos of balcony side rooms as displayed but land into a west facing room with out balcony .  Read fine prints while booking .

reviews.text:
