See you soon  Khyber

reviews.author: Abdullah Saeed
reviews.title: Perfect!
reviews.text: Everything was perfect, the warmest welcoming I have had in India, the best property I have stayed ever, although I am used to boutiques and 5 stars hotels and resorts, yet this resort was amazing in every aspect, breakfast was delicious, staff unlike what some reviews here experienced were warm and kind, I guess they fix that issue. The facilities were nice, the room was spacious. and yes the pool looks as amazing as the pictures :D

reviews.author: Sangeeta H
reviews.title: Best Property in the Himalayas
reviews.text: I loved my stay here! Its high up in the beautiful sacred mountains of Himalayas with such breathtaking views, pristine air, stress free energy, and healing vibration. The GM is outstanding, hospitable, generous, with a quiet reserved countenance. Very befitting of such a serene place! I have always observed the GM sets the tone and atmosphere of the hotel.  And people make the hotel, not the edifice. The entire staff is warm, caring, courteous and pretty creative too - ask them for anything and they will create it for you. The hotel is so Kashmiri authentic. All wood and stone, perfect feel for the mountains...definitely the best 5 star hotel in the Himalayas! Breakfast is fabulous. Food is good. Their Chinese too is exemplary, considering its a Kashmiri hotel. I would love to return...and return. Thank you Vinit Kumar for making my stay so Divine...and possible! I thank the entire staff for their heartfelt hospitality. God Bless you all!

reviews.author: Muhammad A
reviews.title: brilliant staff
reviews.text:
The hotel is located next to the Gondola ... so has a perfect location being on the highest level of the land.
The building, rooms, were all average to be honest, compared to the price being paid.
The only significant thing about the hotel was the staff and the food.
The staff was amazing, in every department/place.
I was received by Burhaan, very decent guy who handled my check in and showed me the room. 
I'd like to thank the restaurant managers, both were superb and very decent. I was seated for dinner then because I had this headache I opted to get back to my room, they made it so easy and Abd-Allateef brought me the food to my room, another decent and polite man.
The next day I checked out , and had to rush so couldn't get enough time for breakfast, Iqbal from the restaurant packed something for me to eat on the road.

Overall it was a nice stay, comfortable, mainly because of the staff. 
Not complaining about the rooms though, they were as seen on photos, but frankly not worth the money spent as they weren't that fancy. but the staff was really welcoming and brilliant.
Onething I noticed, they some kept on calling me " brother ", which may sound unprofessional however I enjoyed it, being a muslim we tend to use brother with all, but furthermore it made me feel home.

I'd probably stay there again if I visit, for the sake of the view and the staff

reviews.author: ApurvNagpal
reviews.title: Great property - needs better service, lower pricing
reviews.text: The property is beautiful, truly amazingly constructed, with lots of wood, natural elements feel. There is a golf course nearby, as well as the cable car - all walking distance. They have a lovely indoor pool, which thanks to its glass walls, has a very open feel. The staff is friendly. However - I found the rates quite exorbitant, especially given the occupancy which was close to nil when I was there. Also, quite surprisingly, I was given a room with a view of the parking lot. When questioned why it wasn't a better view, was told it's what I had booked and would have to pay extra for a better view. This is when the hotel is empty. BTW - the hotel also doesnt serve alcohol (which I think should be mentioned clearly on the site) but apparently doesnt mind if you get your own.

reviews.author: Nasir R
reviews.title: Great services...keep it up
reviews.text: Very nice property with amazing views. Location is absolutely perfect. Awesome food. Generous and very helping staff. Amazing Spa, indoor swimming pool, everything is perfectly placed. Overall it was pleasing and memorable experience with Khyber. I will be looking forward to stay here again. Thank you very much for the services.

reviews.author: Junaid M
reviews.title: Amazing moments
reviews.text: From start to finish the service at this hotel was impeccable! Nothing was ever too much for the staff. Room and grounds were immaculate and the food was amazing even for fussy eaters. Mountains with white crown on them are breathtaking and talking about the spa was amazing. I wont even look at any other hotel when we visit again!

reviews.author: JUNAID M
reviews.title: Breathtaking Views with Excellent Hospitality!
reviews.text:
I stayed with the hotel in July, 2017. Resort is located at the prime location near Gondola. The best thing about the hotel is its views and the staff. I would like to thank Mr. Manzoor, he is manager of the hotel and he made sure that our stay was amazing and he has an attention to the detail and makes sure that your stay is comfortable.

Food is heavenly, must try Khyber Wazwaan Thali and also Kehwa which is served complimentary one you arrive at the hotel.

Regarding the views then the rooms with Himalayan Views area absolutely magnificent and it makes you trans to other world once you have a view of the majestic Himalayas

Must visit for everyone and make sure you dip in their pool and also if you are into fitness resort has a good gym with latest equipment's to work out.

reviews.author: Kimi R
reviews.title: Kashmir is heaven
reviews.text: I visited this hotel on my birthday in August . The rooms were beautiful, the bathroom was very beautiful too . The place is very quiet, the hotel staff is amazing . The only problem I faced was a poor wi fi in rooms , which worked great in lobby area , the served amazing kahwah. It was a great stay

reviews.author: Esther P
reviews.title: Beautiful rooms, wonderful stay
reviews.text:
This is a beautiful, well-located property built and operated to an international 5-star standard.    I was assigned a “Premier” (standard) room (#1010) which faced  a local home, outhouse and further on, the town of Gulmarg.  The valley view would have been acceptable anyplace else, but my goal in this visit was to see and enjoy the mountains.  

So I asked to pay extra to upgrade to a mountain view room with balcony.    I was given the room across the hall #1009) which had a balcony, sitting area and views of the hotel gardens as well as the snow capped mountain range.    Consider if you really want the  “Valley View.”  The upgrade to the Luxury Balcony room was 9,000 rupees per nite and worth it.

The Himalayan View room was comfortable, with a nice sitting area as well as a balcony.   I particularly enjoyed the power-shower and the well designed bathroom.  

The hotel restaurant is very good.  It has an interesting menu to suit every taste and I particularly enjoyed the very good Salad Nicoise and grilled fish dish.

I had one treatment in the spa and found it  very high quality and  professional.  The therapist explains everything  they are doing, as well as the products being used.  I had the Signature 90 min. massage and was so thoroughly relaxed afterwards that I forgot to go to dinner.

I had some issues with the wi-fi, but it may have been local to my room.  Wi-fi was  strong and stable in the restaurant and lobby areas.

It is a short walk downhill to the Gondola ride.

reviews.author: triphank
reviews.title: Best in Gulmarg
reviews.text:
I had a nice stay at the hotel this year in February. It is very close to Gondola and had a lot of ski shops nearby. 
The rooms have a nice mountain view and the Kashmiri food at the restaurant is awesome.

reviews.author: mansingala
reviews.title: Part of Heaven on earth
reviews.text: Have visited khyber twice..once in winter and recently in their summer days.. The experince ws awesome,i think specially the ambience, the view, the peace u get there is something u really dnt wanna miss it. Everything is nicely managed. Be it calabash, restaurants,spas...with helpful warm staff of fnb and manager mr. Aman makes sure tht his every guest leave with excel food and service memories.. Bcoz of these reasons we might feel to mesmorize our memories.. Few things in room service they need to work on but overall experience ws superb... Looking forward to visit soon..😊😊

reviews.author: Nils Ola B
reviews.title: Great hotel with fantastic service
reviews.text:
Great hotel with fantastic service and nice spa. Close to ski lifts and Monkey Hill for those randonee trips on a bad weather day. Although, most visitors are less interested in ski (I honestly do not get why they are visiting Gulmarg in winter time other than staying at a good hotel). Food is good as well, although you get kind of tired of the buffet on the fourth day... 
I miss a small bar where those after ski beers can be bought. And naturally, a glass of read wine with my curry would also be nice:)

reviews.author: SanjayP310
reviews.title: THE KHYBER
reviews.text: Stayed for 6 days 13 to 19th of February 2015. Had gone for Skiing. Fantastic Hotel. No other place to stay in Gulmarg. Great ambience, supreme staff, very good food. Adivse one and all to stay there. Do not waste energy looking for places in Gulmarg. Definitely will visit again.

reviews.author: Lee Alexander R
reviews.title: The best hotel in Gulmarg
reviews.text:
The Khyber is a good hotel and certainly offers better accommodation and facilities than any other hotel in the village. It is conveniently located close the gondola - short walk down the hill in ski boots and then straight up the mountain for powder skiing challenges! The staff are friendly, the rooms are spacious, beds are comfortable and the food is adequate Indian cuisine - not the best but sufficient to satisfy a calorie recharge after a days hard skiing. Could the hotel be better? Certainly, some more attention to fixing problems would not go amiss - the shower in my room was partially broken; the furniture was scratched and looked a bit tired; and the bathroom shower gels and shampoo were never replaced and were running low by the time I left. Moreover, the sound-proofing between rooms leaves little to ones imagination. 

The warm swimming pool and spa facilities were good and looked out on the spectacular mountain scenery. The airport transfers were great and on time. On balance it is a hotel I would stay at again when skiing in Gulmarg.

reviews.author: NikhilChaudhary
reviews.title: Stairway to Heaven
reviews.text:
Forget the Swiss Alps. Outstanding service, luxurious spa, delectable Kashmiri food, interiors speaking volumes about the rich Kashmiri culture... Indeed a Paradise on Earth !!

After spending my first day at The Khyber I realized that the mountains never leave you. Whether it’s the bedroom, balcony or bathtub, the snowcapped mountains and meadows are always there. I will remember my evenings spent sitting on the balcony that offer the uninterrupted view of the snow covered pine trees and the mighty mountains. 

This was my second visit to Gulmarg and first visit to The Khyber. I am happy to say that nothing has changed here since my last visit as the government has banned further commercial construction in this region – I hate Shimla, Nainital and all the Mall Roads in the world. 

Last but not the least special thanks the hotel staff and their impeccable service who can give Rajasthani hospitality run for its money.

I’m going to see you guys again !! Kashmir is my second love.

reviews.author: charukesi
reviews.title: Classy in every way
reviews.text:
I recently spent a memorable three days at The Khyber and came away utterly relaxed and happy with the experience. Everything about this place spells class - from the warm, wooden decor to the gracious hospitality of everyone, from the GM to the wait staff at the restaurant. I stayed in a mountain view room and woke up every morning to stunning views of snow-capped mountains and fir trees. 

The Khyber is also located within walking distance of the Gulmarg gondola but if you wish for a complete unwind experience, you can stay put at the resort. Or head to the spa. The L'Occitane spa here is pure indulgence and not to be missed.

The food at The Khyber is also a winner, beginning from the lavish breakfast spread and ending with a traditional Kashmiri Wazwan at dinner. My favourite space was the Chaikash tea lounge, where I spent a lot of time sipping on kahwa and looking out at the mountains.

This is a property I can't wait to go back to, perhaps to enjoy it in another season.

reviews.author: Code-Name-God
reviews.title: The Gem of Gulmarg
reviews.text:
Thought the whole air trip to the hotel was full of gloominess that the snow was would not have been as much as the last year. But everything changed while Chauffeur greeted with a warm welcome at the airport. We talked a lot about the recent flood happened in Srinagar and how fast it has recovered. I could not find much signs of the flood around the route. Everything was same as before. From Tangmarg the scene started to become white and the beauty of snow was visible.
When I reached the hotel the checkin process was just like as we are back to our home after a long break. The fascinating fact was that everyone around was so happy to welcome you to your new home. The interior of the hotel was so wonderful and maintained in such a nice manner that the wood work amazed me how a boutique hotel could exist in such a poles apart weather.
The room was so large and beautifully maintained that it had everything to make your vacation a memorable one. The amenities were spread from the large LCD TV to a minute emergency torch where you won't need to call the reception for anything else.
In every way the indoors mirror the beauty of the outdoors. The widespread resort boasts different options to get engaged like the 'Chaikash' the coffee lounge, 'Cloves' the restaurant, 'Calabash' the cigar & sheesha lounge, 'Igloo' the kids area, and 'Den' the movie theatre.
'The Khyber Spa by L'Occitane' one of the must try area which includes Spa, Gym, Heated Pool, Separate Steam, Sauna, & Jacuzzi for Men & Woman. The Spa is one of India’s most luxurious and holistic well-being experience. I would recommend a treatments set which can include and Massage & Facial or Scrub, Wrap, & Massage. They are so professional & will pamper you like in a heaven of indulgence.
Thanks to Mr. Sujit Herbert the General Manager who is always there to make sure that you are having a great stay, Mr. Jerin Philip the Front of the House Man who will assist you in each and every aspect of your needs, Mr. Santosh Pandey the Executive Home Keeper who will make sure the stay is far better than at your home, and each employee who takes care of their area so well that you will feel like not to return to your home.

reviews.author: Anitbha
reviews.title: Whoa! :)
reviews.text:
I would definitely recommend this property- if you go to Kashmir.....there's no other place to stay.
 
The room was warm, food was good but more importantly; the staff- Front Office (Nitesh, Abid, Zaffar)/House Keeping (Irshad)/Food & Beverage (Prabhakar, Kamal, Saptarishi) are worth a special mention- my week over there was a breeze because of their superlative hospitality!!!!

The sugar free qahwa has to be tried, as is the daily bubble bath in their awesome tub which has a wow view.

Phase 2 of the Gondola has to be tried, as has the walk around the property- its BEAUTIFUL & should be done; especially if you choose not to wander around a lot from Gulmarg.
If you do however, Sonmarg/Pahalgam/Verinag & of course Dal Lake, Srinagar should be on your list.

Sit outside in ChaiKash & sip a tea or have a cigar......and dream!

One of the best hotels I've EVER stayed in worldwide (and I've travelled the world & am an ex- hotelier).....will return soon, Inshallah!!

reviews.author: KubraSait
reviews.title: I wish I could've stayed here!
reviews.text:
The dates I had planed my visit to Gulmarg, this property was sold out like hot cup cakes.
Hence I chose a property close by, but the reviews and the pictures of this property were oh so damn tempting I couldn't help but make a visit to this himalayan paradise for a meal, and that went into me gorging out and spending a lot of time here.

This property redeemed Gulmarg and Kashmir for me.

We spent a day over looking the range and sipping great coffee (for coffee lovers) and smoking sheesha.

The perfect high and a great conversation starter.

The staff is alert, and helpful and always wears a smile.

The place doesn't smell anything like the village, the ambience music is perfect and just every detail was a reminder that I need to book myself well in advance to get myself a room at this place before I visit again.

Oh! I am also told that they have a temperature controlled pool and its a pity that I couldn't get to use it.

Do visit. It's a jewel.

reviews.author: JohnnyChef
reviews.title: Fogettable
reviews.text: I had been looking forward to skiing in Gulmarg for many years. I was disappointed to find out that the Five Star Khyber Hotel was full so I looked online and found this four star hotel. From the moment I arrived it was obvious it was no four star hotel. I was shown to my room and the carpet was rotten, black almost. At night time the power would go off and it was freezing, the internet and television never worked. The breakfast was inedible and I am a chef who came to India to do a months cooking course in Delhi. The service was rude and unfriendly whenever I complained which was obviously often. The windows were covered in plastic so the view was restricted. Look don't call yourself a four star hotel if you are clearly not. I have stayed in better one star hotels. I will be back and I will book in advance and stay at the Khyber

reviews.author: CarolineRowe
reviews.title: Like being with family
reviews.text: I went to Kashmir to attend the Zubin Mehta concert which was on in Srinagar and decided to add on a night and stay in Gulmarg. I was welcomed absolutely like family and of course blown away by the impressive interiors, very warm and sharply trained staff and, most of all, the phenomenal views. I took a hike with a local guide, and a gondola ride also, and always felt 100% safe, pampered, and at home. The kashmiri kahwa was the best I have tried and their food, especially the western food, is excellent. The rooms are luxurious and the sunken tub is a favourite feature! In fact, I felt so safe and looked after that I cancelled my booking in Srinagar for the next night, where there had been some disturbances, and instead drove all the way back to The Khyber for peace of mind and luxury. The next day the driver took me on an excellent tour around Dal Lake before my flight. The whole experience was perfect from beginning to end!

reviews.author: Marryam R
reviews.title: In the lap of the gods
reviews.text: It's a completely contemporary building, but made of wood and stone, with a few elements of local Kashmiri architecture. There's nothing like it in the rest of the Kashmir Valley, and it is clear that it has been made with passion and inspiration. There is a wealth of handicrafts all over the building, but taken together, they don't give the look of a junky handicraft store. The food is superb, whether it is the Irish Angus steak (I asked for mine blue and it came perfectly done) to the Kashmiri banquet dishes; from the Illy coffee in the lounge to the ginger cookies that are served with kahwa, fragrant with saffron. This is easily the best resort/hotel/guest house in the Kashmir Valley. And further even. The warmth of the mainly Kashmiri staff and their professionalism will have me going back for more!

reviews.author: Ishfaq M
reviews.title: A blissful holiday
reviews.text:
It has just been 3 months since the Hotel has become operational and it seems like it has always been there. This magnificent property is nested on a platue with views of, some of the most scenic slopes of Gulmarg. The opulent interiors and the grand lobby with a number of esthetically maintained terrace gardens, the cigar bar and not to forget the hotspot multi-cuisine resturant that undoubtedly serves the best food in the valley. This is just one part of the whole experience and the staff under the smiling G.M. Mr. Alex ensures that guests are offered a bouquet of well thought out services & amenities, so as to have a wholesome holiday experience. A new addition to the prestigious SLH club in India and the only one in Kashmir. This property gets my two thumbs up! Highly recommended - Five Star deluxe mountain resort experience. 

I also look forward to conducting my company conferences and business meets here and if I find my soulmate soon, then most likely celebrate here :)

reviews.author: Rana Puneet Singh
reviews.title: Special thanks to Irfan.
reviews.text:
Had an amazing and Lovely stay in khyber Resort, the staff was so cooperative, special big thanks to Irfan, he was always there to assist and very very cooperative towards me.
I really appreciate irfan's efforts to make my stay so comfortable and amazing.
Hope to see you soon Irfan bhai.

reviews.author: Compass38959816760

reviews.text:
Loved place, hospitality and food.

Mesmerised be the kind and beautiful gesture of Chef Liakat, and restaurant staff Mr. Firdos and Mr. Aijaz.

Place is top notch and so the are the people who work here and manage ghe property.

Keep it up!
Thanks!

reviews.author: Daydream06639815000
reviews.title: Luxurious Stay
reviews.text: Arrived at The Khyber Himalayan Resort and spa , welcomed very graciously by Mr. Irfan Hussein . Very smooth check in done by him and well assisted. The resort has best aminities and a perfect ambience. Highly recommended

reviews.author: Trek25234661328
reviews.title: Amazing Khyber!
reviews.text: It is heaven on earth kind of a property. The property, food, staff, services were really nice. The stunning view of the mountains from the property and rooms were really mesmerizing. The Hotel is located at the right place for those who are interested in sightseeing and trekking etc.

reviews.author: Escorted Holidays
reviews.title: Very Bad experience
reviews.text:
I as a local travel agent registered by J&K tourism today try to visit the Khyber gulmarg with my business partner from Mumbai. I was not allowed by the security of the hotel to visit the hotel. They told me we were instructed by by their management not to allow local person. So, i waite outside hotel till my business partner came out. In the mean time I deleted the hotel publicity from my foreign clientele platform. It is useless to do the publicity of such hotel whose laws are different as compared to all over India hotels.

Thank you🙏

reviews.title: An Amazing luxurious experience at a mesmerising landscape!

reviews.author: sumeetarora1975
reviews.title: Proud to be an Indian to have such a property in our Country
reviews.text: The location is just excellent. Just a short walk down to the Gondola (steep hike up though). Hotel is just MAGNIFICIENT. The pool is centrally heated and so is the Jacuzzi. The pool faces the outside with snow all around and the atmosphere is mesmerizing. Parvez at the reception is pretty helpful. Breakfast is good. Food though is very high priced but very tasty. Try the local dishes like gustaba and rishta for sure.

reviews.author: abs34
reviews.title: True 5 * resort
reviews.text: Had visited as part of company Conference on 2014  August , Truly found a Royal Resort with excellent view . Only Downside  was the food which is letting down the resort  but overall a Royal resort . Would visit again

reviews.author: Pri S
reviews.title: The best of all
reviews.text:
This is one of the best hotels that I have come so far. Situated in the picturesque Gulmarg where the snow clad mountains and terrains make the place a fairyland, the resort matches international standards. The staff are warm and courteous and take care of the guests. The rooms are spacious overlooking the beautiful slopes of Gulmarg. The lobby is grand and has enough seating space to enjoy a relaxed evening. Though I did not use the spa and the swimming pool but did visit them and they looked like to be worth a try. I will surely go back and stay here in future. The food in terms of variety and taste however can improve a little bit
I was on a business trip for a meeting.

we just have lunch in this hotel and seriously when we visited the hotel we were title upset because Hotel is just near to Gandola Ride and the hotel view is very aweusm,

reviews.title: A PAradise

reviews.author: IndiTales
reviews.title: Classic Luxury in a Classic Destination
reviews.text:
Khyber Gulmarg lets you soak in the old world charm while providing you all that you need for modern living. Their wood dominated architecture to their Chaikash that keeps on serving Kahwas and the views from just about everywhere in the property add to the overall experience of Gulmarg. 

You can sit back and enjoy the views from balconies, get spa treatments in athe most professional way and swim in the heated swimming pool surrounded by snow. 

In the mountains do not expect the service at par with urban counterparts. Staff works slowly and their pace - probably they want you to just sit back and relax. 

The room temperature at night goes very high, invariable waking you up - keep the window open a bit to avoid this.

reviews.author: SG
reviews.title: Luxury Hotel with five star facilities but expensive
reviews.text: Located on height in Gulmarg near the Rope-way. Beautiful Scenery view from all rooms. Swimming Pool with Hot water and Gym working but not used by many guests. Room neat and clean with good quality linen. Bathroom neat with toiletries and fittings. Shower and Tub separate.. a rare luxury. Glass between the shower enclosure and Toilet is so transparent that you may bang your head thinking that it does not exist. TV channels working. Aircon working fine. Food good but very expensive. Starts at Rs 1000 per dish. Nearby market is 2 km away and vehicle cost Rs 500. Market is simple and nothing much there. Rope-way very busy and good. Usually one stage works and not both stages. Avoid Horse riding poni walas, they pester you so much that you cannot wish them away.

reviews.author: govindbabu
reviews.title: The Khyber - Gulmarg
reviews.text:
I went for a meeting in Gulmarg and the attraction was that it was in The Khyber resort.
Kashmir is always a great place to go to and i have been going there since 1982 and I have loved every trip.
The drive from Srinagar airport is about 1.5 hours,one doesnot enter the city of Srinagar but there is a bypass towards Gulmarg.The route is through some tiny villages ,some dry dirty regions and then you enter the hillside and gradually climb up throufgh forests of pine trees and winding roads, the air gets crispy and chilly an we ascend up.The route is lined with many apple and apricot orchards.beautiful sights!
The drive into the lobby is a little steep.You are greeted at the reception warmly and welcomed with their traditional drink - Khava , which is a sweetish brew with chopped almonds - quite refreshing/
The check in was smooth,The lobby and reception area is well decorated with many atrtefacts. The room is large with very comfortable bed and bath.The view out of my room was of pine trees and the Arrafat mountain range.
The group met up late afternoon and we went out for a drive and Gondola ride.
The dinner was a grand affair with traditional Kasmiri dishes.
A great place to stay even when it was not the season of snow.
This ia rated as one of the 10 best resorts in India and after staying here i realised why it is so.

reviews.author: TrueIndian
reviews.title: Excellent Place to Unwind
reviews.text:
Situated on a hilltop in Gulmarg. Travelling time by car is approximately 1.5 hours from Srinagar airport.
Check In and Check Out is very swift.
On arrival one is greeted with "Kahwa" (Kashmiri Green Tea).Thereafter one is escorted to the room.
The rooms are very spacious with king beds with an attached balcony overlooking the meadows. 
The bathroom is also spacious with a bath tub also provided.
Although there is an air conditioner temperature control in the room but still the room becomes very hot at night and can lead to perspiration.
In room slippers and shoe shine are not available.
The resort has a gym, indoor swimming pool, and a spa.
There are multiple restaurants.
The menu includes dishes from all over the country but Kashmiri Wazwan is very delicious and worth trying once during your stay.
There is a convention hall also for meetings.
The resort is very close to Gulmarg Gandola entry.
The room tariff is very high but worth a visit.

reviews.author: GaurAgar
reviews.title: Luxury in the lap of nature
reviews.text: The Khyber resort and spa at Gulmarg, J&K India provides a feel of the nature while providing all the luxuries of a five star hotel. The all wood finish makes this an exquisite property. The food was great- specially the waazwaan. The pool and spa are great. Rooms as well Nouf- the terrace provide a great view of the trees and the peaks all around. On the down-side- the room temperature control did not work- so had to just do with whatever temperature the system set for itself. And even when the tariff is so stiff- the hotel doesn't provide any free wi-fi anywhere in the hotel. Even the paid wi-fi was painfully slow. BSNL Mobile signal did not exist in most parts of the hotel.

reviews.author: 198pradeep
reviews.title: Khyber Himalayan Resort and Spa at Gulmarg, Kashmir, India- a heaven on earth
reviews.text:
Khyber Himalayan Resort and Spa is situated in Himalayan town of Gulmarg, 56 kilometers from Srinagar, the capital city of state of Jammu and Kashmir in India.The resort is situated at altitude of almost 9000 feet in the picturesque valley in Himalayan Pir Panjal range.Khyber Resort is an ideal base to explore Kashmir valley and particularly to take a ride on world's highest sky lift, the Gulmarg Gondola, which connects Gulmarg to Kongduri mountain.

This 86 room resort provides enchanting and breathtaking view of meadows and forests of Kashmir valley and snow covered peaks of Himalayan mountain ranges. Each room in the resort provides this heavenly view, not only from the balcony but also from the washroom through full sized floor to ceiling windows. enjoying this heavenly view while taking tub bath is an unique  experience.
the rooms are well equipped and spacious and have a large balcony with comfortable relaxing chairs. The fittings and fixtures in rooms and washroom area are of high quality.
The resort has good spa, gym and heated swimming pool.
Khyber resort provides a great value for money.

reviews.author: noizemaker
reviews.title: 3х-дневная командировка в Кашмир
reviews.text:
Был в данном отеле в декабре, в течение трех дней. Командировка сложилась очень удачно, работы особо не было, поэтому была возможность оценить окружающий мир)
Отель находится в очень живописном месте, в Гималаях. Из окон открывается просто фантастический вид на заснеженные вершины. Природа и свежий горный воздух - это, наверное, основной плюс этого региона в целом. Но и минусов конечно не занимать. Начнем с того, что это Индия и даже "больше", что-то ближе к Пакистану и Афганистану. Это был уже мой второй визит в Индию, и я знал куда еду. Но вот мои товарищи по командировки были просто в ужасе от города Шринагар, где находится аэропорт, от нашей дороги в отели, дорожного движения, местных водителей, грязи, разрухи. Ну в общем, всего того, что делает Индию Индией))
Насколько я понимаю, люди едут в эти места в горнолыжных целях. Мы были немного с другой целью, но по канатной дороге все же поднялись. Ну так вот, ифраструктура этого горнолыжного "курорта" оставляет желать лучшего, точнее, наверное, оставляет желать хоть чего-то) Потому что там, собственно, ничего и нет. Может быть мы были не в сезон (снега еще было немного), либо были не совсем там. Думаю про регион - это все.
Теперь о самом отеле. Это пятерка. Достаточно уютная, красивая. Даже не по индийским меркам там очень комфортно. Хорошая инфраструктура: ресторан, тренажерный зал, бизнес-центр, своеобразная лаундж-зона с терассой и видом горы. Встретили нас очень душевно: напоили вкуснейшим кашмирским чаем. Не могу сказать, из чего конкретно он сделан, но он был настолько живительным и вкусным, что усталость с дороги как рукой сняло.
Номер был просторный и уютный, с балконом, вид на горы. Чистая ванная с большой душевой кабиной. 
Ресторан тоже отличный. У нас были включены завтраки - шведский стол. Там были и каши, и яичницы, всевозможная выпечка, мюсли, фрукты, орехи. В общем, очень разнообразно и по-европейски (поскольку от индийской кухни я не в восторге вообще). Так же мы в отеле и ужинали, за свой счет разумеется. Цены выше среднего, но не космические. Что самое интересное - очень вкусно. Я даже умудрился взять такое блюдо, в котором был выдержан некий баланс между местным колоритом и вкусом, близким европейскому языку)
Теперь о минусах:
1) Самый большой и главный - это платный интернет, тем более по диким тарифам. Может этому и есть какое-то объяснение, но платить в пятерке еще и за интернет - полнейший абсурд.
2) Тяжелое взаимопонимание с персоналом. Как я уже говорил, я был в Индии во второй раз, и прекрасно понимал, что русский человек с индусом общего языка не найдут (даже учитывая, что у меня лингвистическое образование и отличный английский), так тут еще и сказывалось, видимо, слабое знание персоналом английского. В общем, было тяжело. Особенно, когда мы пытались заказать стейк средней прожарки.
3) Лично для меня это минусом не было, поскольку я не пьющий вообще. Но для кого-то - да. Регион на 99% мусульманский, будьте готовы, что алкоголь не купить. Вообще. Нигде. Никак. В общем, берите с собой из дьюти фри)
4) Местный колорит и городок Гульмарг - это конечно совершенно другая Индия, не такая как на юге. Но и эта крайность немного пугает: местное население по большей части на вид самые настоящие талибы и моджахеды. Вообще, штат Кашмир - спорная территория, и там не очень спорно, периодически случаются терракты и т.д. В горах на дорогах стоят какие-то блокпосты и т.д. В общем, колоритненько))

The view from the resort is breathtaking. The rooms are amazing... Every room has a view.

reviews.author: Travelmate1992
reviews.title: Amazing property !
reviews.text: Just right situated within Pine trees his amazing resort is the last word in modernity & comfort. Warm & comfortable welcoming lobby so well decorated and very soothing. Greeted with the Kashmiri Kahwa is awesome and relaxing  while you wait for your check in! The rooms are luxurious and the cottages are comfortable. The presidential suite is befitting for all heads of states and those looking for ultimate in luxury ! Highly recommended !

reviews.author: siddharth g
reviews.title: Heaven amidst heaven
reviews.text: This is the place to be, live, eat, enjoy and just be at peace! Excellent staff, would like to name "zaffar" from the hotel staff for being so awesome in showing and guiding us around! Just loved this resort, definitely coming back to this heaven next year wih my family. Thanks Khyber for giving me  such an exclusive experience!

reviews.author: AnanyaMaitra
reviews.title: Warm spot in Paradise
reviews.text: The Khyber property is one of the best for staying in Gulmarg. It is strategically located and is just a walk away from the gondola rides that takes one to the Phases 1 & 2 of the Gulmarg peaks. The decor is chic and the place is warm and inviting with the chill fresh mountain air for a backdrop. Rooms are spacious and well maintained and led to comfortable sleep. There's a spa for the tired bodies and the management takes good care of groups and customises services to suit the requirements. The food was heavenly, but the one to die for is the kesar phirni.

reviews.author: postkunal@gmail.com
reviews.title: Snowy Paradise .....!!!!!!
reviews.text:
Been to Khyber Gulmarg for a Business Convention Meet for Four days during 2nd Week of April 2015. It was a two and half hour drive from Srinagar into the snowy town of Gulmarg. The Resort is just perfect.....lovely wooden ambience takes you to the colonial era ...I have been to scandenavian countries of europe but must admit it was no less. The pictureasque place of Gulamrg adds beauty to the resort as well. 

Location is superb . Food was also nice catering to vegetarians like me.....It was truly a fabulous property to spend a luxurious vacation.

Couple of observations : -

Found it really hard to locate the Tea Maker Kit in the room as it was hidden into a unique drawer. 
Room Heating was not available in rooms.
Complimentary Drop facility to lowland/gondola could be contemplated by resort.

Staff and hospitality levels were exceptional  at the resort...Wish to take my family along next time when I visit gulmarg.

reviews.author: Rajesh S
reviews.title: Excellent property at heavenly location
reviews.text: The Khyber is great property at Gulmarg.  You can see the picturesque views of fully covered white hilltops from almost all locations of Hotel, like restaurant area, lobby, room balcony. All the staffers behaves nicely.

reviews.author: Suzanna_stephens
reviews.title: Absolutely fabulous
reviews.text: I visited the property in January this year and loved every bit of the experience. The fusion of authentic traditional Kashmiri culture with state-of-the-art facilities makes it a fantastic stay option. Of everything else that fascinates, the spa is truly an experience that is out of this world!

reviews.author: D_Saxena
reviews.title: Excellent Stay!!
reviews.text:
Stayed at the property for our offsite recently and it was an excellent choice, we chose to stay in Himalyan View rooms and must say each morning presented with amazing views of snow clad mountains, food very regular great except the Kashmiri (wazwan) which was a real treat, very courteous staff, Excellent Spa, Indoor heated pool, all very well maintained. 

Special Thanks to the GM, Mr Sujith Herbert who is doing an excellent job of keeping the guests happy.. will return for sure!!

reviews.author: SamKanwar47
reviews.title: Luxury with a view!
reviews.text: We travelled to Gulmarg in December and stayed here. The place is in the most spectacular location. I have never visited anywhere quite like this. You a surrounded by the most stunning views of the mountains - almost too picture perfect to feel real. The hotel is fantastic. Great rooms, great staff and really accommodating. The food is delicious - please try the Kashmiri Kawa there - it's perfect for the cold mountain air. A must try is the heated swimming pool which is too beautiful for words. They have ceiling to floor glass windows encasing the pool so you have stunning views while in the warm, cosy comfort of a heated pool. It hadn't started snowing while we were there, but it does around January when the gold course gets converted into the skiing area and I'm sure that will be amazing. Wish we could've stayed longer.  I would 100% recommend Khyber to anyone wishing to travel to Kashmir. It was one of the most memorable experiences for me ever!

reviews.author: shenekurien
reviews.title: Simply Aswesome
reviews.text: Went for a team meeting and the place was picture perfect. Totally awesome place, great food, great rooms and excellent staff.  Nice hotel in a very picturesque location. Truly five star in every aspect.

reviews.author: alientravelbug
reviews.title: Location is whoa....!! Total experience is good !!
reviews.text:
Stayed at the hotel for an annual business meet for the company i work with. Hotel location... exceptional... Hotel design .. Superb !! Room design .. Great, but ventilation seems to be an issue.. Breakfast... Grand and definitely not to be missed. Housekeeping can be expedited ... a little slow most of the times !

But definitely will recommend a stay with family and friends whenever you get a chance.

reviews.author: Rohit S
reviews.title: Gem in the hills
reviews.text:
It took us exactly 3.5 hrs from boarding the flight from Delhi & reaching Khyber - may be the quickest that we reached any hill station from Delhi.

Contrary to what we were expecting (post the floods & related issues), the drive from Srinagar to Gulmarg was pretty smooth.

The hotel is set in quite a picturesque setting with excellent view of Himalaya. The property itself could be one of the best hill station resort that I know of in India. The room was extremely comfortable with all usual amenities, food was also tasty.

Although most of the hotels in Gulmarg were closed as an after effect of what happened in Srinagar, it was good to know about Khyber managements decision to keep the property open. 

It has already started getting a bit cold, day temperature was 9 degree - please carry adequate clothing if planning a trip. Reminds me of something I heard 'The weather is never bad, It's the clothing that you carry'.

Sincere advice to everyone - If you were planning a trip to Gulmarg, please firm up your plans. I am coming back in Dec to spend Christmas.

reviews.author: Suket Bhatia
reviews.title: Great Property - Service needs urgent attention
reviews.text:
The property is well located and well done up. We stayed here as part of a large group and felt it was grossly understaffed to provide service levels expected of 5 star properties. Breakfast tables were not ready, dishes from earlier guests were still not cleared on all tables... we had to wait for 10 minutes for a table and still had to make do with clearing the tables ourselves... Definitely not expected when you're paying as much as the hotel charges. Also even upon making a request to open the pool early one day in advance, and getting confirmation that it would be ready, the pool was not ready the next day.
Attention to such small things from the staff would really have made our stay a memorable one.
ROOM TIP: Try to get the rooms having windows on the eastern side otherwise all you would be able to see from your room would be a barbed fence.

reviews.author: Prasad Shriyan
reviews.title: Excellent location, good property. Poor service though!!
reviews.text:
The location is just amazing.. Everything else you would want to do in Gulmarg is about a stone's throw away.. The view from the property is amazing and its well maintained.. 
The service at each touch point was a sore experience for me.. be it check in experience, food quality, speed of service, restaurant timings, housekeeping, etc. were all let downs... Rooms do not have cooling so those visiting in summer months beware... This hotel doesn't have a bar.. So for the dough that you would shell out for room reservations & other services at the property, the value is what you will miss...

reviews.author: eskay1103
reviews.title: Poor service and extremely confused and grossly overpriced
reviews.text: Housekeeping gets done and towels are not replaced, one day you order tea it costs 340 Rs with two cups the next day it becomes 680 Rs ! Linen is not changed even though we stayed for 4 nights  - had to really push hard for getting a room with the mountain view - they take complete advantage of a monopoly like situation. Best to stay in Srinagar and do a day trip to Gulmarg. Easily Qualifies as the poorest hotel in terms of service, bathroom quality and fixtures, no air-conditioning and pathetic service.

reviews.author: Ranjit K
reviews.title: Palace @ 7000 Sq feet
reviews.text: Wow!!! Thats how I describe it in a word. I had the best view of the himalayan range and it was amazing. reviews.author: RajeshDube
reviews.title: Heaven on Earth
reviews.text:
Stayed here for a week...unforgettable experience ....excellent location...heavenly surroundings....excellent service....the property is one of the best I have seen so far. This is a true experience of Heaven on Earth !! The resort is surrounded by green forests and conveniently located near the Gondola ride. The resort has a beautiful swimming pool and spa. The food served here is mouth watering and true reflection of Kashmiri cuisine . Even during snow fall the temperature inside the resort is conveniently maintained for comfort. The resort has sufficient number of rooms to hold business conferences and also big corporate gatherings. The staff is very polite and ready to offer their services.
 The resort architecture and design is very tastefully done and it is said that it took seven years for the construction to take place and complete.location wise I feel this is the best located property in Gulmarg. I recommend to visit this place after snowfall as this is the best time to. Enjoy the surroundings. Go there with family or friends, you are bound to enjoy every moment spent there. Evening time with Kahwah is always one looks forward to !!

All you need is within walking distance and the hotel has their own transport if you don't fancy the walk in sub zero temperatures. What really stood out though was the service. All their staff are perfectly courteous. There whenever you need help but never in your face and intrusive. Would really love to go back sometime.

reviews.author: SamarGGN
reviews.title: Kashmiri Hospitality at it's best
reviews.text:
The great hospitality experience starts right outside Srinagar airport where the chauffeur meets you a genuine smile. He doesn't get too friendly on the way but will answer your questions about flora, fauna, local traditions, culture etc,. very courteously and knowledgeably.

You are greeted with Kahwa while the checkin in done, which is very efficient and then you proceed to your room. The room is very modern but ethnic with a big dose Kashmiri artifacts and architecture all around.

The architecture and the attention to details in the construction is to be seen to be believed. I was surprised to see the manholes also outlined with local tiles.

Since it was a team meeting the Chef met and discussed the cuisines and the menu before hand and I though I difficult to please with food but even I after 4 meals the fatigue has still not set in. Though the breakfast may be improved a bit.

The room service was awesome and the best I have seen across any hotel in the world and our order of Fish and Chips was delivered in less than 20 minutes.

they are still making the spa so you could hear from construction noises but given that you are so well taken care off and also the place is surrounded by such picturesque and serene surroundings - It didn't bother me a bit.

reviews.author: Lucky Rana
reviews.title: Was a Loyal Returning Guest — Wasim from the Front Desk Staff & Poor Service Ended That Forever
reviews.text:
Our family has stayed at The Khyber Himalayan Resort & Spa several times over the years, and until now we had always considered it one of our favorite properties. We have previously left 5-star reviews and recommended it to friends and family. That is why our stay on June 18–19, 2026 (Room 4006) was particularly disappointing.

The first issue occurred during check-in. I arrived at 12:30 PM and was informed that my room would be ready within 30 minutes. Instead, I waited until 2:00 PM. During that time, I watched several guests who arrived after me receive their rooms much sooner. What was most disappointing was the complete lack of communication, explanation, or apology.

The restaurant experience was equally frustrating. Staff appeared focused almost entirely on large groups while individual tables received very little attention. Our food took approximately one hour to arrive, and after the initial order, nobody returned to take any additional requests. We had to actively search for staff ourselves.

The most disappointing interaction occurred at checkout with Wasim from the Front Desk Staff. When I provided honest feedback regarding the stay, there was no acknowledgment, concern, or attempt to understand the issues. Immediately afterward, I was informed that a glass water bottle from the room would incur a ₹500 charge. While I understand that hotel property may be chargeable, the fact that this was raised only after I voiced criticism created a very poor impression and made the interaction feel unnecessarily confrontational.

As a returning guest, I expected better service recovery, better communication, and greater professionalism. The property itself remains beautiful, but hospitality is defined by people, and unfortunately this stay fell far below the standards we had experienced in the past.

For verification purposes, I have attached my booking confirmation with this review.

reviews.author: Sunshine44237212705
reviews.title: How Was This Room Ever Cleared for Check-In?
reviews.text:
I rarely leave negative reviews, but this experience deserves to be highlighted.

We stayed at Khyber Resort, Gulmarg for two nights in March, expecting the standards one would associate with a luxury property. Unfortunately, our stay ended with a discovery that completely overshadowed the experience.

During checkout, we found a used condom underneath our bed. It clearly belonged to a previous guest and certainly not to us. The fact that it remained there throughout our stay indicates that the room had either not been properly cleaned or not properly inspected before being allocated to new guests.

This is not a minor housekeeping lapse. It is a serious hygiene failure that should never occur at any hotel, let alone one that positions itself as one of the finest luxury resorts in the region.

What is even more disappointing is the lack of accountability. We reported the matter, documented it with photographs, and expected at the very least an explanation or acknowledgement from the management. To date, no meaningful communication has been received regarding how such an incident could have occurred.

Luxury hospitality is built on trust. Guests trust that their room has been cleaned thoroughly and prepared to the highest standards. In our case, that trust was broken.

The views of Gulmarg were beautiful, but unfortunately the most memorable part of our stay was discovering something that should never have been present in a guest room in the first place.

reviews.author: Indraneil t
reviews.title: Disappointing Experience at Khyber Hotels and Resorts, Gulmarg: Beware!
reviews.text:
My recent visit to Khyber Hotels and Resorts in Gulmarg left me utterly disappointed and questioning the hype surrounding this place. Despite the exorbitant tariffs, my wife and I decided to give it a try for lunch. Little did we know that we were about to experience a series of letdowns.

Right from the start, we were discouraged by the bell desk, claiming that the restaurant, "Clove," was exclusively reserved for in-house guests. However, upon entering, we discovered a nearly empty restaurant, with only three occupied tables, none of which were occupied by in-house guests as we were led to believe. It became evident that they were simply trying to deter walk-in customers like ourselves.

To add insult to injury, my camera bag was confiscated due to their strict policy against professional photography. While I understand the need for regulations, it felt unwelcoming and intrusive.

Our request for a tour of the property was met with a dismissive response from the receptionist, stating that it would take an hour to complete. We suggested doing the tour after lunch, but it seemed they were more interested in rushing us through our experience.

As for the food itself, it was a major letdown. The Mutton Seekh Kebab, a dish I had enjoyed in various places across the country, was shockingly mediocre. The taste lacked any uniqueness or memorable flavours, leaving me longing for the authentic versions available at a fraction of the cost in Delhi.

The real disappointment came with the Kashmiri Dum Aloo, a dish we were eager to try for the first time in Kashmir. The potatoes served were rock hard, almost inedible. When I inquired about this, the server seemed unaware and uninterested in addressing the issue. They later brought a fresh portion when we were almost done with our meal, rendering it redundant and offering no remedy for our unpleasant experience.

The lacklustre service continued during the property tour. An intern, with minimal knowledge about the hotel, was assigned to guide us. Her inability to answer basic questions about the amenities and evasiveness regarding room availability raised serious doubts about the competence of the staff.

Throughout our visit, it became evident that the hotel staff had little interest in accommodating walk-in guests. They seemed more focused on catering exclusively to their in-house guests, despite the absence of any in-house guests in the restaurant or utilising the amenities.

I cannot help but compare my experience at Khyber Hotels and Resorts with a roadside restaurant in Pahalgam. The stark contrast in taste, quality, and hospitality left me deeply disappointed.

In conclusion, I must warn fellow travellers to approach Khyber Hotels and Resorts with caution. The lack of warmth, subpar food quality, and unprofessional conduct of the staff do not justify the exorbitant prices they charge. Save your hard-earned money and explore alternative options in Gulmarg that offer better value and genuine hospitality.

Rating: 5.5 out of 10.

reviews.author: priyankakandoi
reviews.title: Overpriced, overhyped & simply not worth it
reviews.text:
The thing about this infamous resort which is certainly overhyped is that they’ve managed to use the beautiful Gulmarg view of the snow-capped mountains and the pine & fir trees to their advantage. Take that away, and you’re left with any other mountain resort. In fact, I have stayed at better ones. 

During our check-in, we were told that we’d paid only for 2 guests whereas we were 3 adults. I assured them I’d paid for 3 guests and had to search for the email sent by MakeMyTrip to make them believe me. That was just a minor inconvenience and they more than made up for it by giving us a complimentary room upgrade for which we’re very thankful. But it made me wonder what the room I’d actually booked was like for around 30,000 + taxes because even the upgraded one wasn’t really out of the world. They are literally fleecing guests. Trust me, it’s not worth the money. 

If you’ve heard of the great Kashmiri hospitality, be prepared NOT to witness it here because the staff clearly isn’t bothered. During the breakfast buffet, it’s a maddening rush and they simply have no clue how to handle it. 
Suggestion: Assign one or two tables to one waiter. 
We asked around 5 different waiters for masala tea and still didn’t get a single cup for another twenty minutes or so. I saw a few guests quietly thrust a 100 rupee note into one of the waiter’s hands. Oh so maybe that is why we weren’t served properly because after paying a fortune, are we still expected to tip (or rather bribe) the waiters so that we are served well during our stay. The staff has this high and mighty air about themselves which is clearly not appealing at all. The only person worthy of praise is the ‘Big-Man’ as I’d like to call him since I forgot to make a note of his name. He’s the security in charge and extremely nice & friendly. 

The staff in the pool area were behaving quite strange. They didn’t seem too pleased to see us and nor were they very friendly or helpful in any way. All in all, I’d like to tell you that Khyber certainly is not worth the exorbitant amount they charge. So be careful before you go there all because of social media (which is totally a hoax) and fall prey to this overcharged mess, just the way we did.

-- 
Regards,
Priyanka Kandoi
+91 9800015069

reviews.text: Amidst a small town this place has everything available to ur serve. It’s a huge resort still the service here is worth appreciating. Breakfast spread had number of options to satiate and taste was nice too. They had beautiful view heated swimming pool which was like a major attraction amongst kids. Their kids play area needs to be renovated and should be added more play games as those which were installed were in a damaged condition. One major discomfort I experienced through out my stay was no air conditions in the rooms. They had this option of window but with small kids it was very risky. I am claustrophobic and for people like me it is impossible to stay without a fan or an AC. I would highly recommend them to sort this for future references. I received a due support from Khyber staff during my husbands deteriorated health. Overall it was a pleasant stay apart from the room discomfort I had due to no AC. I recommend this hotel if you are in Gulmarg.

reviews.author: joandee
reviews.title: Perfect as it is
reviews.text:
This hotel is VERY expensive. The first room allocated for me was crappy - it was at the ground floor and the floor length window was 3/4 filled with snow. Absolutely no view. I request for a change, and luckily, there was an availability. The food there is great. The travel from airport to hotel was smooth. There is an operator in the airport which would facilitate your travel upwards. It snowed a lot in Gulmarg and the road back to the airport was difficult. Our flights were cancelled when we were 20min away from the airport. Take note that international travellers have no access to internet and phone line in Kashmir. War zone. So, you need to rely on your driver and hotel for connectivity. 

India is already chaotic as it is, and it is not equipped to handle any additional emergencies and stress.

reviews.title: Beautifully located

reviews.author: Sheikh M
reviews.title: Highly highly overrated utterly disappointed
reviews.text:
At first let me humbly apologise to those who thinks it’s a great property and worth spending 400-500 usd per night in this hotel.
To my opinion it’s a sheer wastage of money. When we step in to a expensive resort we expect service we expect facility we expect good food and good location.
I didn’t see any of these in this hotel apart from a very good location. Only good thing about this hotel is location but if you add on sloppy and slow service poor buffet spread and poor service the upside of a good location flows through your window.
At first let me tell you one by one my experience :
1. Check in. It took an hour to check in .... it’s not that our room was not ready ( we were not informed on that as a cause of delay in check in) we were in the lobby for more than an house before we came to know our room number .
2. Room TV connection was not there when we check in. We had to call few times the service man to fix TV connection.
3. WiFi is poor and slow and it also took more than an hour to fix the WiFi for me . Initially the way I was explained with pass word and ID , I could not log in to my WiFi devise with that password .
3. After paying that huge amount of money per night if you are advised that only two devises are free to use WiFi and more than two device is chargeable then you got a shock. In a family you have multiple device that needs WiFi and surely that more than two.
4. When I booked I mentioned in my booking on booking.com that we will stay with our 10 years old daughter but don’t need any extra bed. This hotel charged us 
USD 60 for my daughter irrespective whether I take any extra bed or not . Trust me no where I faced such and I am sure by now my trip advisor friends noticed that I do Travel a lot and I have never faced this else where.
5. Next morning we went to buffet bfast and the spread was very poor and the only non veg item in that buffet is chicken nuggets and egg which to my expense is poor and when I mentioned this to one of the restaurant guy he seem very reluctant to listen to his and acted like this is it .... take or leave it :(

My opinion is if anyone wants to waste money can surely pick this hotel or else with one night price of this hotel you can have a fantastic stay in gulmarg one night with a good hotel .... food in top rated trip advisor restaurants .... gondola ride with ATR for a family of 4 :)

So it’s your pick whether you spend that money in this hotel for one night or spend that money t have fun in gulmarg for a day with all inclusive.

My rating is based on the return against the price we paid for our stay.

reviews.author: Sharad99
reviews.title: Naysayers
reviews.text:
When I entered the resort I was full of expectations about it. As far as creation of physical infrastructure is concerned undoubtedly they have done a marvelous job. However service and attitude mars every thing. Since we were carrying two suitcases I asked for a stand in the room so that my wife who is suffering from back pain can manage. But the person keeping the luggage didn't turn up with any yes or no. I liked Rajma Rice of a dhaba on the way so I carried it. I requested them to heat it they refused. I went to swimming pool there I asked a person sitting on chair to take mine and my wife's photo he said they are not allowed. In the evening I was interested in having hukka and
 paneer tikka along with some mock tails while my  son was interested in having pizza. I asked them to serve pizza in the lounge as restaurants were about to close in an hour and all of us can sit in one place and have food of our choice but again to my horror and surprise they refused. Both the restaurants were only a few metres away. My son wanted to play with Xbox console but they were having only one unpopular CD. Overall entire staff is anti guest and specialises in saying no. After paying hefty prices this was not what we expected as we have stayed in some of the finest properties of the world including some Oberoi group properties where they go out of the way to pamper the guests.

reviews.author: Ruchita
reviews.title: Beautiful Location
reviews.text: It was just “heaven”... it actually justified to be a must visit in Gulmarg as it is called “heaven on earth” Surrounded by snow and view that gives you beautiful vibes!! reviews.text: Excellent hotel with all the modern fecilities. Irfan at front desk was very helpful all the time.Hotel is well located in lap of nature. Snow laden peaks are visible. Lush green mountains give feeling of heaven

reviews.title: Nice
reviews.text: This hotel is probably the best hotel in Gulmarg. It’s a sky resort hotel. Staff are friendly as is with all hotels in Kashmir. It’s a bit pricy but being the only one at this level it would be. Overall I would say it’s a nice hotel and breakfast is good so is their alacarte menus. Pool and gym are nice and so is the spa.

reviews.author: Anurag Mehrotra
reviews.title: One of its kind ! Amazing stay !
reviews.text:
We stayed in Khyber from the 8th to the 10th Feb 2018, we were greeted by Kahva, a beautiful young lady escorted us to the coffee shop for checking in was a breeze.

The resort was all snow capped and resembled a winter wonderland. However it was full to its capacity and I could see people waiting for a breakfast table.

We had booked for a luxury balcony room with Gulmarg view, DO NOT BOOK THIS ROOM, Make sure you book the ROOM with Himalayan view. The sunken bath tub in the room is alright, however it was a little dirty on arrival and we had to call house keeping to clean it. They were quick and efficient though.

Food is decent and alcohol is served in the evening due to Govt Regulations. They even have a Lounge serving Sheesha, dint try it but looked good. 

Room dinning was excellent with enough options, considering it a 5 star property, I would say the food is up to the mark and reasonable.

The Pool was the highlight of our stay, its flawless, spectacular view, I would say. Even better than the one at Taj Madikeri.

The hotel is beautiful in itself, the best you can have in Gulmarg.

Highly recommend it.

reviews.author: Sanjay2dk
reviews.title: Wonderful Himalayan resort
reviews.text: Beautifully located near snow capped mountains this resort is a must go . Skiing available for almost 5 months . Very helpful and smiling staff and equally good cuisines . They have every thing you can think of for a leisure trip and of course loads of fresh air . Don't miss the spa . Resort doesn't promote alcohol . Being at a high altitude you will have to get acclimatised a little  , hence stay for atleast 5 Nites . Do indulge in tracking and be more with nature . Lovely place !!

reviews.author: Mohitoswal
reviews.title: Do a Khyber Holiday
reviews.text:
my daughter wife and I spent one night at the Khyber.
it was a very nice experience. we had the mountain view balcony room as it was summer. During Snow the Meadow facing room would probably be better. 

The room was well laid out and the Bath was outstanding with good toiletries.

The food and room service is also very good. I could sit in the Balcony for the entire day.

We did use the Spa and the pool and found it to be a great experience.

The Hotel is very close to the Gandola and the fact the Vehicle entry is restricted in the area it makes for nice walks or horse riding.

reviews.author: Esther P
reviews.title: Beautiful rooms, wonderful stay
reviews.text:
This is a beautiful, well-located property built and operated to an international 5-star standard.    I was assigned a “Premier” (standard) room (#1010) which faced  a local home, outhouse and further on, the town of Gulmarg.  The valley view would have been acceptable anyplace else, but my goal in this visit was to see and enjoy the mountains.  

So I asked to pay extra to upgrade to a mountain view room with balcony.    I was given the room across the hall #1009) which had a balcony, sitting area and views of the hotel gardens as well as the snow capped mountain range.    Consider if you really want the  “Valley View.”  The upgrade to the Luxury Balcony room was 9,000 rupees per nite and worth it.

The Himalayan View room was comfortable, with a nice sitting area as well as a balcony.   I particularly enjoyed the power-shower and the well designed bathroom.  

The hotel restaurant is very good.  It has an interesting menu to suit every taste and I particularly enjoyed the very good Salad Nicoise and grilled fish dish.

I had one treatment in the spa and found it  very high quality and  professional.  The therapist explains everything  they are doing, as well as the products being used.  I had the Signature 90 min. massage and was so thoroughly relaxed afterwards that I forgot to go to dinner.

I had some issues with the wi-fi, but it may have been local to my room.  Wi-fi was  strong and stable in the restaurant and lobby areas.

It is a short walk downhill to the Gondola ride.

reviews.author: Thakral R
reviews.title: Good facilities in sophisticated price.
reviews.text: Good housekeeping services with awesome staff attention towards their guests.This is very beautiful and nice hotel located just opposite to Gulmarg Gondola.This hotel provides you all the facilities which are required in Gulmarg.This hotel has massage spa as well and other basic facilities are available.

reviews.author: Vandana G
reviews.title: Much hyped property for the price
reviews.text: We stayed for 1 night at this beautiful hotel Khyber in Gulmarg. I believe this is the only five star and highly recommended property by everyone. The hotel was good, excellent services but definitely not worth the price. Maybe during peak season and a bit of a last minute booking we got a slightly high rate of almost 23K for the night, which seemed high and not really worth the property. There was nothing so extra special about the place which I could really go back and talk about, rather I felt it is over hyped. There was an indoor pool though for kids and a small activity play room to keep them busy. Staff is helpful, services and food was good.  Overall a nice experience.

reviews.author: Pinank77
reviews.title: Good Hotel in Gulmarg
reviews.text:
While you are visiting Gulmarg this is the best place to stay and I cannot recommend any other hotels in Gulmarg.
Right opposite to Gondola cable ride. In Gulmarg you do not have many things to do, but when you are in Khyber you are on your own because it has great facilities to offer, great views of the mountains.
The rooms i felt are a bit smaller. 
The restaurant offered excellent food and all the staff at the restaurant is very co-operative. The food was superb.

reviews.author: Bilal A
reviews.title: Best hotel in gulmarg
reviews.text: This is very beautiful and nice hotel located just opposite to Gulmarg Gondola.This hotel provides you all the facilities which are required in Gulmarg.This hotel has massage spa as well and other basic facilities are available.

reviews.author: sangee468
reviews.title: Conplete package !!
reviews.text: After an ordeal of getting stuck in the highway due to snowfall..the resort was quite a sightn respite . The wooden architecture ,  glass walled rooms, and carpeted galleries added to the rustic charm of the place . The food is undoubtedly class apart and so was the view. The spa is deservingly world class n so is the indoor heated pool with glass walls .overall a must visit for those who experience mountain callings !!! The walk to the resort from road is quite uphill and may not be doable for most plain dwellers. So one shud plan accordingly .

reviews.author: Darshan B
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: Stayed here first week of June and it was amazing. The service was impressive and Mr. Asrar gave us a free room upgrade too..  I would definitely recommend this hotel in gulmarg. The breakfast is extravagant and tasty...

reviews.author: Vamins
reviews.title: Summer Vacation In The Vally
reviews.text:
Beautiful Property 
It was my second visit to Khyber in last 4 months.

Stay: Excellent 
Food: Excellent
Service: Excellent 
Location: Excellent 

Expensive but all worth it.

Gonna visit again in Feb got Ski Trip

reviews.author: Aastha K
reviews.title: Snowy holiday
reviews.text: A place where one gets stunned to see so much beauty. The hotel is the best thing about gulmarg. Food, pool, the ambience, the rooms there is just nothing wrong about this place. You name it and you have it. The staff is so so so brilliant. Never ever seen such courteous people. I would have given 5/5 but we were disappointed with the packed breakfast. We were 8 people and were provided only 5 food packs as we had to leave at 5am due to unrest in the valley. But those packs were pathetic. The sandwiches in that were stale and every food pack didnt even have all things. Would be nice if this doesnt happen with any other guest.

reviews.author: umesh_12
reviews.title: Feel Royal at Khyber
reviews.text:
It's one of the best resort in Gulmarg. You can spend good time with your family. Plan for atleast for 4-5 days. Try to spend 2-3 days in resort also. Plenty of activities for children as well as for adults.
Resort is having different interior & exterior look. Food quality is also good. Those who likes spicy food, they can also enjoy.

reviews.author: anugarg890

reviews.text:
I was here for the vacation enjoyed the hospitality at the best with best services, the resort with most best view in Gulmarg high sunrise peak sunrise
 and best dining experience . To add awesome food which has taste for all which includes beautiful laid buffet for dinner and awesome tea experience in evening tea

reviews.author: kochhardelhi
reviews.title: Good hotel with average views and service
reviews.text: khyber gulmarg is new resort hotel in quaint lol town of Gulmarg. The hotel is nicely made with local kashmiri architecture and memrobilia. What lacks in khyber is open views of gulmarg bowl and average service. The service is slow snd sluggish and even running orders take them good 35/40 minutes to deliver. At the charges you are paying this kind of service is totally unacceptable. We went for meal to Highlands park and really liked the gulmarg valley views from their lounge.

reviews.author: medhavig4u
reviews.title: Different & royal interiors
reviews.text: This hotel has an altogether different interior and their rooms are spacious royal indeed. The location is the best. Food is good, staff friendly & smiling. Room service is fast. Just a tip: my husband found the front desk staff a bit rude. Else everything was just awesome!

reviews.author: sameeragarwal0009
reviews.title: The Khyber
reviews.text: Extremely wonderful to be there. We had lunch buffet at the Khyber and the food was awesome and the menu was elaborate. Perfect ambience for staying. Good view of the valley from Hotel Lobby. Interiors and Architecture of the hotel is very good.

reviews.author: santosh t
reviews.title: Best hotel with great hospitality
reviews.text:
We have stayed in many high class hotel properties around India and abroad . .

This was undoubtedly one of the best property with stunning views of Ice capped mountains and pine and fur trees. . It is one of the largest property with excellent Resturant serving finest food for foodies like us.

The class in hospitality was experienced from the word go . . Our checking inn was handled very efficiently and a personalised service by Mr Bilal , with a ever smiling face and ever ready to help attitude was a very nice experience . . Such a staff makes the property a class apart. He was very helpful to even change our room with a far better views . .

The staff in the Restuarant was equally efficient and well trained to treat every guest with smile and willingness to serve. . They made our 3 nights stay in the hotel very memorable. 

The place is just 3 minutes walk to the Iconic gandola station in Gulmarg. Be ready to hike the peak on which this property is situated as in Gulmarga , you can not use private or tourist vehicle. There is Union which makes it compulsory to use either horses or local vehicles . .

After a tiring tour around  , you have the option of being pampered by a classy spa in this hotel. . Of course - over priced but must try . .

Stay in this world class hotel with best security arrangement was memorable. If you can afford then this is truly the most luxurious hotel in entire Kashmir. .

Positives -

reviews.author: Fibonacci 7
reviews.title: Paradise in Kashmir
reviews.text:
Khyber Himalayan Resort and Spa is easily the best resort in Gulmarg.It is very popular with ski enthusiasts and is located very close to the Gondola
We celebrated our anniversary amidst the snow covered peaks and were blessed with a snowfall a day after we checked in
The Jacuzzi was very good and so was the heated pool
The Hotel lobby was done up very tastefully .The rooms are large in size and the decor is very pleasing to the eye
The buffet dinner was good though we expected to find kashmiri delicacies like Rista and Goshtaba which were missing from the menu

Winter is the best time to go as the snow capped mountains and the white valley looks very beautiful and picturesque .The hotel is always full so it is better to book in advance

reviews.author: Ashish A
reviews.title: Overhyped
reviews.text:
Stayed for 2 nights. 
Positives : location, facilities (heated pool, games room).  

Issues :
1) Air - conditioning /room ventilation. As a winter ski resort, designed for central heating but no ventilation /cooling for the summer. Whats worse they have a promising panel in the room which gives the sense of individual temp control.  
Uncomfortable sleep while paying 5 star rates is unbecoming. 

2) F&B: Quality of food is average. The service is unfortunately sub-par. Waiters needed to be reminded multiple times before you got what you needed.  

I should mention that when the feedback was escalated to Mr.  Basheer and Nawaz, they reacted very well and made best attempt to make amends.  

Overall, we had a reasonable stay at the hotel and it is probably the best property in gulmarg - but there does seem to be a complacency in service in knowing they will have a good stream of business regardless.
