reviews.author: travelunlimited
reviews.title: Amazing Property!!
reviews.text: It was quite a wonderful place so beautifully constructed. Rooms were spacious and cosy. Bathrooms are large and clean. Food was very delicious with lots of variety in the morning buffet and dinner too. Having such luxury and comfort at such a high altitude was totally a different experience. The hotel has indoor pool with large glass windows from where you can have a spectacular view of the valley. It is complimented  with jacuzzi and sauna facilities. Staff was helping and efficient. Overall it was a great experience 🖒.

reviews.author: Harkirat_Singh
reviews.title: Luxury nestled in the Himalayas
reviews.text:
The best place to stay in Gulmarg (or rather Kashmir) by far. Absolutely no doubt where to head to, if you want to experience luxury in the hills. The property itself is nestled up on a mountain with great views all around. While the valley view rooms & city view rooms with private balconies are awesome, even Premier Room with Forest View ain’t bad. The lawns are well maintained and provide for a calm walk. 

The spa itself is great, managed by L'occitane. The use of steam, sauna and jacuzzi is complimentary with the stay, while you can book an appointment with the spa for anything more specific. The indoor heated swimming pool is out of this world. With huge floor to ceiling glass walls enclosing the pool overlooking the mountains & trees, you need to experience it to believe it.

The food is great and the service prompt. Since we had a small baby, we did trouble them for baby food, baby cot, etc. and they didn’t disappoint. 

Do note, the access to the hotel is through a very steep short road. So if you’re walking down to the town, be ready for a steep climb back, though it isn’t a long one. The Gulmarg Gondola is located very close to the hotel and you can just walk down.

reviews.author: Ashish G
reviews.title: Amazing Place
reviews.text:
In the middle of nowhere nestled amidst the pines is this wonderfully exotic hotel. The rooms and and food are really worth every bit that they charge. The unfortunate part is that there is no free wifi. This is such a small thing and yet bugs you to pay. I have yet to come across a hotel in this sort of category charging for wifi. Its like charging someone to use the loo !!! ;-)

Otherwise, the whole holiday was wonderful there.

reviews.author: Surbhi C
reviews.title: Poor Hospitality
reviews.text: FOR A 5+ star hotel i would rate the property 9/10 but for service i wish i cld hv an option of negative rating. We had been der last week a bunch of 13 out of which 5 were kids. So to start with we stayed der for 2 nights paying a 45k plus for those two nights only with complimentary breakfast. A 5 star property denied us a free wifi connection n we were asked to take a paid option...made us wonder which 5* hotel does that. With kids being with us age 4 n half yrs refuse to sit at one place n complete a meal of course for thier mood swings..due to which we requested d hotel for us to pack some breakfast for them...v were to our surprise denied! We had to literally beg for 2 days to lets us pack some breafast for our toddlers...n yes i repeat it made us beg!! post which we were allowed with a very ltd choice n no. of food items( say just about 2/3 idlis e.g). I mean which hotel denies food for toddlers????? On the day of our checkout whr we needed to leave by 8am for our further excursions...the breakfast wasnt ready till 8am..v reached der by 7:30/45am dey refused to even switch on the lights in d breafast area till it was 8am...der were so many other quests who were as zapped as us to know a 5* hotel not serving breakfast b4 8!!!! At that very tym der was a gas leakage in the live food counter which was  unattended by staff memebers...they were completely unaware about this...some guest waiting for the breakfast to start had to personally go in the kitchen area to inform them about this...surprise surprise...none of them seem to b bothered about the same...after repeated calling only then d staff came to d location of gas leakage.Then wen it was tym for checkout in one of our rooms v had used this small handsize towels to wipe some dust on children shoes...n to our biggest surprise we were asked to pay for that dirty napkin.....after a lot of arguements the hotel agreed to not charge for that small dirty towel...i mean v din understand then wat were we paying that 45k plus amount for???? The 45k didnt include free wifi...it didnt include some breakfast to b packed for our toddlers...it didnt include breakfast to b ready by 7....to top it ignorant staff over d gas leak...n icicng on d cake 45 thousand cldnt take care of an used towel??????? Y shld one visit an hotel like this is the question....n ya lastly to top it...the hotel manager comes back arguing that our hotel is a luxury hotel and thats y it cant gives us free wifi???? my question then wat are Taj/ Leela/Hyatt etc hotels?? arent dey luxury hotels??? just for the information of this hotel...we all have been members n customers to these top notch 7* hotels...so plz dnt try to explain us as to wat is a luxury hotel!!!!!! A completely disgusted customer with your poor service n for your so called luxury hotel!!!!!

I saw this hotels ad many a times in travel magazines,so when the time came to book gulmarg,i knew we had to stay here.i am glad we stayed here,our room had the best view,of the mountains right infront of us,me and my family spent almost all day in the balcony watching.worth the stay

reviews.author: Prashant
reviews.title: Warm and Comfortable
reviews.text: Its very warm and comfortable place to stay in Gulmarg. Its very close to Gondola ride. The resort has been setup nicely to give you great views of the snow capped mountains throughout the year. Their attention to service and food is amazing. Try their Kashmiri Kahwa.Their spa and heated pool is worth a visit. The bathrooms are neat and very modern and rooms are a fine mix. Its a place where you find warm Kashmiri hospitality at its best. Its a very quiet and wonderful place to relax.

reviews.author: RambhushanK
reviews.title: Lovely Property
reviews.text: The property is really classy and is very impressive. Lovely facilities and good helpful staff make the stay very comfortable. Breakfast was excellent but the dinner was ok. Facilites are quite good and we had a wonderful time.

reviews.author: heemantsing29
reviews.title: Must Visit
reviews.text:
I travelled Gulmarg 11th March 2016.

We were having our small kid 2 years with us and as we entered the room it was very warm and comfortable, Though outside heavy snowfall was happening and temperature was negative.

Hotel staff was very polite and helpful, We never faced any challenge in service and we were served all requirement for kid well in time, which was our priorit Food taste is not excellent but its good.

Overall it was a good experience for me and my family.

reviews.author: Karishma88
reviews.title: Service needs a major overhaul!
reviews.text:
Stayed here for 2 nights.

Positives:
1. Good location - Close to main attraction (Phase 1 and 2/Gondola ride) and great view of snow capped mountains
2. Spacious rooms and good amenities
3. Good spa experience 
4. Beautiful pool
5. Amazing breakfast spread

Negatives:
1. Wifi is on chargeable basis. Even their main competitor Hotel Highlands provides free wifi!
2. Service is very slow. Took them ages to clear the used dishes we placed outside our room. Took them ages to send someone over to collect the luggage for check out. The receptionist hung up on us abruptly in the middle of an enquiry. They were aware that an elderly person was travelling with us but still gave us rooms in the far end of the hotel which were quite a walk from the main lobby and 2 floors at the bottom! This was a major inconvenience.
3. The women's jacuzzi looked worn out with a big rusted nail lying loose in the tub and parts of the surface peeling out. 
4. The pool area is beautiful no doubt, but a huge piece of shattered glass remained on the glass wall just above the pool. This is a major hazard and it only takes a small bird or a twig or a huge gush of wind to send it crashing down and seriously injure someone in the area. 
5. The restaurants are terribly overpriced.

When we pay so much for our stay, we expect good service. It is for these reasons that Khyber was not our most preferred hotel during our entire trip to Kashmir, although it was the most expensive!

reviews.author: MarciaA1973
reviews.title: Suíça na India
reviews.text: Este é o melhor hotel da região. Fica muito próximo ao centro, de onde sai a Gondola que leva as pistas de ski. Os quartos eram amplos e tinham vista para o patio interno e as montanhas nevadas ao fundo. Não havia muitas opções de divertimento, além da piscina, academia e spa.

reviews.author: Sunil Bhat
reviews.title: Stunning
reviews.text: This is situated in the middle of the jungle and is one the stunning Hotels i have ever seen with a scintillating views breathtaking landscapes you got to visit property once in a lifetime service is also awesome

reviews.author: Ritikanayyar
reviews.title: Excellent property, great food..
reviews.text: We visited the resort in th first week of March 2016. The resort is superb, very nice rooms, lovely scenic views from majorly all rooms.. Especially at the time of snow fall, which we experienced all the three days that we were there.. Food is very nice!! They make arrangements for gum boots for walking in the snow as well.. Staff is very helpful and friendly.. The indoor heated pool is big plus.. It's a gorgeous scene wen ur swimming inside and it's snowing outside.. We had a lovely stay..

reviews.author: Anang_11
reviews.title: Over Hyped - Over Rated - Over Priced
reviews.text:
We were in Khyber for 2 nights stay. We booked this hotel almost four months before. When I entered my credit card details, entire amount was charged immediately, without asking for pin., which was surprising. 

Any how when we reached hotel, we showed our online booking receipt. Staff agreed that booking was confirmed but were not sure that payment had been made. Room allotted to us was premium and having himalayan view. Rooms were specious, clean, well appointed. There was open gallery with sit out, facing snow caped mountains. Bed was large and comfortable. Wash rooms were clean and well designed. But room was not properly ventilated. We had to keep balcony doors open to avoid suffocation. But after some time found room too cold in side and had to close doors. No proper room temperatures were maintained. We called then in the midnight to set A/C temperatures but were advised to keep gallery doors open.

Location of Khyber is a great advantage. (walking distance from Gandola Ride, the main attraction in Gulmarg). View from Rooms, Restaurants and from all over hotel are beautiful. Entire property of the Hotel is Decent and well maintained. Right from Entrance to Rooms, Spa, Pool , every thing gives a feeling of Five Star Hotel.

But when it comes to service and hospitality, it is no way near Five Star Category. The Rates we pay for Rooms are too high as compared to service, warmth and hospitality to be rated as Five Star. It lacks the feeling of luxurious treatment. Staff is required to be trained properly. 

When you are charging so huge rates for rooms you are supposed to provide basic amenities and facilities. No Free WiFi. No proper Travel desk to provide full information and assistance for Gandola Ride. Though Hotel is a walking distance from Gandola, approach road is on a steep slope. Difficult to walk. But no complimentary dropping and pick up facility. Restaurant is too small, considering number of rooms in Hotel. No Multiple restaurants and dining options available. Room service was pathetic. Telephoned to then several times to remove dishes after lunch but nobody turned. We ourselves removed it and kept it outside and it was lying there for hours. But no one bothered to remove it. Restaurant is overpriced and above that room service rates are further 30 % higher. No Chinese food available. At the time of check in we were told to book restaurant first for dining. When we telephoned to book a seat, we were told that restaurant is full and we had to go there and wait for a seat to sit. and this happened every time. 

In all it was a mixed feeling for us. Too costly Five Star property, which lacks five star hospitality. Awesome location, great views, Good Rooms but at the end of the day no luxurious feeling. 

I will not visit again and will find better option next time.

reviews.author: Singh S
reviews.title: the best hotel visited in India!!
reviews.text:
this is the Best property visited so far in India!
If you ever want to visit Gulmarg,this is the place to be!
the place,the aura the décor,impeccable.Expensive but worth it!!

The palace gives you a perfect amalgamation of old world charms and modernity.
the swimming pool has a breathtaking glass view with mountains on one side and trees on the other.It is also very near to golkunda.

reviews.author: priti q
reviews.title: Khyber in Gulmarg
reviews.text: The Khyber is a strange alpine chalet that has evolved into a multilevel wood and stone series of buildings. It is close to the Gondola/ ski lift terminus so if you are a skier its a great location. The rooms were well appointed as were the bathrooms. The buffet was a strange mixture of Indian, Chinese with a pasta dish thrown in to make it continental. The tea shop in the lobby sells Kashmiri Kawa to die for and scones that are like flat biscuits. Very tasty indeed.

reviews.author: Haresh55
reviews.title: Khyber makes Gulmarg feel like mini Switzerland.
reviews.text:
High priced but you would never want anything more. Very classy decors, temperature controlled swimming pool, spa, well equipped gym.... you name it. Rooms were in excellent condition with breathtaking view. The staff was warm and very prompt to help.
I was impressed by the hospitality of the General Manager Mr. Sukhjit Herbert who personally interacted with us (guests) and made sure everything was perfect. He also asked us for some suggestions and our overall hotel experience. We thank him for his time and patience.
Food experience was also good in terms of variety and taste. We had taken dinner and breakfast buffet. My wife is Jain religion practitioner and the food was prepared fresh for her according to her own choice. The entire restaurant experience was excellent thanks to hard work, politeness and dedication of Mr. Sajaad Lone. His enthusiasm, care for the guests and management skills contributed to our excellent experience.
Overall I would say, Khyber is the best hotel one could find in Gulmarg. Though a bit expensive, every penny is indeed worth the experience.

reviews.author: Sanjeev S
reviews.title: Simply Awesome...but devil's in the details
reviews.text:
There isn't much to do in Gulmarg. But one can spend 2 nights, or even more in Gulmarg, just for the Resort! There's class, there's expanse, there's thoughtfulness in the design, style & decor of the place. Heated indoor pool, with glass all-around, global Spa, not so trained, but really warm staff. I would love to go there again, surprisingly, in spite of a few small-small misses.
Like, really low class, broken tea kettle; AC that you can't control; toilet jet that has very long pipe and water flow is just too much; tea stuff that's not replenished;  mattress that's just too-too soft; food that doesn't taste great; rate for same food in room being much higher than restaurant; staff that keeps banging things and makes so much noise and a front office manager who's a bit racist....

reviews.author: prasadmehta
reviews.title: Superb
reviews.text: Superb location, courteous staff and amazing spa. View from the room is amazing with snow clad mountains. Had one of the authentic Kahwa on arrival. The lobby is grand and rooms are quite spacious and comfortable. Food is great and especially the options for breakfast. Will visit again!

reviews.author: rogercharlie
reviews.title: Stunningly Beautiful
reviews.text:
Stayed at the Khyber for three nights in a Himalayan View room. This hotel has class and character. The common areas and the rooms are beautifully designed. Probably one of the most beautiful hotels I have stayed in - and certainly the most beautiful setting for a pool I have ever seen.

The food is quite good - and the menu offers a very wide choice - there is something there for everyone.

I see several negative comments on service. I found the service to be quite good. The hotel staff were very welcoming and accommodating.

reviews.author: SanjayRajpal
reviews.title: Went to meet some friends..
reviews.text: The place is like a grand palace. Fantastic from outside and inside.. It has everything from an indoor pool to a gym room, spa ..recreation etc. Good restaurants. Rooms were very nice and big with a sit out balcony but Frightfully expensive.

reviews.author: AkneogTikna
reviews.title: Can do better
reviews.text:
The title is a typical comment from my school days' report card.
- can do better
- still can do better
- good. but can do better with a little more effort
That's exactly how I felt. More involvement from the team & genuine warmth needed. I interacted with Jerin who showed me around the property quite a bit. Thanks for your personal attention.
Little more professional touch would do wonders.
Food menu also needs variety just like I mentioned for Pahalgam hotel & Vivanta Srinagar.
Views are great & luxuriously done all the way from reception to the bathroom to the amenities. ATTENTION MANAGEMENT - solve the seepage issues ASAP while your woodwork can be saved. Oh! and buck up with the check-out process!!!! None paying in the range of 20k per night finds it acceptable to wait anything in excess of 5-10 mins for baggage to be transferred from room to portico. We and other guests in our presence waited beyond half an hour!

reviews.author: greeengirl
reviews.title: Stunning... Stunning.... Stunning
reviews.text: What can one say about Khyber... it's a stunning hotel with a stunning backdrop against it.... the spa is nice for a massage, the pool lovely but we had a lot of kids making noise... but that's probably a one time thing... the food was good... a little spicy... but it's gorgeous.. a 2 min walk from the gondolas.... a must stay when in gulmarg.. .so much so, that please plan your visit to gulmarg according to the hotel's availability.

reviews.author: Nareshjindal
reviews.title: Good hotel, good location but bad in services
reviews.text: Hotel location superb, rooms and facilities excellent but when it comes to services, they are not good. Any order on room service may take even 2-3 hours usually. House keeping staff still more worse in their behavior.   At time of checkout, i informed the reception at 9:45 am but luggage didn't come down even by 11 am.

reviews.author: Vadiraj Kulkarni
reviews.title: Himayalan beauty
reviews.text: The majestic royal hotel and resort is the best place to stay at Gulmarg. The expanse and the treatment are out of the world. The rooms are very majestic and functionally exceptional. Food is outstanding and staff very warm and courteous. The best part is the view from the sit outs. You can just sit, relax with a cup of kahwa and watch the beautiful snow capped mountains and trees.

reviews.author: neerajgoel
reviews.title: A perfect match with nature
reviews.text:
We stayed here in 2nd week of June 2015 a group of 20 people 5 families. The best stay one can imagine. Very nice property. Excellent location. Very nice rooms. The best food you can imagine of. Very good service. Excellent House keeping. Good Dinning. Very good Menu. Very nice spa. Heated pool is an added feature. Good security. Very nice view.

A few drawbacks : Charging 7 star property rates but no plants, no greenery inside hotel. A few plastic pots are placed but plants in bad position. Spread in 8 acres but no flowers. Parking system very bad. Our taxis were not allowed to stay in parking. So for 2 days we were without vehicle. The location of hotel is on a hill. So your climb from Market or Gandola ride to hotel is a night mare. No service of pick and drop from Hotel. Just the thought of climbing stops you to go outside. I strongly feel that hotel should provide these basic facilities. Other wise all ok.

reviews.author: Vyomaparikh
reviews.title: Disappointment
reviews.text: Extremely unfortunate to have visited this place.. Hospitality and service could be marked negative... They cannot cope up with the guests.. Would not recommend anyone to visit ... Not at all worth the price you pay.

reviews.author: Abhiroop
reviews.title: Awesome ecstatic place amidst the mountains but bad service
reviews.text: We were here for only 1 night since next day we had to leave for Srinagar. At first, when you enter you would feel the royalty that is presence in the decoration of the lobby and the surrounding areas. Exquisitely decorated interiors and wooden finishes all over the hotel is just amazing. Coming to the room, they upgraded me to the  mountains view room with a quite large balcony to sit and feel the calmness around. Everything is ok except for the service and no free Wifi to resident guests. Other hotels of lower category such as Vivanta by Taj  offer at least 24hrs of free usage but Khyber does not. Another point which disappoints you the most is the poor service when it comes to necessary in room services such as toiletries or such other things. Also they dont provide packages such as including one major meal or something of that sort which makes it a little tough on the pocket if you staying for 1 day. Apart from all of these, this is the best place to imbibe and feel the pure snowcapped mountains.

reviews.author: ML84
reviews.title: Royal, Gorgeous and Simply Superb
reviews.text:
We had a wonderful and a very memorable stay at the Khyber Gulmarg. What an awesome property so tastefully and well done. 

Right from the staff to the location to the room views. Please stay in the Himalayan view rooms they are breathtakingly beautiful and worth every penny.

Also the food at their restaurant is excellent. Very good buffet spread and excellent variety and superb taste.

We enjoyed every bit of our stay thanks to Jerin, Zaffar, Preet and Bikash you guys are awesome and can't thank you enough.

I totally recommend this property as a must stay and visit.

A special mention the Spa was excellent and worth the money. Thank you Bikash.

Can't wait to plan my next stay here.

reviews.author: Siddhid
reviews.title: Heaven nestled in snow peaked mountains
reviews.text: Amazing royally done up property with excellent location in Gulmarg. Staff is nice and food is good too. Best to take the rooms with a private balcony overlooking the snow peaked mountain range. Thanks for the warm hospitality Kashmiri style!

reviews.author: Very L
reviews.title: Stunning hotel with soulless service
reviews.text:
The Khyber is a grand property worthy of the praises it has received, view were stunning, rooms were great and food served was excellent all at par with any 5-star international hotel. 

Physically it may live up to its reputation however the service was without soul especially front desk and mid level staff appeared not to be well trained and unmotivated.

And 5-star hotel charging for something as ubiquitous as wi-fi?

reviews.author: NIkhilSama
reviews.title: Heavenly !
reviews.text:
Food, Spa, Pool, View, Room - Everything was outstanding ! 

Heated pool with floor to ceiling glass overlooking surreal snow capped mountains.  Excellent spa.  The restaurant, clove is the only the second place I know (first is 360), that can do a good job across cuisines.  We tried Indian, Kashmiri, Italian, South Indian and breakfast - Each cuisine was done as if it were a Clove specialty.  

Without any doubt the best place to be in Gulmarg !

reviews.author: Laosin
reviews.title: The only Place worth staying in Kashmir 'The Khyber'
reviews.text: This was our first visit to Kashmir and would like to share our experience. We visited Kashmir in May 2015 ( 9 persons) and were super excited as Kashmir is supposed to be Heaven on earth.Before zeroing on hotels my brother in law and I went through every site and review on the Internet but still after paying a lot of money( 10 days cost more than a foreign trip) and booking the best hotels , like Senator Pine n Peak (Best in Pahalgam according to reviews) Heevan , Lalit , Queen Elizabeth House Boat in Srinagar  etc. the only place that felt like Heaven was The Khyber Himalayan Spa and resort in Gulmarg. We spent two days there and it was the best days of our trip ( book the Luxury Room ). The other great experience we had was visiting the Zero point location from Sonmarg ... It was snowing to our good luck and it was the most amazing sight....truly magical, though quite far from Srinagar  and very tiring. Pahalgam was just okay not the great visual treat we had expected. The most disappointing experience was Gondola( after being at Zero point in Sonmarg this felt like a waste of money as visually it was disappointing and not worth the money, time and energy ( spent 5 minutes at Phase 1 and 10 minutes at phase 2  and paid 1400 per head plus 1000 for a guide ). All said and done the next time we visit Kashmir we will drive straight from Srinagar airport to The Khyber in Gulmarg which is about 1.5 hr drive and spend our full vacation there as believe me it is one of the best 5 star Resort and Spa in India Or maybe in the world  too and worth every penny.

reviews.author: RuchiMehta2014
reviews.title: Amazing holiday spot
reviews.text: I loved the heated indoor pool where the kids and I spent the evening. The deep intensity massage at the L'occitane Spa was relaxing. The connecting rooms we got were perfect for a family holiday. All in all, a great place to stay in Gulmarg.

reviews.author: Sumeetbr
reviews.title: world class
reviews.text: everything about the hotel radiates class and good taste...from the grand lobby and common areas, the views from the coffee shop, the welcome, the rooms which are absolutely 5 star, to the staff, the spa and the heated pool with a view, the food, the breakfasts, the service...absolutely top class...nothing in kashmir comes close to this...

reviews.author: rajneesh2052
reviews.title: Awesome Property and Simply paradize in Gulmarg
reviews.text: We really enjoyed our stay at Khyber Gulmarg, would like to specially thank Mr. Aman F&B Manager who was very helpful during the stay.  The location is superb just next to gondola ride with superb view of snow claded mountains. Simply You Guys Rock !!

reviews.author: menonkk
reviews.title: Heavenly View
reviews.text: The entry to the hotel itself was awe inspiring.   The sight of the snow peaked mountains  from the hotel makes your jaw drop.  The lobby which is centrally heated makes a warm welcome from the chill outside.  The rooms are large  and spacious.  The washrooms  are elegant and neatly done. The  window  of the  bathroom offering view of nature is interesting and beautiful. The balcony opening to nature is nice place to relax and have a cuppa.  Good Health Club facilities. The view from  the Gymnasium and the heated swimming pool makes it very difficult to pull yourself out from these places. Can still improve on the food palate and food charges are exorbitant.  Staff are courteous and special thanks to Mr. Sajad who arranged to transport our misplaced camera  at the Hotel to Srinagar. The higher altitude makes breathing a bit difficult.

reviews.author: Sheela3
reviews.title: amazing experience
reviews.text: very good resort in gulmarg with view of mountain snow hills , it is near ropeway starting point so can walk and go to snow peaked mountain, excellent view on way . hotel have loccitane spa very good peaceful nice experience ,heated  pool also inside , other facilities also good . food was good , staff corteious helpful . once in gulmarg must to stay in khyber resort.

reviews.author: PGglobetrotter
reviews.title: I would give it a 10 star
reviews.text:
Honestly, I have never EVER seen such a beautiful property! I was there in March and I still miss it every single day!

I would give it a 10 star but sadly the highest they go is 5.
Its fantastic. Gorgeous view, right in the center of Gulmarg, good breakfast and dinner buffet, amazing rooms and nice atmosphere.

It is the only place you should stay at when in Gulmarg! 

Hats off to the Khyber Team for making my stay so so so so enjoyable.

reviews.author: Aman P
reviews.title: One of the best hotels in the world
reviews.text: Better than any suisse chalet.Fantastic property to take the kids to and just as well for a Honeymoon couple. A real class act from the owner.The gym and pool facilities are state of the art,heated and all.Would love to visit again.Just need to improve a bit on service and food.

reviews.author: shrutisingh11
reviews.title: Best place to stay in Gulmarg
reviews.text: We went in the the month of may and had an amazing experience. The food here is awesome. Break fast spread is lavish. Rooms are very cozy and comfortable. All the staff are very humble and helpful. They have the best tea / kava.

reviews.author: Sanjay Jain
reviews.title: EXCELLENT LOCATION AND GREAT HOSPITALITY
reviews.text: It is the best resort currently on Hill in India with the best view of nature mountain and snow. To top up it has great indoor recreation facility. The general manager Mr Succoth is a great person to interact and ensures that you are the most comfortable guest in his hotel. The food too is great so is the Gymnasium and swimming pool. You rally need to be hear to experience luxury with nature.

reviews.author: Gotta Travel
reviews.title: A destination in its own right
reviews.text:
There are those people who come to Gulmarg & then there are those who come to the Khyber. The Khyber has truly become a destination in its own right. Gulmarg was crying out for a property like this - top end rooms, very high end villas, good food & a great spa. 

The rooms are large, well appointed & comfortable. All the mod-cons are at your finger tips - temperature control, in room coffee/tea making making facilities, satellite TV, wifi (with slightly iffy speed & signal strength). The bathrooms are nice with a separate shower stall & a tub by the window. The tubs are perfect for a romantic soak as you watch the moon rise over the mountains. 

Room tip - ask for a room facing the spa because it's a better view though the rooms on the other side aren't shabby either. 

The hotel offers a multi cuisine restaurant, with both a buffet & a menu to choose from. The breakfast is a star meal with a live egg station and fabulous South Indian dosa-idli breakfasts. There is a tea lounge with a wide range of teas & coffees. If you are trying to kick the caffeine habit try the rose tea, it's amazing. 

A hookah or sheesha lounge is available tans is a nice place to spend the evening chatting & reliving the days experiences. 

Point to note - the hotel doesn't sell alcohol but will be happy to serve you your own if you bring it with you. 

The spa is a revelation with a lovely heated pool. Heaven is watching the snow come down as you lounge around in the pool. There is a gym with some basic free weights, a multi gym and some cardio equipment. I haven't tried the treatment rooms but it's a La Occitane spa so it must be great. 

So whether it's a honeymoon, a family holiday or a skiing trip this is a great place to stay.

reviews.author: Shaan S
reviews.title: Worth it.
reviews.text:
This hotel was simply amazing, the mountain view rooms are spectaculars and the location of the hotel was next to the action but super quite since it was slightly up a hill. The service was fantastic, although some management issues prevailed as only one restaurant was functional and too many visitors in the hotel, they had a cafe with seating but refused to open it for any meals this meant waiting 10 mins to be seated. I really loved this hotel and I'd suggest it to anyone that can afford it! One thing that brought me down majorly was the crowd, super noisy in outdoor spaces and not very pleasing to to be around, one couple was swimming fully clothed in the pool which really put me off from swimming there, even though the pool was heavenly with a spectacular view! 

I would highly recommend this hotel!

reviews.author: VanessaMunYee
reviews.title: fantastic view
reviews.text:
This luxury resort located right at the hilltop from the Cable car station and we could just hike from the resort to some really nice alley

The lobby is huge however the staff took so long to check us in. We had to go for lunch first while waiting for the check in. 

Our room was huge and clean with a couch and a balcony with fantastic view. We had a comfortable bed. Bathroom was clean and big with enough amenities.

They have a restaurant with excellent mountain view.

Wifi is not free.

reviews.author: janetmac
reviews.title: Double Bath with Mountain View
reviews.text: We were very well received at this hotel. Although our stay was just for one night we had a very good room with great facilities and a good view of the mountains (when the clouds lifted).  The buffet dinner had great choices with fresh Naan cooked to order.  Restaurant staff very helpful and informative about the food on offer.  Gondola was a disappointment - we went up for the view but top station was in the cloud and then it started to snow.  Great for those who had never seen snow before but a downer for us.

reviews.author: Vjhajharia
reviews.title: a place worth staying at
reviews.text: we stayed here for four nights. this resort is very beautiful. surrounded by tall trees and mighty Himalayas. One can have a very good view of this view from their balcony, while taking a good sip of hot tea or coffee. Rooms are very well decorated with all the modern amenities. The General Manager Mr. Rajiv is a very charming and nice fellow. Staff over all is very helpful and humble.

reviews.author: tanya_dhillon
reviews.title: One of the best Hotel I have ever seen in Kashmir!!!
reviews.text: Guys its one of the best hotel in Kahsmir. The hotel is awesome we enjoyed a lot in swimming pool. Staff is so polite and helpful specially Ms. Preet in Guest Relation who always there to assist us. Overall the experience was just awesome. We are so excited to visit in December again....

reviews.author: loveindia46
reviews.title: Stunning Hotel
reviews.text:
This hotel came to our assistance following checking into another one nearby only to experience one of the worst hotels ever. Within one hour of arriving in Gulmarg we had checked into and out of our original disastrous choice from the travel agent and into a luxurious room at The Khyber Resort. Goodness me this is a beautiful hotel, the best one (easily the most expensive one) we stayed at during our week in Kashmir.  The young man at reception was extremely helpful on arrival, thank you Zaffir Malik, you were very kind.
The room was beautifully detailed, finished and appointed, the bathroom was exceptional too.  Our dining experience here was also 1st class, dinner and breakfast were both delightful.
Our only reservation about the whole experience, without the wish to sound snobbish was the dress code and behaviour during dinner. I don't really expect children running around the dining room and track suits in a five star restaurant!  That does sound snobbish doesn't it, it doesn't mean to. I just think there should be a dress code of some sorts at the evening service and also some control from the dining area manager over groups of children.
Having said that, if you go to Gulmarg stay at this Hotel, it was wonderful.  Thank you Khyber Resort.

reviews.author: Rajiv K
reviews.title: best resort hotel in kashmir
reviews.text: personalised service. excellent location and views. very good spa and pool. tasty food. The fixed menu dinner is expensive but alacart for a group of 4 becomes reasonable. Staff is well trained and courteous.

reviews.author: harkirat v
reviews.title: If you want the best....than this is it 👍
reviews.text:
Very beautiful property with a very ncy location.
Food and other facilities are also outstanding !
We had a very pleasant stay.....Preet kaur serves very well-very pleasing and polite personality 
G.M. Mr Rajeev and Mr Gupta also cooperate very well....wonderful hospitality 😀

reviews.author: capetown7848
reviews.title: Misleading pictures and missing descriptions ….
reviews.text:
hi,

We recently booked for a forthcoming trip, the Luxury Balcony Rooms agh this hotel. The website shows pictures (obviously the best) but while booking they palm off rooms in this category which do not have the view as shown in the website gallery pictures. The guest is either up for a surprise or fight on arrival or the more alert ones notice on the bookings itself additions such as Gulmarg View or Golf Course View while describing the Luxury Balcony rooms. Whatever they are, rest assured, they are not Mountain or Forest Views as shown in all the pictures used to describe this category of rooms. If you want more, you pay more …… Can't we stop this nonsense in our country so that domestic & international tourists can take things at face value and relax when planning a holiday ??

reviews.author: Koolguy27
reviews.title: New hotel in average location
reviews.text: We recently stayed in Khyber Gulmarg based on tripadvisor reviews & our experience of the property is average mainly for it's location & vegetarian food which leaves a lot to be desired. The hotel is situated close to gondola but lacks views of Gulmarg basin, vegetarian food also lacks the variety & taste specially for Jains. The hotel is new but keeping into consideration the exorbitant rates they charge the hotel does not fulfil its promise of being a best resort in every respect.

reviews.author: Mav1109
reviews.title: Maybe the Best Resort in the world,,, with very average service
reviews.text:
We stayed at khyber in Dec 2013 for three nights... the location, rooms etc are fascinating but when it comes to customer service( don't think that they understand it).. in the three days they managed to confuse our pick up, managed to loose our confirmed booking, charged for Xmas eve dinner( which was already paid for),,,, and above all, there is no resolution ,, it seems that the reservations guy holds all the decisions but he is never found in the hotel..... 

But cant help but praise the place ,, location and hotel is AWESOME... just go there for the place.....

reviews.author: KubraSait
reviews.title: I wish I could've stayed here!
reviews.text:
The dates I had planed my visit to Gulmarg, this property was sold out like hot cup cakes.
Hence I chose a property close by, but the reviews and the pictures of this property were oh so damn tempting I couldn't help but make a visit to this himalayan paradise for a meal, and that went into me gorging out and spending a lot of time here.

This property redeemed Gulmarg and Kashmir for me.

We spent a day over looking the range and sipping great coffee (for coffee lovers) and smoking sheesha.

The perfect high and a great conversation starter.

The staff is alert, and helpful and always wears a smile.

The place doesn't smell anything like the village, the ambience music is perfect and just every detail was a reminder that I need to book myself well in advance to get myself a room at this place before I visit again.

Oh! I am also told that they have a temperature controlled pool and its a pity that I couldn't get to use it.

Do visit. It's a jewel.

reviews.author: Siddharth1850
reviews.title: Amazing Hospitality !!!!
reviews.text: SUPERB !!!! This one word sums up the entire Khyber experience. The hotel is located on the far end of Gulmarg. The suites are excellent and 7003 in which I stayed was breath taking, done up immaculately and very very spacious. The resort has fantastic club and a heated swimming pool , good kids room and a modern gym. I am visiting Khyber soon !!!!

reviews.author: Lata K
reviews.title: Service could be better
reviews.text:
I had heard a lot of Khyber. So when we planned a trip to Kashmir, we made it a point to book a room at the Khyber. We visited in the month of December and let me tell you! you have to book welllll in advance to get a room as we came across many people who couldn't get a booking. Now, why the rush? Coz that's the only five star hotel in Gulmarg! It's a beautiful hotel. The drive to the hotel is awesome! The hotel's lobby is exquisitely designed n spacious. You have a sit down arrangement there, where you can have a card game or just gossip with your family. The check in took some time but they made it up by serving a delicious hot kahwa! Yes, there are too many exclamation marks, but that is how you feel. After waiting for a while, we were checked into a room on the lower ground floor, numbering 600 something. Why am I telling this? So that if you are allotted this number n believe in room service, say an emphatic NO to them. These rooms are the farthest from the pantry n housekeeping and if you order anything, it's going to take at least 1/2 an hour. Even a towel! My husband fractured his hand and there was no first aid and getting a hot water bag was Phew! The water was not hot n it came damn too late! 
This was the only negative point in this otherwise exquisite hotel. The swimming pool was not operational but it is now. It's a beautiful indoor pool. The gym is well equipped. 
Now, the food! The manager at the restaurant was very courteous n gave us some awesome deals as he saw that we were more interested in la carte while my son wanted a couple of things from buffet. The food was tasty. Everything from soups to desserts. Pizza to Chinese to tandoori! 
We stayed for two days. And don't forget to dip your hands in the candy jars strategically placed in the lobby. For the hookah lovers, there is an exotic cigar n hookah lounge. All in all, a good stay soured by bad room service. 
PS: I had mentioned this lacuna in their service in my feedback and I hope they have done something about it. :))

reviews.author: Manun Thakur
reviews.title: Good hotel Horrible Service
reviews.text:
If you're coming to kashmir and specifically to Gulmarg then is the best place to stay...perhaps why they take their guests for granted. 

Make sure you stay in the odd numbered rooms facing the mountains with balconies. We had luxury rooms and that's the minimum I would recommend. 

It is advisable to book your own transport and preferably an Innova to the hotel as the hotel sent us a shabby van with a driver who often held the steering wheel with his elbow while changing gears over the edge of the mountains as he was busy talking to his friends about clothes. 

The food is good but they are awfully slow at serving and when we brought that up the waiter actually said "I don't think so" hahahaha...

Still it's a good property with the best views.

reviews.author: Ranjit K
reviews.title: Palace @ 7000 Sq feet
reviews.text: Wow!!! Thats how I describe it in a word. I had the best view of the himalayan range and it was amazing. If I was not there for a business trip then I am sure  that i would have written a poetry.  The hotel is by itself very beautifully designed. The rooms are extremely spacious.  The bathrooms was well spaced and the jacuzzi a delight.

reviews.author: Karthik Subbiah
reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: We stayed at the Khyber for a week. The hotel itself was beautiful, however the drive to the hotel was quite painful. The rooms were beautiful, and there were a lot of options for food inside the hotel. The hotel staff were well trained and friendly. The architecture of the hotel was amazing. If I had the choice, I would definetely go there again

reviews.author: Arun
reviews.title: serene
reviews.text: no one has seen heaven but to have a feel what heaven can be then a stay in this property is a must. its ideally located , serve good food , very courteous staff and beautiful hotel. the rooms are nicely done. the balcony of the rooms are so beautifully designed that you can spend hours watching serene beauty of Himalaya and probably a feel of the beauty of mother earth.the staff are mostly locals who really knows what is called hospitality.

reviews.author: VibhutiGarg
reviews.title: Pristine beauty!
reviews.text:
A wooden architecture covered with snow all around made our stay very pleasant. The day we arrived in Gulmarg, it started snowing though usually at end of March that is not a regular phenomenon but we were lucky to witness snowfall. The property is very well located and at a walking distance from the point of gondoal ride. The kahwah drink which they offer as the welcome drink is palatable. The food is delicious but the service of the staff at the restaurant is not very good. There were just 1-2 waiter at the restaurant to serve people during the day and even during breakfast though there were couple of them but seem a bit confused and thus were taking lot of time or after repeated reminders, dishes were served. The hotel definitely needs to improvise on the same.

The pool was large and it was a pleasant sight to swim when it was snowing outside. However, the pool was functional when we arrived but after taking an hour rest when we finally decided to go for swimming, were informed that there was a problem in heating and thus closed. The spa was refreshing with all the aroma therapy, adding to perfect romantic holiday. The rooms were well equipped and comfortable. Overall a very pleasant stay.

reviews.author: Anuja_Mashruwala
reviews.title: Beautiful location, loved the woody construction and its fragrance!
reviews.text:
We stayed there for 2 nights 3 days. Stay was peaceful & relaxing. Kids also had their well-equipped den- Igloo to spread themselves. The l'occitane Spa was quite refreshing yet routine but the location added its charm though was quite put off with the arrangement for the couple spa therapy. The room wasn't well equipped for the couple therapy. 
The room service was prompt than the restaurant. 
Overall in love with the property.

reviews.author: ntibrewal
reviews.title: Nice, comfortable stay in Gulmarg
reviews.text: A good hotel in Gulmarg, well located near the gondola, courteous and efficient staff, comfortable rooms and a good multi-cuisine restaurant. The check-in did take irritably long, but probably that was due to guests not having vacated the rooms on time. Local transportation from the hotel is a problem. A taxi from the hotel to the town (2-3 kms away) costs Rs.1000/-. Besides this, the whole experience at The Khyber was wonderful.

reviews.author: Aninda_p
reviews.title: Hoteliers are the worst guest
reviews.text:
Doctors are supposedly the worst patients, and hoteliers the most  difficult  guests.
It probably enemates from the fact that our eye for details , makes us over critical.
However once in a while , we go through such experiences that conforms the  old adage that service comes from the  heart.
Recently in this hotel two young executives at the middle of the night , went out of their way and helped us in our hour of need , for which we shall remain eternally grateful.
A hotel is as good as its staff and this hotel shall always be a front runner as long as it has such wonderful caring young executives.
Aninda Palit
Hotelier
Director, SHPL

reviews.author: Vishal D
reviews.title: Luxurious but ......
reviews.text: We stayed for 3 nights from 23rd May 2014 onwards.  We were allotted room no 4001 which opens up into the parking lot.  The first view was a scorpio jeep  staring at my face . Mr Bilal shifted us to another room on the next morning after we complaint about drivers standing outside our room window. PLEASE DON'T STAY IN ROOM NO 4001. After all we didn't pay a bomb to have a room in the parking lot.  The service was average when it came to room service because everyone seemed to be confused. The property is fabulous and extremely beautiful. Their temperature controlled pool was very good. The Mediterranean food at cabalash (cigar lounge) was very nice where you can carry your own bottles of alcohol.  The food is good but highly priced. A dal costs 500 plus tax. The hotel is excellent but the management needs to improve.  Very few options in gulmarg of this class.

reviews.author: M S B
reviews.title: Memorable Gulmarg trip
reviews.text: Wow!! A great view and equally well maintained décor. Excellent view of snow capped mountains and valley from the room. Would have loved to be there during snow fall. Looking forward to visit ' Khyber' again in October to feel the chilly weather>>>> Paisa Wasool stay..

reviews.author: Samit-Garg
reviews.title: Incredible Experience
reviews.text:
The place is exceptional. It surprises you with the kind of hotel experience that a place like Gulmarg can offer. 

Lavish rooms, great food, cultured hospitality and multiple terraces for chilling out - collectively make it a must do.

It is expensive, but I guess the huge costs of running the property in a place like Gulmarg, justifies their pricing.

Would love to be there again.

reviews.author: Rajesh G
reviews.title: Excellent property
reviews.text: the property is excellent in every thing. One can enjoy with family in the resort only. Earlier I thought Gulmarg is only for day trip only. But i never thought a resort of this kind can be made in gulmarg. I stayed there for 3 nights and everything was perfect.

reviews.author: Kalrak
reviews.title: Good Resort
reviews.text: We stayed for two nights at Khyber Gulmarg. It is a newly built property. Infrastructure is excellent but services need to pick up. Views are excellent. It is not value for money. the price charged is exorbitant as same quality of room can be had at much lesser price in other cities of the country.

reviews.author: Rakeshsony
reviews.title: Dream property
reviews.text:
One of the best hill station resort that I have been. Amazing setting, amazing facilities. Everything is out of the world. 
Food is excellent. You can't ask for more.
They should have some more games for kids.

reviews.author: kawalnain
reviews.title: Average
reviews.text: Thsi newly built property in Gulmarg certainly didn't live upto the hype it has created as it lacked in overall open views of Gulmarg bowl, service & food specially for our vegetarians frndz & their guest apprach which sems to be quite unfriendly. The spa was not operational & to top it all even after paying 20k a room they did not have a bar which a great let down for a so called 5 star resort hotel!

reviews.author: agarwalmohit96
reviews.title: Excellent Place But Poor Service
reviews.text:
We stayed in Kyber Hotel for 2 nights. I must say the hotel is built in an excellent manner, however, they lack proper guest service. We took almost 2 hours to check in in spite of prior booking. We were received at the gate and made to seat in the tea lounge while our rooms were allotted, however after 35 minutes when I approached the helpdesk, they were not even aware of our waiting. We were then allotted rooms 2 floors below, with the elevators "YET TO START". We refused to take the rooms as my uncle is a heart patient and can't climb so many stairs. They upgraded our rooms (Which is a good thing) but took additional 1 hour to do so. Slightly disorganized. The food is gud but if you opt for ala carte than be prepared to be served cold food.

If I am to rate the hotel, than it would be 4.5 out of 5 but service would be 2.5 out of 5.0. They may not get repeated customers if they continue like this.

reviews.author: Avi_loves_travel
reviews.title: Exceptional in Winter
reviews.text:
Best luxury ski resort in Kashmir. Stayed here in winter , February 2013. The gondola to the ski slopes is just below the resort, walking distance which makes it very convenient for skiers.
 
The resort is very well made, offers multi cuisine restaurant and great views from the balcony views. The rooms are comfortable, and well heated for winter.

It offers large close areas for groups and most recommended.

reviews.author: SiddharthVasudevan
reviews.title: Excellent property, many improvements needed
reviews.text: The check in was painfully slow, we were offered some kahwa and then totally forgotten about. The rooms are nice and well appointed. As this hotel is still under construction, be prepared to hear a lot of drilling and hammering noises. The spa is also not functional yet. the business center is also lacking in many aspects. No newspapers delivered to the rooms in the morning. Quality of food is very good and the service in the restaurant is good. Housekeeping also did not attend to the room despite the make my room sign being on. The location is very good. The management really needs to pull up their socks to bring it to the level of other SLH hotels. Not many activities to keep you occupied through the day.

reviews.author: Tender0
reviews.title: Ask and get
reviews.text:
A beautiful property with the best of services. I was very disappointed by the initial allotment of the room (in the basement, near a noisy laundry room?) and lacklustre reception.  I did not hesitate in being vocal about my disappointment and things changed. We were relocated...to a room with breathtaking view of the snow-capped mountains and a valley of trees from the window and its balcony..! Prompt, flawless and obliging service. Very cordial staff. Impressive spread for dinner as well as breakfast..Upon my request the live egg station chef cooked a very fluffy omelette in a very innovative style. Head chef dropped by to check all is well. 
Only caveat - the facilities at the hotel were not yet operational. They need to introduce more in house activities. The kahwa reception was good.

reviews.author: Ahmed Z
reviews.title: Best property in Gulmarg!!
reviews.text: This will rate as one of the best properties in a hill station. Five star deluxe hotel with very nice and luxury rooms. Food and hospitality was also of top class. Ask for rooms with balcony as they have outstanding views of the Himalayan range. Very close to the gondola from where you go to khilanmarg. Only missing thing was Kashmiri cuisine.

reviews.author: imrandp
reviews.title: Excellent Location, Limited options but a greedy management !
reviews.text:
this property being a member of the SLH group boasts of excellent infrastructure, like other SLH properties. however there are some major flaws too ! we stayed for 3 days in end of may 2013 in balcony room no. 2019 - first floor. the property is located slightly above the Gondola boarding station gate which is past the taxi stand with horses blocking the main road leading to the property. Secondly the most annoying factor is that the management has installed mobile phone jammers high up on a pine tree which works by blocking all mobile phones & wifi above the lobby level; in spite of full signal one cannot make or receive calls. This has been done so that the guests staying in the property use the room telephone & pay the inflated long distance charges. The mobile phone operators whose fake full signal one will receive when within the hotel are Aircel, Airtel & Cellone (BSNL POSTPAID).

The staff are also over worked & work beyond their normal shift hours & with no lift in the property, it is really physically challenging for them too especially in peak season ! The spa & swimming pool are not yet ready but noise levels for the on-going construction activity during day time is low, hence that's tolerable.

the f&b options for veg & non-veg are limited & highly priced, however the food is tasty. waffle counter missing in the breakfast hall & buffet lunch & dinner are prices @ 1600/- per person but with a limited spread. the kava served in the lobby is excellent but not the original Kashmiri kava as its without tea leaves ! the room temperature cannot be increased beyond 24 deg C and that's a problem for kids who would like to sleep at 27 deg C, the most comfortable temperature. in-room digital temperature controller though is of high quality and at par with other SLH properties like Wild Flower Hall of Oberoi above Shimla !

Presently the best in Gulmarg, hence full occupancy.. and since its a new property the minor issues should hopefully be sorted out soon ! Getting your own vehicle & keeping it with you will help as car hire options are limited too !

reviews.author: AMSAVANI
reviews.title: IN PRAISE OF KHYBER GULMURG AND ITS STAFF
reviews.text:
I stayed at the Khyber Hymlayan resort and spa at Gulmurg for 2 nights recently. I went with no expectations but the hotel turned out a big and pleasant surprise. One of the best hotels/resort i have been in. (have visited many all over the world).The service is impeccable. the food v delicious and varied. The terraced  garden and manicured lawns were a treat for sore eyes. The staff are more like hosts than hotel staff.The View from he balcony rooms is awesome and mind-blowing.near paradise.
 Mr. Mithun at the front desk was an epitome of courtesy and helpfulness. Wonderful experience. I cannot rate it more as there are no more dots above. wish you all the best and see you soon. Will come back

reviews.author: Maneet99
reviews.title: Good going.
reviews.text:
This is just less then 2 hours away from Srinagar Airport. The staff was welcoming & helpful. We had a premier room with a very modern bathroom. The hotel is yet to finish its pool, fitness & spa facilities. I would say to them, with such wonderful property & location, they should brace themselves to give some world-class services. The staff at front desk works fine, but still got to do more in terms of english language & most importantly to have a hold on the neighbour-gondola rides. Breakfast was not bad, they should change the menu on daily or alternate basis. I would definitely recommend to stay in this beautiful Hotel with family.
My request to the management of this hotel, to do their extra bit to make this a class hotel, rather then run-of-the-mill hotel. It deserves to be in a league of its own due to its location & architecture. You have won the first round but still long way to go.

reviews.author: raj
reviews.title: need to work hard
reviews.text: fanatastic location....well designed public and private spaces...good facilities.....good food but very heavily priced should stress on serving local cuisines also...rather than the regular punjabis cusine.........all staff appeared new thats way services and other managerial affairs not upto the mark.....housekeeping staff on floor was good and hard working.....staff response overall ok...but courteous staff....sometimes appeared confused and could not take decesions.....well dressed and mannnered staff at all levels........ good concept to have doctor inhouse but he charged us rs200 for his visit had no idea regarding this..................now are bad expirences.....in our two day stay our rooms mcb must have tripped at least ten times and the last one was at twelvepm at night...though th estaff was sincerely working on no issues regarding that but the issue is that with all the technicalities available they could not understand and control the sitituation....which was really very irritaating we had asked teh manager to change our rooms but they were not willing to do so and they continued our stay despite not resolvingthe problem fully that was a bad gesture on teh part of management...and also no compilimentaries were served to us in form of compensations................and no elevators were there.....no floor phones to connect to reception was available.........corridors were stinking whenever it was raining outside....informed teh managers and floor house keeping concerns...........wooden floor in toilets an d wet corridor was very slippery and would lead to major maintanance in future for teh hotel management.....the glass concept was a poor thought......and several minor issues related to planning an d maintenence must be seriously seen by the hotel managements.......

reviews.author: Bhanu R
reviews.title: A leisurely vacation in Kashmir, an unforgettable one at The Khyber. As usual most of the things are simply superb here
reviews.text:
Wonderful hospitality. A stunning breakfast spread with immensely hospitable staff. Outstanding housekeeping by Shahid and Arbaz kept us enthralled in our cozy mountain facing room the joy amplified by stunning views of the lush green meadows with horses and ponies grazing across, lazily. The santoor player charms every morning with the lovely breakfast however the amplification can be a bit moderate. 
The Khyber has everything to fall in love for and I look forward to our third visit and more.

reviews.author: zeenia c
reviews.title: Impeccable service & Great hospitality
reviews.text: Had the best stay ever at The Khyber Gulmarg.Such a wonderful property & so very well maintained along with an indoor temp control pool,24 hr gymnasium,steam,sauna,spa and you can spend all day at the resort if you don't wish to step out and just chill at this gorg property.The food is just yumm so you really don't need to get out of this hotel as you can find the best of the things under 1 roof.Now coming to the amazing staff,a big shoutout to Mr Ishfaq from the front desk for being exceptionally  good at his job.Right from the time of check in till check out he was at our beck & call even when he wasn't on duty,he would still ans my calls to help me with the wheelchair for my mother.He is so efficient,courteous & extremely hardworking.He ensured we had the most comfortable stay.Mr.Muzammil from the restaurant/in room dining was totally hands on his job & always a step ahead.Before i would have to call him for any request,he would call and check and have everything arranged with utmost efficiency.He is very very hardworking,thoughtful & both Mr.Isfaq & Mr.Muzammil ensured my mother had a memorable birthday.The housekeeping staff managed by Mr.Shabbir  ensured absolute cleanliness throughout our stay and made us feel at home & timely kept checking on us for any requirement in the room.The security staff were so careful whilst handling my mother on the wheelchair and assisting her to get in and out of the car especially whn it was raining.I can't be more grateful to the entire team for giving us such a lovely stay.

reviews.author: Jyotirmoy D
reviews.title: A great Picturesque hotel with amazing people.
reviews.text:
One of the finest property i visited in recent times. The entire team deserve a round of applause for their effort for making our stay wonderful.

+ Ve points: 
1) They upgraded my room after arrival without even asking them. Which shows their commitment & seriousness for making the guest more comfortable.

2) Staffs..staffs & staffs...from the moment we reached airport, then security, receptions, F&B staffs, room services staffs, the hotel management team, Spa/Gym staffs, Houskeeping staffs..all are well spoken, behaved & treat us nicely & helped us in every possible way in their capacity. This is made us more comfortable & ignoring very minor small loopholes.

3) Great infrastructure, well maintained property with a amazing VIEW you love to memorize for life. 

If you are nature lover,  Need  a quality stay with amazing view..then pls go for it.

reviews.author: H J
reviews.title: Amazing Views and Unforgettable Memories!!
reviews.text: Amazing views, staff and resort. We had a fantastic time at Khyber, the staff was friendly and extremely accommodating. The food was fantastic and they even planned out a small anniversary surprise for my wife and I. We would definitely come back again. Highly recommended if you’re visiting Gulmarg.

reviews.author: Tourist45570376302
reviews.title: My experience at Khyber Gulmarg
reviews.text:
KHYBER ...A  NAME BY ITSELF
A home away from home. My best holiday till now . I loved the location  the rooms the food the hospitality just a perfect holiday pakage. I thank each and everyone to take care of my family and me 
Mr Mahesh the main head who was extremely friendly and very helpful 
Chef Khemraj  for sushi thai curry ,
Chef Veer fried rice nachos ,
Chef Aabid pizza and pasta 
Mr Vikram for dosas
Mr Shabir,Mr Amir Javed,Mr Bilal
 ,Mr Zahid, Mr Hilal ,Mr Farooq,Mr Ishfaq
Mr Varun , Mr Arbaaz for house keeping, these are just a few people who depict the hospitality and that's  how khyber is different from others❤️

reviews.author: ALI DUBERIA
reviews.title: Exceptional Trip
reviews.text:
One of the best hotels I have stayed in Kashmir, the location of the property is amazing and the hospitality of the staff added to its excellence. The serene views of the Himalayas were very calming and a sight to behold.
 Within the premises, among the restaurant staff Farook Ali, Ganie, Junaid, Aamir, Javed, Zahid ensured I had a relishing food every time and the housekeeping staff especially Samiullah made my overall stay awesome. The front office staff Ovais, Front Office manager Mohd Rafi were very efficient and helpful and a special thanks to Mr Rafi who made our stay amazing and beyond imagination. Among others who were also very helpful were the coffee shop (Chaikash) staff, Ruqqayah (Swimming pool attendant) and others. The musician through his soothing music made a mesmerizing effect on the mind.

reviews.author: Ridhima G
reviews.title: Must visit good food
reviews.text: We came here for lunch at 28 July and we ate at the pan-Asian restraunt the food was so good I told my parents to go again at 29 July the location is perfect and the food is even better I cannot imagine but there are 6 restraunts in the hotel this is a must visit and one of the best lunches I have ever had the view is decent and staff is interested in starting a conversation with you

reviews.author: Gideon J
reviews.title: Amazing Stay!
reviews.text:
The resort provided not only a luxurious escape but also a haven of care and hospitality that exceeded all our expectations.

During our stay, our 18-month-old son fell a bit sick during the night. In such a remote location, we were initially worried about accessing medical help. To our immense relief, the resort had an in-house medical attender and the necessary medicines available, allowing us to act quickly. This level of preparedness was astonishing and undoubtedly saved us from a potentially distressing situation.

We would like to extend our heartfelt thanks to Faisal, who coordinated everything with remarkable efficiency. His prompt response and genuine concern were truly commendable. Faisal also ensured that our stay was comfortable throughout, going above and beyond to assist us with baby food and any other needs we had.

Another highlight of our stay was the personalized BBQ dinner that the resort organized upon our request. The atmosphere was perfect, and the food was delicious, making it a memorable evening for our family.

reviews.author: Gurmeet
reviews.title: Memorable stay and the property is stunning!
reviews.text:
It's a stunning property on the laps of beautiful mountains. The property is very warm and cosy and has gorgeous views. The rooms are well maintained and has all facilities required for a comfortable stay. The staff is very courteous and was always ready to help and assist. The swimming pool is the highlight and kids enjoyed their time in the pool. 
The food was delicious and I would like to thank them for sending us a cake to celebrate my parents 50th wedding anniversary. Small gestures goes a long way. Given a chance we would love to return back and stay at this property in the winters.

reviews.author: Parvathi B
reviews.title: Great hotel!
reviews.text: We had an amazing stay at this hotel. The food was very good, and the staff were immensely helpful. The food was delicious. Definitely make sure to check out the pool and gardens at this property, and the cable car ride just outside of the hotel. Definitely recommend staying here!

reviews.author: Pravesh
reviews.title: Best experience ever
reviews.text: Very good service very comfortable stay Mr . Ishfaq And Muzamil  from IRD were very helpful. It was like a stay in of the dreams . Price of the property speaks of its facilities , location and luxury. Would definitely visit in the winters. Recommended to all

reviews.author: Anjali P
reviews.title: Samovar treat
reviews.text:
And the name Khyber is synonymous to Kashmir luxury..

A mandatory visit was due..when in Gulmarg..
The ambience was as breathtaking as the chinar trees and wildflowers in the valley.

Kahwa smelled good..
The big Samovar was inviting..
Faisal came smiling bearing the kahwa..
As we were sipping it..
Mr Rajamouli (RRR) fame comes and smilingly says, he wants kahwa made by Faisal..

This cute looking boy has the right amount of magic in his hands..
Deference, agility and the smiling face..

Khyber becomes a beautiful memory as we leave..to come again..

reviews.author: Ashish Gopal
reviews.title: Truly Jannat
reviews.text:
Khyber had always in my bucket list. I stayed with my wife and daughter. Its amazingly beautiful property walking from Gandola station. Lovely pool with jaccuzi and special thanks yo pool caretakers Mr Suhail and Ms Shafiya. rooms are super comfy with all amenities. Housekeeping is super prompt.   Food is yummy, we had Pizza and Pasta at  Italian Restaurant and Mr Varun F&B manager is a lovely host. Buffet breakfast was equally delicious and we complimented Mr Charanjeet Head Chef. Firdaus also needs special mention as he served us nicely & lovingly. One thing I suggested them about is to have a Millet & Healthy Organic spread at Buffet since we are from Wellness Industry and its the need of time. 
Only thing I feel its bit expensive but yes luxury comes at a price.
Yes we will be definitely coming again in winters.

reviews.author: Deepak D
reviews.title: heaven on all sides
reviews.text: the most fantastic location...amazing food....great property...a special thanks to pariza from the front desk , varun and his team from f&b....head chef khan from the Italian restaurant....best pizzas ever...thanks for looking after us and making our stay memorable

reviews.author: Abhi A
reviews.title: Hostility
reviews.text: Very Nice hotel, and hospitality very very good spacialy Aarif and Aamir are the best,  hotel clean, hot indoor swinging pool, hotel ambient perfume mind blowing.. we will surely come back again but in month of December Jan

reviews.author: abhi vani
reviews.title: Great property with some issues
reviews.text: Beautiful location and property. The view from our rooms and adjoining terrace was amazing. The food was excellent and the staff was accommodating. The Italian restaurant was quite nice and so was the game room and pool.  The only bothersome aspect of the stay was the heavily scented corridors and the poorly ventilated rooms. The central heat was also on and this created stuffy, dry, and overheated spaces in the hotel.

reviews.author: poonam b
reviews.title: A fine bloom in the meadow of flowers
reviews.text:
Very good and hospitable staff
Varun the F&B incharge the restaurant staff Faisal aiyaz arrived and Iqbal deserve special mention
Spa is also very good staff was accommodating and efficient. Overall great experience

reviews.author: Shubhra S
reviews.title: Beautiful property and excellent service
reviews.text: Beautiful and scenic hotel - the best resort that Kashmir has to offer. What’s even better is the service in this hotel. It is out of this world. Special shout-out to Firdous whose service at the restaurant was so good that we will come back only to experience this again. Thank you for the amazing experience!

reviews.author: Amitolive
reviews.title: Hotel in a Box feeling
reviews.text:
ROOMS  DONT HAVE VENTILATION .ONLY HEATING CAN HAPPEN .ONE FEELS SUFFOCATED IN THE ROOM AND WE HAD TO OPEN WINDOWS FOR AIR. WINDOWS DONT HAVE GRILL SO CANNOT OPEN BECAUSE OF SAFETY AND INSECTS.
HOTEL HAS A CAFE IN LOBBY OUTSIDE WHICH IS A OPEN TERRACE WITH DINING ARRANGEMENTS. WHEN WE ASKED THEM TO SERVE US FOOD THERE ,THE STAFF WOULD AVOID SAYING THEY HAVE BOOKED TERRACE FOR SOME FUNCTION ( WHICH NEVER HAPPENED ). YOU FEEL YOU ARE IN A CLOSED BOX AND CANNOT TAKE THE FEEL OF FRESH AIR WITH COFFEEE.
DURING CHECK OUT PROCESS ,WE ASKED THE  RECEPTION PEOPLE TO CHANGE THIS AND LET HOTEL GUESTS ENJOY DINING OUTSIDE  IN OPEN AIR. SHOCKINGLY , WE WERE TOLD THAT HOTEL HAS THE POLICY OF CHARGING FOR TERRACE - WHICH THEIR SENIOR MANAGER LATER ON DENIED AND APOLOGIZED

FOOD AND OTHER STAFF WAS GOOD.POOL /SPA GOOD

reviews.author: Voyage41360011866
reviews.title: Heaven in Kashmiri
reviews.text: Trip was amazing  filled with wonderful memories. Our Buttler Abishek helped us through every thing we needed around the hotel he is a kind person and caring . The Italian restaurant had amazing food especially the spaghetti. We would Definitely love to come back here soon. With my friends and family.

reviews.author: Dr Anupam Gupta
reviews.title: A must visit place
reviews.text:
AN excellent hotel. Truely the paradise in Kashmir. The rooms, the vies for the room, the staff... Every one has a smiling face.
 One of the best places I have stayed. The food is excellent.  Mohit and Varun the restaurant Managers,   Firdaus and the entire staff whose name I don't remember are  very polite and prompt in service.   The Wazwan served on first night along with the surprise Anniversary cake was just awesome. The Pizza at the Italian restaurant was one of the best I have ever eaten. And Mr.  Varun served it with a smile.

The only downside was my bad experience with the concierge from whom I booked a full day cab. He promised me that the car would stay with me all day till 9 PM in night. The Driver Irfan of Innova No JK 05 C 1349 was outright impolite and abusive. He wanted to be back at 5 PM.  He fought with us and misbehaved very badly and asked us to get down on the road. It was very scary and we had no choice but to come back to the hotel. When we ultimately reached the hotel one of your Managers Mr. Sajad also tried  to take sides with the driver and vendor saying that as you have not taken car from the hotel reception we are not responsible. Then I insisted on calling the bell Captain who had booked the car and asked to bring the complaint register. When I persistently asked for the complaint register and to call either the bell captain or a senior person from the management they all stated apologizing and started requesting me not to report to the management.  I was very astonished by the behavior of the vendor and drivers of the Taxies along with Mr Sazid of the hotel. What pained me was that the staff of the hotel is hand in gloves with them. IHOPE THE MAMANGEMENT WILL LOOK INTO THE MATTER AND SEE THAT THE GUESTS ARE NOT TAKEN FOR A RIDE BY TAXI VENDORS WITH CONVINNACE WITH THE HOTEL STAFF

reviews.author: Sumayya K
reviews.title: terrible food, some wonderful staff
reviews.text: Mixed reviews -- the spa was amazing and a highlight. The rooms are beautiful but for the price, the service is extremely lacking. The food was the worst I've had in years, including at hotels that are 1/4th the price. Everything we ate was disappointing except for some daal and rice at dinner once -- the Italian restaurant is something people should avoid. There are many illogical decisions with decor (too dark) and music (terrible). Many of the Indian guests are extremely rude and bad mannered and it ruins your experience to see them treating servers that way. In general, although I was delighted to visit Khyber after having heard so much about it, it was definitely not worth the outrageously exorbitant price (most I've ever paid for a hotel in my life!). The only consolation is I hope this money goes to support the economy of Kashmir at this time. Two of the female staff (Nusrat at reception; Hameeda at the pool downstairs) went out of their way for us and made us feel really comfortable.

reviews.author: sandeepv287
reviews.title: Super Place..Next to Gondola Spot
reviews.text:
Super place , super service , super nice..This is one of those places which are definitely expensive but need to be experienced atleast once in your lifetime.. The whole resort is very picturesque and you had people taking pictures at every corner… 
We had some slight issues with our room initially but they got resolved pretty soon .. Kashmiris in general are amongst the politest people in India and hence customer service to everyone in their staff comes very naturally to them.. 
If they can add a better Travel Desk which can connect tourists to authentic cab drivers in Gulmarg then that would help a lot and avoid many from getting fleeced..
All said , would love to visit again in winters.

reviews.author: DevShetty
reviews.title: Grand stay at Gulmarg at the Khyber
reviews.text:
The hotel is the only 5 start property in Gulamrg. The location as one can expect is lovely, Its a steep 100 meters walk down to the gondola. If you have some senior citizens with you then you can hire pony or taxi to come up 100 meters to the hotel too. 
The rooms are good, spacious. The interiors are a bit old now and considering the winter weather there its not easy to maintain the wooden exteriors and interiors.
The swimming pool is heated but was shut for 5 days for repairs. Gymnasium and spa is very good. The food is quite good, breakfast is amazing. Staff is very helpful. The lobby is very grand. The temperature control in the room can be tricky as it can get very warm.

reviews.title: Summertime Sadness @ Khyber
reviews.text:

I would feel ripped off even if I paid half for the room. I would not recommend it to anyone, especially not in the summer.

reviews.author: zafeer_akbar
reviews.title: “Heavenly Khyber” makes you fall in love with Gulmarg, Kashmir, and it’s people
reviews.text: The Himalayan Resort is not just the best boutique hotel of the country, but also a place that exudes beauty, peace, hospitality, and luxury all in one. It is a resort bound by breathtaking views, exclusive service, and commendable staff who are the best at their job. You are sure to experience immense bliss as you enter the resort’s courtyard that has a palatial undertone and stretches down to their cafe lined by huge glass windows with panoramic views. We stayed at their Himalayan view room which is of their best and most recommended rooms with a balcony facing the great Himalayas (it is the room you see in most of their online pics). The restaurant is finely done with good food offerings. Do not miss taking a dip in their heated pool, again offering exquisite views from 3 sides. From their staff, IDREES at the front desk was very professional, welcoming, and helpful - he got our room upgraded at a reasonable price. HILAL was another of their staff at the very best of service. SHAFEEQA at the pool and recreation area reception was v knowledge and kind to help us. Cannot wait to visit Khyber again!

reviews.author: Mir Usman Disooki
