reviews.author: vmaloo
reviews.title: Serenity
reviews.text:
The Khyber is a property where the hype precedes the visit. A majestic hotel nestled amidst refreshing pine forests, it certainly is a resort beautifully made. While we had booked Premier Rooms, we got this changed to the Luxury Room Himalayan View, the room with the balcony overlooking the forests and the mountains and this decision was something we did not regret. 

The hotel only had one operational restaurant during our stay, the multi cuisine Clove (unsure if it has others) and we were pleasantly surprised by the taste of the food. Generous portions, excellent service and tasty food were a consistent experience there. 

The reason why we wanted to visit Khyber is when we saw pictures of the spa and the swimming pool, both enclosed in glass structures to help enjoy the grand view outside. While the view was true to the pictures and the pool was heated (oh, the relaxing feeling when you enter!), the health club is the area where Khyber’s claim of “there’s absolutely nothing spoilt here besides you” shows signs of cracking. The gym was unmanned every time I visited, while the pool only had one attendant who was usually busy running errands. This single male attendant was responsible for running the whole show, including the female changing areas. This is something that is unacceptable. The steam room produced no steam and the cleanliness in this area was subpar. However, in all honesty, entering the heated pool and looking out of the floor-to-glass ceiling to the untouched Himalayan sight made me forget all of this in a jiffy. 
The spa experience was unexpected, and not in a good way. During the therapy, construction and maintenance work was going on, phones were constantly ringing and people were talking, breaking the expected experience of being transported away in a world with zen-like calm. While the whole property is beautifully build with wood, making the therapy rooms soundproof and adding a carpet to the wooden flooring in the spa would go a long way as we could hear every person walking outside the therapy room. The therapists, while claimed to be highly experienced with special training from L'occitane, never asked for prior injuries and while the therapy was not bad, it was not great either. While all of these were excusable, the coup de grace was about to come. On complaining about these to the spa manager (who I will not name here), she refused to believe us, saying the construction was stopped within 5 minutes and the other noises were due to the cleaning staff when we could see people with hammers entering and exiting the spa. Her final conclusion to this conversation was ‘let me know if you want to do the therapy or not within 5 minutes. What is the point of having this conversation?’

The recreational area had table tennis, carrom, foosball, snooker and a non-functioning air hockey table, all of which we highly enjoyed. It also had a theatre which guests can book and enjoy movies in, available to guests on a chargeable basis, but we never ended up using it. 

The Khyber is an impressive property with views unlike any other. It is beautifully built with well thought-of features and is highly maintained. While some areas still need the polish of a Taj or an Oberoi, this trip made me realise that the people at the hotel can change the experience you have and everyone here at Khyber greet you with smiles and are extremely helpful. While some people can absolutely ruin your experience, others can turn it into an amazing one, and I want to call out some names who helped make this experience such an amazing one: Mr. Ishfaq Bhat at customer relations, Ab Qadir at the restaurant, Rahul, the barista and especially Irfan Hussain at the front desk and Mr. Rafi Bhat, the duty manager, who have time and again helped us to make the stay comfortable. You guys made Khyber live up to its massive hype. A big shout out to them and everyone else at Khyber.

reviews.text: It was a great stay at Khyber, will definitely come back during the winters to experience snow here. reviews.author: Gargi Sen
reviews.title: Nice property with average service
reviews.text:
Just checked out from this hotel after 3 nights of stay and honestly speaking I felt it is bit over-rated.
We were in Luxury Double Room Gulmarg view.

Positive highlights: The location is good, a property of this size and all the amenities at this location is commendable. Some of the staffs particularly in the restaurant were professional.

Negative highlights: The housekeeping was below expectation and that ruined our mood. The flush in the toilet was not working properly and though we complained a few times there was no permanent solution. Everyday after room cleaning they did not replenish the commonly used items like toiletries and towels which even in a standard hotel is done. We have to dial them to ask for new shower gel bottles or towels. The curtain came out and they fixed it after two days. The chairs in the balcony have no cushions. 

Individually each issue may not be a big concern but all of them together gave us the impression that this hotel is not guest friendly in-spite of the fact that the charge is premium and is considered to be a luxury hotel.

reviews.author: Darshant1975
reviews.title: Stay away and save your money! Worst service at extremely high prices. Ritz Carlton prices & highway motel service.
reviews.text:
Khyber Hotel stays true to the Gulmarg culture or looting and duping. Minimal value for money. Save your money and stay somewhere else! Over all I would say stay in Gulmarg no more than one night anyways. 

- I had confirmed booking with my international credit card in April. One day before my flight in a June, they email me that they cannot process my card and my booking will be cancelled in 12 hours. I had to spend multiple hours calling back and forth to finally get someone to respond and give me a payu link. 
- extremely bad service and they make you feel like you should be thankful for being there.  From checkin to checkout , the staff had a constant air of attitude.  
- Dirty rooms, clogged showers. We had to stand in the clogged showers just to take a bath. 
- the elevator stopped working for 1 day and my old mother who has challenges to go up the stairs has to go through immense pain and suffering just to go to her room and back. 
- there is no AC and their thermostat doesn’t work right. Even their technicians can’t get that working right. As a result, my family slept in extreme heat and had to open up the windows which led mosquitoes inside.  When I shared this with the manager and front desk, they were like “there is thermostat and you don’t know how to work it”. 
- food is sometimes ok and most times extremely bad. The worst Palak paneer in the entire world is found here. And I have eaten Palak paneer from Greece to Toronto to New Delhi to New York and beyond. 
- beware and check your booking twice. I booked through booking.com for triple occupancy and when I reached the hotel, I was told that the booking was only for 2 people and I had to pay 10,000 RS extra.  
- no hotel cars and the taxis they call  will charge you 800 RS just to get to the market and back. 
- Cloves restaurant dinner and breakfast are average. But extremely expensive.  Dinner for 4 was 7000 RS. 

I have stayed at Taj, Hilton, Ritz, Welcome group, Marriott, Westin including cabins in Yosemite/Tahoe and many others but never had this bad service in my entire life. 
The only good thing is the location and the cabin like feel as well as the grounds. 
-

reviews.author: sherberryy
reviews.title: Heaven on earth
reviews.text:
I visited Khyber in 2019 and it was the most magical resort I have ever stayed at. I have heard that they are under new management, which is unfortunate since the old management was exceptional. The entire resort is a time capsule of Kashmiri culture and heritage including the artwork, furniture, and traditions. Traditional Kashmiri kahwa is served to guests in the lobby. I hope that they maintain these aspects of Kashmiri heritage. Resort staff are hospitable, kind, and welcoming. The restaurant is great; however, it serves a majority of food catered to South Indian tourists which I did not enjoy. One of the staff members kindly ensured that the chef prepared meals that I would actually like. They went above and beyond to make our stay enjoyable. 

The spa is exceptional and I enjoyed the massages there. Massages are done in separate rooms to ensure modesty. Likewise, there are private men and women's jacuzzis for added privacy. The pool is beautiful and the water is heated in the winter months.

Ski slopes are easily accessible from the location of the hotel. The hotel is on a high hill in the mountains. The view of the valley is breath taking. Make sure you wake up early to watch the sunrise.  

Khyber Resort is a fairytale. Dreaming of visiting again.

The Heemalay visit by Gandola - cable car is just meters away and very easy to access.

reviews.author: Gauri K
reviews.title: The little extra is what you get here.
reviews.text:
Loved the hotel. There is great attention to detail given in designing this hotel and it is well maintained. The staff is great. 
The food is the best in Kashmir beyond doubt.
We forgot a few thing in the room and they were kind to send them to Srinagar.

reviews.author: ankita.gpt3
reviews.title: Family visit
reviews.text:
The journey to this hotel from srinagar was very beautiful. 

Hotel is situated at mountain top surrounded by ice and  beautiful mountains for a perfect view. 

Structure of the hotel is of wood which give the interior a very rich look. The rooms are very comfortable and cozy for a chilling weather. 

I loved the warm water pool with a beautiful glass view of mountains. 

Food was outstanding and hospitality was it's best. 

Perfect place for a family vacation. 

Enjoy.

reviews.author: harshbegwani
reviews.title: a luxury stay
reviews.text: friendly staff ! ausum food ! truely a himalayan resort !! the view from the room is very scenic and calm ! its just snow snow everywhere in the winters !! has a hot water swimming pool . the hotel has a controlled temperature which is the best part of the resort !

reviews.author: This.and.That
reviews.title: Breathtaking property in dire need of overhauling their service
reviews.text:
The property is straight out of the gorgeous ad in the Conde' Nast magazine. The hospitality in terms of the warmth with which the staff interacts with you is also world- class. But that's also the probelm area- when one pays for a luxury vacation one does not anticipate calling up the helpdesk for fixing the basics like room heating, bedding etc.
Even though every call was met with promptness, we got tired of calling for essentials by the end!
And the biggest let down is not being allowed to order beverages, (let alone liquor) at their gorgeous poolside.

reviews.author: Siddhant R
reviews.title: Amazing property at Gulmarg
reviews.text:
We visited this property during winters when there was a snowfall. I would recommend to visit this property only during winters, has some breathtaking views especially from  Himalayan view room. Though this property do has some 'cons' as well:

Cons-
1. Free internet which hotel provide is like 2G speed internet. Its very slow in this 4G world. Although they do have option to upgrade the internet speed but you have to burn your pocket for that.
2. Hotel staff is uninformative. I would say not all but some staff is.
3. This is completely dry hotel. So make sure you carry alcohol along with you. Hotel does provide you space to sit for free but with chargeable sheesha service and snacks.
4. Though hotel location is fantastic and is near to everything you want to do in Gulmarg but still last 100m to reach hotel is like you are climbing a mountain. So whenever you want to go to hotel after completing any outdoor activity, you have to literally climb last 100m. (If you r willing to spend then private taxi can drop you to the hotel. They will charge Rs 200 for to drop literally for 15 seconds only)

And some Pros-
1. Food. Hotel serves you very delicious food. One of the best I have ever had in any hotel
2.  Interior. Almost entire hotel has wooden interior decoration which was quite a relief especially during winters. 
3. Recreation room, Swimming pool and Gym - They will charge you for swimming costume but the location where swimming pool is quite amazing. In winter its hot water swimming pool
4. Hotel itself - Its best in Gulmarg. So if you want to spend money put into this one.

In the end, hotel does provide airport pick-up and drop service from Srinagar. But its on a chargeable basis.

On the whole, we enjoyed our stay in Khyber and will recommend to everyone despite some cons in this property.

reviews.author: yatenderkumart
reviews.title: Gulmarg with Kyber Pass Resort
reviews.text: The property was built tastefully with very good architecture. The service is very good, the hospitality is very good. in the room all basic amenities are there. the food is good and you can take any item of your choice.

reviews.author: Sugam K
reviews.title: Ultimate luxury!
reviews.text:
It is indeed an ultimate luxury. Amazing property with a breathtaking view. We had one of the most memorable vacation, all thanks to the management for making our stay so comfortable. Special thanks to 
Mr. Saqib for pampering us all that while, from the towel art in the room to the surprise cake, everything was just perfect. We can't thank you enough. 
Looking forward to stay with you soon. 
Regards-
Sugam Kapoor

reviews.author: Aarthi I
reviews.title: Must Must stay for a day atleast...
reviews.text:
The Khyber was what made our stay at Gulmarg breathtaking and beautiful. Unfortunately, there was an accident at Gondola while we were there and fortunately we werent on the Gondola that day. Even though we couldn't take the Gondola ride, which was the main attraction, our stay at Gulmarg was one of the most memorable ones... 

Starting with the location, its one of the most beautifully placed, to give the guests the breathtaking views of the pine trees. The resort itself is about 4 years old only, so the property looks beautiful with the wood exteriors perched on the mountain. 

The food was good, I would suggest to take a package which includes the meals as they have a good chef and clean meals. 

The service is great, people are very hospitable and kind. 

The only downside is the walk out of the property, which is quite a steep one up and down. There isnt much that you can do around gulmarg without either a vehicle or a pony. Even a meal at a local restaurant comes out to be very expensive and you need to haggle your way through with the vehicles and pony guys. Your own cars too arent of much use there, as you have to end up using the local guys only. The hotel guys also cant help much int his regard as they are all unionized. 

A definite must try at the hotel are 
1- Swimming Pool - available free of cost for the guests, and is temperature controlled. A sure shot place for the family to enjoy even if its cold outside. You get swimming costumes to buy as well, in case you forget to carry. 
2- Sauna/ Steam/ Jacuzzi - all available for the guests free of cost. Except the jacuzzi needs repair and replacement, atleast the one for the women. 
3- Spa - Amazing specialists for spa massages, must must do when you are here. 

Lots of green area for the kids to run around and enjoy. I would definitely want to come back when it snows here...

reviews.author: MeenuKolkata
reviews.title: Must visit
reviews.text: We went to khyber. The reception , the rooms and dining services were superb. There was snowfall making the resort view beautiful . Spa and hot water swimming pool overlooking snow was a nice experience .

reviews.author: salahudin123
reviews.title: “Paradise”
reviews.text: This Hotel is really located in Heaven and sounded by the beautiful forests it is in the heart of kashmir Place called Gulmarg,The Hotel is well decorated and has nice furnishing,The staff is very nice and food is very delicious.I would refer all the guests to this hotel if they want to enjoy the stay in kashmir.

reviews.author: rahjal1
reviews.title: Amazing Property
reviews.text: We had a lovely stay at this property in may, 2016, we were a couple with two children aged 11 each.The hotel is fabulous with sweeping views and well maintained. A stay here is highly recommended for a maximum of two days. The options for the children are a bit limited and the games room being unsupervised can get a bit messy. The Buffet is excellent but gets a repetitive after a while. The spa is top notch and highly recommended.The Staff is ever smiling and helpful. Room service is prompt and swift. Overall a thoroughly enjoyable trip!

reviews.author: Rinku B
reviews.title: Holiday at Khyber Resort Gulmarg
reviews.text: Excellent hotel, very comfortable and great staff! the restaurant staff was particularly very helpful, they made food as per our instructions and as per our child's liking. The view from the hotel is breathtaking. The heated pool was an amazing experience.

reviews.author: GAURAV
reviews.title: Best location and bet property in Gulmarg
reviews.text: The place is great, the people at the Resort are extremely helpful..the food is good. And such luxury at such a place is like...you have to stay there to believe it. Have been going there for the last 3 years and will go their again. Only one disappointment - nno free wifi - no cellular reception in the property - Free wifi a must

reviews.author: darshanaps
reviews.title: Amazing hotel, great food and beautiful location
reviews.text:
It a beautifully located hotel, very comfortable and amazing food. It has amazing views and has a party lounge area where if your in a group you can make it the most happening place in the mountains.
Rooms are very nice, but make sure to get rooms on the main floor especially if your visiting in winter. 
If you have children, please be careful while using their heated fool as some of the tiles and edges in the pool are broken and chances of your child getting hurt is a possibility.
The spa is worth using.
Food is amazing and if you inform them of any special preference or meal requests, its usually taken care. Do ask them for suggestions, especially if your ordering A-la-Carte meals.
Its a magical serene and truly a heaven on earth. Must stay property.
Needs advance booking and during your booking put in your room floor request.
Floors at the lower level are not advisable while there is still snow or in winter months as it can be a very gloomy room. 
Please make sure you check your bills correctly when settling your accounts at the hotel.

reviews.author: shilpamehra
reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text: It was like a magical kingdom at the foothills of the Himalayas. Khyber surpasses all expectations. The building and the construction, with the intricate wood work is outstanding. The food at Cloves, the multi cuisine restaurant was great. The servers and chefs were out to please every whim and fancy. The tea, or rather, Kehwa at the terrace was fabulous. What is so extra ordinary about the property is its location, with a stunning view of the snow capped mountains and the lush greenery.The General Manager of Khyber, Mr. Vinit Chhabra was a pleasure to meet. Puneet the front office manager was kind enough to show us around the property. Khyber has all the ingredients for an awesome stay. Highly recommended.

reviews.title: AMAZING
reviews.text: the place is very nice, and has a heated pool and a lovely spa also. It is like heaven on earth. It is a must visit should not be left at any cost. We enjoyed a lot over here. Will go to the place again.

reviews.author: vishabverma
reviews.title: Luxury in the mountains !!
reviews.text:
Property is located at very peaceful location...One of the best and luxurious resort in the Himalayas with Awesome view of mountains, spacious room, good breakfast and very helpful staff.
They have pool, coffee shop, hookah lounge. You can find everything at one place...... 
😊👍🏻

reviews.author: kmehshar
reviews.title: Relaxing Weekend!!
reviews.text: I went here with my firends. This is a verry great resort for getting relaxed by spending a weekend here. We enjoyed a lot. Good hospitality. Good Staff. Rooms are aso good. Neat and tidy rooms.The khyber is surrounded with mountain which also one of the best location for good scnery at resonable price.

reviews.author: Rashi R
reviews.title: Disappointing ! Annoying ! Waste of money !
reviews.text:
When I made my booking for KHYBER resort, I was extremely hopeful and looking foward to an experience of a lifetime. Needless to say the 2day stay costed us a whopping amount, yet even receiving an advance warning from my friends and relatives I continued to take my chances.
At the time of check in i was extremely delighted to know that we had been upgraded to the Himalayan balcony view room, and I was very thankful to the reception staff for this gesture.It was only later that I got to know the upgrade was the effort of our dear family friend Mushtaq Bhat, who continues to recieve 'best performance award' as a travel agent from the hotel during every assisment. Contrary to this, the extremely arrogant and disrespectful manager had the audacity to stop Mushtaq Bhai from entering the hotel premises. My mother was very upset by this behaviour recieved from the reception manager and even threatened to cancel our entire booking at that moment. The reception staff assumed that we were escorting our guest Mushtaq Bhai to our room and they objected due to this reason. This was very absurd and totally non acceptable. We had booked our entire trip through Mushtaq Bhai and are extremely thankful to him.From this point on followed a series thorough disappointments.
1. After paying 60,000 for 2 night stay at the property , we are charged 700 rs / day for wifi ! Are you kidding me ! Such a shame on the hotel !
2. The pool overlooking the Himalayas , proclaimed to be one of the countries best , is not function due to some unending repair activity ! Disappointing once again.
3. On my second day at KHYBER , I decided to use the Gymnasium. I enthusiastically put on my gym wear and headed to the gymnasium which looked well equipped in terms of the machines , only to discover that I would choke to death if I continued to work out in the presence of the hot air pumped into the gym, and a temperature of 24degrees being maintained by the staff of the spa! I repeatedly requested the staff to switch On the A/C, and they kept assuring me that they were in the process of doing the same all through my work out!
Agitated this time ! 
4. These guys should set a record for the worst room service ever ! Period !
5. The F&B staff was very arrogant and cold. The seemed to be extremely disinterested except for one girl from the staff, who was more diligent as compared to the entire hotel staff put together. 
Special service was provided to the big groups, I guess they are ones who leave behind a whooping tip as well. The F&B staff did not even care to refill servings that were finished, even after we repeatidly requested. I don't think the staff understands the meaning of a 5 star hotel in the first case !
6. We visited the hotel in July and needless to say there was no provision for ventilation in the rooms. It was hot in the days, and warm in the nights ( pleasant outside )
Now this is really mysterious whether the hotel has air conditioning services of not! At the time of check in we asked at the reception and were turned down saying tha hotel doesn't offer this service get! However the room service staff offered to switch on the same upon on a special request , but I guess he was later thrashed by the staff to revealing this secret! We continued to suffer in the heat. In the remaining 2 days, we were utterly confused as half of the staff proclaimed that the AC was deliberately switched off by the hotel authorities and the other half said that this service was yet not available at the hotel.
We felt extremely cheated!
If I am asked to summarise my stay at KHYBER resort , I would simply compare it to that fancy gift wrapped box, which is stuffed which newspaper from the inside!
Guys if you think you have too much money to make a booking with this resort I think you rather make a donation instead , atleast that would earn you some blessings!

reviews.author: Amit B
reviews.title: Hospitality is very poor
reviews.text: The hospitality is very poor, the room sofas are broken, Wi-Fi is not free which is available at every hotel today which was embarassing, door lock also not in the upright condition, playroom equipments are not working, Infact the pricing which they had kept when compared to the services are not up to the mark or not value for money. Vintage would be the best property at Gulmarg.

reviews.author: swati d
reviews.title: HEAVEN ON EARTH
reviews.text: If you are staying at Khyber, you will get to witness heaven on earth..truly amazing....you dont need to get out of the hotel to see the scenic beauty..it is all visible from the hotel too..wonderful location...excellent facilities...great staff...hospitality awesome..food divine....its just value for money....I would definitely stay at this hotel again and again.

reviews.author: rathi_star
reviews.title: Best place with poor management
reviews.text:
We booked 3 room as we r 3 couple with kids . They alloted rooms 6001 , 6002 n 6004.
 1. which r far 4m all amenities as we r with children they have no sense of it. 
2. In Egloo  (play area) they cannot afford  360 box cd  , as we stayed 3 day and done wonderfull  billing but in many request management have machine answer. They r fail to maintain it.
3. Sofa of 2 rooms is damaged .
4. Very slow services in restaurant. 
5. Poor staff training 
6.plz keep surprise audit with mistry guests  (for owners)

reviews.author: anish1710
reviews.title: Great experience! Must visit in winters
reviews.text: I stayed at this property for 2 nights with my wife.I would like to thanks the reservation team (Mr. Irfan) for allowing us to defer our booking at no extra cost, even when our initial booking was non-refundable. It is an hour drive from Srinagar airport. Make sure you carry hard copy of your reservation confirmation as you have to show it at the check post. Check in was smooth, welcome kava drink was a nice touch. Rooms and property have that typical hill station look. The heated pool was nice. There is  jacuzzi and steam facility in locker rooms. It might be just the timing, the property was really full with mostly extended groups with kids. Breakfast & dinner buffet was limited and decent. I would recommend ala-carte options as the preparation was much better. There is a waiting to get seated in the restaurant, so make sure you plan accordingly. No hotels/restaurants in Gulmarg serve alcohol so make sure to carry some with you from Srinagar. Hotel does lack a good concierge who could help you would bookings. Wi-fi is paid. Over all a good experience., would love to come back in winters with snow all around.

reviews.author: pmathur2014
reviews.title: Brilliant resort
reviews.text:
We spent 2 days at Khyber , the staff and management are wonderful .
property is probably one of the best in the country ..... 
food , service and facilities are exceptional and world class.
Thanks to the team at Khyber who take pains to ensure all guests go delighted .
Truly a relaxing and enjoyable place.

reviews.author: Abhimanyu B
reviews.title: Great relaxed time at Gulmarg
reviews.text: We spend a relaxed time at Khyber this June when we were visiting Kashmir. Room was very comfortable, the view was outstanding .. With a great lounge view both inside and outside .. Food was excellent and service was great ! Would like to see improvement in wifi access in the hotel..and at least one connection should be free per room looking at the rates.

reviews.author: Kuldeep K
reviews.title: Paradise in a Paradise
reviews.text: I think this resort deserves more than  5 star ratings. After travelling in many countries I can say that this is best resort/hotel we ever stayed. We can not forget the wonderful view from our room (better than Switzerland/Sweden), the hospitality and we still remember mouth watering food. Staff is so friendly that after our 4 day stay we knew most of them by name. I think Khyber resort is a heaven in the hills. One can not get this kind of hospitality in any other resort.

reviews.author: seema m
reviews.title: luxury hotel
reviews.text: from the entrance only u can feel luxury there. property is very well design . very close to gandola and golf course. their swimming pool and jacuzzi is must enjoy . food is good. but at coffeshop sevice is very slow.

reviews.author: FamilyTravel
reviews.title: Top class resort
reviews.text: Stayed during summer (June end) in their two bedroom suite/cottage. The living area was huge/spacious with two separate flloors (including servant room with attached bathroom at lower level) and everything was impeccable and luxurious. The view from the room was great overlooking mountain peaks. Couple of minor problems, the hot water took a long time to come through (had to turn on all the faucets including bath tub). WiFi was not included in the room charges and was limited to two devices per day, which is annoying when free WiFi is available everywhere.

reviews.author: Chirag D
reviews.title: Heaven in the Hills!!!
reviews.text: Had a wonderful visit and stay at Khyber. It is a stunning property with magnificent rooms and cottages. The staff is extremely helpful, attentive and welcoming. A special mention for Saqib who took care of all our needs, including on his day off for Eid. The only negative point of the hotel is that they do not serve alcohol, but you are allowed to carry your own. I look forward to going back again, next time to experience the Winter!!!

reviews.author: Zorin
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: Stayed here for 02 nights from 05 July 2016 and upon check in Bilal at front office upgraded our rooms,had a pleasant stay and the service was excellent Imran and Mujib at the lounge and Ishfaq in the room service gave excellent service,though the Breakfast buffet needs improvement in terms of options other than that the Food was good though tad expensive,overall a must visit if in Gulmarg.....The staff is very courteous and helpful.Will surely visit again

reviews.author: lykenZ
reviews.title: Simply Wow
reviews.text: Wow just wow! A truly beautiful hotel. The breakfast was amazing with everything you could ask for. The service is what you would expect from one of the most exclusive hotels in Gulmarg. Not forgetting the great views of the mountains. Well worth a visit.

reviews.author: Puneesh P
reviews.title: Good property but poor management
reviews.text: I have stayed in the property for 2 nights along with the family in the month of june 2015 & the management is below average as compared to the beautiful property. The pool was under maintainance at the time of visit & the management was not compensating. They were filling the pool with a 1 inch plastic pipe & it was going to take 3 days to fill.

reviews.author: Priteshdel
reviews.title: Property is Good , Claimed 5 Star , but servicing below average
reviews.text:
WE have visited Gulmarg and stayed in Khyber for 2 nights. The Property is good, ambiance and surrounding is fabulous but when it come to the servicing is is below average. The price what they charge is so high and very expensive as compare to similar properties in any other (other then J&K) , they Claim they are 5 star but the quality of Servicing Housekeeping, F&B , in room dining, Front office is below average.
And worst part  is no one is bothered about this. I have already told the Front office of the hotel about my feedback, but i dont think they are bothered..

The quality of food is also average and worst part they dont have items to serve , which they have in there menu card and in in room dining .'

I have to think twice now  before I book this property for my next trip to Gulmarg, in coming winters.

reviews.author: sharan1988
reviews.title: Complete let down
reviews.text: I spent 3 days (june 23-26 2016) at Kyber and for all its hype its a complete let down. The day we took our room the heaters wasn't working had to make couple of calls for them to rectify it , the paint from the bathroom ceiling was flaking off, cracked marble at many places,loose hand shower that kept falling and when my wife got here toe cut when she went for a swim there was a piece of glass in the swimming pool (took pictures for record) and the hotel staff nor the useless General Manager of the hotel had the courtesy to ask how she was. I had a word with the General Manager - Vinit Kumar Chhabra was not very helpful and was the most useless of the GM i have seen. After having been paid so much of money just to experience the hotel which has been by far the worst in hospitality. And i don't even want to start talking about the breakfast which was tasteless and insipid .

reviews.author: Kinshuk A
reviews.title: You Rule Gulmarg!!!!
reviews.text: The only reason for staying in gulmarg was this hotel because i happened to see the hotel in Conde Nast and a few special recommendations from friends. This hotel is outrightly the RULER of Gulmarg. Beautiful furniture, tastefully done rooms with magnificent room views, amazingly courteous and polite staff. The facilities were far too many but we managed to enjoy the most of it. The only thing we missed was the swimming pool which was not under maintenance. Mr Sadiq from Reception was the highlight who made us comfortable in every possible ways. A must experience property for luxury travelers.

reviews.author: creativecircle80
reviews.title: Good but not best
reviews.text: Khmer in gulmarg is a good hotel with modern rooms and facilities but service and staff attitude is lacking as the management seems to be complacent and non receptive to complaints. During our stay almost all our small requests were ignored making you realise the hotel's management requires a course in hospitality. Small requests like fresh milk with chocolate for our child was not adhered to even after several reminders, we had pre ordered kichdi for dinner but it wasn't made as they told us the waiter who took that order is off duty now! Khyber is exorbitantly priced and such excuses at those prices are in acceptable.

reviews.author: 62shwetad
reviews.title: Jannat~e~hind
reviews.text: Last year..in March wen it was all white everywhere..snow dashed;we stayed at Khyber fr two nights..never ever to be forgotten, the warm interiors were a treat to body n snowfall ,a treat to soul!!!amazing food , high end hospitality:n sipping ka wah was all we enjoyed. Experience at spa was ultimate too. The temperature controlled indoor pool wasanother way to keep our spirits high...I can visit n revisit the place ,any no of times , given a chance.. Must go if u think "Dharti par bhi swarg hai"

reviews.author: hakothari
reviews.title: Most pathetic 5 star property ever witnessed, deserves to be called one star property
reviews.text:
We booked 3 premier rooms through agent(Dastan Travels) for check in on 29th June 16 and check out on 30th June 16 (3 couples and one infant). I would like to take all the readers through disaster experience at so called 5 star property Khyber so that you will think twice before emptying your pockets for their pathetic services.

We were highly disappointed to know on 28th june evening that we will not be able to use heated pool(highlight of the property) as the same has undergone maintenance w.e.f 29th June till 10th July. To be noted they did not give any prior intimation to agent/ us about the same and we got to know through their website.

Check in experience was even worse than a 1 star property. We reached hotel lobby at 11.45 am and infant traveling with us was quite unwell and restless because of health issue.They assured us of best rooms asap. At 2.30 pm after almost all the guests got their check in done, they took us to the left over rooms which they allotted to us(room no. 5011, 5012, 5014). To our surprise, they allotted room with twin size beds to 2 couples and when we objected, they simply said they did not realise it and apologised. 
Next they gave us room 4001, 4003 and 4006. Room 4001 and 4003 had car parking of the hotel as room view. We had no choice as all other rooms were given to their preferred customers. We were utterly depressed to realise we have paid approx INR 20,000 for such a room. Obviously there was zero privacy level and trespassers could easily peep in the room so you cannot pull off the curtains at any point of time. Room 4006 had no view at all and all one could see was hotel property and adjacent cottages so we denied taking that room. 

They again shifted 3rd couple back to room 5011 and said this is all we can give you so we compromised with a room view of iron wires and wooden rods and cursed ourselves to waste INR 20,000 on such a property. There was only a slight glimpse of Himalayas which is the USP of the khyber property. By the time we got settled, it was 3.30 pm(took more than 3 hrs just to check in) and lunch time was over for us so we dint had lunch because of all the hassles faced.
Finally at 6 pm we could have first meal of the day and it seemed really delicious as we all were hungry to the core.
We had a one to one meeting with Mr. Vineet Chhabra(Hotel manager in charge) and explained him about each and everything we faced. He just nodded to us and accepted everything and kept apologising. He offered us complementary dinner and assured us that we will not face any further trouble. Dinner experience was good enough and food was the only good thing about Khyber.
Next day we checked out at 11.30 and asked them to keep our luggage in cloak room as we were proceeding to Gondola. When we came back to take our luggage, we were shocked and taken aback to see the way our luggage was literally thrown out of the hotel and they justified they have no empty space in cloak room. They placed a 20 kg suitcase over my hat and another 15kg bag over eatables.In addition we also experienced below mentioned issues:
 - Since the rooms had no AC, because of suffocation, we ultimately had to ask hotel guys to put a fan in our room at night 1.30 am
 - There was water leakage in room 4003. 
 - Phone provided in room 5011 was not working and had to be repaired.
 - Whenever any housekeeping/ cleaning/any other assistance was required, it was not a very prompt one, it took atleast 20 mins for someone to come and do the needful may be because rooms are very widely spread across the property.
 - There was absolutely no co ordination among the people representing the hotel.

So all in all it was a total money waste for us and we had the worst stay ever at any 5 star property. Not at all recommended.Pathetic service and below average room views.

If inspite of all the above issues, one still wishes to stay at Khyber, do so at your own risk as hotel guys are not trained to make your stay memorable.

reviews.author: arun p
reviews.title: Best Star class Category
reviews.text: I Visited Gulmarg in The month of may. One the best hotel In Kashmir is The Khyber Himalayan Resort. We stayed there for 2 nights, Had a wonderful time at the hotel and specially in the Warm Swimming pool which was just Amazing. If Anyone stayed a night am sure u will extend your stay at The Khyber resort. One thing Which is not expected is they charge so much for room and Charge extra if we want to use Wifi which is not

reviews.author: HIMALAYAS0904
reviews.title: LUXURY IN THE LAP OF HIMALAYAS
reviews.text:
Luxury in the lap of Himalayas
 
We visited Khyber during may end 2015 with two young kids. The check in was pretty smooth but It took about 20 minutes till when we were asked the sit in the lobby which has nice views of the snow capped mountains .Since the entire hotel  is centrally airconditioned except for a few areas hence one doesn’t feel the chill of gulmarg once inside. Since we all were very tired hence the checkin executive offered to discuss things in the room itself.The balcony was simply amazing with the best views one can have of the Himalayas in any resort in the hills.the luxury himalayan view room was what we expected it to be , quite nicely decorated with touches of Kashmir yet modern overall with a sunken bath with a huge window offering the snow capped mountain view.We were given the traditional kashmiri tea called the kawah which was nice.However, thereafter there was no voluntary interaction from the management to help the guests chalk out their stay plan .The kids play room was quite a disappointment as the only thing good was  the xbox and table tennis which we could not play both the times we visited the playroom as it was preoccupied by another family both times. I was also expecting some swings and slides and hammocks in the outdoors but found none .
The swimming pool was one high point during the stay as we all enjoyed it a lot but the tiles need a lot of maintenance as my daughter cut her foot with the small broken tiles . The attendant was prompt enough to get the first aid kit and tried to help my daughter . We then requested the staff to ensure repair of the broken tiles as anybody could get hurt and we ourselves were walking cautiously thereafter in the pool as we found many broken small pieces on the pool floor. The kids pool was nice and my son enjoyed it a lot.however the walk from the pool the the rooms is very long and cold as the entire passage is not heated .
The snack menu and the main menu both have very limited choice and need more variety.The staff otherwise courteous was reluctant to warm the amul taaza I was carrying the for kids and infact one of them advised to heat it in the room in the water kettle and the  kettle got spoilt because of this wrong advice.The staff was not very quick in clearing the mess and I had to pitch in to help them.
On the day of check out we had to check out early as our flight was at 10.30 am from Srinagar , hence we requested the staff to pack some breakfast stuff from the buffet breakfast but they were very reluctant and said that there will be extra charges on the sameFurther , no one from the hotel is there to inform you on the Srinagar traffic on weekdays and we got stuck for an hour in the traffic jam and missed our flight. 
Overall the hotel scores high on the location but needs to work towards making the stay more memorable by offering to help  guests plan their days in gulmarg and also be more helpful and supportive as is expected of any five star like TAJ or Oberois.

reviews.author: DivyanshiNM
reviews.title: Not the worth the price
reviews.text: No airconditioners in the hotel. The fridge does not work in the room. After several complaints the matter was looked into.  Price approx 350 $ but not worth it and just not upto the international standards.  Extremely disappointed

reviews.author: DrRavi16
reviews.title: Unexpected Amazing Beauty in Himalya
reviews.text: I have never expected such a beautifully crafted resort at  isolated Mountain peak. perfect location surrounded by snow peaks. walking distance from Gondola rides which is the main attraction of Gulmarg. Room servic is good . Centrally heated. with all modern amenities.

reviews.author: kapooranu
reviews.title: Amazing and wonderful
reviews.text: Beautiful resort in beautiful surroundings. Totally loved the time spent in this hotel. Spa  is top class. Indoor swimming pool with warm water is cherry on the cake. Enjoyed our stay to fullest. Worth the money spent. Recommended in Gulmarg.

reviews.author: PankajKumar781
reviews.title: A Heaven on Earth
reviews.text: Visited the place during November 2014. It was a great experience for me & my family.The place itself gives a great feeling of having on a different part of the planet, the beauty, the snow especially the Sunrise & sunsets at #The Khyber Himalayan Resort & Spa. it was a tremendous experience of the #Cloves-the coffee shop, #Chaikash-the tea lounge,#Calabash-the hookka lounge. the cloves i liked the most. The room service was also good on the click. Mr Aman Dhiman #Manager and his team Vikas, Iqbal, Prabhakar, Brijkishor had a great contribution for making this trip a succesful one. They guided us to encounter those beautific scenes which i would not been able to see elsewhere.

reviews.author: Rushman1
reviews.title: Great location and service
reviews.text: Visited the place in July 15. Sitting on top of Gulmarg the hotel has great views of the Himalayas. I would like to say a special thank you to the staff for all their help with my reservations and check in as well as great service. Hope to be there in the winters too

reviews.author: mansingala
reviews.title: Part of Heaven on earth
reviews.text: Have visited khyber twice..once in winter and recently in their summer days.. The experince ws awesome,i think specially the ambience, the view, the peace u get there is something u really dnt wanna miss it. Everything is nicely managed. Be it calabash, restaurants,spas...with helpful warm staff of fnb and manager mr. Aman makes sure tht his every guest leave with excel food and service memories.. Bcoz of these reasons we might feel to mesmorize our memories.. Few things in room service they need to work on but overall experience ws superb... Looking forward to visit soon..😊😊

reviews.author: AnnRa
reviews.title: Fantastic rooms!!!
reviews.text: The rooms are gorgeous and every detail is exquisite.. The lighting is beautiful and the scenery from the balcony is breathtaking... Though there are resorts with better view in gulmarg, the ambience of this place is to be experienced ..it is a stone 's throw from the gondola ticket window. However it would be good if the resort arranges drop /pickup from this point as it's a difficult steep climb esp with kids..the staff is polite but felt the service was mechanical and did not match the ambience of this place. No one approached us and asked if our stAy was good at any point in the 2 days v were there. The kids room called igloo should be housed in a glass like structure like the swimming pool.. Right now it is 2 floors down in a windowless room and seems out of place in this well designed resort. My husband visited the spa and gave a thumbs up for the experience, must do when at the hotel ..

reviews.author: manishabinani
reviews.title: gulmargs crown
reviews.text: very courteous staff. awesome ambience. wonderful amenities comfort par excellence. food still brings water to my mouth.congrats chef n thanku for amazing samosa chaat n hot pakodas.convinient location

reviews.author: dillliwala
reviews.title: Superb Hotel
reviews.text: Gulmarg is a small pristine valley with not much to do except take the gondola up the mountain or trek around the area in summer. So this oasis is a great retreat with excellent rooms. The ones with the balcony make more sense considering the weather and the heavenly experience of sipping a beverage there any time of the day.Rooms are generous sized and very well appointed. Bathroom is a treat. Everything works and still feels new. Service too is warm. If one had to be picky, one would ctitique the service level in the restaurant ...takes long for anything. All things considered - highly recommended!! Must go again.

reviews.author: noizemaker
reviews.title: 3х-дневная командировка в Кашмир
reviews.text:
Был в данном отеле в декабре, в течение трех дней. Командировка сложилась очень удачно, работы особо не было, поэтому была возможность оценить окружающий мир)
Отель находится в очень живописном месте, в Гималаях. Из окон открывается просто фантастический вид на заснеженные вершины. Природа и свежий горный воздух - это, наверное, основной плюс этого региона в целом. Но и минусов конечно не занимать. Начнем с того, что это Индия и даже "больше", что-то ближе к Пакистану и Афганистану. Это был уже мой второй визит в Индию, и я знал куда еду. Но вот мои товарищи по командировки были просто в ужасе от города Шринагар, где находится аэропорт, от нашей дороги в отели, дорожного движения, местных водителей, грязи, разрухи. Ну в общем, всего того, что делает Индию Индией))
Насколько я понимаю, люди едут в эти места в горнолыжных целях. Мы были немного с другой целью, но по канатной дороге все же поднялись. Ну так вот, ифраструктура этого горнолыжного "курорта" оставляет желать лучшего, точнее, наверное, оставляет желать хоть чего-то) Потому что там, собственно, ничего и нет. Может быть мы были не в сезон (снега еще было немного), либо были не совсем там. Думаю про регион - это все.
Теперь о самом отеле. Это пятерка. Достаточно уютная, красивая. Даже не по индийским меркам там очень комфортно. Хорошая инфраструктура: ресторан, тренажерный зал, бизнес-центр, своеобразная лаундж-зона с терассой и видом горы. Встретили нас очень душевно: напоили вкуснейшим кашмирским чаем. Не могу сказать, из чего конкретно он сделан, но он был настолько живительным и вкусным, что усталость с дороги как рукой сняло.
Номер был просторный и уютный, с балконом, вид на горы. Чистая ванная с большой душевой кабиной. 
Ресторан тоже отличный. У нас были включены завтраки - шведский стол. Там были и каши, и яичницы, всевозможная выпечка, мюсли, фрукты, орехи. В общем, очень разнообразно и по-европейски (поскольку от индийской кухни я не в восторге вообще). Так же мы в отеле и ужинали, за свой счет разумеется. Цены выше среднего, но не космические. Что самое интересное - очень вкусно. Я даже умудрился взять такое блюдо, в котором был выдержан некий баланс между местным колоритом и вкусом, близким европейскому языку)
Теперь о минусах:
1) Самый большой и главный - это платный интернет, тем более по диким тарифам. Может этому и есть какое-то объяснение, но платить в пятерке еще и за интернет - полнейший абсурд.
2) Тяжелое взаимопонимание с персоналом. Как я уже говорил, я был в Индии во второй раз, и прекрасно понимал, что русский человек с индусом общего языка не найдут (даже учитывая, что у меня лингвистическое образование и отличный английский), так тут еще и сказывалось, видимо, слабое знание персоналом английского. В общем, было тяжело. Особенно, когда мы пытались заказать стейк средней прожарки.
3) Лично для меня это минусом не было, поскольку я не пьющий вообще. Но для кого-то - да. Регион на 99% мусульманский, будьте готовы, что алкоголь не купить. Вообще. Нигде. Никак. В общем, берите с собой из дьюти фри)
4) Местный колорит и городок Гульмарг - это конечно совершенно другая Индия, не такая как на юге. Но и эта крайность немного пугает: местное население по большей части на вид самые настоящие талибы и моджахеды. Вообще, штат Кашмир - спорная территория, и там не очень спорно, периодически случаются терракты и т.д. В горах на дорогах стоят какие-то блокпосты и т.д. В общем, колоритненько))

reviews.author: indiancouple
reviews.title: The ultimate in luxury
reviews.text:
The place is expensive, but if you can afford it, you would be foolish to look anywhere else in Gulmarg. The hotel spells class at every nook and corner. The rooms are superb, so are the restaurants, and so is the spa. In fact, you are tempted not to leave the hotel premises at all. The hotel itself becomes the main attraction in the lovely town of Gulmarg !
We have stayed at many great hotels around the world, and I can say that this would surely rank as my best ever hotel experience till date.

reviews.author: DEVANSH10
reviews.title: Awesome!
reviews.text: The best part of whole of Kashmir trip was Gulmarg and what made it even more special was Khyber! Truly its a wonderful property with serene views of the mountains and lush green lawns. The rooms are just fantastic. Every thing of this hotel is perfect!! The heated swimming pool and jaccoussie are a great time pass. Though everything here is a bit overpriced but its worth it! Overall a fabouless and memorable experience!!

reviews.author: MeghaMawandia
reviews.title: mixed bag.. read carefully
reviews.text:
Rooms and location is fantastic. However there are lots of stairs! There are stairs to go to rooms to go to the lawns along each layer of lawn. When we asked them for a ball to play in the lawn they said the lawns were not for children. Only place children to play was a closed room with no windows called the igloo. I don’t fancy the idea of taking my children to a beautiful location like Gulmarg and cooping them in a  room to play the xbox. To cap it the ‘Igloo’ was 2 stories down with the toilet- you guessed it 2 stories up! 
Their famed heated pool decked with bisazza tiles had tiles popping off and their changing room was wet and worse then a roadside toilet.

All this apart, the food was excellent! Their chef is adept at Italian as well as Indian and their service staff is courteous and polite. I would go again but restrict myself to the rooms and the restaurants.

reviews.author: RasheshShah
reviews.title: Fabulous Hotel and great experience
reviews.text:
We visited Gulmarg from 30th June-2rd July and stayed at the Khyber and really loved every minute of it.  The Hotel the facilities and the staff all were excellent. Great food too! would definitely love to go again

Would recommend the Gondola ride. Both phases. The view from 2nd phase is an experience.

Planning to go again in Winter for Skiiing in Gulmarg.

reviews.author: CHANDAN C
reviews.title: The place to be!!! Must visit in kashmir!!
reviews.text:
The cherry on cake is what i call this in my kashmir trip. Stayed at the hotel for 2 nighs on 3-4 july 15. And it was a memorable experience. The most amzing hotel in hills. The staff is very courteous and friendly. Mr sajad in restraurent totally floored us with his hospitality. Very cooperative and attentive staff. Extremely helpful. Very well maintained pool spa gym sauna..
Best was the spa . Extremely luxurious spa at par with any five star hotel in delhi. Massage was too relaxing!! Food was amazingly good and portions served were also large as compared to other hotels in five star category!! Perfect location near the gondola.. Awesome view . Best place .
Rates are on a higher side but they truly deserve it. Go if u want to seek luxury!!
Also- guide mr ahmed very genuine gor gulmarg (+91 97-97-280163) 
Taxi driver for kashmir trip- mushtaq bhaijaan - 099-06-460370.  The best person in the whole trip. Very genuine and caring taxi driver. Felt like family with him. You can book him for entire trip! Reasonable and genuine . Will take you to right places and gives genuine advice!!Highly recomended!!

reviews.author: sanjaysilli
reviews.title: Overall good experience
reviews.text:
I with my family stayed in this property in month of june '15. Ever smiling and helpful staff. The location and archtecture is spell binding.
The let down is the food and dinning area. The dinning hall is too small, cogested, crowded and choatic for otherwise such a fabulous property.
The food has limited range and average in quality.
The rest of the stay makes up for this short coming.

reviews.author: Anshul Aggarwal
reviews.title: Heaven fall here
reviews.text:
1.excellent location near to trolly cable car.
2.fully covered with snow in winter.
3.awsome food.
4.spa facilities are awsome.
5.hot water swimming pool is a relaxing part.
5.playing gorund and area we can say is big and well maintained specially for kids.
6.rooms are very very luxurious wid a spacious balcony with a heavenly view.
7.staff was very warm and humble...hospitality was no doubt upto the mark.
8.i would love to.come here again & again.

reviews.author: Abbas08
reviews.title: Oh Khyber! You beauty
reviews.text:
To begin with we got lucky, reach Kashmir and greeted with a 6 feet dump of snow. Gulmarg is surreal, unbelievably beautiful. 

Disclaimer - I did not stay at the Khyber, but spent two lovely evenings on a property tour and with friends that were staying there.  

I'm not always a big fan of big resorts, Khyber is different. It is both a statement and yet intricately artistic. It is grand, yet subtly tasteful. All of Gulmarg is wonderful location, but Khyber has it best. 

The view from Khyber and the rooms is only mountains and nature, you cannot view the rest of the town. (which at times in hill stations can be an eye sore). The food was delicious! 

My friends who stayed there were delighted in every aspect. Rooms/ Views/ food and incredible service. 

I would go back to Gulmarg to stay at Khyber and ski some more.

reviews.author: avinash678singh
reviews.title: Great place......
reviews.text:
Stayed at khyber in june....... The hotel is very well maintained and the service there was very nice and courteous.... We got rooms with nice views....
Loved the interiors at Khyber.....
Very luxurious and classy....

reviews.author: vkuthiala
reviews.title: Truly World Class setting
reviews.text: The last 45 minutes of road journey from Shrinagar to Gulmarg must rank as one of the most beautiful that you would encounter anywhere in the world - if you love the mountains. The zero point en-route would mesmerize you and then the large meadow that looks alike a green bowl housing a golf course - indeed breathtaking. And then when you drive up to the hotel Khyber - you are left in a stupor that takes a while to dissipate. The balcony rooms are fantastic - facing either side. The restaurant serves excellent food and the serving staff is ever willing to top up the buffet selection. Try the Tandoori Trout. And they have fantastic indoor heated pool - which would transport you to Norway or North Scandinavia.

reviews.author: siddharthPune
reviews.title: Heavenly luxury
reviews.text:
My friend Raman Khosla & I were delighted to spend 2 nights from June 24-26 at this super luxurious resort. Contrary to many reviews on this site, we found the staff of this resort cordial. Both our contacts with the reception were very good, Sajjad during check in & Manzoor at check out. 

The view from our room of the tall trees against the green slopes & snow capped mountains was amazing. We had an outstanding ala carte lunch at the main restaurant Cloves. The service here was very good. Sajad Lone at this restaurant was specially very warm & friendly. Though the wifi internet was paid (Rs 750 / 24 hours for 2 devices) it was fast & worth it. Special thanks to Adil at the reception & Farook from the wifi team for helping us restore our wifi internet in a few minutes even as early as 5 am. 

The warm swimming pool in the cold rainy weather felt out of this world. The spa could be more well planned. The men's area doesn't have any changing rooms, the shower rooms need more hanging facilities, the urinals could be segregated. We had very good massage & facial therapies at the L'Occitane spa (separate review). 

We also liked the fact that Khyber was 5 minutes walk from the gondola. All said & done, Khyber was heavenly indeed.

reviews.author: Ritu G
reviews.title: Amazing place to be in winters
reviews.text: Simply awesome,although i went there in summers but i feel o should return here when snow is all around as u can skii and have all the fun in snow just outside the hotel,lush gardens and beautiful is what i would call this place ,although newly opened it lacks in service ,the gandola ride just around the corner helps and i love the heated swimming pool

reviews.author: Puneeta_j
reviews.title: Luxury in the lap of nature!
reviews.text:
The Khyber Himalayan Resort & Spa is the most luxurious hotel in Gulmarg. They have a cordial staff. Room that I stayed in was of premium category. They are small but neat and tidy. Good, pro-active room service. Food I feel is overpriced. Hotels boasts of an interesting architecture, magnificent wooden decor with beautiful lobbies.

Over all it a peaceful place away from the stress of life!

reviews.author: PUNEESH PURI
reviews.title: Poor
reviews.text: The property is good but the staff & hospitality is nill. The staff & service is not up to the mark. The GM of the hotel should be demoted to a captain level as even after making a written complaint there was no answer from him. You can visit only for the property

reviews.author: Rajni P
reviews.title: Home away from home
reviews.text: Excellent hotel. The staff was very attentive and great. The restaurant didn't have enough A La Carte choices in the menu. Overall experience was good. The swimming pool was amazing. The Spa was great as well and the staff inside the Spa was great also.

reviews.author: Qazi N
reviews.title: Naqeed
reviews.text: I went there is May , there was no valet parking, had to park self, no security, washroom was not clean, they don't serve good after 3 pm , just drinks n snacks,what if guests reach late to hotel, do they have to go out for food? It's a 5 star hotel so you need to provide all facilities

reviews.author: biswasss
reviews.title: Nice new hotel in bad location
reviews.text: Hotel khyber in Gulmarg is a new resort hotel with modern amenities though the hotel and is good but it has average service and below average location .The hotel is situation on one side of gandola and there is no where one can go for walk. There is hardly any views of gulmarg bowl. The hotel does not serve any liquor which was not informed to us at the time of booking. Overall a good hotel but in a place like gulmarg to need good views which hotels like Highland Park or Nedous hotel offer.

reviews.author: Samyak M
reviews.title: Excellent Location
reviews.text:
This is probably one of the finest places one can stay in gulmarg. The property is simply beautiful with a breathtaking view of the himalayas from the rooms.
The staff is extremely friendly (though the accent might make you feel that they aren't warm), and the rooms are very well appointed. Though the walls are very thin and you can practically hear almost everything from the next room.

The hotel is very close to the Gandola Ride - which is supposed to be the main attraction in Gulmarg.

The rooms do NOT have A/C - but have heaters instead. Make sure while checking in they show you how to operate it.

Food quality is strictly average, but is excellent as compared to the other restaurants in gulmarg.

reviews.author: sam122014
reviews.title: "Why go to Switzerland"
reviews.text: I stayed with my family 3 weeks back at The Khyber it was out of the world hospitality .As soon as we entered the hotel we were amazed with the lobby and the architecture of the hotel . We were then taken to a Tea lounge for a free Kahwa Ms Preet took us around the property and showed us the different area and things to do. We planned a dinner for our family at Nouf  it was a traditinol Wazwaan dinner which was great i really recommend everybody to try the experience as it is out of the world.Overall food and service was excellent and staff was very cordial and humble.Will difinetely come back again with a bigger group.......

reviews.author: sps100
reviews.title: All bell 🔔 and whistles
reviews.text:
The property is palatial in looks, the similarities end here, reception was lukewarm nothing like Lalit Srinagar 
Very poor service, a glass of fresh lime soda took them an hour and 3 calls, the telephone was out of order, it took them 3-4 hrs and when I summoned the duty manager that it was done, just about, as the handset was still not working 
Another word of caution ⚠ 
BSNL and idea 💡 do not work in the rooms 
Food is average

reviews.author: sparkle217
reviews.title: awesome experience
reviews.text:
We just got back 2 weeks ago from our trip to kashmir. We spent 2 nights at The Khyber and it was a wonderful experience. 
First impression as we entered the property took our breadth away. The meticulous details are worth a mention. The interiors are so gorgeous that you just want to stare at every corner. the views from the rooms are amazing. The location is just perfect, We just could not stop taking photos! We found the staff extremely helpful, special mention to the F&B assistant manager Mr Kamal. Also Miss Preet and so many members of the staff in the restaurant. I was impressed when Ishfaq( i hope i spelt his name right) asked how both my girls were doing and he remembered their names. Small gestures goes a long way and most hotels are almost robotic nowadays. Here the staff was friendly, indulging the children with small treats from the buffet etc. From the guy at the gate to the house keeping staff all were very polite. All in all we had a wonderful experience, the kids had a blast we shall definitely go there if we go to gulmarg.

reviews.author: KHManager1
reviews.title: The best property in Kashmir
reviews.text: We stayed in No. 1 hotels during our Kashmir trip. Khyber in Gulmarg, Pahalgam Hotel in Pahalgam and Taj Vivanta in Srinagar. Khyber was undoubtedly the best among these best. The Balcony view rooms were very large, tastefully decorated and lavish in utilities. Very good housekeeping and so was room service. The food was also amazing complimenting the service. The location of this hotel is within walking distance to the gondola, from where you go to snow clad mountains; particularly important point as you are not allowed to use your vehicles inside the Gulmarg and you cannot walk much because of ups and downs in road. The only bad experience I had was that while checking out my luggage was not tagged and it was loaded in a Tempo Traveler belonging to others guest and the management had no clue about it. Thanks to my car driver who knew the driver of that Tempo and he phoned him and then we could get our luggage after chasing him for 20 kms. The worst part was that the management did not even bother to apologize. Had this been not happened I would have rated them seven stars.

reviews.author: RashmiChawla2014
reviews.title: Heavenly
reviews.text: The place is awesome. A place to pamper yourself and worth the money spent. The service is excellent and staff is extremely courteous. The steam and sauna really helped me unwind. The spa treatment was extremely relaxing.

reviews.author: aditya_mehta85
reviews.title: A must visit place!!
reviews.text: Me and my wife were always fascinated by the thought of visiting Srinagar also Kashmir on a whole!! Finally we made it happen last month that is June. Our choice to stay in Kashmir was by default Srinagar. So we narrowed on Vivanta by Taj, Srinagar. Was real hot n kinda humid in srinagar. Moreover there wasn't much scenic beauty to appreciate sitting in middle of Dal Lake. We decided to hire a cab and spend a day in Gulmarg. And this proved to b the wisest decision of ours on this trip. Such a mesmerizing beauty this place is! Our driver suggested us of having a meal at Khyber Resort. He was all praises of this place. And we went by his suggestion.This resort is so beautifully placed/located all surrounded by gorgeous peaks. Wonder how they would look covered with snow. It was really warm n cozy in the resort. Were greeted with a warm welcome as well. Though we were not staying with them but even then the warmth they showed in welcoming us was overwhelming. We chose the all day dining CLOVES for a lunch. Again the same welcome it was. The staff was real competitive to guide us through the menu. The menu was a complete guide to local flavors as well as International ones for any international traveler. We were lucky to have their manager Kamal Rawat on the floor that time. And this guy made us regret our stay at Vivanta Taj by his Courtesy and stylish service. He almost read our mind as to what we are looking for in terms of local flavors! And he was Bang on.. The food was equally amazing, far far better than we had whatever and wherever in Srinagar. Thank you so much for such a pleasant afternoon at Khyber. Looking forward to stay with you guys next time with all the snow around!

reviews.author: Arun0102
reviews.title: Realy a home away from home
reviews.text: It was a great experience. I visited the Resort last month and had a memorable stay. All the staff was too caring and helpful. Check in was smooth and room was nice. The restaurant experience was outstanding. Staff over there was too attentive. Kamal the Restaurant manager was too caring and very soft spoken. Over all I had a great time in the hotel and will say that it is the best option in Gulmarg.

reviews.author: Zuhaib
reviews.title: Wonderful Property & Service
reviews.text: must say this is a superb property. we 5 friends went in june. one of our friend was not well. they gave us best service, best care with their smiling helpful staff. food is yummy. service was excellent. Though we only had dinner there and were staying in a different hotel. we enjoyed alot and its so centrally located .

reviews.author: Nandinizah
reviews.title: Dream place to relive the life
reviews.text:
We stayed here last week and must confess it's a beautiful well managed resort, small small gestures like complimentary cake on anniversary were really helpful to have memorable experience.

In a destination which is so far away this resort is amazingly well kept and services were truly luxurious. Eagerly waiting for the winters to come back for skiing

reviews.author: Prabir Jha
reviews.title: Excellent property!
reviews.text: We spent some memorable time at the Khyber in Gulmarg, an amazing property, with excellent large rooms and bath. Very well appointed. The service we experienced was brilliant, including the hot Kahwa on arrival. We enjoyed a well spread Wazwan, excellently done. The view from my room of the snow capped peaks was riveting.excellent place I would love to return to when it is all covered in snow.

reviews.author: Madhuridhanuka

reviews.author: BAhuja
reviews.title: Beautiful locale

reviews.author: 894Rahul
reviews.title: One of the best hotels of the world!!!
reviews.text: I with my family visited Khyber last month,and it was quite amazing ....food, rooms,hospitality at its best.Also staff is quite helpful.I recommend this property to every one coming to Kashmir!!!!and also one of the best thing is its location,it is a walking distance from one of the famous cable car i.e gulmarg gondola

reviews.author: Naman D
reviews.title: Deja Vu

Had stayed here 6 months back, that time gulmarg was in blanket of snow, this time it was in smell of horse dung and greenery, loved my stay with this particular hotel.

only on dampener is hotel have stopped giving kehwa as complimentary, now they charge which is not a great idea....

keep the standards as it is, will visit again for the Ski in next year...

reviews.author: anandsunita

The food was excellent.. The service superb..!

reviews.author: pranav s

I went with my family a few days back, and this hotel was one of the best hotels i have ever visited in the Indian hill stations.

reviews.author: Mehru B

One suggestion - there should be separate small changing rooms in the swimming area. (which do not have a shower or toilet. These are just meant for changing clothes) In the women's side, you are expected to change your clothes either in the shower or in the toilet.

reviews.author: Narinder C
reviews.title: Worst experirience
reviews.text: We very excited to stay there as we heart a lot but it was very dis appointed us were a group of 9 stayed in 4 rooms but i will not recommend any body for this properly due to poor service every where including house keeping front desk restaurant  behaviour maintenance cleaning etc even when we up dated about this to the general manager he said yes we know you had problems last night during dinner but his approach was very casual and was least bothered as he sad we are running on 100% occupancy but if continuers i dont think any body will repeat as we cancelled our booking for 13 rooms which were booked for my silver jubilee anniversary in sept NOT WIRRH STAYING

still the best and most expensive place to stay in Gulmarg.

reviews.title: Oasis in Filthy Gulmarg
reviews.text:
Gulmarg is definitely not as pristine as it's been shown in Tourism Brouchers and documentaries, it's smelly, filthy and extremely unhygienic, had a disastrous first impression of this destination while entering it.

Kudos to team khyber for ensuring and changing my whole impression about this place with their hospitality, service and going out of the way to my demands.

Pool water is a concern which needs immediate attention, It need daily cleaning which is definitely not happening. Spa is superb, masseurs are well trained and well behaved.

reviews.author: eskay1103
reviews.title: Poor service and extremely confused and grossly overpriced
reviews.text: Housekeeping gets done and towels are not replaced, one day you order tea it costs 340 Rs with two cups the next day it becomes 680 Rs ! Linen is not changed even though we stayed for 4 nights  - had to really push hard for getting a room with the mountain view - they take complete advantage of a monopoly like situation. Best to stay in Srinagar and do a day trip to Gulmarg. Easily Qualifies as the poorest hotel in terms of service, bathroom quality and fixtures, no air-conditioning and pathetic service.

reviews.author: Bhawna C
reviews.title: Very bad experience all over
reviews.text:
The hotel maintaince is too bad , in room on bed sides some dirty particles r seen like some food dishes particles. In bathroom the bad smell is coming , bathtub is very dirty and the things like towel complete sets r not kept . No hand towels were kept.
The lobby wash rooms r  very dirty. The service is very poor in resturant. After giving the snacks order we waited for an hour and when we gave the food order they dont know what the food order was , they didnt kept the plates , the food came after a long time, they werw bringing dishes one by one because they didnt remember the order, the roti's were not properly served , the roti's shape were too bad as some untrained person was making, at last we ate in the dish bowls because they forgot to put the plates . The buffet was very bad and the break fast buffet was also too bad there was not much variety.

At last i should say the whole experience was too bad . We are paying so much for the one day stay which is not worth . I will suggest the people not to go this place ever.

reviews.author: D0shi
reviews.title: Room for improvement
reviews.text:
No doubt, once you enter The Khyber, you feel high. The entrance to the resort is just grand. Once you are in, and if you have a taste of collections,what they have, you just can't stop appreciating. 

But there is a lot more required in SERVICES. It is just POOR. We checked in at 2 PM and had our bookings for two nights, for two rooms. Our one room was not ready till 4 PM. We just waited in our one room. Even after second room was ready, we had to call almost thrice  to have our room keys delivered, and programmed. Ultimately I had to visit personally to the guest relation area to have my room key delivered. The one room which we were given Room No. 3001, did not have any partitions in Bathroom. It was under some renovation, and even a single use of shower by one person, could make the whole bathroom wet and slippery. And it actually did. We complained for almost full day about it, and did ask for compensation for the services not provided to us, all went unanswered. We got the change of room only on next day.

Swimming Pool was under some repair, and we could not enjoy it during our stay for two nights. 

Food menu does not have much change, or does not have more option to choose. Vegetarian desserts were out of stock even at 9.30 am on breakfast menu. But still the food is just good.

BUT>>>BUT>>> that's all.That's the only bad about The Khyber mentioned above...

 Rest of the things are just TOOOOOOOOOO GOOD. The best view, The best feel of stay. Since there is nothing much to do in Gulmarg in June-July, you can have full use of Hotel amenities and can hit the Gym, Have your Spa. We enjoyed a great. Every hotel does have some sort of Service related Problems,and Khyber is not exception. But I would very much strongly recommend this Hotel.

Gondala is though not properly maintained and not clean and though OVER PRICED as Rs.1400/- each for 2 levels,  One must go for it. Do not try Ski in July, and the charges are too much for a small span of ski. We were asked for Rs.2500/- each for Ski, charged for Rs.1500/- each, was not worth it. Some people from other Hotel managed to have the same thing at Rs.800/-. The name Khyber to the local guide makes you pay more. But the Stay is just worth the money. Go for it. They will improve...

reviews.author: Sumit S
reviews.title: Awfully poor service, rude staff........
