reviews.author: Pratibha K
reviews.title: Khyber is Gulmarg, Gulmarg is Khyber
reviews.text: From where do I start.. Gulmarg is a very small area and not much to do except the Gondola ride (3-4 hours max) but Khyber Resort has turned this idle location into an exceptionally perfect holiday place. The view from the resort entirely engulfs the beauty of Gulmarg. The facilities of the resort are comprehensive - nicely done rooms, fully equipped with modern amenities(airtel HD TV in rooms - Taj does not provide it in Srinagar) , play areas outside and inside for kids(XBox games) , spa for adults, swimming pool, jacuzzi, steam, sauna, mini theatre, tea lounge, hookah bar and lovely sitting areas all along the property. The staff is well trained and a special mention for team leader 'Zahoor'. The space has been used very well to give you a wholesome experience; from majestic entrance, grand lobby to walkways. For e.g. the walk towards the spa/pool area itself is so beautiful that you don't mind taking the many stairs it involves, very thoughtfully sitting areas are made along the walkway. Their Spa is far superior than many in urban cities. Our stay at Taj in Srinagar was disappointing as compared to Khyber Resort. If you are visiting Kashmir do not miss Khyber Resort at any cost.

reviews.author: Hankuna_Matata
reviews.title: Oasis in Heaven
reviews.text:
Just a few things you should know before we talk about the hotel. Gulmarg is an incredibly beautiful place especially in the months of Dec-Feb given fresh powder snow, cleanliness, not very crowded, and incredible natural beauty. We would definitely recommend this period. 
it is also the best time to enjoy Khyber - a rare high end and full service option available in the hilly regions in India.

Khyber was less than a 2 hour drive away from Srinagar airport. The roads were good and coupled with the beautiful surroundings - we had a good start to our journey.
The hotel greets you with a hot cup of traditional Kashmiri Kahwa which is a must have. I would rank the hotel ambiance in line with the top premium 5 stars in India.

The hotel is indeed located in the middle of a field which was covered by heavy snow and the beauty was amplified with several pine trees. For once the hotel looked much more spectacular than even the pictures on the website both from outside and inside. The rooms are tastefully decorated and provide equally outstanding views with no stones unturned for the good experience.

The hotel has centralized temperature control and all rooms are fitted with modern amenities. You can go outside, play in the snow for however long you want and the warm hotel awaits you the moment you start freezing. They have lots of designated areas to enjoy the snow, for outside views etc. in case you just with to relax in the hotel.
Just one complaint, walls are thin. We unfortunately shared a wall with a noisy group in the other room which was not very helpful in the night.

The Gondola is walking distance away from the hotel which gives easy access to the higher points in case you want to ski. We did not try the spa, but spa, heated swimming pool, jaccuzi etc were available.

The hospitality is at par with the Oberoi service which I rate at the highest level in this country. We had a small accident while skiing and the hotel staff took great care of us during the rest of our stay. 

The food quality was good, but the options are a but limited. The hotel has a buffet and a multicuisine ala carte menu. However, you can run out of options during a longer stay. The hotel staff can however help with some off the menu options as well in case you are craving for something else. The hotel has only one restaurant (all day) and one cafe. the restaurant options to me was a limitation. Alcohol is not served in the hotel.

The only other shortcoming was our departure from the hotel. The hotel had run out of cars and hence had provided us with a local taxi. We had paid double the money for a hotel car which could directly take us to the airport, instead we had to travel in local ones and change car in between (one for snow and one for road).

Overall, we were well taken care of, and without exaggerating, I can safely say that this was a superior experience than some of our other trips to Europe and New Zealand, both in terms of scenic beauty and hospitality (that too at a fraction of the cost).

reviews.author: Sujata752
reviews.title: Heaven is the word
reviews.text:
We were here in Jan 2014. Awesome is the word. One of the best properties ever visited and the best hospitality even experienced. Awesome view from balcony.First, when booked, though it to be overpriced, but once in - felt should have been there longer. If you did not experience Khyber, I would say you did not experience Kashmir.
The gondola is just outside Khyber and a bare one min walk.
Very good food. Excellent Kahwa to keep u warm.
Words fall short for this particular property!!

reviews.author: Vaishali Havaldar
reviews.title: The khyber
reviews.text: Excellent stay. It is located very close to gondola rides. They provide vehicle to go to gondola. Beautifully decorated, food we tried in the grill section. Steak was out of this world. Wish we had more days to enjoy the hotel. The view from the rooms was breath taking. If we ever come back to Gulmarg we would want to stay here.

reviews.author: Alokmili77
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: We were upgraded in deluxe rooms,hotel was not fully operational.we had a nice view from our bathrooms showing snow across the tub glass so near you.It was snowing and seen life time best view from the hotel.food was exceptionally good.Shooting team for film Bang Bang were scheduled to stay there but there trip was cancelled,because of disturbance.

reviews.author: Darvish
reviews.title: Unexpected Luxury nestled in Himalayas...
reviews.text:
Gulmarg tends to be touristy and crammed during summers but Khyber’s location ensures that you’re far and away from the madding crowds besides offering you with some of the best views of the layered mountains and the mist. This is one place that will overwhelm you with its sheer grand feel, as you seldom come across a luxurious resort of this size in the hill stations. Mostly, we expect a simple & functional lobby and basic room standards, but a few addresses like this have truly raised the bar. 

Don’t miss the traditional Kashmiri Kahwa on arrival while their staff completes the check-in formalities. It’s very intimate and comfortable lounge at the far end of the extended lobby, with large bay windows separating sunlit verandahs overlooking the hills. The rooms have the typical comforts of five-star hotel and resorts in other parts of the country, just that you would not have expected it here. The décor is creatively inspired by local Kashmiri artistic motifs. However, despite being a new hotel, some structural elements had maintenance issues like the sliding door between the wardrobe and toilet. 

We had a large spacious balcony sit out attached to our room, a perfect place to brood and admire the blissful views. With Kashmir having extended daylight in summers, you have the flexibility to optimize your hours between the balcony and bathtub as the view gets replicated from toilet as well.

We preferred taking all our meals at the resort itself. The breakfast and weekend dinner buffet spread was extensive and a-la-carte menu had some interesting local cuisine choices. Service was a need area at times, as the staff was not well-trained to be attentive or make eye contacts. They looked busy all the time without really attending to the guests. Service issue was also faced when we had to request thrice for something as simple as keeping an extra duvet in the room. 

Otherwise, the team is very knowledgeable to interact with and seemed to have background experiences with some of the leading International hotel brands. The resort management also went out of their way to arrange Gondola tickets for us, a must-do experience if you are in Gulmarg. This saved us from the frustration of getting into long queues. We were advised to come back in winters, esp. February to experience another aspect of Gulmarg. 

Khyber is a destination in itself and you’re tempted to be back here soon, hopefully, their spa would be operational soon.

reviews.author: Eesha k
reviews.title: great place to spend time !
reviews.text: Really a great place to be with family and friends. Had a good time. Excellent service, cooperative staff, nice rooms. Place well built to add in the beauty of kashmir !! A perfect destination for spending time with your closed ones. Good food. Scenic beauty to the best !!

reviews.author: supermehra
reviews.title: Excellent service & well appointed rooms
reviews.text:
Possibly the best hotel in Gulmarg, the Khyber is an excellent, brand new property. The hotel has the feel of a "wood cabin" with great views of the mountains & woods. 

Pros:
1. Located very close to the Gondola starting point & the golf course. 
2. Service is outstanding with eager to please staff.
3. Rooms are brand new and were the most comfortable in Kashmir. 
4. Food though limited in choice, was generally decent.
5. Chaikash their tea lounge is a great hang out and serves lovely kawa. Also decent cappuccino.  
6. The room we had, overlooked the hotel gardens which are perfect to relax in. Hotel also does bonfires on request for an additional charge. 
7. Kids have a cinema, trampoline, billiards table (poorly maintained), garden area to play in, all of which keeps them busy.  
8. We shared our suite with 2 kids, which worked out well. The room balcony was spectacular. 

Cons:
1. The hotel has some construction still underway. Can be noisy if you are nearer the construction. 
2. The approach to the hotel is cluttered with ponies which make a real mess. No real fault of the hotel, Gulmarg is just like that.  
3. The hotel restaurant was shut which meant that you had a choice between the buffet & an open air continental restaurant. The buffet tries hard, but isn't very good. It also gets boring if you are going to eat three meals times 3 days in the same room! Gulmarg has no other real options outside the hotel. 
4. The lack of authentic Kashmiri food was our greatest disappointment. When in Kashmir why would you want to eat continental? Perhaps for the europeans who come skiing in the winter!
5. NO ALCOHOL...... so BYOB!

Overall, I would highly recommend Khyber.

reviews.author: Amit K
reviews.title: Superb property with great views
reviews.text:
Newly built, superbly done up hotel. Hotel owner seems to have spent a fortune in building it (some parts still under construction). Spa is still to be operational. 

Stayed in a room with balcony - comparable to the best. 

Had the best Kahwa tea of my trip (which was offered while check-in was being done). However, food quality was generally not up to the mark, maybe its early days.

reviews.author: CHANDRAChandigarh
reviews.title: Good for Winter
reviews.text:
Stayed 4th & 5th June 2013

The check in was painfully slow, we were offered some kahwa and then totally forgotten about. The rooms are nice. However almost half of the rooms have balconies for which the hotel charges approx Rs 3000 extra.  Rooms with No balconies have a big glazed wall for a good view of the forest beyond, but then the glass was never cleaned.
 In this hotel we had to go down 2 floors to reach our room. Provision for lift is there which was not installed as yet.
The spa is also not functional yet. The business centre is also lacking in many aspects. No newspapers delivered to the rooms in the morning.
 Quality of food is good and the service in the restaurant is good. 
Housekeeping is poor. Hot water tap was delivering tepid water, while cold water tap was dry. After complaint  mechanics did come over to fix up, though the job done was not perfect.
The location is very good. 
This hotel has all the services under one roof, which is very important in winter when it is snowing outside.
My Nephew who was also with us on this trip and had stayed in Highland park hotel many times earlier had booked this hotel for a change. His was of the opinion that in Summer, Highland Park would be a better choice, while in winter this Khyber Resort  would be OK.

reviews.author: NEERAJ2791
reviews.title: EXCELLENT LOCATION GOOD HOTEL
reviews.text: Good new property still under construction. Staff was really good and cooperative and presentable. Food quality is really good with cleanliness in the restaurant. Rooms balconies gives a lush green views of deodar trees. Only problem we faced was the smell of new wood work polish in the lobby, our room was changed after request to manager. Really value for money

reviews.author: Loyalka_S

reviews.author: Sandip Kumar
reviews.title: My stay at The Khyber Himalayan Resort was truly exceptional, and I greatly appreciated the property’s serene and peacef
reviews.text:
My stay at The Khyber Himalayan Resort was truly exceptional, and I greatly appreciated the property’s serene and peaceful ambiance. I did, however, observe that the interior landscaping could be further enhanced with an increased number of pine trees to elevate its natural beauty and tranquility.

I would also kindly encourage the hotel management to consider adopting more flexible policies toward guests and to accommodate their requests, as memorable guest experiences go far beyond monetary considerations.

I would like to extend my sincere gratitude to Chef Ankit Rawat and Mr. Gupta for their outstanding culinary service throughout our stay. Chef Ankit’s expertise is a true asset to The Khyber Himalayan Resort and played a significant role in making our experience memorable.

I would also like to acknowledge the exceptional hospitality provided by Mr. A.B. Qadir and Ms. Mubina, who exemplified the true spirit of Kashmiriyat through their warmth and dedication to guest satisfaction.

reviews.author: Madhur C
reviews.title: Khyber
reviews.text: An unforgettable experience...rooms need a little maintenance.  Their manager varun is an excellent singer... special mention to mubina in restaurant

reviews.author: Firdos Mirza Sr. Adv.
reviews.title: Out of The World
reviews.text:
"Out of the world" is the only expression while we stayed at Khyber. In 4 days of stay I could not find a single fault with anything. The staff was proactive. Food was amazing with diverse choices. Live music by Waseem Yousuf was mystifying.
Chef Ankit Rawat, Chef Lokesh and Chef Ramzan prepared out of menu delicacies that we tasted for the first time. Shabir, Mubina, Shafiq, Hilal took all efforts to make us comfortable.

reviews.author: Nikki kapoor
reviews.title: You will definitely revisit

reviews.author: Fearless51868552172

shabir was a warm host in Pan asian

reviews.author: Jey R
reviews.title: Overrated!!
reviews.text: We were originally booked to spend 5 nights. This booking was made months prior. About a month prior to our stay the travel agent called to say the the Khyber had canceled one nights accommodation due to a private function. In hindsight, I am glad that our stay was reduced as the last two nights of our stay was horrendous. Both nights were interrupted by external noise and I finally confronted the GM and sought a refund of a nights accommodation which was granted. I will not recommend this hotel as I think it is overrated.

reviews.author: Passport07119103345
reviews.title: For best experience in Gulmarg there is no place like Khyber, highly recommend it.
reviews.text: We had a great experience at Khyber. Iqbal and muzzamil gave us fantastic, convenient and timely room service. We were extremely pleased by the service. Chef Rajesh Gupta served us delicious food, chats especially gol gape and aloo tikki chat were delectable.

reviews.author: Mobile23872037328
reviews.title: great Experience
reviews.text:
Great experience 
The food , the staff was quite nice

chef Adil was more than generous to help us enhance our overall experience 

Must visit 
We had stone bowl egg rice, it was delicious and must try.

We had it twice during our stay.

Overall great experience and nice ambience

reviews.author: uma m
reviews.title: Khyber  -Yummy food -great Chef!
reviews.text: Great place! We visited pan-Asian restaurant. Chef Aadil was fabulous. He took care of us by suggesting great delicious veg items. He is courteous and  professional.  Yummy food. This restaurant had some great views of forest!  Had a great time. Thank you

reviews.author: Vacation47660182093
reviews.title: Best experience
reviews.text:
We had a great time at Khyber resort. The service in all departments was best. Specially, in the food department Abhishek, Arif Tantary gave us a personal attention and took care of us very well and always with a big smile. Also all the chefs paid special attention with our requests. At the reception Irfan made our stay very comfortable.
The place is very beautiful and location is the best.

reviews.author: ajax
reviews.title: top notch
reviews.text:
Everything is great here, whether it is the food or the hospitality or the rooms and services on the property. 

Highly recommend to visit Kyber. Chef Aadil took good care of us and also the other chefs Rajesh, Muneesh and head chef Ranjan catered to all our needs so thank you and will visit you again.

Do try Pan Asia the food is authentic and the view whilst eating such delicious food is worth the visit.

reviews.author: RAJESH Malhotra
reviews.title: Great escape
reviews.text: We 4 couples, senior citizens stayed in Khuber resort and were greatly impressed by the staff courtesy and hospitality, exvellent location amongst pine trees and mountains, great food and  good rooms. The spa and centrally heated Pool was great experience add on.

reviews.author: Tour02051210293
reviews.title: Kashmiri wazwaan at Khyber Gulmarg
reviews.text: Loved the resort. Enjoyed every moment. Tried Kashmiri wazwaan first time. Thanks to Mr Abhishek giving us brief about the authentic dish. Abhishek was too good in his service. He was friendly with us and our kid too liked him. Will definitely recommend this property to our family and friends and we too will visit again soon

reviews.author: Orchid
reviews.title: **Luxury Stay with Exceptional Hospitality!**
reviews.text:
Our stay at this hotel was nothing short of amazing. The location is absolutely perfect. The hospitality was top-notch, and we were treated to a truly luxurious experience throughout.

The food was excellent, and we had the opportunity to try authentic Kashmiri cuisine thanks to Mr. Junaid, who went above and beyond to ensure we had a memorable experience. He was incredibly courteous and attentive, making our stay even more special.

From the seamless check-in process to the overall comfort of our stay, everything was simply fantastic. We can't recommend this hotel enough for those seeking a blend of luxury, excellent service, and a great location!

reviews.author: Jet34175508901
reviews.title: A trip to the mountains
reviews.text: Great resort and wonderful ambience. On the most picturesque spot, Khyber is worth all the accolades. Spot on service from the staff and prompt on special requests too including recommendations and suggestions! A must resort to have the most wonderful experience. Special mention to Arif and Abhishek for going above and beyond in suggesting food to try and places to visit for the most memorable experience at Gulmarg!

reviews.author: Mahendra G
reviews.title: Most scenic & comfortable resort.
reviews.text:
Excellent service in every department.
Restaurant staff very friendly & obliging particularly Abhisek, Arif & the team.
The chef & the team also went out of their way to look after needs.
We would certainly visit again in the near future if time allows.

reviews.author: Poonam Amol B
reviews.title: Beautiful The Khyber and Thank you Harris
reviews.text:
It was a wonderful experience. 

Staff members were good but Harris was superbly good and taken care of us during our visit to The Khyber @paradise “Kashmir”  
Food was good and view of Himalayan range is breath taking. Swimming pool is one of the attraction too of this place. 

Thank you Harris once again.

reviews.author: Navigator13855961521
reviews.title: It’s heaven on earth to stay here must visit solo
reviews.text: One of the best properties outstanding  food most beautiful ambience ever and over that each and every staff from enterance to guest services to housekeeping to food its untouched.. I would recommend everyone for a must visit best staff ever

reviews.author: Jagdish B
reviews.title: Good but service excellent
reviews.text:
Hotel is very good. What let us down were the poor views from our room and a very average breakfast. 
Service was near perfect and staff extremely caring and courteous.  Special mention of Chef Gupta and Chef. Muneesh.  Also Ishfaq ( In Dining )..can't remember other names but truly awesome service.  Expensive hotel and dinner meals in dining extremely highly priced ( but good quality ).

reviews.author: Raghuv A
reviews.title: Restaurant: Pan Asian
reviews.text:
We had Pan Asian food like Thai Curry, Kung Pao Paneer and various desserts. 

The Food was amazing along with the overall preparations and experience. 

Chef preparaed the food all as per our requests and orders. 
Spl mention: Chef Adil & Mr. Fayaz.

reviews.author: Parikshit P
reviews.title: Great stay and even better service
reviews.text: Our family had a great experience at the Khyber. The stay and service were impeccable considering we had a 1 year old with us. Particularly, Iqbal and Ishfaq were absolutely amazing and made our stay extremely hospitable. Thank you for a great experience

reviews.author: Ami M
reviews.title: Best experience in winter
reviews.text:
This a great hotel with top amenities. The location is very near to the gondola ride. 
The staff and food amazing.
But as the rates are very high, i feel its more value for money during winters when it is mesmerising in gulmarg and u r in a top class facility.

reviews.author: VIDUSHI W
reviews.title: Simply a wow
reviews.text: Excellent place. Chef Niranjan Thakur and his team serves excellent food. Just can improve on room service. Rest ambience and view every thing is perfect. The property I’d well maintained and staff is well behaved.

reviews.author: Sightseer12546368284
reviews.title: Over Hyped Hotel, Terrible experience
reviews.text: This is an over hyped hotel. Over priced. Service is horrible to say the least. Food is terrible. Rude, totally unfriendly staff.  Chef does not know how to make an omelette also. There are many more properties in Gulmarg better than this place. Please avoid.

reviews.author: Ganesh Sunder
reviews.title: WOW & AWESOME
reviews.text: OUTSTANDING property & ambience….Excellent staff service & hospitality, especially from Mr Firdaus, Cloves Coffee Shop & Mr Rayees - Front Office…Thank You to these gentlemen to make our experience “WOW”

reviews.author: Vaishali Dawar
reviews.title: Amazing stay
reviews.text: We had an amazing stay in this stunning property.The beautiful views from the Himalayan view luxury room is food for the soul.The heated pool with views is one of its kinds and the staff is cordial and hospitable. Very impressed with the impeccable service and quality of food. Special mention to Firdaus at the restaurant who made us feel special by taking such great care of us.A true luxurious retreat!

reviews.author: Mehar
reviews.title: Khyber a true kashmiri experience
reviews.text: First time in kashmir was extremely happy and satisfied by this wonderful property! Great accommodation, scrumptious food and great service and hospitality. Special mention to firdaus at the restaurant, he took such great care of me and family by the end of trip he knew our names and likes and dislikes, almost felt like family! Three cheers to the khyber family!

reviews.author: Sightsee61939148421
reviews.title: An extraordinary stay at Paradise on earth
reviews.text: Khyber felt like a palace stay in the midst of valleys and mountains. Staff did an amazing job with pleasing us at every nook and corner. The food, hospitality were phenomenal. Spa service, coffee shops and many others were like icing on top of the cake.

reviews.author: Vineet Gupta
reviews.title: Amazing hospitality
reviews.text: The hospitality and food is amazing! The chef ensures personal attention to every guest and if you have special dietary requirements, that is also taken care of by the team. Firdous provided excellent hospitality and was very helpful throughout our stay. The staff greets you with a smile each time. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Piyush
reviews.title: Hospitality par excellence . Special mention to Aijaz Ahmed@ Sajjad at F& B. They were always ready with a smile .😀😀
reviews.text: Hospitality par excellence. Special mention to Aijaz Ahmed & Sajjad at F&. B . They were always ready for your smallest need with a smiling face and were there for us for all 3days of our stay. Also Abhishek was very helpful and took great care.

reviews.author: riddhi
reviews.title: Very happy with service Specially firdousparray please look for him when in Khyber truly appreciate his efforts 🍃🍃
reviews.text: Had good time with family would have given 5 but not happy with there spa facilities steam sauna not clean rest every thing perfect good quality staff very good happy with firdousparray and entire staff felt so good love there quick response to all

reviews.author: nihit14
reviews.title: Peak luxury
reviews.text:
Great ambience.. great staff..
Everything feels premium.
Rooms were top notch.

Heated pool was the highlight. There should be more attendants by the pool. 
Food was great. Buffet spread was great although should have more local delicacies.
Cold coffee served by the pool was very average however they were kind enough to give a well made cc next day.

Mr Firdous and Mr Aarif at the restaurant were extremely cordial and prompt at their work, made us feel extra special. 

Overall amazing premium experience.
Prices are way too much but I guess this is what it is at luxury resorts.

reviews.author: Farhat
reviews.title: Disgusting Experience
reviews.text: My recent visit to Hotel Khyber with my friends was highly disappointing. The staff's response to our inquiry about the bill charges was utterly unacceptable. Rather than providing a simple explanation, they astonishingly directed us to the high court, implying that the prices were dictated by a legal authority. This was not only frustrating but also bizarre. To make matters worse, the manager's (Shakir) behavior was completely absurd and unprofessional. Additionally, the food quality left much to be desired. The most egregious example was the exorbitant charge of 325 rupees for a single bottle of water that should have was priced at 125 rupees. This pricing discrepancy was unjustified and added to our overall negative experience

reviews.author: shadaab ali
reviews.title: It was a birthday celebration which got more special and beautiful with our guide miss beenish
reviews.text:
It was a beautiful birthday celebration with my  friends and our guide Miss beenish , I really want to thank her for making our day more beautiful and special she is very calm down to earth person and her way of talking to her clients is impressive 
Thank you beenish once again for making our day more special and beautiful

reviews.author: sonimadhu
reviews.title: Amazing stay
reviews.text:
The hotel is located at some height and is an amazing property. The area is well secured . The hotel staff is very friendly and hospitable. 
The best part is the heated swimming pool with spa. 
The breakfast buffet has a large spread. Food is very good. 
The staff is very honest. We shifted our room. And forgot our wallet in the old room by mistake. That was returned immediately by their incharge. We were really impressed by their honesty. 
Our overall experience was excellent.

reviews.author: Abhijeet
reviews.title: It doesn't get better than this.
reviews.text:
Top notch luxury, comfiest stay, fluffiest pillows and the warmest staff- apparently "you CAN always get what you want"  at Khyber Resort. Special shout out to Chef Ranjan Thakur and Mr. Varun (f&b) for making our stay oh so comfortable and memorable and for all the spectacular food we ate in the picturesque ambience.

To pick and choose "best parts" of the resort would be cruel but you just can't miss treating yourself to the heated swimming pool and L'Occitane spa. 

Worth every penny!

Can't wait to be back in winters!

reviews.author: NorthStar56757419011
reviews.title: Poor Experience at Khyber
reviews.text:
Book For 2 nights
Checking in on 03/09/2023
Rooms are not maintained well, our room is #3005 housekeeping service is very poor, hair on bath tub, use water in tea kettle previous guest, tea cups dirty inside we shown housekeeping staff after that he clean, after that going for dinner at "Clove" no taste of foods, we informed your restaurant manager about the same, after having dinner we come back to room then saw in bathroom the face towels is from Radisson hotel really I shoked, what type of service Khyber give to the guest..till now this is my experience

reviews.author: Vipul J
reviews.title: Excellent property with below average service
reviews.text:
Excellent property with below average service
The location and amenities are best in class but maximum staff are untrained local guys having lack of motivation and training as per the 5 star standards. They should have more of IHM trained staff to make it a wonderful  service experience also. Better if they give this gem  to Oberoi’s or Taj.

reviews.author: Dixit
reviews.title: Had a great spa session at Khyber
reviews.text: The therapist was very professional and had a healing touch , a must try for anyone who is visiting Khyber. Dr. Gaurai was very knowledgeable and able to understand the needs and was able to guide what kind of therapy session to be taken.

reviews.author: Urvashi
reviews.title: Very stellar Property
reviews.text: The place is absolutely beautiful, the rooms and service is amazing and the staff is extremely accommodating, courteous and helpful. I had gone with a group of around 20 people and got support in managing everything from the team. I closely interacted with Firdous and Rouf from the reservation team who made the reservation process very smooth, Manzoor from front desk helped throughout with everything, Mubashir from reception showed us around the property, recommended places to visit and made us experience the best hospitality i have seen, Randhir from events helped me plan the best plans at the hotel for the group and was super accommodating of all my requests. All the staff were very kind and helpful. We had a great stay!

reviews.author: Mohammed Y
reviews.title: Foot relief at Khyber
reviews.text: Spa manager Dr. Gaurai suggested a foot relief my therapist Ms. Chewang was a great experience her techinque of massaging was so relaxing and not to forget the herbal tea in the last overall was a wonderful experience at Khyber

reviews.author: Ludhiana
reviews.title: Heavenly experience! Just what I needed!
reviews.text: Excellent spa service. Met Dr. Gaurai spa manager whose experience & guidance helped me to get a perfect spa experience. The therapist was very experienced, gentle & polite. She understood my needs & I felt really rejuvenated!

reviews.author: Coastal504309
reviews.title: 90 minutes spa at Khyber
reviews.text: Had one of the best spa experiences suggested by Dr. Gaurai and the healer was Deepeshver whose technique and massage routine was very professional and relaxing. Property is very pristine and beautiful and recommend this to anybody looking for a Himalayan vacation.

reviews.author: SKSCal
reviews.title: Exceptional property
reviews.text: Stayed here in the month of September 2022. The property itself is outstanding with a variety of things to do. We had a family vacation and occupied room #s 2001, 2003 and 2005. Our housekeeping person was Mr Gulzar, and a special mention and thanks to him for the special and wonderful service. The daily housekeeping and turn down services were top notch, all our requests were met and very promptly. All in all, a very pleasant stay and thanks to the whole team

reviews.author: Kajal
reviews.title: Spa with Loccitane
reviews.text: Met Dr. Gaurai and advised for a nice relaxing spa and it’s worth to do it. And did the same with Ms. Niyaso and she is very gentle and I can say she is jus perfect for the massage. Keep it up….. thank you

reviews.author: Ludhiana
reviews.title: Evening spa at khyber
reviews.text:
Good relaxing therapy suggested by Dr gaurai good property.  Burger was good. Rooms are good. 

Visited khyber 1st time.

I will surely suggest my and friends and family . Beautiful place .

I visited with my family and would like to come.

reviews.author: AV
reviews.title: Hotel and spa
reviews.text:
Outstanding spa and ambience of the hotel.. 
the view is to die for and the trees surrounding are amazing… spending some time here is a must and going to the nearby Gondola is also a must sight seeing experience

reviews.author: Hyderabad
reviews.title: Mrs Shruthi
reviews.text:
Had a great time!!
Must visit with family/friends.
At Loccitane spa we had a 30min eye treatment.
Its was relaxing n must try.
Recommended by Dr Gaurai.
Healers were professional and felt very relaxed after we are done with the treatmet.

reviews.author: Anjana
reviews.title: Experience
reviews.text:
My family,friends and I had a great time...We loved the kindness and the hospitality ... We had lot of fun and did a lot of things...we will never forget our experience 😁
Thank to the front desk person Shahnaaz for our wonderful experience.. she was very caring..😊

reviews.author: Andleeb Wanee
reviews.title: Most Memorable trip
reviews.text:
we had gone for our friends 50Th Bday celebrations. the place, the hotel, the service, the food and more importantly the people at Khyber were exceptional and professional. we had an amazing time, our stay was v comfortable and memorable.
special mention to Shahid, Naseer, Rayees ahmed ,Manzoor and Abhishek from house keeping were outstanding, their service and dedication was unmatched to any other place we have been to.
the entire staff of F&B and front office team. special thanks to Manzoor front office was super helpful.

reviews.author: S K Z
reviews.title: Highly recommended
reviews.text: Visited in September 2022 and highly recommend this place. The spa by L’Occitane is a very different experience here. Special mention to the manager Dr Gaurai and the therapist, Imitiaz. They are experts in their respective fields and the service was outstanding

reviews.author: DrAKS1
reviews.title: Excellent Food
reviews.text: Excellent service and food. Special Thanks to F & B Manager Mr. Randhir for taking care of our Vegan needs. The staff was very polite and helpful. Rooms were clean and spacious. Overall a splendid hotel worth visiting. The heated pool needs special mention as an added attraction.

reviews.author: Jitin
reviews.title: Wonderful Stay
reviews.text:
Very highly recommended this property, in Lap of Himalayas,

We traveled entire world but Khyber is awesome, Rooms are very nice cleaned, the location is mind blowing, Food is also delicious In Cloves 

Staff is very friendly, Professional especially shoot out Mr Irfan Hussain at the reception, he is very curtsy and helpful, He was always intouch with us weather it Indoor help or out door, he provides us great service  in every angle, also his Accommodation Manager Mr Akhtar with Smiley face. 

Thanks team Khyber we love you❤️ And will come back soon 

Regards,

Jitin Agarwal

reviews.author: Sanchita Vijay
reviews.title: Beautiful, picturesque property with friendly staff
reviews.text: We stayed at Khyber, gulmarg from 18-20th sep, 22 & must say it was a truly beautiful & super comfortable stay with great amenities & good staff. The property is truly luxurious & each corner of the property is worth a picture. The staff there is truly courteous with special mention to Mr Abhishek, who was really kind enough to go out of his way to help when required. He had been super helpful & truly courteous at all times. Mr Rahul at the pool side is another great one who was more than helpful at all times also considering that we were traveling with a 1 year baby & he was always available to help. The property is one of its kind & it was a delight to have visited the same.

reviews.author: Kriti Jain
reviews.title: Amazing Property...Great Hospitality
reviews.text:
Absolutely enjoyed our stay at The Khyber Gulmarg.

The Khyber is an amazing property with the most breathtaking views ever. The Khyber has a fascinating views of  the  mountains,forest and the meadows. We are fortunate to witness a good rainfall fall during our stay.

All the staff (Reception, Restaurant ,Housekeeping & Spa) is always warm and cordial. The Hospitality at The Khyber is the best you will ever experience.

Special Mention to Mr.Muzamil from Room Dining who was exceptional in his work and fulfilling all our wishes. He was very Polite, Prompt and, always helpful in customizing our food,they way we want. He gave special attention to our requirements for our baby.

Overall worth a visit.
Thanks The Khyber for making our stay so wonderful..

reviews.author: Aarya Ganeshkumar
reviews.title: Good visit
reviews.text: I liked the service here very much… I was accompanied by many kind staff like hamida and Rahul who served splendid drinks and awesome service … I recommend visiting the place surely.. it is located in Gulmarg Kashmir

reviews.author: Bhawna
reviews.title: Bhawna dange
reviews.text: Really good and relaxing..must have spa at Khyber spa loccitant..it was recommended by Dr.gaurai and she gave the good deal too😊 even the property is really awesom…food ambiance n everything was good.

reviews.author: Kalpana bansal
reviews.title: Amazing hospitality and best resort in j&k
reviews.text:
Our stay at Khyber is very very comfortable especially the staff in housekeeping is extremely cordial and were available at one call  .
Bilkees,Gulzar, sarvida and their manager Abhishek were extremely helpful  at every step if we need anything they were available with wide smile . 
We will remember our stay at khyber life long .

reviews.author: Garish
reviews.title: Spa services
reviews.text:
It is nice and full professional service provided with satisfaction.Keep it up Khyber.Dr.Gaurai manager is fully aware to provide service as per required.
It was nice staying here as nature is vary close to this.

reviews.author: Shivangi Agrawal
reviews.title: Massage
reviews.text:
It was excellent service and the professionals/ therapist were really great at their work.

Healers: debeshwar, bishal, niyaso provided excellent service. 

Dr. Gaurai was great at coordinating and managing everything efficiently.

reviews.author: J L
reviews.title: Simply Excellent
reviews.text:
This property ticks at all the right places. 
Booking √
Check in √
Room Decor √
Amenities √
Housekeeping √
Food √
Dining service √
Location √
Views from the room and the hotel √
The room and hotel decor is so tastefully done, it beats all the 5 star chain properties hands down.
We stayed in 2 rooms with family 5012 and 5014 on 19th Sept.
Special mention for good service by Ferdous at the restaurant and Riyaz at front desk.
I came down with altitude sickness, their house Dr. was prompt to attend.
When at Gulmarg, stay only at The Khyber.
Simply outstanding.

reviews.author: CHAITANYA P
reviews.title: Best place to visit.
reviews.text: Very beautiful place to enjoy and relax . Property itself doesn't allow u to move outside as it is so peaceful and beautiful. Food spread in buffet is very good. Entire team from senior s to down the line is very well behaved. It is a real value for money property.

reviews.author: Sumedha Tiwari
reviews.title: The Best Spa Ever at The Khyber, Gulmarg
reviews.text: We had a 60-minute Swedish massage. Our therapists Chewang and Shivam were wonderful. The couple massage room is very well done. Our therapy was done under the supervision of Dr. Gaurai who knows just the right things that you need! Easily the best massage experience! Highly recommend the L’Occitane Spa at Khyber if you’re staying here.

reviews.author: Manoj Vora
reviews.title: A perfect break from the city life
reviews.text: Stayed in the premium room with balcony which presents the gorgeous views of the Himalayas. Mr. Irfan insured that the checkin was smooth and was very helpful throughout. Would also recommend the name of Ms Bilkis from housekeeping. The staff in the dining room was very polite and helpful. The restaurant served great Jain Food. The hotel is situated very close to the Gondola station but, the only drawback is the steep slope one has to climb to reach the hotel.

reviews.author: Vacation Vibes
reviews.title: Most Memorable
reviews.text:
Sorry for writing wee late, but here i go. Hotel is best in whole of kashmir, In Gulmarg best property to stay if budget is not the constraint. I strongly recommend to stay here to enjoy the hospitality of khyber. Right from check in till check out everything went smoot. We met lovely girl Zahida at the front office who was very kind to show around the property, very warm welcome from her made this trip totally worth it. Even the base category room are big so family of 3 or 4 can easily comfortably stay here. Property is really well maintained. Heated pool is the lit.

the housekeeping team (tabassum) is something i will never forget, very very well behaved, soft spoken, twice a day coming to clean the room is commendable

food was by far we had best in the entire 8 days trip of kashmir. Restaurant team literally makes u eat double than your capacity. they are so so nice and helpful want you to try different things. Breakfast was a huge huge spread and dinner they served on ala carte. My special thanks to Bilal, i am sorry i forgot lot of names. but thanks to Firdoz from f&b team who took really good care of us.

I will never every forget such lovely team. What makes khyber khyber is the THE TEAM, you guys are just amazing. Kudos.

reviews.author: ashish a
reviews.title: Evening spa at khyber
reviews.text: Spa is very good my spa instructor is imtiaz is very good and... my consultant dr gaurai is very cooperative hotel khyber is very good nice view excellent staff and view is also amazing .. so pls visit ur family

reviews.author: mohit bhargava
reviews.title: Holidays
reviews.text:
Really had gr8 time in khber gulmarg.
Fantastic hospitality by mr Firdous parrey at restaurant.
Mr Zakir was good at swimming pool.
Also thanks to Mr. Rahul & zahida
Fooding ,location, hospitality at its best.

reviews.author: Passportofawanderwoman
reviews.title: Absolutely relaxing couples massage
reviews.text:
I was visiting Khyber and I had the pleasure of getting a massage session with Chewang and my husband has his message with Shivam. They were absolutely professional and had a great session. I had really tight IT band and she did such a great job of releasing them. 
I'm gonna definitely go back to them for another session while I'm still massaging. 
Also, Gaurai did a great job of recommending the appropriate massage for both me and my husband. 
Loved every bit of our hour masaage.

reviews.author: Kanchana S
reviews.title: An overall amazing experience so far
reviews.text:
I checked in today and had the most amazing experience right from check in till now.
The highlight of the day has been the spa experience. I was sceptical at first but Dr. Gaurai made me feel comfortable and my therapist Anita was amazing. I had the most relaxing experience.
Please definitely try this if you visit this amazing property.

reviews.author: Siriisha M
reviews.title: The best in gulmarg
reviews.text:
One of the best experience I had today . Iam so thankful for this suggestion from dr.Gaurai to experience the most beautiful massage today at khyber ♥️ do not miss this when you are here 👍🏻 
Thank you for the best service niyaso..along with scenic views at this beautiful property enjoy food and services 👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻

reviews.author: Kirti J
reviews.title: Spa at khyber
reviews.text: Marylina was good and tried to give her best. Dr. Gaurai guided me really well. Khyber is beautiful. One of my best experience. People are very hospitable and hospitality is good. Rooms really nice and kids friendly.

reviews.author: Dr.Shaunakk Patel
reviews.title: Very good and friendly experience with Ms.Uznain
reviews.text: Me, my mother and father visited this lovely hotel and right from meet and greet to answering our every little request Ms Uznain made sure it was promptly met with a smile. She also clearly explained things and also gave suggestions which we like. Because of this amazing experience we will certainly like to visit here again. Two thumbs up.

reviews.author: Akhila
reviews.title: Honeymoon Bliss
reviews.text: It was a great experience with Khyber Hotel, we were here for one night. We tried the Couples spa and the Spa Manager Dr Gaurai was really helpful in selecting the right treatment for our special spa day. Our healers, Niyaso and Imtiaz did an amazing job.

reviews.author: Ahmed Seth
reviews.title: Best Resort in Kashmir
reviews.text: Enjoyed a lot. Ambience is awesome. Staff is courteous and very polite, extremely helpful. perfect hospitality. Highly recommended those who visit Gulmarg. Special Thanks to Wasim Sultan Bhai. Awesome.

reviews.author: Vishakha
reviews.title: Mesmerizing
reviews.text: Best location and people out here(Mr Wasim , Mr Irfan ). I am in love with this place ! Gulmarg beauty has the best hotel out and they provide the best service. Best place to chill and enjoy the land of paradise

reviews.author: Vids
reviews.title: Surreal Experience at Meadows of flowers - The Khyber Gulmarg
reviews.text:
After much contemplations we decided to go to Kashmir for our short week long trip. 

We decided on two places to visit in Kashmir.. One was Gulmarg and another Srinagar as we were travelling with our 7 yr old daughter and a 1 yr old toddler... 

When it is Gulmarg then it's Khyber.. No second thoughts.. Though resort is the most expensive one with 40k per nights (off season) peak seasons are mostly sold out... But the experience is worth spending each penny..

The resort has two views - Gulmarg and Himalayan..

The Himalayan view is the highest category rooms when you can even see Gondola phase 1 and phase 2 cable car track. The rooms are equipped with all modern amenities, a big bath tub overlooking the Himalayas (Apar Parvat), the property, lush garden with beautiful flowers and roses, it had heater in the room, separate shower area, toilet area, separate closet with cupboards, a king size bed, sofa, balcony with big sitting area. We were allocated Room no. 2019 which is on the second floor and closer to Gym, swimming pool and spa area. 

There is one restaurant near the reception which is 'Cloves'. The staff is really pleasing and way too friendly and helpful.. In - room dining services is very quick and prompt.. We never faced any issue with our baby food we ordered in room or in the restaurant.. Special thanks to Mr Ashish, Chef Shahabaz and the serving staff Raees (always smiling and helpful).

Few other staff which made our stay more comfortable are Hamida (swimming pool), Omar (guard), Apsara (Spa).

However, I would like to express few low lights of our stay..  

At the time of check in we were informed that The sauna, jacuzzi, steam were out of order. For which Mr Mhd Rafi at the front desk had been very arrogant and his tone of response was completely unapologetic. They claim that they had informed their travel partner 15 days back of our stay ie 28th Aug (though we didn't received such notification) and if even they did it wouldn't have helped us as their non refundable policy gets over before 1.5 month of your stay dates. To which the response was "as if you are going to use this facilities for a whole day' it's just question of 1 hr. Which you would spend using these facilities so what's the big fuss.. You can any which ways use other facilities like swimming pool." Imagine the arrogance, one books such an expensive property  keeping in mind the facilities and amenities offered to the guest.. 

The swimming pool area was dirty and under maintenance with workers working to and fro carrying sacks of cement while you are swimming in the pool... We highlighted this to their management.. We were staying there for 4 days n 3 nights to enjoy the property and hospitality.. Would not have expected such an attitude from a premium property like this. 

After bringing it up time and again their GM Mr. Vinit Chabbra offered body massage at their spa.. That's what they could do to compensate for the inconvenience caused..which again was a reactive response.. However, we do appreciate this gesture from Mr. Chabbra but Mr. MHD Rafi  remained unapologetic. 

To the contrast we had wonderful experience with their restaurant staff at 'Cloves' .Special mention of Raees, Mr Ashish, Chef Shahabaz. 

The breakfast  spread@Cloves was elaborate. With dosas, omlettes, juices, kahwa, deserts /breads, other breakfast items like poha, upma, idli, wada, khakra, fafda (seems like they expect lot of Gujarati tourist). My favourite being cold coffee and Kaali (masala fresh lime soda). They didn't serve lunch and dinner buffet due to low occupancy.. However on our request they did serve dinner buffet on the last day of our stay which was not elaborate however worth trying. 

Overall the stay was very comfortable with great housekeeping and restaurant staff. Amazing surreal views, spacious rooms.. Worth spending time and money at The Khyber.

The Khyber is a must stay for anyone visiting Gulmarg!

reviews.title: Good Ambiance. Nice Upkeep. Not so great food. The only place to stay if in Gulmarg!
reviews.text:
With amazing rooms and views, khyber has you relaxed from the get go. My check in process was a little haphazard. The food at Khyber was below average. But, Mr Firdous at the restaurant made sure that we got the exact kind of tea we wanted for breakfast every day. He also made sure to provide us with great service day and night. 
I had to get a mattress changed at a very odd hour of the night. Mr Arif Hussain at the reception, made sure that, that happened and we got what we wanted as quickly as possible. 
We had a lot of trouble with the operator, they couldn’t pass on the message properly even once. I wanted some bandages for my hand, and I just didn’t get them, forget about getting them late or something, I just didn’t get them. 
If the problems I faced at Khyber are improved upon, there wouldn’t be any doubt in selecting Khyber if you are in Gulmarg!

Ps: the climb to Khyber from the soots downhill is very steep. It’s not an easy climb if you don’t have a vehicle coming back up.

reviews.text: Staying in Khyber was dream coming true to me & my friends. Kashmir truly is paradise on earth. The views were wow. The food was absolutely fantastic The property’s I stayed in Kashmir 1 Khyber 2 grand lalit 3 Gurkha houseboats.4 pine&peak..

reviews.author: Ariba Qureshi
reviews.title: Best stay ever

Especially Muzammil, Aijaz,Waseem,Rayeez and Junaid! They treated us so well that we didn’t miss home at all! The trust and comfort they develop in their guests is inexplicable.  It’s my second time at Khyber and I’m already tempted to visit again ! Highly recommend the hotel! One of the best properties in India! Khyber is an experience in itself!

reviews.author: Sara Q
reviews.title: An impeccable experience

A very very special mention to the kindest and the most helpful people that assisted us in Khyber. reviews.author: Mehran Qureshi

reviews.author: MuktiAgarwal
reviews.title: Awesome stay at The Khyber Gulmarg . If money is not an issue , then The Khyber  is THE PLACE to be but plan way ahead 😊

reviews.author: shoiabrafi
reviews.title: Paradise in Paradise
reviews.text:
Its high up in the mountains with breathtaking view of the entire landscape.
One of the best properties i have visited .Service is top notch and food is not bad.
Must visit if you are in Gulmarg.

reviews.author: Sangeeta H
reviews.title: Best Property in the Himalayas
reviews.text: I loved my stay here! Its high up in the beautiful sacred mountains of Himalayas with such breathtaking views, pristine air, stress free energy, and healing vibration. The GM is outstanding, hospitable, generous, with a quiet reserved countenance. Very befitting of such a serene place! I have always observed the GM sets the tone and atmosphere of the hotel.  And people make the hotel, not the edifice. The entire staff is warm, caring, courteous and pretty creative too - ask them for anything and they will create it for you. The hotel is so Kashmiri authentic. All wood and stone, perfect feel for the mountains...definitely the best 5 star hotel in the Himalayas! Breakfast is fabulous. Food is good. Their Chinese too is exemplary, considering its a Kashmiri hotel. I would love to return...and return. Thank you Vinit Kumar for making my stay so Divine...and possible! I thank the entire staff for their heartfelt hospitality. God Bless you all!

reviews.author: aditi b
reviews.title: Excellent stay
reviews.text:
This was my first visit to Kashmir. 
One of the most beautiful properties I have visited. I got a complimentary upgrade on request. The room and bathroom is fantastic. We had a lovely view from our room. The staff is very impressive!

reviews.author: sidra k
reviews.title: Best experience
reviews.text: It was my honeymoon trip to Kashmir and we had heard about this beautiful & luxurious hotel. We booked it and when we reached there, the property was huge and no words could compare the beauty surrounded it, the lady at the reception (Khalida), on hearing that my husband & I were on our honeymoon, gladly made arrangements and shifted us to the Himalayan view luxury room. The service was quick and food was very tasty. We spent some time in there heated pool, enjoying the view of himayas and beautiful huge Pine trees. In all our stay at Khyber was memorable and we still remember it beauty & serenity.

reviews.author: Nisarg Vyas
reviews.title: Excellent property in Gulmarg
reviews.text: Best property in entire Kashmir.  I stayed with my family here for two nights. The hotel is amazing with such a beautiful location. Staff is extremely hospitable, service excellent. Food is good too. They have a heated swimming pool and their spa service is awesome. It’s a 5 star property so the rates will be high but definitely worth it. If you want to stay in Gulmarg stay in Khyber.

reviews.author: Shabar M
reviews.title: Quality of food not good.
reviews.text: I visited there along with my family. Although the Ambience is good but the quality of food and drinks is not good. The bakery in the coffee shop is stale and from the taste it is clear the is no fresh. By the name and desfription of the drinks on the menu it seems that it is something exclusive but the drinks are pretty ordinary and nothing more than just a fruit mixed with milk. Certainly it a waste of money for the amount they charge. I would think thrice before visiting them.

reviews.author: daud r
reviews.title: Visit to coffee shop with friends
reviews.text: I visited Khyber resort Gulmarg to day for the first time along with my family. I had heard a lot about the place but was really upset after visiting. We order nutrition smoothie which the suggested is quite good, but after having it was as if having medicine such as cough syrup. Ordered cold coffee with ice cream that also was average and not as good as one would expect at such a luxurious place. Ordered pastry which was not fresh at all. We get fresh and much bigger pastry at any bakery in Srinagar which is 10 times cheaper. Also as we were sitting on the open balcony of the coffee shop while waiting for our order we started taking photos on the staircase leading to the garden, but to our surprise the staff told us we are not allowed to take photos as we are non resident guests. Really a bad experience from such a costly hotel. No value for money and don't recommend the place. You have much better and cheaper places available at Gulmarg instead.

reviews.author: Dawood H
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: The deck at The Khyber Himalayan Resort nd Spa has views from every direction and is a lovely spot for guests to converge and relax over casual dining. In the evenings, the fragrance of pine from the forest mingles with aromas of freshly grilled meats, cooked just the way you like on traditional coal-fired barbecues.

reviews.author: pankaj p
reviews.title: Ultimate stay and awesome staff
reviews.text: We stayed here in September 2017. The hotel is awesome and the staff is very cooperative. I really appreciate Mr. Manzoor Front office Manager and Mr. Basit (Front Office). Very well done up interiors and great service.

reviews.author: NehaLikes
reviews.title: Luxury in the lap of nature
reviews.text:
5 star property, serene views, surrounded by huge mountains, impeccable service despite being not a tourist season. 
Their Kahwa was the yummiest that we had in our entire visit to Kashmir. 
Though we think that the beauty of this place will be a highlight in winters but even in this season we got to witness abundance of fresh air and greenery. Interiors are both traditional and modern- to keep the Kashmiri feel alive and also mantaining the comfort. Amazing walnut wooden carvings and baitakh.
We stayed there for one night and 2 days. Their spa services are also amazing, it is managed by L'occitane and the daily offers are something to grab for a complete relaxation!
All in all - a complete package of luxury, service and nature.

reviews.author: Junaid M
reviews.title: Amazing moments
reviews.text: From start to finish the service at this hotel was impeccable! Nothing was ever too much for the staff. Room and grounds were immaculate and the food was amazing even for fussy eaters. Mountains with white crown on them are breathtaking and talking about the spa was amazing. I wont even look at any other hotel when we visit again!

reviews.author: Isha_Anandpura
reviews.title: Into the Himalayas – The Khyber
reviews.text:
Surrounded with snow covered mountains and conifers, Gulmarg, situated in the western Himalayas, is described as the centre of winter sports in India. Due to its breath-taking panoramic beauty this place has been the shooting spot for many Hindi movies. Must mention the ‘Bobby Hut’ here, a scene from the famous Bollywood movie ‘Bobby’ was shot in a hut at this place which is now called as the ‘Bobby Hut’. Normally, people visit this beautiful place for enjoying the winter activities like Skiing, Tobogganing, Biking (Snow Scooters), etc.

Interesting Fact: Gulmarg Gondola is claimed to be the world’s second highest cable car service.

Gulmerg has got many hotels and family resorts. Our stay at The Khyber Himalayan Resort and Spa proved to be one of the best of its kind. Firstly they greet you introduce you to the Khawa, a regional tea. A cup of Khawa is enough to keep you warm throughout the day. They have maintained an impressive garden which is a nice place to sit and witness the charming atmosphere in night. Staff is quiet friendly and helpful, guides you to your reserved rooms and helps you transfer your luggage.

Eat & Drink

Eating at Cloves, multi cuisine resto at Khyber is an amazing experience. The arrangement and the lighting add up to the pleasing ambience of the hotel. The food offered according to one person is amazing and enough to fill your stomach.
Chaikash offers soothing and refreshing beverages while the Terrace Lounge is a nicely done al fresco dining with elegant views of surrounding area.
Their Sheesha lounge ‘Calabash’ having big glass windows out looking the landscaped hills and forests, and Nauf filled with sweet fragrance of pines, are a good place to sit and enjoy the visit with traditional delicious barbeque dishes.

Stay

The Luxury Balcony room was nicely done with all modern amenities. High Speed Wireless Internet is easily accessible and does not have any connectivity issues. A big LED was placed right in front of the King size bed. A tea/coffee maker, some Cold Drinks and high quality nuts and chocolates and some fresh fruits were also available in the room for free of cost.

The Bathroom had a sunken tub which was quite big, shower area and dressing room. It is equipped with high quality toiletries.
The best part was the beautiful view of the snow caped mountains that came from the balcony and the bathroom as well. At night the atmosphere got even more magical. Beautiful Lamps light up and the moonlight falling on the snow made it look even more scenic.

Play

Besides a pool they have a fairly updated gymnasium and a separate section IGLOO for children (which feature many indoor games to play and enjoy).
For Adults they had activities like skiing, trekking, RIDES.
You can spend time at the world’s highest golf court. They also had a snooker room.
Also for movie lovers they had THE DEN having the latest Bollywood and Hollywood releases.
In summers they host activities like ATV Rides, gondola rides, mountain biking, rock climbing, Pony- Horse riding and jeep safaris.

More Information

Hotel: The Khyber Himalayan Resort & Spa
Location: The Khyber Himalayan Resort & Spa, Gulmarg 193403, Kashmir (J&K), India
Phone: +91 1954254666
Accommodation: 5 Star

reviews.author: Arif M
reviews.title: Wonderful experience
reviews.text: Spend some of the best moments of my life here...It was an enthralling experience for me and my family.The Khyber Himalayan resort and spa is not any other 5 star hotel, there is Kashmir in its every nook and corner,be it interior or exterior view. The staff makes you feel,you are at home. Thanks for making my stay wonderful...hoping to be there again esp in winters.!!

reviews.author: Roohi
reviews.title: Amazing experience
reviews.text:
I have no regrets to come and stay in such a beautiful resort in Gulmarg., despite all the negative news coming every day or two. It's safe to travel Gulmarg and enjoy the vacations.. I have never expected such a luxurious hospitality in the valley of Himalayas. Especially the view from spa and balcony rooms, good food. It's a superb location to enjoy both romantic and adventurous stay, heart welcoming staff, fantablous views, and great hospitality.
It made my holidays so memorable.., definitely recommend this resort for great vacation.

reviews.author: JUNAID M
reviews.title: Breathtaking Views with Excellent Hospitality!
reviews.text:
I stayed with the hotel in July, 2017. Resort is located at the prime location near Gondola. The best thing about the hotel is its views and the staff. I would like to thank Mr. Manzoor, he is manager of the hotel and he made sure that our stay was amazing and he has an attention to the detail and makes sure that your stay is comfortable.

Food is heavenly, must try Khyber Wazwaan Thali and also Kehwa which is served complimentary one you arrive at the hotel.

Regarding the views then the rooms with Himalayan Views area absolutely magnificent and it makes you trans to other world once you have a view of the majestic Himalayas

Must visit for everyone and make sure you dip in their pool and also if you are into fitness resort has a good gym with latest equipment's to work out.

reviews.author: PreetKS
reviews.title: Awesome resort, Hospitality is great
reviews.text: We dined in Khyber Resort. The food was very good. It's located very close to Gondola ride. We met with Manzoor who is Asst. FOM in Khyber, he is a great manager. Explained a lots of things about Kashmir and nice places to visit. Highly recommended to all. Visit once

reviews.author: SinghRakesh
reviews.title: Breathtaking scenery, friendly staff, amazing attention to detail
reviews.text:
From the minute we entered and were greeted by a very helpful Khalida for the checkin and orientation, the service at this resort continued to be top notch. 

Visited with family and parents and stayed in room with mountain facing balcony. 

Rooms, views, details, spa, warmth... at the top level in India and on par with the best internationally. The only comparable experience in India has been the Vivanta in Coorg. 

There are limitations like non provision of alcohol, but those are clearly communicated in advance.

reviews.author: amitk189
reviews.title: "Khyber" Best Hospitality in The Himalayas
reviews.text:
I am an Airline Pilot and travel all around and I will say my Favorite place to stay is Khyber in Gulmarg because of the warm hospitality, friendly and loving team which is carefully selected by a experienced management who working together as a team makes Khyber the best hotel I will say.

I have visited and stayed in Khyber for over 60 days while I enjoy Gulmarg in its full beauty during Jan, Feb and march with snow all around. 
2015,2016 & 2017 stay has been outstanding and memorable.

It's a "SNOW PARADISE" with over 20 feet of snow recorded every winter and the quality of snow and ski terrain is simply magical.
I have skied in New Zealand , Europe and Australia and so far I must say Gulmarg is the best.

Stay at Khyber is extremely comfortable with centrally heated airCon and a heated pool with Amazing Breathtaking Views, it's a Superior Luxury resort with the highest ratings and facilities.

Khyber has one of the best views of The ski Terrain which is over 4000m and the beautiful Peaks all around.It is conveniently located near Gondola.

The warmth can be felt upon arrival in Srinagar until flying back making it one of the most memorable trips of your life just because of the excellent hospitable staff and the beautiful property nestled in the mountains. I feel blessed to to say that we have such a luxury ski resort making Gulmarg a world class destination.

In fact I have seen hotel guests booking for the next year while checking out, it's simply an amazing and an unforgettable experience. 
Words are not enough to describe the beautiful memories I have and one can experience staying in Gulmarg at Khyber.
I always think very highly of the staff and management which does it job so diligently making it the best hotel by a good margin.

Can't wait to be back in Khyber.

reviews.author: singharj
reviews.title: A Jewel in the Himalayas
reviews.text: Despite the negative publicity about Kashmir we decided to go. No regrets and Khyber is the best game in town. Staff is well trained, facilities are superb. They take care of all your needs. We celebrated our anniversary at the hotel and they made a delicious cake for us. We enjoyed a nice party with the staff and management team. Thank you Khyber for making this an enjoyable stay and being a great ambassador for Kashmir.

reviews.author: Anupriya V
reviews.title: The best romantic get away
reviews.text: We have stayed at many luxury properties but this one clearly stands out. The warm and welcoming staff, exquisite food, beautiful pool in the perfect location,the spa well maintained property, nice view from the room - You get it all. I would strongly urge all to visit Kashmir and this property and don't be sacred with the unrest. People and place - both are beautiful and we must support them :)

reviews.author: Kabir H
reviews.title: Falak-ol-Aflak; “the heaven of heavens
reviews.text:
Khyber is a wonderful top-notch hotel, luxurious and enchanting in every manner. Located high up in the lapse of Pir Panjal range in breathtaking Gulmarg. This is one of the finest hotels to relax and rejuvenate in Kashmir. 

We landed in Srinagar and were picked up by the hotel car. The journey from the Airport to Gulmarg was smooth, safe and comfortable. At the Hotel we were greeted by the very warm and hospitable staff. The welcome drink of traditional Kahva was simply irresistible. The Himalayan view room was extremely comfortable. Another highlight of the hotel is the temperature controlled pool and the l'occitane spa.
The hotel is child friendly and the khyber team goes all out to make you comfortable.Special thanks to Khalida for having taken special care especially our baby!

I would whole heartedly recommend Khyber Himalayan Resort & Spa and I don't see any reason why would you hold yourself back from visiting heavenly Khyber and  a paradise called Gulmarg!

reviews.author: Akhil G
reviews.title: Khyber amazing hotel
reviews.text:
This resorts is nested near gondula ........ the resort have of Gulmarg view and Himalyan view .... each and every room so
