reviews.author: Pinaki D
reviews.title: Experience Heaven on Earth
reviews.text: An excellent place to stay with great modern amenities, great ambiance , lovely staff, overall luxury  redefine..  was celebrating my wifes birthday was a great occasion to be in that premises was handed over a lovely birthday cake as a complimentary by a courteous staff ( Aswak ) have you for making a event a memorable one..

reviews.author: tarushy
reviews.title: A jewel in the valley
reviews.text: Khyber was a perfect mix of luxury and fun. It is very close to the spot where one alights the Gandolas in Gulmarg. I went without any expectations and was surprised to see world class luxury in small town like Gulmarg. The view frm our room was uninterrupted by any man made structure...only the beautiful valleys of kashmir to cherish fr life. The service was fantastic and they had a lovely breakfast spread too. We were a large group so they gave us some special discounts for food. Overall the best place to stay in gulmarg but it is a bit expensive. However the experience was worth it!

reviews.author: Kimi R
reviews.title: Kashmir is heaven
reviews.text: I visited this hotel on my birthday in August . The rooms were beautiful, the bathroom was very beautiful too . The place is very quiet, the hotel staff is amazing . The only problem I faced was a poor wi fi in rooms , which worked great in lobby area , the served amazing kahwah. It was a great stay

reviews.author: Deepen D
reviews.title: Best Hotel in Kashmir
reviews.text:
The perfect place to enjoy Kashmir hospitality and weather. We were lucky to experience snowfall from the time we arrived to till we left the place. It was the last snowfall of the season. Perfect to cover the ski slopes. 
Elegant Kashmiri interiors. The rooms sizes are huge. The best place in the room is the bathtub next to the window and to see snow falling outside. 
The food is excellent. We tried the traditional Kashmiri spread for one meal. We were stuffed and highly satisfied. 
The swimming pool and fitness area is fantastic. Heated pool in a glass enclosure and snow outside make the perfect setting.

reviews.author: Kumareshr
reviews.title: BEWARE OF GIVING CREDIT CARD DETAILS
reviews.text: When you book for this hotel through online or phone if you give your credit card number and expiry date that is enough for them to debit your card for the entire amount of your stay without you swiping the card or any other second line authentication the bank can't do anthying because they use a foreign website to debit your card bypassing RBI REGULATIONS REGARDING SECOND LINE VERIFICATION. imagine the kind of security risk when they are able to debit our card just by credit card number and expiry date the main aim of the hotel is to debit your card before your arrival even though you pay an obscene amount with no value for money for this property if you not negotiated small things like wifi also they will deny you uncourtesly this is over hyped property by various sites you will end paying exorbitant food price for dinner if you have not negotiated for dinner plan other than it is close to gonadala there is nothing extra ordinary about this property for the price you pay presently as of today Iam staying in this property and this is my live expericience BEWARE BEWARE ABOUT GIVING CREDIT CARD DETAILS UNLESS YOU ARE READY TO BE DEBITED BEFORE YOUR ARRIVAL AND READY TO EXPOSE YOUR CARD WITH FURTHER DEBIT BECAUSE IT IS POSSIBLE ONCE THE RBI PROTOCOL BYPASSING IS DONE FOR PNP TRANSACTIONS WHICH THIS GUYS ARE DOING.

reviews.author: Fayaz A
reviews.title: Hospitality Redefined !!
reviews.text: We recently spent a couple of days at this resort and what a fabulous experience it turned out to be!! The location was absolutely breathtaking and the premier room where we stayed was a perfect blend of luxury and elegance. What really bowled us over was the top-notch quality of service at the resort. To say that the hotel staff was friendly and helpful will be an understatement-they were well-groomed, very pleasant to talk to and were incredibly supportive throughout our stay. From offering quick medical assistance when I was down with flu to getting a complimentary cake for celebrating our kids’ birthday-they did everything they possibly could to make our stay at the resort an unforgettable experience. We were particularly impressed with Sajjad, Ashfaq, Rafiq and Ishaq who went out of their way to make us feel at home with their warmth and impeccable service. With its stunning location, classy ambience and outstanding hospitality, Khyber certainly ranks as one of the best hotels we have stayed in. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: mahesh p
reviews.title: Decent stay at Gulmarg
reviews.text:
It was last week in September and season in kashmir was about to end.
We had a 2 day's decent stay here. Location of of the property is beautiful. Interior and decor was simple. It had all fine amenities but would not rate it as five star.
Entrance climb is so damn stiff that one can not think of walk down or up. Food was nice and had all kinds of cousine.

reviews.author: yasif07
reviews.title: ROYAL, CALM AND SERENE PLACE
reviews.text: Our stay at Khyber resort was the best from all the places we stayed in Kashmir. Their service was very welcoming , friendly & very warm.  All the guests are treated with a welcome drink of Kashmir named " kahwa".  The tea was one of the best Kahwa i ever had . We book the cheapest rooms in the resorts and even then , we were super excited in seeing the layout & views the room had to offer us. They were very lavish at providing us a lot of complimentary water bottles and tea, which usually is charged in every other hotel we had been :). The show stopper for all these amazing facilities in the resort was when we entered the pool and spa at the resort , the design intend was perfect to please every customer who had come in search of a place to relax ,detox and enjoy the calm natural  paradise that was seen everywhere we looked in Gulmarg. the pool was heated and it offered a clean views of the beautiful surroundings. one can lay in the pool for hours gazing at the beautiful ice mountains & pine trees around.  Over all i would suggest this hotel to everyone who wishes to visit Kashmir & you would be missing alot if you dint . :)

reviews.author: Soumava N
reviews.title: Amazing service
reviews.text: The idea of an indoor pool , sauna , steam, jacuzzi , spa ..in gulmarg itself is a thrill. Tried out the resort as gondola was not operational the day we reached gulmarg. Mutton sheekh kabab & hukka has to be tried .apart from the dip in the larger than life pool experience. Hotel staff ..pretty amazing ..helfpful & smiling .. there were some issues with internet during our stay yet they made the entire checkout experience very smooth .. will definitely stay again

reviews.author: Shutterbugger
reviews.title: Great location, interiors & service. Bit pricey, but highly recommended
reviews.text:
We stayed there as a couple in Sep 2015. We found the tariff a bit steep but would be willing to repeat our stay in the winters there. Its a beautifully done up property with lovely landscaped lawns and pool/spa area. There are lots of steps inside and outside the resort - might be tough for the elderly or those with physical challenges.

We stayed in #4003 which was a non-balcony room. was spacious and comfortable. the higher priced balcony rooms with mountain view would be great if you're willing to pay up extra for the awesome view. balcony rooms with Gulmarg view don't have a special view - imo not worth the extra charges.

+ LOCATION-situated within 7-10 mins walking distance from the Gulmarg Gondola (cable car to Apharwat peak). helps steer clear of hiring ponies. on the flip side, the walk back from Gondola to the hotel is a bit steep and tiring for unfit people
+ INTERIORS-very well done up. comfortable and clean. modern, clean bathrooms. however, maintenance could be better in some areas (more below)
+ FOOD-found it to be decent. breakfast spread is very extensive (eggs, multiple south indian options, north indian, fruits, breads, juices etc). traditional kashmiri cuisine was really tasty
+ SERVICE-calls to the front desk and housekeeping were promptly answered and requests fulfilled quickly. wait staff at the restaurant was also good and very friendly.

- BATHROOM MAINTENANCE-one of the tiles in the bathroom was broken. shower area water was getting clogged due to drainage issues. found the bathtub a bit dirty and had to ask for it to be re-cleaned before using it. For the tariff they charge (comparable to 5*), these issues should not be there at all!
- CHARGEABLE WIFI-given its remote location and tariff being charged, it should have been wi-fi with limits on the # of devices allowed
- CENTRAL A/C- it gets uncomfortably hot during the day. perhaps it needs to recalibrate for summer months since temps definitely need to be a bit cooler than they are set in Aug/Sep. in-room controls don't work in modulating temperature

SPA-we used the spa for a neck,shoulder,head massage session. It wasn't bad but we've had better massages elsewhere. Didn't think there was anything distinctive here owing to the L'Occitane tag.

reviews.author: Atique K
reviews.title: Luxurious abode
reviews.text:
Great place.
Worth every bit of your money.
Service, location, spa, pool, steam are splendid...
Very close to gondola
The welcome drink is refreshing and sets the tone of the place 

Food options can be better 

But nonetheless....it's a super place.

reviews.author: neerajhardik
reviews.title: Good hotel limited views
reviews.text: Khyber resorts Gulmarg is a recently opened good hotel with modern facilities however the views from the hotels are very limited. The hotel does not open up to views of Gulmarg bowl. We went to highlands park and founds the views to be much better. Overall average because of limited views.

reviews.author: Rohit S
reviews.title: Superb stay at one of the finest in the region
reviews.text: Stayed on 13th sept nite. everything from check in to checkout was smooth.rooms are big and clean and the resort is in midst of tranquility and peace. Food was the best we had on our trip to kashmir. one small thing which they can offer to guest is complimentary wifi which though currently available on chargeable basis. still as there was phone connection we could use our 3G services. tried clove restaurant and the spread was amazing. tried igloo play area for kids which has table tennis and some Xbox for fun. overall highly recommend if you are in the valley and if you haven't experienced Khyber hospitality then you surely have missed a lot.

reviews.author: 198pradeep
reviews.title: Khyber Himalayan Resort and Spa at Gulmarg, Kashmir, India- a heaven on earth
reviews.text:
Khyber Himalayan Resort and Spa is situated in Himalayan town of Gulmarg, 56 kilometers from Srinagar, the capital city of state of Jammu and Kashmir in India.The resort is situated at altitude of almost 9000 feet in the picturesque valley in Himalayan Pir Panjal range.Khyber Resort is an ideal base to explore Kashmir valley and particularly to take a ride on world's highest sky lift, the Gulmarg Gondola, which connects Gulmarg to Kongduri mountain.

This 86 room resort provides enchanting and breathtaking view of meadows and forests of Kashmir valley and snow covered peaks of Himalayan mountain ranges. Each room in the resort provides this heavenly view, not only from the balcony but also from the washroom through full sized floor to ceiling windows. enjoying this heavenly view while taking tub bath is an unique  experience.
the rooms are well equipped and spacious and have a large balcony with comfortable relaxing chairs. The fittings and fixtures in rooms and washroom area are of high quality.
The resort has good spa, gym and heated swimming pool.
Khyber resort provides a great value for money.

reviews.author: Smritipuri
reviews.title: Will be visiting AGAIN!!!!
reviews.text: My husband and I stayed at Khyber Jan 2015. I would recommend the Himalayan view room. It is spectacular worth every penny. :) food was great. Although since it's a spa resort no alcohol available. There is lovely sheesha/cigar lounge. I don't have words to describe the beauty of the place and the view from the hotel. Services are excellent. I fell ill because of cold cold weather thankfully they had a Dr available 24/7 special thanks to Aijaz to be readily helpful at all times and making our stay further more pleasant.

reviews.author: Jasmiet M
reviews.title: Magnificent view .. No words can describe the feeling
reviews.text: Amazing best 5 star property in Gulmarg next to Gondola. The balcony rooms give an unprecedented view of Afharwat Mountains. Food is awesome with choice of 3 restaurants . Loved enjoying long hours at the balcony...

reviews.author: nitasha_communique
reviews.title: The best ski restort in India!
reviews.text: The food, the staff, the location, the indoor pool and the bar, make Khyber a place one must visit to get an athentic ski resort feel in India. The staff we thought were rude initially, however, later we realised the hotel is overbooked and they were overworked and were actually very sweet. Getting here was a problem as we were stuck in a snow storm, eventually we had to be pulled up on snowmobiles, luggage and all in town in the freezing cold and snow, but that made the entire thing memorable as i remember it till today! Kashmir is a beauty and Khyber makes it even more beautiful if possible. The heated indoor pool and the much needed spa spells luxury and while expensive, we suggest you go in for all 3 meals at the hotel as its not easy to roam around in colder months namely oct-march.

reviews.author: Vchellani
reviews.title: Superb!!!
reviews.text: The Khyber resort is an amazing experience, the decor of the hotel, its location and the amazing staff make this the best hotel in the area by far. The experience of staying at the khyber is unparalleled, the food at the clove restaurant was very good and chaikash their coffee / pastry shop is very good too with very friendly and helpful staff. The service in the hotel overall, from room service to the restaurant to spa was just excellent. We took a luxury room with the mountain view and it was spectacular and worth the additional price. We trued the spa as well, covered that as a seperate review

reviews.author: jaiswal2015
reviews.title: Hotel is average
reviews.text: we visited this place in winter this year our main motive was to ski from the the peak of affarwat only problem we faced was heating system in hotel was not working peoperly otherwise food is gud , rooms are nice ...

reviews.author: Parth B
reviews.title: Not what promised , arrogant staff
reviews.text:
We visited in august and booked a 2 bedroom cottage with "full service kitchen".
When we reached the hotel the definition of luxurious kitchen was a microwave without any utensils.
They randomly made us put some stuff at the gate for security purpose, the head of security was a super arrogant person.
If you don't allow any stuff you should pit on the website.
We contacted repeatedly, but there was no answer finally almost at night manager responded.
The swimming pool floor tiles are broken at many points, you may seriously injure your toes there.
I may still go back to Khyber for the location and lack of other major competition. However with an expectation of some cheap guesthouse at a nice location

reviews.author: Sam_Fra_Global
reviews.title: Best 5 star hotel
reviews.text:
Khyber is a Luxury 5 star hotel which has again redefined the hospitality of Gulmarg. It has different category of rooms. The Himalayan View Rooms are excellent.

The swimming pool is great to have at this altitude.

reviews.author: Meha1234
reviews.title: very relaxing and beautiful
reviews.text:
We had heard a lot about the property and thus booked this as a treat to both me and my husband after our 10 day trip in leh. Though the hotel is pretty, few points they could improve on:
1. Due to less occupancy, the hotel did not look fully operational. Ex - no Buffet ( which was a disappointment for meat lovers) Also for veg, there were limited options apart from few mains in Indian dishes. 
2. Lights were dim throughout the hotel etc. 
3.The wifi was very slow
4.The hotel could add more activities and maintain the existing ones like snooker table a little better
5. The AC in the rooms don't work on individual need basis as the hotel is centrally managed. Hence in Aug, the room gets a bit too warm while sleeping.

The pluses:
1.The staff however, was very polite and courteous and ensured we have a lovely stay. The manager too went out of the way to get us an upgrade so we could enjoy the mountain view with a balcony. That made us feel really on top of the world literally and not made us feel the pinch in the wallet due to the high prices of the rooms even in off season. 
2. Quiet and relaxing
3. Rooms were very comfortable with excellent bathrooms. 
.
Overall, nice experience but would be better in season time when the hotel really looks beautiful with snow.

reviews.author: madhulika02
reviews.title: excellent
reviews.text: excellent stay at a wonderfull property , staff was very nice and cordial . its a five star property worth staying with the forst view which was amazing . swimming pool , sauna was well maintained . the staff went out of their way to make the stay more memorable . one thing for sure you should have more option in welcome drinks .

reviews.author: S D
reviews.title: Great Location
reviews.text: The Khyber is the best hotel in Gulmarg. The location is away from the town so there is ample peace and quiet. The Hotel has a grand entrance, lot of wood used in the décor . The food is good, but while you are staying there might as well eat at different places rather than same food at the Hotel. Due to off season we had a slow service and very forgetful waiters. The rooms are nice but there is a typical odour in the bathrooms. The hotel is right next to the Gondola ride so very convenient as that is one of the prime attractions when the ski season is off. The last leg of the walk up to the hotel provides good cardio exercise.

reviews.author: DelhiTraveller1979
reviews.title: Not as expected
reviews.text:
We went to gulmarg on a family vacation, and everyone in delhi was talking about this property called Khyber. Everyone we spoke to said we should stay in this property. With very high hopes we arrived at this grand looking building, and loved the scale. But soon we realised the various problems this property had. The luxury that the building expresses is not translated into the service or the management. While we were there, everyday there were fights at the reception about poor service, many guests complained about poor management. Food at the restaurant was average and basic beverages like coke took twenty minutes to arrive on the table. The staff seemed to be untrained but very courteous. The food was very very average and the Kashmiri food wasn't good.

We stayed in the base category rooms, and we had to change rooms do to could smell and lack of cleanliness. The rooms are a decent siZe and the bathrooms luxurious but the servicing of the room was poor. The toilets floor was dirty, one day there was no hot water and the guy who came to check put on the shower and walked in dirty wet shoes all over my room, the housekeeping guy who came to clean had a stinky mop making the whole room unliveable. After several complaints and me visiting the reception since no one on the phone seemed to be understanding the issue,  over two hours, I finally got hot water and managed the night but wet cleaning the floors myself to get rid of the foul smell.

Also ever time we opened our window since they didn't that there Ac plant running and it would get hot and stuffy in the room, we got a foul smell into the room. Also the entire hotel seems to have a lot of damp while the lifts and the staircases were dirty and not cleaned. But on the bright side, the spa services were fantastic. The spa staff is very good and my experience was relaxing .

Even if I disregard this experience as a bad experience anyone can have, the hotel is poorly located. The real charm of gulmarg is the rolling hills which can't be seen or experienced from Khyber. Also Khyber is planned in away that you are always looking inwards into the hotel grounds rather than out into gulmarg. 

If you really want to experience the heaven like beauty of gulmarg, Khyber isn't the place to stay until you want to climb down a very steep slope and go on a pony to the other side everyday to experience it. If you want to take a cab it's three hundred rupees just to get dropped one way. The hotel does not provide this service and they ask you to go to the parking and take a local cab.

Khyber as a hotel could be on any hill station and does not do justice to being located in gulmarg. 
If this property isn't managed well, it will start looking very run down in a few years, which is sad because the owner seems to have made it with a lot of passion and love.

reviews.author: Suket Bhatia
reviews.title: Great Property - Service needs urgent attention
reviews.text:
The property is well located and well done up. We stayed here as part of a large group and felt it was grossly understaffed to provide service levels expected of 5 star properties. Breakfast tables were not ready, dishes from earlier guests were still not cleared on all tables... we had to wait for 10 minutes for a table and still had to make do with clearing the tables ourselves... Definitely not expected when you're paying as much as the hotel charges. Also even upon making a request to open the pool early one day in advance, and getting confirmation that it would be ready, the pool was not ready the next day.
Attention to such small things from the staff would really have made our stay a memorable one.
ROOM TIP: Try to get the rooms having windows on the eastern side otherwise all you would be able to see from your room would be a barbed fence.

reviews.author: travelBugs5040
reviews.title: Simply Beautiful
reviews.text:
We stayed for 4 nights in March with a group of friends (adults, teens and kids) . We had heard that it's a lovely place from people who had visited and had great expectations.. Well, Khyber lived upto our expectations. 
The stay was comfortable, food was very, very good, staff was very polite and the surroundings were spectacular.
The only hitch was the climb to get to the hotel. Hope they have a car service as the climb up is very steep.
We even went to the spa and it was excellent!
To sum it up.... We are definitely be going back!!!!

reviews.author: kabiir k
reviews.title: Fabulous Experience
reviews.text:
1. Khyber is a beautiful property and very well maintained.
2. Very courteous staff. very Helpful. 
3. Good food. Good variety
4. Lot of recreational facilities available.

Thanks Rachna, Zafar and Manuj.

reviews.author: ManishRaut
reviews.title: Breathtaking Place
reviews.text:
Mind blowing surroundings 
Impeccable service 
Beautiful rooms and excellent staff 
Negatives been on the incline hence the trek can be arduous but worth it atleast once
Close to the gondolas 
No place for drivers 
Beautiful swimming pool and the lounge is well maintained

reviews.author: Caramel1436
reviews.title: Amazing hotel in a wonderful locale
reviews.text:
The Khyber is an amazing hotel in a beautiful locale. .....the staff very hospitable......the rooms extremely comfortable ......the food delectable.......in short everything seemed perfect.
A special mention for the General Manager Mr Alex Koshy...... Who was extremely enterprising and hospitable and will surely take this hotel to great heights

reviews.author: Mariya_Nagree
reviews.title: Khyber: A must place to stay in Gulmarg
reviews.text:
You feel completely relaxed and pampered at Khyber. 
The rooms are well furnished and every detail is looked after. They all look over either the valley or snow capped mountains, both of which are breathtaking! 
The cuisines, be it, Chinese, Kashmiri, Continental or even the breakfast, were delectable! 
The staff is warm, cordial and friendly. A special thanks to the manager, Mr. Alex. His hospitality and generosity made our stay at Khyber a memorable experience!!

reviews.author: Pradeep024
reviews.title: Luxury in the lap of nature
reviews.text:
Hotel sits right in front mountain and view is amazing.
They have 2 category of rooms one without balcony and another with balcony. View is pretty amazing and you can stare at ranges for hours while enjoying your cupa tea. And it can literally take hours to explore all variety of tea Khyber has to offer. They have dedicated tea lounge which serves 24 variety of tea. A wide range menu and roof top barbeque just makes it perfect. 
Traveling with small kid is always challenging, our occasional special food request was always delivered with smile by chef. 
Swimming pool is under construction while gym was functional.
Only negative was air-conditioning which kept breaking down.

reviews.author: SMP1943
reviews.title: Khyber in Gulmarg
reviews.text: We were at the Khyber in Gulmarg in mid-September and found the place to be a great retreat, away from the town,  tucked away amidst hills and staffed by the most polite, efficient and friendly persons at every level. Wish the pool and the Spa were functional!

reviews.author: SamarGGN
reviews.title: Kashmiri Hospitality at it's best
reviews.text:
The great hospitality experience starts right outside Srinagar airport where the chauffeur meets you a genuine smile. He doesn't get too friendly on the way but will answer your questions about flora, fauna, local traditions, culture etc,. very courteously and knowledgeably.

You are greeted with Kahwa while the checkin in done, which is very efficient and then you proceed to your room. The room is very modern but ethnic with a big dose Kashmiri artifacts and architecture all around.

The architecture and the attention to details in the construction is to be seen to be believed. I was surprised to see the manholes also outlined with local tiles.

Since it was a team meeting the Chef met and discussed the cuisines and the menu before hand and I though I difficult to please with food but even I after 4 meals the fatigue has still not set in. Though the breakfast may be improved a bit.

The room service was awesome and the best I have seen across any hotel in the world and our order of Fish and Chips was delivered in less than 20 minutes.

they are still making the spa so you could hear from construction noises but given that you are so well taken care off and also the place is surrounded by such picturesque and serene surroundings - It didn't bother me a bit.

reviews.author: kkhan2013
reviews.title: mind blowing experience
reviews.text: I had lunch at the resort a few days back and trust me it was one of the best experiences.You can select from a wide menu ranging from Conti,Chinese,Indian and Kashmiri.the staff treats you specially and makes sure that the experience at khyber is unique.Would rate this as number 1 hotel in terms of infrastructure and trained staff

reviews.author: mature12
reviews.title: Good hotel with teething problems
reviews.text: Nice hotel with good location .romms have problem in getting hot water in the bath rooms or temperature control does not work. Food section need to improve.GM of hotel frm himachal was nice and courteous.selection of room to new guests need to improve. Except these hotel is beautiful with excellent location.Bit too costly

reviews.author: vishal0151
reviews.title: the best hotel in whole of kashmir
reviews.text: i know gulmarg is famous for gondola ride but i would rate this hotel above that. excellent infrastructure, delicious food, brilliant service, spacious rooms, and the whole staff was very responsive and helpful. i will only visit kashmir because of this very hotel.thank you khyber family.

reviews.author: Sabitamittal
reviews.title: One of the best one
reviews.text: The experience was out of this world. I am again going to be there in dec, 13. Location, placement and facade were marvellous. Typical Kashmir structure embodied in rich wood. Washroom were out of this word experience. Wooden flooring in washroom unseen before. Great food and more great kahwa.

reviews.author: amitgujral1961
reviews.title: Spectacular resort!
reviews.text: I think the Khyber is a destination by itself! It is one of the most beautiful mountain resorts in India. I have never seen local artifacts presented so tastefully. The staff was by far the best trained we encountered on our visit to Kashmir. Everything from the rooms, toilets, lobbies, common areas are beautiful and have all the amenities one would require. The food was excellent and when we decided to check out early morning apprehending some disturbance en-route to Srinagar, the staff had already put in breakfast hampers in our transport...I think the Khyber will set a new bench mark for the tourism trade in the Kashmir valley!

reviews.author: Dhaval T
reviews.title: Memorable Stay !!!
reviews.text:
I stayed in Mountain View Room in the first week of Sep 2013. The view is just exotic. It was a One night stay where i felt i was in heaven. The food was outstanding and interiors of the hotels have been done traditionally and good. The rooms are spacious with wonderful set of people around. 

I would like ot visit one more time...

reviews.author: Dhruti2013
reviews.title: wonderful stay at khyber
reviews.text:
it was a memorable stay in Khyber.Amazing food,energetic set of employees around.
The location is amazing,I stayed in Himalayan view rom and the view from the room was  just lovely

Pony walas have spoiled Gulmarg

reviews.author: Milind P
reviews.title: Fantastic Property at a beautiful location
reviews.text:
The Khyber @ Gulmarg is a fantastic property, only recently built, at a beautiful location. As soon as you enter the hotel, you can see that it is a class apart in all respects. From the Furnishings to the paintings, to the rooms and the flooring, everything is tastefully chosen and done up. The Staff here is very courteous and polite. Food is lovely. However, there is no bar in the hotel, which may be noted. There is a kids area, comprising of a trampoline, swing and see-saw, which my daughter loved. Further, there are other entertainment options like the snooker, carom, etc, This area was under construction.

All in all, we had a fantastic experience at this hotel and would highly recommend it. I would even go so far to say this IS THE BEST HOTEL IN GULMARG.

reviews.author: PreethiNat
reviews.title: Pricey!
reviews.text: We stayed for a night at the Khyber. The interiors are beautifully done but the wooden flooring is quite slippery. The staff were extremely cordial and very courteous. The welcome tea was very refreshing and the servicing staff took extra care to satisfy us.  However, the food did not agree especially the fresh fruit juices that were offered during dinner. The stay was overall good but the bad experience was after checking out. We had missed our cellphone and tried to trace it back but the numbers were not reachable. The staff were also very curt to us over phone. The after service could definitely be improved. Overall good stay, but not worth the hefty amount we paid for it.

reviews.author: Firozabad
reviews.title: Very good property at good location
reviews.text: I stayed at many hotels across the world. This resort is one of my good hotel. The room was very clean good interior.all the amenities were there.  Staff was very good and cooperative. Food was excellent .I will like to stay again in winter

reviews.author: Ghulam N
reviews.title: Kohinoor of Kashmir
reviews.text:
No words can describe the beauty of this place, no poets can sum it in a song, no priests can chant it in a tone, such is the beauty of this resort. Right from the moment u enter this place, you are greeted with an upright security guard. When u hit their main porch u get to c one of the biggest chandeliers i have ever seen in any part of this country. The decor is perfect to Kashmiri culture. Check in seems to be spotless with the welcome drink being a cullad(cup) of kehwa. Escorting to the room,escorting and explaining the features of the room--all this just makes it up for the 2 hour journey from Srinagar.

I stayed in the mountain facing room.What mind blowing the view is early morning, You got to be lucky to be in Kashmir and even more luckier to be in Khyber to revisit the dawn and dusk from your room balcony. 

Restaurant seems to be a personalized for every guest that walks in. Kudos to the thinking behind the scenes for making every guest feel special.

Just to sum the experience short, the staff there seems to have a smile and never say no attitude which speaks of the training imparted and am sure would match up to the international standards at any given point of time.

Just an advice--Get more of the Kashmiri Cuisine rolling in the menu.

reviews.author: ajay35
reviews.title: Wasted effort
reviews.text:
We just returned back from Kashmir. We stayed at Khyber - Gulmarg for 1 night. The hotel has very tastefully done interiors my compliments to the interior designers. However other than this nothing is right with the place. The central heating in my room was not working. On complaining the service dept worked on it and was able to rectify the fault only after repeated attempts which meant service people moving into & out of my room repeatedly also showing that they don't have any SOP of regular maintenance. The room heater provided in lieu of central heating was of blower type and was noisy instead of noiseless oil filled radiator type.
Restaurant serves food of very ordinary grade compared to exorbitant prices
In spite of having informed that I was there for celebrating my Anniversary they made no attempt to make the day special for me instead I was given a room with lousy view instead of mountain view.
Mr Deepak who is in charge is a sweet man however seems to be bogged down with operational issues hence cannot devote time to take care of extras like doing something extra for a guest if he is there on a special occasion.
Would not like to stay there again until & unless they really improve.

reviews.author: shraddhasingh
reviews.title: Exceptional
reviews.text: Exceptional view, good service, beautiful interiors - its a treat to stay at The Khyber. It's the only luxury resort in gulmarg and they've done a brilliant job of every little detail. I'd definitely recommend a vacation here.

reviews.author: Khalid A
reviews.title: Excellent location to stay in Gulmarg
reviews.text:
Excellent stay 

we booked through Akbar travels

it was great with family rooms were spacious with balcony 

weather was rainy and all over clouds 

we were lucky Gondola was open on the day we reached for both phases 

Beauty full place to visit 

No tension or disturbance was noted during entire stay in Kashmir 

problem reported outside were not present 

I recommend tourist to plan and visit Sonamarg, Phalgam

Srignagar 

Doodh patri 40 km away from Srinagar Place to see too

reviews.author: sunil d
reviews.title: Stay only for Rooms
reviews.text: When we visited this hotel in June it has no spa, no swimming pool, no bar so basically you are paying so much only for the rooms. It is a brand new property & rooms are decent so is the food but the name is very deceptive as it is neither a resort nor a spa. Maximum 01 night stay in more than enough in this hotel & gulmarg only for the cable car ride.

reviews.author: gargi2013
reviews.title: great place to be.
reviews.text: breath taking view, delicious kashmiri food, great cigar/ shisha bar. rooms are well equipped. bathrooms are very good. great place to be.take breakfast on outside varandah. spa is starting from october. ask hotel to arrange your gondola tickets to avoid queue.

reviews.author: virender j
reviews.title: Good new hotel with average views
reviews.text: This is a good new hotel in gulmarg with very average views. The problem in gulmarg is that old hotel like highlands & nedous command the best views but are very average now as they have not upgraded their properties & new hotel like Khyber & vintage are no doubt mucg better but with very average views. Otherwise the food served in Khyber is good but exorbitantly priced where an average meal per pax without drinks is approx 2000/- per head. Do try this hotel in winters for the snow experience!

reviews.author: The Turban Traveller
reviews.title: The Only 5 star standard Hotel in Gulmarg.
reviews.text:
I think Khyber is the only 5 star hotel in Gulmarg as on date. If u wanted to stay in 5 star hotel than you have only one choice "Khyber Spa & Resort " . 

It's value for money and I am sure with their Good Food & Excellant Service your stay is going to be the best one.

I strongly recommend this hotel .
I stayed there for 3 nights in first week of sept 2013 and planing to visit again next month with my family & friends in a big group .

The staff is very nice & helpful , from security gaurds to their general manager everyone gives you very personalised service which is great. 

I wish they should open more hotels in J&K and wish them good luck .

reviews.author: CarolineRowe
reviews.title: Like being with family
reviews.text: I went to Kashmir to attend the Zubin Mehta concert which was on in Srinagar and decided to add on a night and stay in Gulmarg. I was welcomed absolutely like family and of course blown away by the impressive interiors, very warm and sharply trained staff and, most of all, the phenomenal views. I took a hike with a local guide, and a gondola ride also, and always felt 100% safe, pampered, and at home. The kashmiri kahwa was the best I have tried and their food, especially the western food, is excellent. The rooms are luxurious and the sunken tub is a favourite feature! In fact, I felt so safe and looked after that I cancelled my booking in Srinagar for the next night, where there had been some disturbances, and instead drove all the way back to The Khyber for peace of mind and luxury. The next day the driver took me on an excellent tour around Dal Lake before my flight. The whole experience was perfect from beginning to end!

reviews.author: SwapTre
reviews.title: Excellent Experience
reviews.text: This was a family vacation & we had booked 2 rooms. The check-in process was smooth & we were upgraded to adjacent balcony rooms with a great view. Our stay was for 3 nights & thoroughly enjoyable. The hotel lobby has a very cozy feel to it & the property is built was an eye for detail. The staff here is excellent & so is the food. We were offered complementary kahwa(local hot drink) at their tea-lounge with breathtaking views. The rooms are done up very well but the beds were too cushy to be comfortable. There is also some construction activity going on at present. We compliment the manager & the staff for this beautiful experience.

reviews.author: Prashant65
reviews.title: enriching experience
reviews.text: khyber has a great view from the balcony. very helpful staff who looked after us very well. arranged for our outdoor activity. guide provided was good--took us to the gondola and then a mountain trek to drung which was amazing. the surroundings left us amazed at the beauty around us. we preferred the trek instead of the routine drive around gulmarg and didn't repent the decision!

reviews.author: Darshikaajoomal
reviews.title: Awesome location
reviews.text:
Khyber was a beautiful stay for our whole family. The hotel had upgradedus to mountain view balcony rooms . Since we were travelling with three adults in the age group of above 70 years they were nice enough to give us the same category but on a lower level. We had 2 more rooms for us on the 1st level. Our rooms were fabulous and the children enjoyed the big bathrooms and bathtub.
There are lots of activities for children of all ages. The swimming pool and spa is to open in September 3013. They have a trampoline in the lawns and small baby area and. Children's area. 
But we managed to do lots of treks in and around our hotel. The locals were very glad to help us also. 
The gondola to go to level 1 and level 2 is just a two minute walk outside our hotel. It takes around 10 minutes to level 1 where there is nothing much to see. Level 2 is at 15000 feet above ground and we passed through clouds on our way up. It was cold . We had rent horses to then reach the top where you can see the Line of Control or if very fit you can trek up. It will take half hour. But the air is very thin so if not used to it might be difficult.
It is a half day trip .
You could ask the hotel to get you a local guide who can help with all the tickets and trekking. 
They will also help to organise other treks in the area . It is beautiful .
Food at the hotel is very expensive, but you have the option to go to local dhabas where the food is very fresh and clean also. There is no alcohol served in the hotel. But if you bring your own , they will serve it to you either in your rooms or even in the restaurant.
We had a wonderful last meal which was a barbecue on the terrace, with fresh sea food, meat, pastas and enough vegetarian options also.
Breakfast was very good with lots of options to choose from. Even though we were there for four nights we never got bored of the food. 
Service was very good. The housekeeping was always helpful.
But since we there in August and lucky or unluckily we got very hot weather in the day, and there are no AC in the rooms. So it can get stuffy to sleep. We would keep our balcony rooms open after lights out and had to call for table fans. They only have heating in the room, coy they have never experienced such hot weather.
Overall a very good trip and an excellent stay.

reviews.author: aakb1970
reviews.title: Very fabulous location and hotel! Nice staff and very helpful!
reviews.text:
Liked the place with great reception and hospitality. Like it very much. Stayed with family with kids, very safe and located two minutes from Ganola!

Hotel provide local trip to near by location with hotel cars. 
 Staff is eager to help!

reviews.author: decorage
reviews.title: Fabulous stay!
reviews.text:
We had an absolutely fabulous stay at the hotel. The Manager welcomed us by our name - a small but thoughtful gesture. Makes a guest feel welcome to know that they are expecting you. 

Our rooms got upgraded to beautiful, valley facing rooms with balcony. You can spend the entire holiday just gazing at the breath-taking view.....

The hotel is well-priced and the luxurious setting can spoil you for your next destination. Taj at Shrinagar fell short of our expectation after experiencing The Khyber.

It is a definite recommend for everyone visiting Gulmarg. We would love to go again when it snows.

reviews.author: rohit s
reviews.title: ABSOLUTELY FANTASTIC!!
reviews.text:
There is absolutely nothing negative that I can even think of!!
What a beautiful resort, stunning location and views and completely serene!
It's actually a great getaway from Delhi because of a 1 hour 10 minute flight and a two hour road transfer from Srinagar!!!
We were there to celebrate our marriage anniversary and the staff made it very special!
We will go back, maybe in winter.

reviews.author: Rahul Lalit
reviews.title: Simply Superb!
reviews.text:
We stayed at this fabulous property in the second week of August and this was the best stay of our entire Kashmir holiday. The property is grand and tastefully done up having a very woody-very Kashmiri sort of feel to it.  Rooms and bathrooms are very nice, beds extremely comfortable and the view is spectacular. We had the best food at this hotel whether it was Chinese, Continental or local Kashmiri cuisine. The chef gave special attention to specific needs of the guest (which I have only seen at Oberoi properties in India) and other hotel staff was extremely courteous too. 
I would highly recommend this hotel and would love to go back for another vacation!!!

reviews.author: saurabhkhabia
reviews.title: Good
reviews.text: Hotel as just started some time back wen we visited so hotel staff seemed fighting for time.  They were short of staff to. Food very few options for vegetarian. Rooms on levels which r down r not good.  Gondola Ride in gulmarg is good.

reviews.author: RekhaChoudhry
reviews.title: Good product, Fabulous locales!!
reviews.text:
My son had booked us here and I was a bit skeptical about staying here given that Gulmarg had seen the opening of this hotel only a very short while ago! Having said that, I was pleasantly surprised to see that this hotel was affiliated to the SLHW and thought to myself that the affiliation obviously held some merit to the hotel's services.
The product simply blows one away! Wafting smells of sweet saffron laced kahwa and the nuttiness of the walnut furniture are enough to create a mesmerising effect. The rooms are large and redolent with Afghan and Kashmiri influences. Large sunken baths overlooking the Affarwat mountains are sure to ease out any strain that one might have felt while coming to the hotel.
Our stay was however peppered with some unwanted faux pas. The toilet in the room backed up and nearly overflowed at around midnight. The complaint was however, attended to quite promptly.
The service at Cloves (the all-day dining restaurant) was pathetically slow and lacked attention and coordination. We received our drinks after we had finished our soups and appetisers. And this is despite us being the only three guests at the restaurant. This laxity was however, made up quite well by the food, which I must say was great, both in portions and taste.
Overall, I would say this was a great retreat and a must visit for people coming over to Gulmarg.

reviews.title: Heaven on Earth
reviews.text: We stayed in Khyber Resort at Gulmarg on 26th and 27th August 2013. No praise is enough for the quality of the hotel and services it offers. There is a warm hospitable team manning a fabulous property which is clearly the est in India in terms of value for money and customer focus. The location is on top of a hill with a fabulous view. The food is outstanding and the staff leaves nothing to chance to make your stay comfortable. If I were to rate this hotel based on my experience of holiday stays across the world, I would definitely rate this as my best experience.Look forward to enjoying many more holidays in this serene hotel which makes you feel on top of the world - literally!!!!

reviews.author: rmanroa
reviews.title: Resort with a view
reviews.text:
Stayed there from 29 Aug - 30 Aug. We were allotted 3 luxury balcony rooms (east wing) on the first floor. The rooms were very modern, well maintained with flat screen television and tea/coffee warm kettle, centrally air conditioned, etc. Similarly the bathroom was fantastic with a nice shower section and a bath tub. The only let down was the view, an absolute disappointment. On opening the curtains all we could see is trees and the parking complex!!! 
The breakfast spread in the hotel was great. South India, Pav Bhaji, cereals, milk shakes, juices, sausages, baked beans, cappuchino, kahva etc... Our first night dinner at Cloves restaurant was good. We opted for ala carte. Most of the dishes are priced in the range of Rs 600-700 plus tax. Our next days dinner at Nouf (open only for Dinner) was great. Its an open air grill restaurant and definitely pricier (Rs 800-Rs 1000 per dish plus tax) but the food was fantastic. At Nouf we can bring our own alcohol and they are happy to serve it to us. This restaurant has limited capacity and tends to go full. Hence prior reservations recommended.
The hotel also has a cigar and sheesha lounge.

reviews.author: Leona M
reviews.title: Magical setting...
reviews.text:
Another property that I’m not sure where to begin...?

The views, the location, the hospitality, the food, the staff and the comfort of the rooms are all exceptional.  This property excel’s itself in every way possible.

The only disappointment for us was that the swimming pool and spa facilities were not open – they are expected to open in October – so a trip back is a must.

There is a peace and serenity about this property that you cannot describe.  I would return, especially in the winter to see the contrast with the snow and to be able to experience the skiing.

I cannot fault this property in any way except for the building noise and building staff constantly walking around.  The on-going building and noise ruins the tranquil surroundings as it starts around 8am and only finishes around 8pm which is disappointing.  We sat on our balcony every evening to appreciate the sunset and admire the views only to be disturbed with the constant drilling, talking and sawing from the building of the spa and chalets…guests should be made aware of this before arrive so to avoid disappointment as you can not appreciate a bath in privacy whilst looking out towards to views without looking at building staff.

I would however extend a big compliment to the assistant GM, Waseem for a compliment of staff that are friendly and offer a superior service and go beyond the call of duty for your guests.

This property comes highly recommended and as I mentioned before I would return in a heartbeat and cannot wait for my next trip to Gulmarg.

reviews.text:

Hotel is beautiful and strategically situated just 5 min walk from the Asia's longest Cable car "Gondola". As, soon as u enter resort one get the feel of Kashmir's local culture. Whole hotel is beautifully carved with Walnut wood, Lobby is beautifully designed as a traditional Kashmiri house with front desk and concierge assistance. Resort boast high level of service with their fully trained and courteous staff starting from the airport pick up chauffeur " Mr.Bashir" who was very courteous to Food and Beverage Executive " Mr.Robin" to Housekeeping "Evening turn down service staff". Resort provide delicious food and beverage option with their local and international selection of dishes at Cloves, Nouf and Chaikash "Tea lounge" at lobby level offer varieties of teas to enjoy at alfresco sitting or inside with mountain view, eating breakfast buffet at cloves sitting at Alfresco is just so heavenly.Our room with Balcony " with Best View of all " was just so perfect at par to any 5***** deluxe resort, One can enjoy a twin bath tub and best in class features. We were so impressed with the the warm and courteous service we got by Khyber Resort that even our trip was over we have decided to come and stay here during winters. 
I would like to Thanks Front Office, Food & Beverage " Mr.Robin " , Housekeeping, Airport pick up Chauffeur, Security " Mr.Deeepak & Mr.Rahul " for making our stay at Khyber a memorable stay.

reviews.author: Sowmith r
reviews.title: Khyber should allow booking amendments for medical situations
reviews.text:
Booking Dates
7-11 October 2024

I recently had a disappointing experience with Khyber. While I understand their policies, I felt let down by their lack of flexibility. Due to an unexpected health emergency, we had to request a cancellation or, at the very least, change of dates. But despite explaining the situation and providing all necessary documentation, the hotel refused to accommodate our request.

I am well aware of the non-refundable nature of the booking, but given the large sum of money involved, I had hoped for some level of understanding. Emergencies happen, and it’s unfortunate that in such a situation, the hotel’s response was strictly policy-driven, with no consideration for the circumstances.

It’s disappointing to see that a business prioritizes policy over the genuine difficulties of its guests, especially when significant amounts of money are at stake. I hope Khyber reevaluates how they handle such cases in the future, as a little empathy could go a long way.

We lost about 2.5 lakhs on this booking.

reviews.author: Ritin R
reviews.title: Great experience!
reviews.text: Luxurious and comfortable property with modern amenities! We stayed as a family and had a nice experience. Gurpreet had been super kind person, very warm and kind, she looked after us very well and always catered to our requests with a smile. Her colleague Tahir also did a great job and made us smile at every touchpoint. Would highly recommend Gurpreet for her professionalism,  ownership, positive attitude and client centricity. She made our stay very comfortable with whatever she could do. She followed up with me and delivered a birthday cake for my wife at 9:30 PM. These things really made us feel great and she was the reason behind those. The restaurants are good - Our overall experience at Clove was good but we had one bad episode where we found that outsiders were also allowed to access the restaurant along with the hotel guests; this caused inconvenience as we encountered not so very courteous group of men sitting next to our table and  creating lot of discomfort for us. However we raised this complaint after changing our table, it was managed by the restaurant manager Shakir and other restaurant person  who advised us to move away from that group of guys creating trouble (which we had already done), we would have appreciated Shakir even more if we would have advised those guys to watch their manners and stop creating nuisance in the dining area! Anyway, sans this experience, everything else was nice. We must mention about Abhishek, who despite being a junior staff member apologized on behalf of the notorious bunch of people who made us move to another table, he looked after us well and his kind gesture impressed us and we really liked his sense of ownership and maturity despite being a junior staff. Shakir endeavoured to improvise our experience the next day and arranged a nice dinner for us at Brava, the Italian fine dine restaurant which we commend and thank him for. At Brava, we met Varun, the restaurant manager, he took our experience to the greater heights that we really adored. He was very caring and kind at all touch points. Extremely sweet and courteous. He made our experience at the restaurant super memorable, his selection of must try dishes was amazing, service attitude was commendable, he went that extra mile to wow us at all times!  He got a birthday balloon for my wife, motivated his staff to sing for the b’day jingle for her. All in all he made a mark and made our stay truly memorable. Overall the hotel is very nice and comfortable and staff members are amazing! Highly recommend the property!

reviews.author: Aditya Pramanik
reviews.title: Stay at The Khyber Himalayan Resort & Spa Gulmarg, Kashmir
reviews.text:
Stay at The Khyber Himalayan Resort & Spa Gulmarg, Kashmir
We stayed at The Khyber Himalayan Resort & Spa for 02 nights from 2nd to 4th October 2023. It was a family trip. First, we went to Srinagar to attend a friend’s wedding. There were 04 of us and hence reserved 02 double rooms for our stay. Booking was made via the groom who was getting married. The rooms which were reserved for us were the Premier Rooms which got upgraded to Luxury Balcony Gulmarg View. Our arrival had been conveyed by the Revenue Head who conveyed the information to the hotel’s FOM, F&B Director & GM. All 03 mentioned above welcomed us and met us on arrival. We were walked to our rooms and then explained the rooming amenities. The FO Associate (Gurpreet) was very friendly, and calm, and asked us questions about our travel. The view from the rooms was fascinating and felt more luxurious than the hotel’s description. Quality of food prepared & personal attention by staff members starting at Brava (Italian Restaurant) to Calabash (Outlet for sheeshas & small eats) to Chaikash (their waiting lounge at the Lobby), Cloves (Khyber’s signature all-day dining restaurant) were great experiences. Associates and managers to mention are Surley (Housekeeping), Firdaus (F&B) and Sarida, Manzoor (FO), Mr Chhabra (GM), Vaibhav (Director, F&B) & Chef Sushmit Daniels (Executive Chef). We stayed at Khyber during our trip to Kashmir and it’s one of the best stays ever. Post our stay, we all have decided to go to Khyber once again during the winter period. The level of customer care stands out. If you plan to stay at The Khyber, stay there for 02 nights. Another person to mention is the Santoor player, Umar Farooq. His music is amazing once you get to listen to his tunes during the day. It soothes one’s mind. We will be back for another stay very soon. So, looking forward to that.

reviews.author: Sarmin
reviews.title: Good service, over priced hotel
reviews.text:
A very large hotel, nice property. Check in & out experience was good. Premier Room was clean, comfortable bed & pillows. provided plenty of amenities- lotion, Shampoo, conditioner, shower gel, soap, shower cap, beauty kit, dental kit, shaving kit etc. Tea, coffee, bottle water & slippers were provided as well. The buffet breakfast had varieties of hot & cold dishes. Multi cuisine Restaurant sitting is nice & we enjoyed breakfast, dinner, lunch there. food quality was good & delicious. The interior design of the hotel is nice (but needs polish/painting, looks old & damp). The reason for 4 star - over priced hotel, does not go with the room appearance (old look, not polished, walls need painting. Shower drainage is not good, flow water to the toilet area even though there is a glass partition in between. Provided instant coffee & cattle for boiling water, no coffee machine).
Staffs speaks English & helpful. Over priced hotel.

reviews.author: foodieklix
reviews.title: Excellent Property with Bad Food
reviews.text:
The Hotel is one of the finest properties we have stayed in. The room furniture & finishing is par excellence. The toiletries & each & everything in the room is high standards. The room service was efficient. The lawns & indoor pool really added to our stay experience.
We had lunch at their  Multi cuisine Restaurant Cloves. We ordered Indian, kashmiri & Asian food. The Indian & Kashmiri food was completely bland & lacked proper cooking & spices, when we complained, the chef & exec chef came & just listened & we werent even offered to get the meal redone/replaced. The meal prices are so exhorbitant that one expects atleast some decent meal & staff attitude. We were told by the chef that on next visit we will provide you best meal. What????? Is this a response to such a pathetic meal & that too coming from the exec chefs of such an amazing property. Only the Asian food was nice. Really our worst meal ever for Rs.17,000/- ( not even worth a rupee ). Later that night we called in food from Bakshi dhaba & trust us the meal was delicious with perfect spices & flavours & we paid 1900/- for a wholseome & delicious meal.

reviews.author: J J
reviews.title: Incredibly special
reviews.text:
Very good hotel with amazing signature Kashmiri hospitality.

Food and service were impeccable and the room was newly renovated and comfortable. The balcony was perfect and we felt lucky to be perched atop this incredible destination.

Unfortunately two things can be improved:

Two cockroaches were in our bathroom one evening. A staff member came immediately to remove them and we did not see them again.

The surfaces surrounding the buffet (walls, counters, etc) should be cleaned after each service. I could see dust and grime behind each pot of food. The ladles should be replaced after some time and the general area should be cleaned on a regular basis.

reviews.author: Shagun G

reviews.author: P_1015
reviews.title: Terrible experience, avoid at all costs!
reviews.text:
We had a really bad experience at The Khyber Resort. We paid an enormous amount and were treated so badly.

When we arrived at the hotel, there was a literary festival in progress. The hotel staff and the management were clearly differentiating between the VIP festival guests and ordinary guests like us - this poor experience continued throughout the day where we were just not treated well. 

The hotel guests were not wearing masks, and the hotel staff was not insisting on it. No COVID protocol was being followed because the entire lobby was packed with VIP Security and staff. 

The hotel did not inform us that of the 4 restaurants onsite, only one was available for the ‘non-festival’ guests. Absolutely no information was provided about this along with the booking. 

Further, though the pool is closed due to covid, the hotels Instagram account continuously advertises their pool facilities, misleading guests. And while they claim that this is due to COVID, no other COVID protocol is being followed here. Gym and spa are fully open - how is this safe? 

When we checked in, there were dirty dishes outside our room, which were only removed after three hours and that too when we called housekeeping. This is an appalling experience for guests. No one wants to see dirty dishes outside their room upon checkin! The staff were clearly not interested in anybody who wasn’t part of the VIP entourage. 

When we reached out to the hotel manager, he was dismissive rather than addressing our concerns. His response was - you should’ve told me sooner. Another manager called us on the phone and told us that he can’t do anything either. 

This is a terrible experience, there’s simply no point in staying in this hotel. They’re looting their guests. Good luck to you if you’re an ordinary guest and not a VIP.

reviews.title: Heaven in Kashmir !!!!
reviews.text:

reviews.author: Ashutosh Singh
reviews.title: Kyber the Crap resort
reviews.text:
There breakfast starts at 8 AM in the morning . However we wanted our breakfast at 7 AM because we had a flight to catch. We had informed the management about this in the night itself and they had promised us breakfast at 7 AM. However, once we went to the restaurant at 7:15 AM for breakfast, some lower staff behaved very rudely and asked us not to have breakfast before 8 AM. He said he has no information about early breakfast. Highly disappointed with Kyber.
Food is also mediocre , not a class like other 5 star resort spas. Guys working here are inexperienced and highly unprofessional , low in their behaviour . Not a Kashmiri pride at all. Please stay in some other resorts in Gulmarg . This kyber resort is not worth the money and connect. It is absolute crap.

reviews.author: Abha T
reviews.title: Beautiful hotel and excellent service
reviews.text: We were at Khyber from 6th - 9th October and had an overall pleasant experience at the hotel. The service was fantastic, particularly the staff that took care of in room dining and the restaurant staff. The hospitality is fabulous. We were taken care of quite well particularly by Mr. Irfan Husain. My aunt had a fall and fractured her wrist - the hotel staff went beyond the call of duty to ensure that she was comfortable - they arranged for quick transport to the nearest hospital as well as had their resident doctor come and check on my aunt regularly. The entire staff asked after her health constantly - truly one experiences the beauty, kindness, selflessness, hospitality and goodness of Kashmir!!!. The restaurant staff and the chef paid a great deal of attention to all my meals as I have diary and gluten allergy - the chef personally curated and prepared my food - which was excellent. The yellow dal and guchi pulao are one of the best meals I have had. They made fresh almond milk and vegetable juices for me for breakfast. It was a disappointment that the pool was shut due to covid. The gym is fantastic. I think the hotel would be more stunning and value for money in winter when it is covered by snow.

reviews.author: Priyanka Shah
reviews.title: 11/10 HOSPITALITY
reviews.text:
Dear Sir/Madam,

We'd like to compliment a few of your  staff members - Aamir, Firdaus, Abdul, Aijaz, Waseem, Irfan at Cloves and Deepali and Imtiaz at the for the excellent service that they provided us during our 5 night stay at the Khyber.  Right from the moment we entered the hotel, we were greeted with ear-to-ear wide smiles from the staff that already made us feel at home. All the staff members at Cloves recommended some of the best dishes to us and went out of their way to ensure we had the most delectable meal. What impressed us the most was their attention to detail as we saw them take extra efforts to ensure that the table was clean and that we were hydrated properly by filling the glasses with water every time they felt that they needed to be refilled and bring us fresh hot food refills from the kitchen at regular intervals. Since it was our anniversary holiday, they even decorated the room for us. 

We had heard a lot of amazing reviews about Khyber. However, the warmth, affection, and hospitality showed by your staff in addition to the fabulous meals and spa experience that we had truly exceeded our expectations and made our experience even better. 

Such a commitment to customer service is to be commended. You can rest assured that we will be frequenting Khyber very often.
 
(We had a few additional waiters at the table serving us but we were unable to thank them on our way out as they had left for delivery. Please do convey our heartfelt gratitude to every single member of the team)

From the location to the service to the hospitality to the cleanliness to the hygience to the kindness - All in all, it was hands down one of our best trips. 

Your happiest customers,
Priyanka Shah and Rahil Shah.

reviews.author: Souvik S
reviews.title: Beautiful but misses out on customer experience!
reviews.text:
To start with the highs - the upkeep of the hotel is brilliant and luxurious. I loved the corridors and the rooms as well. The property is centrally temperature controlled and hence interiors are very comfortable. Rooms are opulent with all moder luxuries thar one can expect. 

The food is very good, and I will say that the breakfast spread is one of the best I have had in hotels/ resorts of this league. 

Now why would I still rate this place a 3 / 5. That's because of the service, and that too when I compare it with properties of this league. Clearly the speed and care for service towards its guests is far from expected. We had to ask multiple times for water, the water kettle was not clean and getting it exchanged took time !

Frankly, the hotel is definitely worth a stay, but will I go back for more given the level of service? - I am not sure

reviews.author: GuptaSajal
reviews.title: 3 Great Nights in Khyber
reviews.text:
This property is right next to the Gulmarg Gandola and walking distance from the Gulmarg market. One side provides the view of the golf course and the other of the snow covered peaks. The service is next level here. The staff is very friendly and will help you with everything. My wife and me got a free upgrade to a higher category of room when we had a minor issue with the one we had booked  (Noise from the other guests, since they were 10 of them with a few rooms next to ours). She had surprised me for my Birthday and while we out of the hotel, the staff had decorated the entire room on her request. There were other several occasions when we thought that the hospitality exceeded our expectations. 

Please note that the hotel does not serve or sell any kind of alcoholic drinks. The CALABASH is the hookah lounge where guests are welcome to get their own alcoholic drinks and enjoy the evening in a cozy ambiance. CHAIKASH is the Coffee shop from where you can try the fresh Kavah or a warm beverage and enjoy it in the outdoor seating with a view of the snow covered mountains. 

The fitness center is a mix of Kashmiri and Modern architecture and one definitely has to jump in the pool which overlooks the forest with pine trees. There is a SPA as well which i believe is operated by L'Occitane. We did not get the chance to book a session but I am sure it would have been worth it as well. 

I would recommend this property to anyone travelling to Gulmarg and one can visit it any time of the year since every season in Kashmir is magical.

reviews.title: Dream vacation
reviews.text: Haven't enjoyed any resort as the Khyber Gulmarg . Every aspect of our stay was special . Special mention of the house keeping staff . They were outstanding . Special mention of Kaiser he really knew what outstanding Hospitality means .

reviews.author: Mahendra Soni
reviews.title: Experience the Best Window view!
reviews.text:
I planned my trip just seven day in advance and after going through couple of articles I decided that Khyber seems to be the only luxury choice available in Kashmir. I did not know much about the property so had very limited expectations But as soon I checked in and entered my room I could not believe the view I saw from the Balcony. in onne word BREATHTAKING. Some important points
 - Always choose the Himalayn View room even if you have to pay a big premium. Trust me even a 500% premium is worth it.
- Bring your Alchohal yes Bring your Alchoal
- Bring your Swimming accessories or else you will miss the best swimming experience in all weatherbest indoor swimming pool (google Kyber swimming pool view)
- They serve good (not great) food and the menu is vast. The best thing is they serve many varieties of good tea which is a major plus for me. Their Kawa is not that great cause they add sugar.
- Their temperature control in the hotel is superb so you can travel anytime of the year.
- Their staff wont talk to you. Yes this is the only and biggest minus. They need to address this problem urgently if they want to meet global stanndard of hospitality. 

I could actully write 5000 words review of this property but just wanted to highlight some major poinnts.
