reviews.title: Really Heaven On Earth
reviews.text:
As being my first trip to Kashmir I am speechless and really got mesmerized by both of its beauty and the hospitality that we tasted in the middle  of Himalayas.It was stunning since we landed at Airport from there we started our Journey in heaven as mentioned by my friends,through the villages and the fir laden forests and the distinct beauty had truly made our one hour long journey tireless so the warm welcome from the front staff was impecable.The property is amazing from rooms to facilities they offer,indoor pool with sauna Jacuzzi had a nice treatment at the Spa food has great taste with variety along with high standard service that is what one expects.Surely recommend for the first stop in Kashmir. 
Truly Amazing will come to visit again in future.

reviews.author: Satendra N
reviews.title: "Absolutely Amezing"
reviews.text:
This hotel is honestly heaven in the chaos of gulmerg.the beauty of landscape nd gardens is so peaceful and relexing,that you really have to experience.
the staff is super friendly and the service is amazing.
the rooms are spacious and comfortable with all modern amenities.
Abhishek from  HK is very helpful during my stay.
I strongly recommend this Stunning establishment.

reviews.author: janecartama
reviews.title: great resort everywhere wow factor
reviews.text:
i spent my birthday in october 2017 at the khyber himalaya resort nd spa the staff and adminitration thhy are friemdly  trained veryywell
 thhe staff are profesional and well trained made one feet der home interior of the hotel and best part of the hotel is indoor heaated pool and many  more activiies over their i cn suggest everyone to come their nd visit khyber  if u go to kashmir.

reviews.author: pankaj n
reviews.title: Just wow.....
reviews.text:
As the word describes itself....warm,outstanding and wonderfull.....this hotel is simply outstanding.....prompt services is the main key of this hotel....
Staff has a smiling face with generous behaviour...
Food was authentic n very delucious....wish to visit again.....

reviews.author: Waheed Hassan
reviews.title: Breath taking scenic beauty!!
reviews.text:
The place is really awsome, as if seems untrodden place, away from the rest of the world under the shadow of Himalayas with such a beautiful Hotel around, adds luxury to the dwelling beauty.
The staff is cooperative, humble and professional, which made my stay comfortable. True kashmiri hospitality experienced.

Thanks a ton☺☺👌👌

reviews.author: Nasir R
reviews.title: Great services...keep it up
reviews.text: Very nice property with amazing views. Location is absolutely perfect. Awesome food. Generous and very helping staff. Amazing Spa, indoor swimming pool, everything is perfectly placed. Overall it was pleasing and memorable experience with Khyber. I will be looking forward to stay here again. Thank you very much for the services.

reviews.author: Javid Dar
reviews.title: Visit khyber to understand the real meaning of "Agar Firdous Baro-e-Zameen Ast.....Hamein Asto Hamein Asto Hamein Ast
reviews.text: Amazing experience, with amazing beauty all around, with amazing service and among amazing staff. whenever I visited the hotel it felt like home away from home. The hospitality of people around especially the staff is wonderful. The food is amazingly good. I would strongly recommend that everyone should visit once and then they can realize what they are missing in life. i would like to thank personally Khalida for being so helpful and generous all the time.

reviews.author: prateek s
reviews.title: Worth the price
reviews.text: Very good and comfortable hotel.. they have all the facilities one can think off...one of the best Spa and a heated swimming pool...staff is good and friendly...most of them go out of the way to make you comfortable...gulmarg as such is beautiful..

reviews.author: Rinku P
reviews.title: Snow 💕
reviews.text:
My first luxurious trip in Dec 2015. It was heaven on earth. Took a room with view of Himalayas. What more could I ask 😍 
Food spread was good for all 3 meals. 
Gulmarg is just behind the hotel so don’t have to worry about transportation. Gondola ride is awesome and the feeling of being 35000 ft above the sea level is freaking awesome. 
Liquor not allowed. They have temperature control swimming pool which at the time we visited was under renovation 😞

reviews.author: time31traveller
reviews.title: Great View and Comfortable Stay
reviews.text: A trip to Gulmarg is incomplete without visiting Khyber! Beautifully made property with a lovely stay experience! Must visit and worth every penny spent! We took a Himalayan View balcony room and that definitely is recommended!

reviews.author: Jordan_Bhan
reviews.title: WoW experience @ Khyber
reviews.text: One of the best Resort in entire Gulmarg. Especially the views from the rooms. Product is awesome. Services are up to the mark. Staff is highly professional. We had a great time and wish Khyber team all the best. Will come soon again.

reviews.author: Ovase K
reviews.title: Wonderful place with wonderful people
reviews.text:
Visiting Khyber is like stepping back in time.The best of the Resorts I have ever visited till now.They have a unique way of doing the registration formalities by taking you to their Tea Lounge and doing the formalities while you enjoy the typical kashmir kehwa. This is followed by the complete show round of the property at your will.
The food is good & service at par with any other luxury hotel.
The pool has a breath taking view so has the spa rooms.

reviews.author: Karishma R
reviews.title: Great resort in Kashmir
reviews.text: I visited Khyber with my family for lunch it was great. The interior of resort is amazing. Staff is so friendly, we met Asst. Front office Manager Mr. Manzoor he was so polite and professional towards his work. Will surely stay in Khyber on our next trip. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: guptasanjeev49
reviews.title: mesmerizing
reviews.text: The location of the hotel is amazing with a lovely views, homely feel and very attentive staff great food and service.Must visit once in a lifetime.Basharat and Manzoor were great .great spa and love to be back soon .

reviews.author: mriduchamaria
reviews.title: Home away from home
reviews.text: Khyber is THE place to stay in Gulmarg...one has to experience the hospitality to know what the stay is about..the staff was very warm..a special Thanx to Manzoor n Khalida for making our stay so comfortable n memorable...also Mr Shyam who made sure our taste buds we're satisfied to the T...he was like a wizard waving his wand n the best of the cuisine would b on your table...the indoor pool was a nice place to relax n unwind...looking forward to coming again during winter

reviews.author: Toufeeq Ahmad
reviews.title: amazing view nice staff ... Ishfaq
reviews.text: we been dere along with my friends Ishfaq,Irfan and all ...are friendly ... we had pizza and tea out side it was just like dat we are in heaven the beauty and hotel design are out of this world ... i would love to be dere again ...insha allah ,,,

reviews.author: Shailaja SS
reviews.title: Beautiful Location
reviews.text: The only good thing about this property is its location. Rooms are just good. Food very average. They seem to have a very crazy system when tourists come in vehicles hired from Srinagar, they do not permit either the vehicle be parked at the hotel or the driver to stay there. The staff at the restaurant speak extremely loud. The only saving grace was a staff by the name of Shaukat at the restaurant who was very polite and did his job well.

reviews.author: jenilthanky
reviews.title: Super fun
reviews.text: Had visited the property during the end lag of September. The drive to the property is scenic. The hotel is warm & cozy. People are also very friendly. Did not feel any safety issues in & around the property. Would like to mention a special thanks to Aizaj. He really took great care during our dinner time. Thanking irfan for real good sheesha. Overall really satisfied with the service & warmth of the entire hotel staff. Thank you for a memorable holiday.

reviews.author: Jibran A
reviews.title: The Best Hotel in Kashmir.
reviews.text: Undoubtedly best place to stay in Whole Kashmir, Amazing food with efficient service, Snow fall on day-2 of our trip was icing on cake. Spacious room with sunken bath and beautiful valley view. Thanks to the Khyber team to give amazing start to our 7 nights trip in Kashmir. 😊❤

reviews.author: NTR
reviews.title: Brilliant Architect with Wonderful View!!!
reviews.text: Undoubtedly best place to stay in Gulmarg, Amazing food with efficient service... Snow fall on day-2 of our trip was icing on cake.. Spacious room with sunken bath and beautiful valley view. Thanks to the Khyber team to give amazing start to our 7 nights trip in Kashmir.

reviews.author: AhujaAggrawal
reviews.title: True sample Of Kashmiri Hospitality.
reviews.text: Without doubt one of the favorite hotels I stayed during my time in Kashmir. The Khyber Himalayan Resorts and Spa Is the best Property in the whole jammu and kashmir. It reflects true sense of kashmiri culture. I would advice everyone to visit kashmir and to Stay in Khyber Himalayan Resorts And Spa.

reviews.author: Ashish A
reviews.title: Beautiful hotel, beautiful setting, very nice staff
reviews.text: Title says it all. The hotel is at the foothills of a mountain, close to everything. The hotel grounds are beautiful and meticulously maintained. The staff is super-attentive and caters to all your needs. Loved our stay there. Wish it was longer.

reviews.author: Niyati M
reviews.title: amazing place, amazing time
reviews.text:
Travelled in march 2016, we were 3 couples with 3 kids each 4 years old and we had a fantastic time in khyber, they took utmost care and made sure everything was just right. 
Our presidential cottage, had a huge space with a heated jacuzzi, a person butler mr. sajjad who was just very warm and made sure the kids were well looked after as well. 
It was cold and snowing in march, but their heated pool was super for all of us to have a great time. An amazing experience. Food was delicious and they did make it to the requirement of our kids too. A must for all to visit here.

reviews.author: nrm77
reviews.title: AMAZING!
reviews.text: As part of my birthday gift to my husband, I had booked an entire holiday to Kashmir, with stays at the top hotels in Srinagar and Gulmarg. We only stayed at the Khyber for a day, but what a memorable stay it was! Gulmarg is truly heaven on earth. The peak of Mt Apharwat offers some of the best views ever! Loved it. The hotel itself is spectacular! The spa and the pool in particular are just incredible. The views are incredible too. We had kashmiri biryani/pulao for lunch at one of the restaurants (I think it was called Cloves), and it was amazing! The cheeses were incredible too. Rooms were really comfortable as well. Overall - Khyber is one of the best hotels I've stayed at in India, and I am so glad that we celebrated my husbands birthday here.

reviews.author: triphank
reviews.title: Best in Gulmarg
reviews.text:
I had a nice stay at the hotel this year in February. It is very close to Gondola and had a lot of ski shops nearby. 
The rooms have a nice mountain view and the Kashmiri food at the restaurant is awesome.

reviews.author: govindbabu
reviews.title: The Khyber - Gulmarg
reviews.text:
I went for a meeting in Gulmarg and the attraction was that it was in The Khyber resort.
Kashmir is always a great place to go to and i have been going there since 1982 and I have loved every trip.
The drive from Srinagar airport is about 1.5 hours,one doesnot enter the city of Srinagar but there is a bypass towards Gulmarg.The route is through some tiny villages ,some dry dirty regions and then you enter the hillside and gradually climb up throufgh forests of pine trees and winding roads, the air gets crispy and chilly an we ascend up.The route is lined with many apple and apricot orchards.beautiful sights!
The drive into the lobby is a little steep.You are greeted at the reception warmly and welcomed with their traditional drink - Khava , which is a sweetish brew with chopped almonds - quite refreshing/
The check in was smooth,The lobby and reception area is well decorated with many atrtefacts. The room is large with very comfortable bed and bath.The view out of my room was of pine trees and the Arrafat mountain range.
The group met up late afternoon and we went out for a drive and Gondola ride.
The dinner was a grand affair with traditional Kasmiri dishes.
A great place to stay even when it was not the season of snow.
This ia rated as one of the 10 best resorts in India and after staying here i realised why it is so.

reviews.author: amit_8
reviews.title: Heaven in mountains
reviews.text: A beautiful hotel property in Gulmarg. Excellent rooms, excellent food. the staff is brilliant. Special mention of Mr Jaffer Malik, Manager , He is brilliant in looking after Guest comfort, always smiling and upto task. he made our stay special. the spa is great, the staff better at the spa . overall an amazing property to stay.

reviews.author: AnAustralianAngel
reviews.title: Simply Heaven !!
reviews.text:
This resort has the best location. The views are simply fantastic. The food is good. Service is polite n friendly. Management are very helpful. I loved everybit of my stay. Will reccommend anyday and will surely return. 

Great for couples, families or friends. 

Look at my pics and u will know this place is worth coming.

reviews.author: RanjanGoenka
reviews.title: Our visit to the resort 24Oct - 26Oct 2015
reviews.text: Had booked the hotel on recommendation of a friend. Truly, it exceeded my expectations. Despite its ground spread, the property is maintained immaculately with friendly people all around you to extend any assistance. Great to see the GM always around meeting and greeting guests. The swimming pool surrounded by snow beyond the surrounding glass walls was amazing. Keep it up !! However, I feel WiFi should have been free - it seemed too petty for being charged for it.

reviews.author: Gautam m
reviews.title: The place to stay
reviews.text:
A property to die for. Simply its the best property one can find in Gulmarg with breathtaking view and great food.
The property has a proper spa with an indoor heated pool . The Staff is very courteous and helpful.

reviews.author: Nitu Jain
reviews.title: Nitu Jain
reviews.text: Excellent hospitality in every sense..The perfect view, the perfect atmosphere in the resort even though it was snowing outside. Every member in the resort makes it a point to make you extra comfortable. A must visit. Thank you Khyber for the memorable time we had there.

reviews.author: Rahul L
reviews.title: Gulmarg
reviews.text:
This is the best property that you will find in Gulmarg; overall a very pleasant place with good hospitable staff.
Sometimes the rush during the evening hours in the resturant does make the place look a little out of place but easily understandable.

reviews.author: renuyou2015
reviews.title: Fantastic service, excellent people and cannot thank them enough for handling emergencies so well
reviews.text: We had 150 people form our family staying at the Khyber for 3 days from 2nd oct 2015 - 5th Oct 2015. The hotel handled such a big group with all smiles and excellent service. We enjoyed every bit of the stay, felt like our home for all age groups.  We had 2 emergencies, serious ones and cannot stop Thanking the hotel in the manner they handled the situations. they were so efficient and calm, we did not have to worry at all. They are superb, we all highly recommend the hotel and would love to go back again! Love the pool and its location

reviews.author: Reshmi_Sameeth
reviews.title: A Memorable Stay !!!
reviews.text:
I travelled to Kashmir with my family in the month of October.We chose to stay at Gulmarg and from the tripadvisor reviews we decided to book Khyber.And I am extremely happy to say that we were not at all disappointed.Infact it turned out to be one of the most memorable holidays ever.We stayed in the balcony room with mountain view and the view was just awesome.
The food and service at Cloves Restaurant was extremely good . 
Khyber is within walking distance from Gondola .Also,there are some local sight seeing spots nearby.
Khyber shall surely be my choice if I ever visit Gulmarg again.

reviews.author: Sivakumar S
reviews.title: Our trip to Gulmarg.
reviews.text:
Friends this was our first time to Srinagar and its a 75 mins travel to Gulmarg there we received a very warm welcome from the team there.

We stayed in the presidential suite and we're ably assisted by Mr.Sajjad who was our Butler for the day.

We also enjoyed the offerings at the spa and found them to be well trained for the task.

In all it was a very memorable trip

reviews.author: rohitgurgaonguy
reviews.title: Could have been much better
reviews.text: We recently stayed in Khyber resorts gulmarg and we rate our stay as average. The hotel is new & has god rooms but same cannot be said about their food and service. The food is very rich and in spite of putting a special request for light food we had lots of cream and rich gravies. The service also is slow. The views from the hotel could have been better. Overall average.

reviews.author: Jignesh d
reviews.title: The best of best hotel
reviews.text:
Quick check in and check out
Superb hotel
Great view ( breath taking)
Excellently maintained 
Already recommended and they loved the place
Never seen such a superb resort
They had the courtesy to call back and inform that we have forgotten some valuables.

reviews.author: pranav kapur
reviews.title: Pool with the view
reviews.text:
If you like the mountains you will love this Resort.
We booked the cheapest room so it did not have the best view but we hardly spent any time there.
Its a spa so they don't serve alcohol but I suggest you carry your best malt for that weather.
The indoor heated pool has got the best view so don't forget to take your trunks.

The only issue was the smell in the corridor which refused to go on both the days we were there for.

reviews.author: Madhvesh
reviews.title: Charming Place to Stay in Heaven
reviews.text: Truly world class hotel with charms of Kashmir embedded! Will recommend every body to stay here if you can. The only bit of concern was that the food choice was a bit limited which should not be for a hotel of its class!

reviews.author: manisha91086
reviews.title: 5 star property  The most beautiful and luxurious hotel
reviews.text: Very good property  and good service  .Situated on a hilltop in Gulmarg. Travelling time by car is approximately 1.5 hours from Srinagar airport.  Was staying in 1001 room . Spacious luxury rooms.with pine tree and chinara trees view .

reviews.author: Ashok S
reviews.title: The most beautiful and luxurious hotel
reviews.text: This place is breathtaking stunning. Three sides of hotel was covered with ice up to 2nd floor (avoid taking basement floor in winters). Walkable distance to Gandola rides. Excellent indoor hot water pool and tastefully decorated alleys. Internet access is limited because of government control. Otherwise pretty safe place.

reviews.author: Sarbari G
reviews.title: The most desirable place to stay in Gulmarg
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Khyber for one night in October 2015.  Tired  from all the adventure one had undertaken during the day, I just wanted to slump into a chair to never get up again.  However, the reception staff were very friendly and courteous and helped me by encouraging me to take rest, being nice and hospitable to me and even showing  multiple rooms so that I could choose one with a good view.  

I have forgotten the name of the lady from the reception who showed us to our room, but her service orientation was excellent.  She stayed around till I was happy with the room that was allocated to me.  

The room was very nice needless to say, like all other five star facilities.  lovely bathroom with separate cubicle for showers, WC and a great bathtub.  all other facilities of tea/coffee, TV etc like any other five star facilities were available in the room. 

I would like to write about what I liked about the hotel.  I liked their service orientation. I have already written about the lady from the reception who needs a special mention.  now about others -  I needed to get a pair of trousers laundered and they did that within three hours.  I also loved the restaurant staff, their attentiveness, the quality of the food and their friendly services.   

the hotel's location is fantastic, surrounded by the mountains and jungles, beautiful large french glass windows and lovely decor, the rooms are welcoming and warm. 

I did not use the spa so cant write about that.  They could have given free WiFi but that did not matter much.

It is certainly the most desirable place to stay in Gulmarg.  I came back as a happy guest.

reviews.author: TrueIndian
reviews.title: Excellent Place to Unwind
reviews.text:
Situated on a hilltop in Gulmarg. Travelling time by car is approximately 1.5 hours from Srinagar airport.
Check In and Check Out is very swift.
On arrival one is greeted with "Kahwa" (Kashmiri Green Tea).Thereafter one is escorted to the room.
The rooms are very spacious with king beds with an attached balcony overlooking the meadows. 
The bathroom is also spacious with a bath tub also provided.
Although there is an air conditioner temperature control in the room but still the room becomes very hot at night and can lead to perspiration.
In room slippers and shoe shine are not available.
The resort has a gym, indoor swimming pool, and a spa.
There are multiple restaurants.
The menu includes dishes from all over the country but Kashmiri Wazwan is very delicious and worth trying once during your stay.
There is a convention hall also for meetings.
The resort is very close to Gulmarg Gandola entry.
The room tariff is very high but worth a visit.

reviews.author: Swetakandoi
reviews.title: Luxury amidst nature!
reviews.text: We were at Khyber with a mix ed group of friends and family,also varying in nature,but the property and staff extended themselves to make it a memorable trip.The Indian food is sumptuous,the temperature controlled indoor pool is a treat in the cold weather,l'occitaine spa is super,overall we had an excellent trip.

reviews.author: Clonemole
reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.text:
We stayed for just a night in Sep'15. The service quality is very good, you are given a thorough welcome brief by a customer service lady which is rare nowadays . 
Food is good but not great. The massages very slightly expensive but worth the money. And the indoor heated pool is the cherry on top. 
Gulmarg as a place is very basic offering splendid scenic beauty. Making this hotel as a base for your Gulmarg more than makes sense as it is the best in the area.

reviews.author: GaurAgar
reviews.title: Luxury in the lap of nature
reviews.text: The Khyber resort and spa at Gulmarg, J&K India provides a feel of the nature while providing all the luxuries of a five star hotel. The all wood finish makes this an exquisite property. The food was great- specially the waazwaan. The pool and spa are great. Rooms as well Nouf- the terrace provide a great view of the trees and the peaks all around. On the down-side- the room temperature control did not work- so had to just do with whatever temperature the system set for itself. And even when the tariff is so stiff- the hotel doesn't provide any free wi-fi anywhere in the hotel. Even the paid wi-fi was painfully slow. BSNL Mobile signal did not exist in most parts of the hotel.

reviews.author: sanjuverma
reviews.title: very good, calm and awesome hotel
reviews.text:
excellent hotel, all wood wood finish everywhere. I loved the place though expensive. we were greeted very warmly but at the entrance luggage was scanned and we were told to open bags, disappointing.
we paid Rs35800/- for two rooms for one night plus we paid Rs 5000/- extra for two kids. they gave us Gulmarg side view which was disappointed, we requested for mountain view rooms which was politely declined stating hotel is full. it was not true as one can see next morning, it was not even half occupied. staff is very polite and courteous but only in talking, not in making small favors for their guest. 

excellent indoor pool, Jacuzzi and sauna. enjoyed thoroughly. 
Wi-Fi is not free.

reviews.author: The_Meanderer
reviews.title: Preparing for the winters
reviews.text:
Full marks for a great view from the hotel towards the mountains, appetizing meals (special thanks to the chef for kid meals), courteous staff & for the property itself.

Issues were regarding the reservation desk at the time of booking, inflexibility on dates even in off-season (and It was off season!), intentional or unintentional ignorance of local developments and lack of complimentary wifi (even budget hotels offer free wifi these days). The worst of it all was the smell of paint right outside our balcony; think they were preparing for the winters when the foreigners come in droves. My sense is this could have been easily avoided with better logistics given the low occupancy during our stay.

reviews.author: gurinder o
reviews.title: good hotel
reviews.text: very good rooms excellent stay.front desk manager is so nice they upgrade my room free of coost.resturent bit expensive.sona steam gym swimming stunning.loction of balcoany rooms  perfect.definitely best hotel in gulmarg.

reviews.author: nitingupta2015
reviews.title: Dream Destination
reviews.text: We had two nights stay at this awesome property. The stay was made memorable by the hospitality and the warmth shown by the staff. Would like to thank the entire team right from Sujeet(even though he was traveling) to Zafar to Manzoor. Might not remember most of the names but everyone was very courteous. Zafar had arranged for a cake which was deliiiicious on our anniversary. Thanks so much to the entire team for putting up a great show. But for the initial communication gap, I would rate the entire trip as a dream.

reviews.author: Indore Rocks
reviews.title: Jammu & Kashmir's heavenly beauty is only complemented by this great resort !
reviews.text:
It is really a great Small Luxury Hotel - how resorts are meant to be ! Definitely the best in Gulmarg or rather in whole of Jammu & Kashmir ! 

The resort is marvellous with its decor, ambience, location, and people. Location is the best bit. We travelled in a large group of Young Indians (Yi) - around 80 of us (yeah) !!! And had the resort to us. 

The rooms & suites were brilliant - each overlooking the Himalayan mountains or the Gulmarg village, both picturesque. The balconies in the rooms were just superb. 

The staff took great care. The managers and their team members were all brilliant. especially Mr. Mallik Zaffar. 

Although the food was quite good, the vegetarian options may be improved. The Kashmiri Tea - Kahwa - is served every day and is brilliant. 

The L'Occitane Spa is wonderful, though only same-gender therapists allowed. 

The temperature-controlled indoor swimming pool overlooking the valley is superb, however, it had some mosaic tiles coming off when we went and needed some repairs. 

There are various other entertainment options, but we didn't get to try many as we had lots to do with the group. 

Our arrangements were made all the more easy & brilliant because our complete tour's booking & stay arrangements were made by J&K's best travel agency - Shiraz Travels, Srinagar. 

We had a brilliant time going on one of world's highest ropeways - the Gulmarg Gondola. And we also enjoyed teeing off at one of world's highest golf courses too - the Gulmarg Golf Club !

reviews.author: Pravinmainkar
reviews.title: 60 th birthday celebration
reviews.text:
Excellent We have been there on 25 th September 2015.
Great hospitality.
Nice location with good view from our balcony.
I have celebrated my 60 th birthday on that day.
Unforgettable experience.
Excellent & tasty food.
Thinking of visiting again with my son & daughter when they visit India.

reviews.author: Amitabh  Y
reviews.title: Khyber himalyan Resort and spa at gulmarg kashmir a heaven on earth by "My Family Escapes"
reviews.text: Khyber Himalayan Resort and spa is situated in town of Gulmarg. The capital of state of jammu and kashmir in India I would recommended the Himalayan view room it is spectacular worth every penny food was great there is a lovely sheesha cigar lounge I don't have words to describe the beauty of the place and the view of the hotel. Services are excellent.Loved enjoyed long hours at the balcony. Very cooperative and attentive staff. Extremely helpful.  recommended to me by My Family Escapes..

reviews.author: Ruchi K
reviews.title: Great Hospitality!
reviews.text: We stayed in the two bedroom cottage  in Khyber for two nights 2nd and 3rd October . The location of the property is ethereal , the tranquility is mesmerizing and the beauty of the nearby hills ( the view from our cottage ) simply exquisite !! Thank u for the great hospitality and service at Khyber ! We had a great holiday ! Special mention for our friendly driver Mr Shahnawaz who got us from the airport and took us back to Srinagar !

reviews.author: a2z_pune
reviews.title: Excellent location with beautiful decor!
reviews.text:
This a true 5 star hotel placed at excellent location.  The views it offers are absolutely breathtaking!  I went with my wife and kids and we truly enjoyed the stay. 

Pros: 
1.  Excellent property with great amenities.
2.  Courteous staffs
3.  Sumptuous breakfast

Cons:
1.  Expensive!
2.  Wifi per day costs INR 750/- per device which should have been complimentary.
3.  The local union at Gulmarg will make thing unpleasant.  You cannot park your own vehicle at the hotel or take it to the local market.  The hotel needs to put some check on them or at least allow complimentary drop or pick up from the local market.

At the moment Khyber is the only 5 star property in the region; and offers the experience you may want to have!

reviews.author: Bijoy M P
reviews.title: First anniversary at heaven
reviews.text: It was our first anniversary and we decided to spend the weekend at gulmarg and we have booked khyber for 3 nights. it was 3 hours drive from srinagar airport. excellent location. walkable distance from gondola station. checkin was smooth with a welcome drink the traditional kashmiri kahwa. we have booked premier room but we got an upgradation to luxury balcony room with himalayan view. no words for the view from the room.simply awesome...!!! overall excellent luxury hotel at 8825 ft above sea level.

reviews.author: Vineet_Gautam
reviews.title: Heaven on earth
reviews.text: We were here for 3 days and 2 nights . A very hurriedly planned trip but this place was in my mind for long  and it disappoint a bit. This is he best place to go .. The hotel is just beautiful with all modern amenities you can ask for . Though there was no snow but would love to go back when there is snow. Staff is good and food very very good though breakfast choices could be improved . We tried mutton biryani which undoubtedly was the best I ever had . Even dum aloo Kashmiri was very good ...

reviews.author: Sirinder
reviews.title: Weekend Getaway at Khyber Resort.
reviews.text: Spent a weekend end of September. A really beautiful experience. The room was excellent with a breathtaking view of the snow-capped mountains. Service was courteous and efficient; food very good, with a wide variety of choices. Highlight was the beautiful indoor swimming pool with sauna/Jacuzzi and a well equipped gymnasium

reviews.author: hotelshreeresidency
reviews.title: Stunning view from Swimming pool & spa
reviews.text:
This resort is the best in Gulmarg. In late summers or monsoons you may find it a little overpriced because no snow covered peaks are visible from the hotel. 
But yes once the snowfall starts till early summers this resort is pure luxury with amazing views from the Chaikash (Tea Lounge), Centrally heated Swimming pool, Spa Rooms, room balcony, etc............(SNOW....SNOW.... & SNOW covered trees)
Truly a five star hospitality between the snow.......

reviews.author: Rohit S
reviews.title: Gem in the hills
reviews.text:
It took us exactly 3.5 hrs from boarding the flight from Delhi & reaching Khyber - may be the quickest that we reached any hill station from Delhi.

Contrary to what we were expecting (post the floods & related issues), the drive from Srinagar to Gulmarg was pretty smooth.

The hotel is set in quite a picturesque setting with excellent view of Himalaya. The property itself could be one of the best hill station resort that I know of in India. The room was extremely comfortable with all usual amenities, food was also tasty.

Although most of the hotels in Gulmarg were closed as an after effect of what happened in Srinagar, it was good to know about Khyber managements decision to keep the property open. 

It has already started getting a bit cold, day temperature was 9 degree - please carry adequate clothing if planning a trip. Reminds me of something I heard 'The weather is never bad, It's the clothing that you carry'.

Sincere advice to everyone - If you were planning a trip to Gulmarg, please firm up your plans. I am coming back in Dec to spend Christmas.

reviews.author: Jeevan_Talwar
reviews.title: Good Hotel But Pathetic Service
reviews.text: Khyber is one of the Best and only 5 star Hotel in Gulmarg. Its one of the most recent constructed hotel in Gulmarg having activities for almost every age group . The Hotel Luxury Rooms are very nicely done and so are the washrooms . The rooms with balcony are very airy and welcoming giving warm feeling to the guest . But the story on the service part is most unexpected or unacceptable . We checked in in the hotel around 2.30 PM . The rooms which were provided were 1 Himalayan view and other was Gulmarg View . We refused to accept Gulmarg view as it had hopeless view and  looked very dull compared to the Himalayan view rooms . The  Hotel blocked the ( Himalayan View rooms ) rooms for the guests who didn't even checked in . On our request the manager agreed to give 2 Adjoining rooms with same view . Although both the rooms weren't ready and we were told to enjoy lunch in the meanwhile our ( 2 rooms ) will be ready . We entered in the Restaurant and the buffet was going on but we decided to go for Ala cart  order .The order was placed at 3 PM . The food wasn't served to us uptill 3.45 PM . On asking the waiter the repply was blunt and shocking that the staff was busy dealing with room service and buffet thats why we weren't served the food . Finally we had to call manager and FnB Head for our rescue and provide food at 4.00 PM . A 5 star hotel takes 1 hour to serve food . There is no denial that food served was HOT and tasty . The Hotel has a very nice kids play area equipped with all facilities like XBOX air hockey carom-board blocks etc . There is nice heated swimming pool too. Overall all our experience was good . This hotel is meant to stay for atleast 2 Nights . The Gondola Ride is just walking distance from the hotel . The surroundings are lush green and a Nature loving person would love to be here . You can also see Top of Gondola from balcony view rooms .

reviews.author: Shameemnahvi
reviews.title: Simply WOW !!
reviews.text:
First of all I ll like to say THANKS A TON AAMIR ANWAR,who suggested me to visit HOTEL KHYBER.It has been an awesome experience of mine to visit the hotel.
AMBIENCE AND LOCATION::The ambience and location of the resort is unparalleled.Its has the most beautiful location matching to that of world class resorts,and trust me guys u ll skip a beat when u ll get a sight of the landscape.
FOOD AND SERVICES :: The quality and class of food is simply superb.Apart from that the MENU is very diverse.We get all types ,all varieties of INDIAN,CHINESE,ITALIAN AND CONTINENTAL cuisines that too very relishing.The staff is very much trained and hospitable.
VALUE TO MONEY :: Just one word...guys u ll get more than 100% in return..

reviews.author: OccTraveler2013
reviews.title: Breathtaking location and beautiful hotel
reviews.text:
The resort is situated at a breathtaking location, surrounded by the majestic Himalyas, close to the Gondolas and the golf course. The service is as wonderful as the resort architecture and amenities. The staff very warm and generally efficient. 
The breakfast was super but he restaurant food was not up to a standard of an Indian world-class hotel. The servers and their supervisors still seem to be on a learning path. I am sure that will get better but was a little disappointing.
One thing that was a pleasant surprise in a difficult health situation was that they have a resident doctor at the hotel. My sister had trouble related to her heart disease when we were there and I suffered from diarrhea when we came to the hotel. It was Dr. NAZIR AHMED who helped us. His expertise, including on-the-spot medications were very helpful and kept our overall trip experience extremely positive. Thank you to Khyber management for having such a thoughtful arrangement. 
A truly rejuvenating experience.

reviews.author: fassil123
reviews.title: Excellent Stat
reviews.text: Excellent Location, Amazing and tasty food with courteous staff around. It is a Pearl in Kashmir. I would say it exceeds expectations..... I along with my Family Loved the stay and we will come back to Khyber soon..

reviews.author: sangeeetaa
reviews.title: Wah Khyber
reviews.text: We were originally booked in vintage but had to change to Khyber as vintage was closed for putting a Stp & we didn't regret it one bit. Good rooms with balcony though service is little slow, food is also good but on the expensive side as average per person comes to about 2500/- with soft drinks & mineral water. They must inform that pool, spa & bar is not operational at the time of booking only. Overall recommended

reviews.author: Ron and Jeanne B
reviews.title: Lives up to its billing as a luxury Himalayan resort, but no alcohol.
reviews.text: Truly upscale public and private areas, with a nice “mountain” feel.  Excellent dinner and breakfast buffet.  Good service from all staff.  Spacious and very well appointed rooms with good views from all of them (as best we could tell). Very clean.  However, several areas and facilities (e.g. spa and swimming pool) under construction/reconstruction in October 2013, no elevators (although it’s only three stories) and, temporarily, no view from dining room. Furthermore, views of the mountains were almost total obscured by air pollution on our visit (we didn’t even bother taking the gondola ride)—but we were assured this is not a problem in the winter and earlier in the summer. (Of course,we have had many assurances in India of things which didn’t turn out to be true!)

reviews.author: jt05
reviews.title: Amazingly charming hotel in a spectacular setting
reviews.text: This is an amazing charming hotel in a spectacular setting.  The rooms are fabulous and the views from the room and bathroom are stunning. The service is great and the staff is very friendly and welcoming. Probably one of the best hotels I have stayed in India.

reviews.author: Ajay G
reviews.title: What a location
reviews.text: Very we'll located and super place. Very new. Great view from the rooms. Did not feel like leaving the hotel. Grand breakfast and superb food in the restaurant . Nice balcony and friendly staff. Hotel follows a no alcohol policy

reviews.author: Gurrinder
reviews.title: Good hotel but the location
reviews.text: During our visit to gulmarg we stayed in khyber resorts & it was well come change after staying in highlands park over the years. Good rooms & food but the location is not as good as what highlands park had to offer. We also missed the spa, pool & bar all being non operational. Overall the best option in gulmarg.

reviews.author: chinnupaulose
reviews.title: Great service,Great Stay...
reviews.text:
A beautiful property with breathtaking view, the Khyber Himalayan Resort would add on to your Kashmir experience without any doubt!!!
The rooms were excellent with great interiors and detail. The view from the balcony of your room is one which I promise, you will never get tired of !!!
Have to put a special mention for the GM, Mr. Alex Koshy and the staff for the hospitality extended during our entire stay there. Great Service, Great Stay...
Our only disappointment was, that we could not see the place all covered with snow and take in the same view from the balcony of our rooms.Could not imagine how beautiful that would be too.

An experience that we would love to relive again !!! this time when it snows!!! 

The Khyber is a excellent choice for couples as well as family or with friends.Totally recommend it...

reviews.author: manu_manmadhan
reviews.title: Heaven on Hills !
reviews.text:
Had an excellent experience during our stay at Khyber !
Every aspect of Hospitality right from the time we entered the Property premises till we checked out left a memorable experience in us. A special mention goes out to the GM & all the staff who made us feel at home with their warmth. The rooms too were well anointed with a breathtaking view of the hills ! Would recommend Khyber as a must stay when you visit Kashmir.

reviews.author: Swati
reviews.title: Stopping by woods......
reviews.text: The Khyber Himalayan Resort is a very pleasent surprise.....a modern yet vintage, beautiful in wood, huge yet well guarded, probably the highest and with best views....all the good things that can be for a beauty loving traveller. We loved the Kahwah...which was extremely refreshing complete with the crunchy almonds. The rooms were fantastic, the bathrooms excellent, the views from the rooms breathtaking, staff well trained and courteous. The restaurant definitely demands special mention with an elaborate breakfast spread. The chef was prompt to serve the custom made continental dishes which were delicious as well. My 5 yrs old child also loved the food here. The lounge with various kinds of sitting arrangements leaves one in awe. This also houses a little area which all kids seemed to love. The evenings felt good at the lounge teaming with happy families relaxing here. Overall, such a superb stay in Gulmarg which does not even have a local residential area is amazing.

reviews.author: Indranil R
reviews.title: Excellent Hotel
reviews.text:
This is one of the best properties in Gulmarg. It is a very modern hotel with 5 star facilities. The view of the snow clad mountains is excellent from the rooms as well as from the lawns. 

The food is OK but not great.

The rooms are very clean with modern facilities, tea coffee makers, etc. 

The toilet is very elaborate and extremely modern. 

The hotel is located very strategically near the gondola station. 

However, since private transport is not allowed inside Gulmarg, one has to hire a pony to approach the hotel. 

This is an ideal hotel for honeymooners.

reviews.author: RAYEES K
reviews.title: On top of the world
reviews.text: Had an awesome experience at khyber.What a beautiful place this is. The hotel is luxurious with spectacular views. One can just sit in the balcony and keep watching the mountains and feel the weather changing from sunny to cloudy to sunny again.Full marks to the staff on the hospitality front.Food Quality, Rooms all are just Superb.The multicuisine restaurants, luxurious rooms, housekeeping and room service waiting for you hand and foot, amazing views from the room, spot-less bathrooms will make you feel royal.

reviews.author: anu26
reviews.title: Relaxed holiday
reviews.text: Had an awesome experience at Kyber Resort,the check in was fast and delicious kahwa was offered upon arrival.The view from the rooms was breathtaking as we had informed the hotel we wanted good view rooms..Had read negative reviews for this property,but ours was amazing..It is a very hospitable propert where you raise your eyes and a person would come and ask if anything is required.. The buffet spread was lavish.i would specially thank Mr Mudassar( concierge) who made our stay a memorable one.. He had arranged our gondola passes too.The hotel provides an excellent free shuttle service to the dhabbas and shops nearby..A must try is their open air barbeque restaurant which serves excellent continental food..As we wanted to have lunch outside the hotel one day,we were told to have at Bakshi dhabi by the hotel,but I would recommend Vashnoo Dhaba which is just adjacent to Bakshi..it serves very good food.Gondola is very near to Kyber so very accessible..I would expect that they soon start their spa and more activities in the evenings..Movie theatre is very good in the resort but they charge a handsome money to book a show..Overall i give 10 upon 10

reviews.author: gopalmittal

reviews.text:
Perfect holiday destination. never thought that a property like this is created in heaven!!
 just awesome.
Food is also very good. 
Only check in was delayed don't know why.

reviews.author: Stormsurgeon
reviews.title: Not so great Khyber Experience- it's a Tourist Trap!
reviews.text:
After a lovely stay at the Gurkha houseboats in Srinagar we headed to Gulmarg and checked into the Khyber and had reservations for 2 rooms - 5003 and 5005. The reservations were made a month in advance and Mr. Wajid was handling it for us. He also assured us that he would include one meal along with breakfast as part of our plan.  When we reached the hotel it was lunch time and we headed straight for the buffet area which is not in the restaurants but in a hall below with round tables that makes u feel that u are eating at someone's wedding reception. As soon as we picked up our plates (we were starving) we were told that ours was a CP plan and not an MAP as Wajid had promised us. We went to the Guest relations desk and spoke with Bilal and explained him the situation. He told us that Wajid had left the hotel for good and whatever commitment he had made could not be carried out by them. We asked him to clarify this with Wajid at his end, but he told us that he will get back to us. ( he never did - we had to call and ask him what was the update- which was negative) A commitment made by a hotel employee is the hotel's commitment as well. They should take responsibility and get things clarified at their end rather than make the Guest call the Reservations office and explain the whole scenario there and send mails etc of the communication. After all this they don't even have the courtesy of atleast informing us what the status is. The problem is a lunch / dinner buffet is a steep 1600 plus taxes. I feel it's extremely overpriced considering the limited buffet spread, ambience and service is concerned. For 6 of us it works out to be quite an amount ( especially when your mentally prepared that the deal includes breakfast and a meal) 
2. We asked the person who handled our check in if he could arrange our Gondola tickets ( he never got back to us ) - we met him the next day after we completed the ride and got only cold stares from him. 
3. The lifts do not work. Considering this is a 5 star property and a luxury hotel - this is the least that one can expect. I was with 2 kids and  I saw a lot of elderly guests having trouble climbing the innumerable stairs. 
4. We booked khyber with the hope that we could enjoy the spa and the indoor heated swimming pool. Their website prominently displays these facilities. However when we check in they tell us that the construction etc is complete but it will be commissioned in 15 days ( another disappointment )
5. The bars in both the rooms were empty - we called them to stock the bars - they never did. 
6. The flush in the toilet of 5005 didn't work - had to call them to rectify it. 
7. The drainage of the shower area was blocked and dirty, and water used to pool while taking a shower. (See pic) 
8. The shower apparatus was faulty and while taking a shower caused injury to my thumb. (See pic)
9. The fittings of the tub are so bad that they come out ( see pic ) 
10. The brown ball on the snooker table is missing - brought it to the notice - again - no response. ( it's not a big issue but I lost a close snooker game with another guest because of that ) 
11. Avoid the cold meats at the buffet - I had a glass particle in one of them and they look very stale and unappetizing. 

All in all, the khyber is the only 5 star in Gulmarg. So anyone who would like reasonable luxury and comfort would have no option but to book the khyber at its steep rates. However I feel that they need to improve on many aspects otherwise they would not do as well as they hope to do considering the poor service and customer feedback is concerned. On the plus side - the food is amazingly good and amazingly over priced as well. The steep climb to the property from the road below would make u struggle for breath no matter how fit u are and it would have been nice if there was a shuttle service ( I didn't ask them to provide me one - knowing the way they charge I would have had to pay more than a one way road trip to Srinagar !! 
Basically if u have the money to throw and can ignore the shortcomings - it's a good place to stay. Otherwise I hope that Koshy and his team buck up and improve otherwise a lot of prospective guests would be left disgruntled.

reviews.author: Devendra d
reviews.title: Super EXCELLENT
reviews.text:
just short of words to express the luxury that has gone behind making this resort, such great detailing in Interiors and with wonderful touch of Kashmiri tradition, there is nothing that you can look for or can regret.
Your visit/stay to Gulmarg would be incomplete without touching on this property.
Food Quality, Rooms all are just Superb.

reviews.author: KnottedBraid
reviews.title: Awestruck!
reviews.text: The resort is nestled in the foothills of the Himalayas. Oh...what a beautiful place this is. The hotel is luxurious with spectacular views. One can just sit in the balcony and keep watching the mountains and feel the weather changing from sunny to cloudy to sunny again. The restaurants and classy and the service is impeccable. Full marks to the staff on the hospitality front. They are extremely charming and courteous. I will be back at this wonderful place during the winters.....

reviews.author: huddysue57
reviews.title: Beautiful hotel
reviews.text:
The Khyber hotel is undoubtedly a beautiful place to stay. The balcony room we stayed in was very clean , the bed was extremely comfortable and  the view was stupendous. The staff were all very friendly and very helpful. The food was excellent , my husband had the lamb which was to die for :)
We had two issues with the hotel , one was the checking in procedure , although our booking was for a balcony room with a mountain view they though it would be ok to give us a room on the other side of the hotel until I insisted on a mountain view room. Also a member of staff knocked on our bedroom door to tell us I must go to the front desk and pay immediately , we had paid in advance through our travel agent so this was very upsetting but the issue was quickly sorted and we received an apology for the mistake . I am sure the check in procedure problems will be sorted as the staff gain more experience. We would certainly stay here again.

reviews.text:

It has to be a balcony room if one is staying at the Khyber!it's worth every penny!the rooms are very nice clean and classy service is top notch...and the food too is really good???be it alacarte or even the buffet breakfast ......

all problems wee fixd in minutes...be it wifi connection..we had IT GUY COME OVER IN5 minutes and fix it .....be it the hot wart at the tub.".was fixed in 5 minutes...they sure have taken care to make sure the stay is top notch and without any hassles...thank you KHYBER for a perfect stay....
Yes the swimming pool was not in order..but could care less about it....and only problem I thought was due to some construction work...had few workers walking around abt...but was not much of a nuisance anyways....so not a concern."
WORTH EVERY PENNY...."..

reviews.author: SunandhaV
reviews.title: Khyber - The heaven is here... here... here...
reviews.text: Khyber is one of the best places for tourism destinations in India. Coming from South India, North India was a mystery all these places. We had mixed feedbacks about our holiday destinations - Srinagar and Gulmarg. But stay in Khyber is the best of all. The multicuisine restaurants, luxurious rooms, housekeeping and room service waiting for you hand and foot, amazing views from the room, spot-less bathrooms will make you feel royal. My bday fell on our honeymoon trip and surprisingly, the roof top restaurant (Nouf) in the resort, waived our bill as a token of appreciation. It was a really nice thing to do. It was memorable and pleasant stay at Khyber and we will renew our vows next year in the same place, possibly an extended stay.

reviews.author: John K
reviews.title: As breathtaking an experience as the Himalayas
reviews.text:
My wife, daughter and I stayed at The Khyber on our trip to Gulmarg in October.
The resort is situated in a breathtaking locale..surrounded by the majestic Himalyas, close to the Gondolas and the golf course.
The service is as 'wonderful' as the resort architecture and amenities.
Truly a King among resorts in the Himalayas.
The staff very warm and highly efficient.
One should trek down to the waterfall with a picnic hamper..I am told that the trek is truly worthwhile.
A horse ride to Khilanmarg and the Paper trees is a must.
A truly rejuvenating experience.
Thank you team Khyber.

reviews.author: sacrai
reviews.title: Paradise on Earth
reviews.text:
One of the most luxurious hotels in India .Very well thought of with Great location overseeing the forest and the mountain.
Staff was courteous and helpful with every minute detail thought of.Food is very nice and service is good but the sitting area is very small making one feel cramped for space esp during breakfast.
Good stay .Must stay here if visiting Gulmarg.Checkout needs to be smoother.Takes a lot of time.
TIP: Select the rooms with balcony for great view.

reviews.author: Ayush Chauhan
reviews.title: If only luxury could buy you everything...
reviews.text:
Suffice to say this is easily the most grand and the largest hotel/ resort in Gulmarg. Great location (minutes away from the Gondola), fantastic views of the hills, grand architecture, lavishly done lobby, spacious rooms, plush interiors. We stayed in their premium rooms (with attached balcony) and it was a memorable stay (the rooms are a little small for the money charged - but not unmanageably so). This was my third trip to Gulmarg and I am amazed by the warmth and hospitality of the people there - Khyber was no different. Their service was prompt - and the brutal yardstick for that is warm milk at 7am for our 20 month old daughter. They didn't let us down once ! :) 

We were in Khyber late September 2013 and the spa / indoor swimming pool / gymnasium was still coming up. They took good care to ensure that the guests weren't bothered by it and I believe they were on track to have it up and running by this winter season. 
 
But like I said, if only luxury could buy you everything.. sigh ! And I must put a caveat here - that this part of the review is very personal and therefore not everyone would agree with it. For a place as charming as Gulmarg, its a pity that Khyber makes it slightly impersonal for you. And for a resort this size and lavish, it is not surprising. So the food was good but not great - infact just a few kms away is the oldest hotel in Gulmarg - Nedous - where we were served by two old, jovial butlers who have been with Nedous for the last 35 years. And the difference became evident - in the conversations that were missing, in the home-made mutton that was distinctly Kashmiri, in the charm that slightly rustic, undone exteriors have.

So in that sense, Khyber fails to provide the warmth and culture of Gulmarg. What works for it is the luxury and the dramatic surroundings. What doesn't is the intimacy, warmth and culture that should have been there - and only for that reason you also end up feeling that it is over-priced. I wouldn't be going back without trying some other places first.

reviews.author: 719vijayk
reviews.title: Finest Hotel in India
reviews.text: One of the best hotel in India which makes ur stay special and memorable. The staff is so frndly and helpful. Delicious food with lot of cuisines to choose. Room services are so prompt. Khyber is the second attraction in gulmarg.

reviews.author: dedacain
reviews.title: Improve check out procedure
reviews.text:
We had an excellent and a comfortable stay. But they need to improve check out procedure professionally. After paying my restaurant dues and filling their review form, when I was proceeding to my taxi suddenly one person appeared and asked if I had paid the room rent. We felt really offended and did not expect such an attitude from such a famous resort. I stayed near my taxi told them that we had paid in advance through Make my trip portal and had given the vouchers at the time of check in. Another person came out after some time and said no problem and that we could leave. I had a sudden feeling that is Khyber resort only needed international tourist with big credit card in their purse? 
Anyhow as a senior contributor, it is my duty to point out the mistake by staff so that they can improve the services. Please take the American plan otherwise your food bill will be very high. I really love the attitude of restaurant manager; Deepak …Property has an excellent view and always take room with balcony. I really loved the kava served at lobby tea stall and I can never forget its aroma. Dr Jain

reviews.author: vardaan m
reviews.title: luxury redefined with beauty
reviews.text:
The decor of the hotel was classy and the rooms were luxurious along with a unique property ,fascinating views were served. The range of restaurants was good. The location was good but it was
 damn hard to walk the steppe climb.the service was also good.but the downside is the facilities chart. All the pool,spa,recreation area etc were close at the time I visited . If they are opened soon , this is a definite five star indeed.

reviews.author: Rahul C

reviews.text:
Khyber, a good property having excellent ambience and services in Gulmarg. 
Specially Mr. Bilal in Calabash is very good person and having good communication skills.

reviews.author: Voyage_De_Plaisir
reviews.title: AWESOME

The rooms are excellent with amazing view of valley and mountains , the Breakfast at their Banquet is memorable , the only missing part is THE BAR ...... Rest it is a Jewel of Kashmir ......

reviews.author: Pavan G
reviews.title: Bitter sweet experience at Khyber
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Khyber Resort at Gulmarg along with four friends on the night of 29th September. The weather was perfect with just a little chill as we drove into Gulmarg. The property is strikingly beautiful to say the least and is built like a fortress cocooning you in a world of beauty, peace and tranquility.  It is unlike most properties that one typically sees at the hill stations- it is very luxurious and tastefully done. The lobby, the tea lounge, the restaurants every thing is very warm and comfortable. The food is quite nice with a fair amount of variety for the breakfast and dinner buffet. The rooms are spacious, very well appointed and comfortable. The staff is courteous and helpful.
The only problem- but that is a big one is the lack of functioning elevators at a '7 star' place which is built over multiple levels in separate blocks that are not inter connected. We were in rooms two levels below the lobby level and each floor had 3 flights of stairs. In spite of the place having a soft launch over a year ago; the lack of a spa,proper gym etc. may not matter but the absence of elevators at a place more than 8500 feet above sea level is a serious issue. In fact, it made us curtail our vacation plan by a day due to the effect of the numerous steps augmenting the high altitude effect.
We found Khyber as one of the most amazing properties at a hill station in India. The presence of functioning elevators will go a long way in elevating the guest experience further.

reviews.author: Naresh23
reviews.title: Paradise at Gulmarg
reviews.text: Its a beautiful hotel, the food is absolutely delicious and the staff very helpful. The gondola is very close to the hotel. Recommend go both the phases. The sight is absolutely breathtaking. Even though there was no snow in september it was a great trip. Recommend October, jan to march and june july.

reviews.author: DayTrip63145269404
reviews.title: Mr. Mohammad Rafi, Arzu  and the rest of the wonderful team. I Love you guys
reviews.text:
The Khyber Himalayan Resort & Spa in Gulmarg is truly my favourite place in Kashmir. Whenever I visit Gulmarg, I make sure to dine there. The resort is beautiful, but what makes it really special is the amazing and professional staff.

The Front Office team always welcomes me like I am at home. A special thanks to Mr. Mohammad Rafi (FO Manager), who always greets us warmly and takes such good care of us. He is truly the best! He always suggests the best dishes, informs us about new promotions, and even gives us a tour of the hotel, updating us about all the new things happening in the property.

May Allah bless Mr. Mohammad Rafi and the rest of the wonderful team. I really appreciate their hospitality and I genuinely love this place and the people who work there. 🌟🏔️❤️

reviews.author: Pe
reviews.title: Mohd Rafi deserves a promotion!
reviews.text: came to celebrate a birthday and had the best time with great services and hospitality from Mohd Rafi - khyber is the best!!!

reviews.author: Climber62323863536
reviews.title: BEST STAY IN GULMARG WITH THE BEST SERVICE AND VIEW
reviews.text: Had the loveliest stay at The Khyber in Gulmarg. The property is beautiful, the views are stunning, and the whole experience was so peaceful. A big thank you to Firdous, Mubina, Junaid, and Manoj for their warm and amazing hospitality. Truly made the trip even better. 💖

reviews.author: Divya Lenin
reviews.title: Extremely Misleading Property – Not Worth the Money!!!
reviews.text:
We booked the Luxury Balcony Gulmarg View Room at The Khyber for our 5th anniversary, and the experience was extremely disappointing. The so-called “Gulmarg view” is completely fake and misleading. Instead of the beautiful valley view shown on their website and travel platforms, all you actually get is a hut view. They have conveniently erased or hidden the real images everywhere, which clearly amounts to misrepresentation and cheating customers.

The hospitality is equally poor. The staff and management seem least bothered about guest concerns, offering no proper assistance or care. For a property that claims to be luxury, the service was far below basic expectations.

Another major disappointment is the swimming pool, which they overhype in every advertisement. Shockingly, it is only accessible from 12 pm to 9 pm, and guests are not allowed to use it in the morning. This is the first hotel we’ve ever seen with such pathetic and restrictive rules, making the whole facility pointless.

Overall, this property is not worth the money. Please look for better hotels in Gulmarg—don’t fall for the misleading pictures and promises. We truly regret choosing this place for our special occasion.

reviews.author: Rana Puneet Singh

reviews.author: Afiyat P
reviews.title: The Khyber Gulmarg: Luxury, Views, and the Exceptional Service of Chef Abid Khan
reviews.text:
The Khyber Himalayan Resort & Spa in Gulmarg offers a truly magical, five-star experience, perfectly blending world-class luxury with the raw, breathtaking beauty of the Himalayas. Its stunning location near the Affarwat peaks provides instant access to adventure, while the resort’s elegant architecture and amenities, like the gorgeous heated indoor pool, guarantee total comfort and serenity.

Beyond the views, the hospitality and dining are what truly set The Khyber apart. The resort’s restaurants feature a magnificent spread of both Kashmiri and global delicacies.

We must give a special and heartfelt commendation to Chef Abid Khan. His personalized attention and passion for the cuisine were outstanding. Chef Khan’s commitment to catering to guest needs, ensuring the authenticity of local Wazwan preparations, and personally engaging with diners transformed our meals from excellent to truly unforgettable. His dedication is a perfect example of The Khyber’s world-class service.

If you seek the ultimate luxury retreat with sublime food and genuinely personalized care, The Khyber is the definitive choice.

reviews.author: Gourav
reviews.title: Unforgettable Stay and Outstanding Culinary Experience!
reviews.text:
Our stay at The Khyber was absolutely wonderful - the perfect blend of breathtaking views, cozy luxury, and truly heartwarming hospitality. The property itself is stunning, surrounded by snow-covered mountains and peaceful pine trees, but what truly made our experience special was the incredible team who looked after us.
Big shout to staff, they were very polite and courteous and always ready to help. A special mention to Farooq, Junaid, Varun, Ishfaq and Chef Rajesh Kumar Gupta. They were knowledgeable about the menu and offered great recommendations. They were genuinely friendly and made us feel like valued guests. Their smiles and positive attitude made the evening even better. The chef's passion for food shines through in every dish he creates - each one has a perfect balance of flavor, creativity, and presentation. Every meal the chef makes like it's made with genuine care, and his dedication ensures that dining at The Khyber becomes an experience guests never forget. Every interaction with the staff and chef felt personal, and their smiles and thoughtful gestures added a special touch to each moment. They truly made us feel like family.
Overall, The Khyber stands out not just for its breathtaking beauty but also for its people who make it so special. The staff and the chef together create an experience that lingers in your heart long after you leave.
Highly recommended for anyone seeking genuine hospitality and world-class service in the lap of nature.

reviews.author: shubhra92
reviews.title: Winter wonderland!!
reviews.text:
If you’re looking for a luxurious getaway in Gulmarg, The Khyber Resort is the place to be. Nestled amidst stunning snow-capped peaks, this resort offers a truly picturesque experience. The views alone are worth it—imagine waking up to a blanket of white, with pristine mountains stretching as far as the eye can see. And It’s just 100 meters from the Gulmarg Gondola. 

The hospitality here deserves a special mention. Bilal and Nazima went above and beyond to make our stay memorable.

Food at The Khyber is excellent! The Lebanese restaurant is a standout—not only does it serve authentic cuisine, but the addition of sheesha makes it an even more enjoyable experience. Don’t miss Brava, where I highly recommend trying their Spaghetti Arrabbiata—it’s absolutely delicious. Also, all restaurants here are BYOB for in-house guests which was a surprise for us. 

If you’re planning to visit, make sure to go during the snow season. The magic of The Khyber in winter is unmatched, with its cozy interiors and breathtaking surroundings.

reviews.author: Divya Kapoor
reviews.title: The best place to stay, if you intend to have a relaxing holiday with the best hospitality.
reviews.text:
Stayed at Khyber for the 2nd time this September, 2024 as we wanted a different experience after the 1st visit during the snowy season in 2018, which was magical. But the end of monsoon season is as beautiful! Greenery and ofcourse the clean fresh air is all we want for a break atleast from the concrete cities we live in. 
The rooms, the restaurants are all nice and comfortable. No complaints (except that it would be nice to be served coffee/tea in the restaurant even late evenings). 
What makes Khyber the best place to stay in Gulmarg, or the entire Kashmir region, is definitely it's location (you don't need to go out of the resort really, to enjoy the most picturesque views). Second, and as important almost, is the hospitality. The staff are very efficient, polite and pro-active. They take all the effort in making it a memorable stay for you. 
I wanted to celebrate my husband's birthday (in advance while we were there), so they arranged for a small cake that evening as a surprise (as I'd requested for one), and even decorated the place with birthday balloons and flowers. It was really special indeed. 
Big shoutout to Arif, for best service, his friendliness and warmth. Zahid gave us great knowledge about the place and motivated us to be back soon for skiing too! Chef Gupta (can't recall full name) was too sweet; all our requests were met with immediately (hot hot mooli parathas, yummy french toasts, sweeeet lassi). The fresh apple juice was the best ever and we gulped down so many glasses! I asked for a certain tweak in the Kahwa, and that was also done to my satisfaction. 
Truly grateful for such a memorable experience that now we certainly will be back for a 3rd time. :)

reviews.text:
I was persuaded to stay at the Khyber by my cousin (who happens to be in the travel industry) a week ago.  I'm so glad he convinced me to stay there.  The hotel itself is a wooden marvel! Having lived in the northern Midwest part of the US, I know what a toll winter takes on outdoor structures, especially wood.  The artistic detail and its maintenance were excellent. Let's lets talk about the staff. From the moment we arrived to the moment we left, the staff was attentive and sincere.  A gentleman at the reception desk named Irfan was a standout amongst standouts. He assisted us with services at the hotel, and out of the hotel (especially arranging for currency exchanges).  The food (and I'm a non-veg) was impressive on an ala-carte  basis. Unsurprisingly, the breakfast buffet was not as impressive, but the service was prime.
If I return to Gulmarg, I definitely will stay at the Khyber!

reviews.author: Dhruv Kumar
reviews.title: Highly over-hyped. Very bad experience.
reviews.text:
Surprising that I'm compelled to write such a review for such a highly rated property.

The overall experience, to our surprise, was way below our expectations and way way below the hype.

1. Their famous heated pool is not really 'heated' - It is just lukewarm water.

2. All amenities and F&B in the property are exhorbitantly priced. Even the taste or quantity doesn't make up for that price.

3. Personal experience - we had a Jain family with us and they ended up eating non vegetarian! Yes, only because the hotel kitchen - UNAPOLOGETICALLY - messed up the order. Highly unexpected from such a reputed property. Vegetarians please beware and double-check your meals. For the icing on the cake - All this happened after an incomplete order was sent to the room.

4. Staff isn't really very hospitable and not even well trained. Co-ordination between their teams is also surprisingly very poor - to the extent that while placing an order at the coffee shop when we asked if it could be sent to our room - we were told to call IRD and talk to them and that the coffee shop team would be of no help.

5. Their lounge serves only Hookah and the atmosphere is rather dull with small sittings. So in case you're travelling in a big group it would be difficult to find a place where you can all enjoy together. Not to miss - their premier rooms are just moderately sized without any balconies.

6. Not all the amenities mentioned in their service list are functional at all times - best to call the front desk and check for each and everything. During our visit, their mini-theatre was not operational (without any logical explanation from their team).

7. The location is undoubtedly unlike any you would have seen before. Best time to enjoy the view would be when its time for snow. The interiors of the room are average.

BUT hospitality and service - UNEXPECTEDLY HIGHLY DISAPPOINTING

reviews.title: Epitome of Luxury
reviews.text:
The Khyber is a lovely property facing the snow capped Himalays. The views are mesmerising. The rooms of all categories are luxurious and super comfortable. All amenities in all rooms remain the same however the square footage and the views differ. All the rooms do not have the same views of the mountains unfortunately. The gulmarg facing rooms have the most eye catching views of the mountains. The rooms on the other side are facing the forest overlooking a little hutment. 
Senior citizens and people with challenged walking should request for rooms close to the reception as there is a lot of walking in the hotel considering it is built on a mountain. 
The swimming pool complex is state of art and an eye candy. Beautiful heated pool with its hypnotising views is relaxing for the body which has trekked in the morning into the mountains and so calming for the mind. 
People with larger budgets should definitely opt for the gulmarg facing rooms with balconies. 
I would definitely visit this property in the peak winter season with its white blankets in its full beauty.

reviews.author: sarojpatni2
reviews.title: Outstanding stay
reviews.text:
In last 50 years of our married life we have traveled extensively throughout India and at least 40 other countries. This gave us a chance to stay at  several superb hotels. But in our opinion this hotel should rank at top three out of them if not at number 1. We are so pleased by our selection of this superb property for our 50th anniversary celebrations. From very smooth and dignified check in to emotional check out everything was perfect. 

One of the most beautiful  large room we have stayed,classy furniture, superb Mountain View, big clean beautiful bathroom, extremely clean linen and towels, noise free sound sleep on very very comfortable bed were few of the things we would like to mention.

Apart from these delicious food, fast room service, very polite knowledgeable ever eager ready to serve staff added much more pleasure to our memorable stay.

Well spread buffet breakfast with outstanding service despite jam packed morning is another thing we must add in our list.

Overall we can safely say that in our entire stay we could not find a single thing to complain which was very disappointing for us senior citizens who always try to find faults in high end properties 😉

As my wife and I both are above 70 we were assuming this will be our last visit to beautiful, lovely,charming Kashmir but 
this hotel has made us to rethink about our plans. Just for this gem of a hotel we will try to visit again sometime in near future during winter to enjoy the beautiful moments.

Definitely a full 10 out of 10 to this lovely lovely hotel. Will recommend our friends and family members to stay in The Khyber for long lasting beautiful memories .

Would again like to thank the entire management team and staff for their outstanding services and thoughtfulness. God bless them all. Please keep it up!!

reviews.text:
We visited Khyber for 5 days and stayed in the Himalayan View Rooms. While enough and more has been said about the breathtaking and stunning views around, I’m particularly happy with the service. Firdous and Muzammil were extremely helpful and polite. The rest of the staff were extremely attentive and quick to help as well. The people that really caught my attention was the people clearing the snow out, every morning. Each morning about 5-6 people step out and manually shovel out large amounts of snow to clear the path, for vehicular movement. Despite that, there is a good 300 metres at least that needs to get cleared out, each morning. Those guys were super friendly and at ease, even as the temperature was at -4 for most parts. A huge shoutout to those guys! Suggestion would be to get a guide, it makes life so much easier. Manzoor was our guide there and he made life super easy for us, from getting us to the right places to getting us vehicles with excellent drivers!

The sheer amount of work that goes into ensuring that customers have a good and comfortable time at the property is endearing. Definitely recommend the property, we had a fantastic time!

reviews.author: K Dev
reviews.title: Khyber Himalayan and staff 👍🏻
reviews.text: Had the privilege of visiting the Khyber Himalayan Resorts Gulmarg this weekend and it was a delightful experience. The property is perfectly located for some time away from the hustle and bustle of today's fast moving lifestyle which is complemented by the cordial and helpful staff. reviews.author: Obaid
reviews.title: Review
reviews.text: Excellent facilities,dining, lodging housekeeping, value for your money. Very cooperative staff, Arif and his colleagues very helpful. You feel at home. A place worth to stay in with  beautiful view of nature.

reviews.author: Amit_Maini
reviews.title: Fabulous hotel... Outstanding hospitality...
reviews.text: Visited Khyber with my wife and stayed for 2 nights. This was the last leg of my 8 day trip in Kashmir and I'm so glad I ended my trip on a high all thanks to this outstanding property. Right from a warm welcome by Muzammil to a brilliant F&B and bonfire experience by Bilal and Sameer. There cannot be a better location to stay in Gulmarg. Please opt for the Himalayan view rooms else you will be missing out on something magical. Looking forward to visit the hotel once again in peak winters to experience the hotel in its glory.

reviews.author: Voyage21585398171
