reviews.text: I will always thanks for the hospitality . Specially Mr.kaiser (house keeping) for the excellent behavior . One should come Khyber once when making tour to KASHMIR . Kashmir really mini Switzerland . Khyber is one the best property one should always come once here..

reviews.author: niravtalsania
reviews.title: Gulmarg a winter destination
reviews.text:
The best hotel in Gulmarg , located right next to the Gondola, which is the cable car ride to 14000 ft summit of the local Himalayas, the chief attraction of Gulmarg.
Food is good, could be better,especially the Indian cuisine.But its quite expensive, both food and stay , so be ready to go light on your wallets.
Beware of locals , they exist to fleece tourists, bargaining is a must, the bargain rate is fixed at 50% of what is quoted by the locals if you have good bargaining power.
Guides are not needed at all, you can directly go to gondola from the hotel, the drivers will tell you the guides will stand in lines for tickets for the gondola etc, hire a guide only if the line is very long, that too dont pay him more 300,400 rs.
Hotel staff is very courteous, and oh very Islamic. So they dont serve booze and no joint serves booze either in the entire resort town, so best carry your own, especially if you rely on a swig of cognac to get through cold nights.

reviews.author: SATISH
reviews.title: The KHYBER
reviews.text: Super property super location amazing whether.... 7 star hospitality good staff specially house keeping is jus too good mentioning the name (Mr Kaiser)... Food is jus amazing... World's most beautiful place is GULMARG that to in THE KHYBER

reviews.author: apoorvas427
reviews.title: Super location, excellent property.
reviews.text: Worth experiencing this hotel in summer and winter.  I visited Gulmarg, Kashmir after 44 years.  Srinagar, Pahalgam and Gulmarg are totally safe to move around.  Hotel, Rooms, Food, Spa, Gym, indoor heated pool is excellent.  Quality of food and service is also the best.  Special thanks to Mr Manzoor, Manager.  Also special thanks to Mr Ameen, Mr Aijaz, Mr Imtiaz, in the restaurant, for their excellent service.

reviews.author: Dream06053975337

reviews.author: Adventure44011262601
reviews.title: Beautiful in and out
reviews.text: Beautiful location, beautiful people!!!! Best hospitality I have come across in a while .. Super sweet staff, good food, lovely Himalayan view rooms, the spa and indoor pool were great too! The snow biking and atv is nearby and too much fun! I am so happy to have visited. Breathing problems are real but the inhouse doctor is too good!!! Hats off to the entire team ! Definitely coming back... 😍

reviews.author: TheBeckhams421
reviews.title: Food absolutely delicious
reviews.text: We were driven up to Gulmarg from Srinagar, amongst the first to be able to reach the resort in a regular car after an unexpected heavy snowfall. A lot of men were standing around in town. We staggered along the road towards the hotel, nearly being knocked into a ditch by a convoy of army vehicles. So by the time we arrived at this haven we were more than a little distressed. We were served first class Kashmiri tea sat next to the important military personage (and family) whose arrival had just about caused our demise ... Followed by lunch. By far the best and most sophisticated food we'd had up to that point whilst staying In other first class hotels on this our fifth trip to the sub-continent. The waiter spoke perfect English and came from one of the villages. Really good to have a proper chat with someone. We shared Kashmiri lamb in a sublime tangy sauce and lotus roots in a different delicious sauce. This was a welcome interlude in a somewhat stressful day. For the standard of cuisine and the quality of service we actually thought it was good value. If you're going to splash out on fine dining somewhere then this is the place. We imagine it would be wonderful to stay there.

reviews.author: Sgm
reviews.title: Amazing staff ! It's the USP OF KHYBER
reviews.text:
The hotel is a beautiful property . This review is as honest as it gets. 
Well maintained rooms but nothing that will blow you out. The rooms are like any others luxury hotels . Infact the only thing that blows your mind is the view. So basically you are paying for the view. (Which in winters is totally worth it ) 
What I loved the most was the staff , irrespective of the general protocals these luxury hotel have , I found the staff extremely sweet and helpful ( More than the average ) specifically I found Miss Khalida lone super efficient and amazingly courteous . She knew her job really well and went an extra mile to make us feel welcomed .  Some people leave a great impression on your mind and she totally did that. 
Food is a little disappointment as compared to the rest of the good things. 
Spa Center is amazing .
Staff is beyond amazing and totally cooperative.
Ambience is beautiful
View from the room is to die for.

Only drawback are
Food and the less of wow factors in bedrooms( like mini Bar options , room snacks , good teas n coffee bar options , good toiletries are few things missing ) 

Rest it’s a worthwhile place

reviews.author: Hari Govind U
reviews.title: "Mesmerising Royal Retreat on the lap of Luxury Paradise on Earth "
reviews.text:
Gulmarg ( A Travellors paradise ) in November , we were blessed with the First snow fall of the season starting a day before we landed in Gulmarg 17th Nov .

We made our stay so special by staying in 'The Khyber Himalyian Resorts and Spa" ( The Khyber )  , The Khyber was so special to us to celeberate our 25th wedding Anniversary  . To describe "The Khyber"  in one word is really very difficult for me ,it is " Luxury Paradise on Earth " .

 As a Civil Engineer I admire the amazing Architecture of the property  and our special thanks to Mr , Umar Traboo  MD  khyber group and the Architect for creating this amazing Resort . I am sure they would have spent years of time in designing and executing this Marvel.

The warm great welcome experience given by Ms. Kalida Lone (  let me call her Ambassader of Khyber ) was splendid and so inviting to drink a hot local Kawa drink along with walk /introduction to the property and our room . She mentioned during her introduction that we will extend our stay for sure and  no doubt we were so immersed in the the splendid views, climate , hospitality and we extended our stay .

The rooms are with great view and very well furnished, right from paper napkin holder to  laundry delivery box to the false ceiling is finished with wood well polished , the joy was in eye for the detail of every item . Hats off of the team which has created this heaven in Gulmarg .

First two days we stayed in primier and the last day we were upgraded to the Himalayan view retreat which had the ultimate view with a Balcony to sit and enjoy the beauty of Nature with the Himalyian peaks as a back drop  Spell bound view . The corridors were decorated with Kashmiri arts , pictures kashmiri birds and animals .

 We enjoyed the stay and enjoyed every loaction of the resort ( the dining Hall , Coffee shop , Gym , indoor swimming pool , good library books , Spa ) . My favourite space was the coffee shop  and excellent service by Mr. Junaid Ahamed ( a chicken sandwich with a cup of hot coffee is an Aesome experience )  . 

Food was extardinary and were well taken care at the restaurant by Mr. Ishfaq Hussain , Mr.Hamid , Ms.Saifed Pakesza and Mr.Gulam Khadir friendly team of Khyber ,thier hospitality was at the best and interactions was so good for us understanding the Kashmir valley in full . 

Ms Kalida and Inhouse  Paramedical Mr Nazeer Ahmed went all the way out in attending to my wife's leg sprain that was very nice approch and a great support to us. A Highly effecient centeralised  heating and ventilation system was working very well and keeping us in comfort all through our stay  . 

The resort is very close to Gundola  and All purpose Vechile ( AVT ) station . 

A HIGHLY RECOMMENDED AND  MUST PLACE TO STAY AND ENJOY GULMARG THE KASHMIR VALLEY . 

We enjoyed our stay and wish the Khyber team all the best . Please visit Kashmir people are so good and Hard working,  very friendly  , arts and crafts are so extradinary , the valley is really beautiful .

Cheers ,
Hari GOVIND.U

reviews.author: Javed
reviews.title: Paradise in Heaven
reviews.text:
The Gulmarg Boutique is one of my favourite boutique hotel in India,the rooms have phenomenon views of mountains covers with snow and pine forests.the food is delicious and the multicusine restaurant has options of indoor and outdoor seating.

They have awesome sheesa lounge for all the sheesha  lovers  out there

reviews.author: Sidharth H
reviews.title: Luxury @ gulmarg
reviews.text:
We were in a large group with kids and had a fabulous stay at Khyber. The food was great and the staff were attentive. Rooms were nice and we enjoyed the balconies. 

The indoor heated pool has great views and the kids games room is also nice.

Would highly recommend staying here.

reviews.author: Vanessa D
reviews.title: Perfect welcome to Gorgeous Kashmir that turned out to be magically romantic!
reviews.text: One of the most gorgeous locations we've stayed at. The views from our room were just stunning, staff were extremely warm and welcoming, definitely felt pampered and well looked after. Loved the attention we were given, from advice to suggestions, to helping us with our onward journey, this is what exceptional service is meant to be where every need was taken care of with a smile. Excellent facilities with a spa, sauna and a temperature controlled indoor pool - just wished we had more time to utilize all of it. Special shout out to Khalida who was just brilliant and an big asset to Khyber.

reviews.author: Nipul Raval
reviews.title: FULFILLING EXPECTATION
reviews.text: Me and my wife had wonderful 2 nights stay. Everything perfect. Location, Room, food, services & comfort Much More Than Expected. Warm & professional Hospitality by hotel staff from bottom to top. Thoroughly enjoyed staying here. Will love to visit again this property. I strongly recommend this property. Worth staying.

reviews.author: Sukhmani W
reviews.title: Love the place but faced a few issues this time
reviews.text:
My husband and I love Khyber. We came here for our first anniversary two years ago and thought it best to be back here for our third. However, this time we faced a few issues with the hotel. 

The AC in our room stopped working at 3am and while we could’ve called someone about it, the thought didn’t strike us at that time of the night. So we had to open the door and sleep to reduce the stuffiness in the room. 

The food was strictly average as well. In fact, something reacted with me and I had a tough time the whole day after the dinner. The food was much better on our first trip here. 

But not all was bad. They surprised us with a cake for our anniversary and made sure we got a room with a fantastic view. 

The facilities are still quite amazing in the hotel including the spa. 

Best visited when it snows.

reviews.author: Gaurav Dua
reviews.title: Exemplary Staff. Incredible Property. Every pennies worth
reviews.text:
Our experience in this resort was incredible. We traveled with our 2 year old kid and it was an enjoyable trip for three of us.

Standout staff, with their courtesy made our stay memorable. The restaurant Clove is incredible. The chefs were really spot on  with almost everything we tried. Rooms were amazing. View amazing.

Swimming pool was well heated and we didn’t feel it was 6 degrees outside. The whole resort is centrally heated.

Kids play room is extremely well kept and really enjoyable for parents with toddlers 

Goes deep into your pockets but it’s money well spent. You won’t regret it.

Will definitely return soon.

reviews.author: mmssaa
reviews.title: Exotic splendour
reviews.text:
The hotel is breathtakingly beautiful I was awed the moment I saw it , 
The hotel staff from the moment you enter is polite and helpful , I felt their hospitality is was super ! Right from the person who picked us ,to the reception , the restaurant staff were very friendly and indulgent , definitely would love to visit again !

reviews.author: Pradeep K
reviews.title: Excellent stay at Khyber. Thanks Roamland Holidays
reviews.text: We booked a package based on our friend's reference with Roamland Holidays which is Kashmir based travel company. Everything went well from stay & transportation. Overall, my family enjoyed & we had a great time in the lap of nature. We certainly recommend to travel & stay at least a night at Khyber Himalayan Resort in Gulmarg. On a side note, we are thankful to team Roamland Travel for making our tour a comfortable & hassle free.

reviews.author: manish b
reviews.title: One of the best experiences in Kashmir
reviews.text: This property is located in the middle of the forest with breathtaking views from the rooms. Rooms are beautifully done and have all the comforts of a luxury hotel. Staff is very warm and welcoming. This hotel is one of the reasons, I would want to visit Kasmir again.

reviews.author: Devashis B
reviews.title: A beautiful hotel with fantastic service
reviews.text:
My first visit to Kashmir. Have heard of Gulmarg a lot to be the bed of flowers. But taking into consideration the reputation of Kashmir Valley as projected by the media was bit apprehensive with what would be there out there in the offing. The moment I arrived at Gulmarg I was shocked by the beauty of it. The hotel from the entrance to the last minute have been tastefully decorated. The photographs of the hotel I have uploaded bear the testimony of the taste. The wooden work, the decor, the arrangement as well as the architecture of the resort was marvelous. That’s not all. The service and the hospitality makes your stay wonderful. In this regard, I would like to mention that all the staff of the resort were very responsive and helpful and special mention goes to Mr Saukat Wani. 

As regards safety, the resort is safe and takes all precaution to maintain safety. 

I shall again visit whenever I visit Gulmarg again.

reviews.author: _jensseine
reviews.title: Das beste Hotel in Glumarg
reviews.text:
Wir waren auf einem Snowboard Trip in Glumarg und haben im Khyber gewohnt.
Der Service und die Freundlichkeit der Menschen sind unerreicht. Das Hotel hat für die Region einen sehr hohen Comfort. Frühstücks- und Abendbuffet sind reichhaltig und üppig. Spa und Freizeitbereich wurden ausgiebig benutzt. Wir hatten eine traumhafte Zeit. Leider eine Reise die nicht alltäglich ist. Trotzdem möchten wir sie gerne wiederholen.

reviews.author: Malhar Mehta
reviews.title: Great property, amazing location and excellent service
reviews.text:
The Khyber is the best property in Gulmarg. It has amazing view amongst snow clad mountains. You cannot find a place better than this in Gulmarg. The Gondola ride is walking distance from this place. 

All the rooms have amazing view of the snow clad mountains and pine trees. The hotel is centrally heated and it is only when you step out of the hotel that you realize what is the temperature outside. Hotel is well-staffed and the entire staff is well versed with the requirements of the travelers. They ensure that all the travelers do not face any issues with regards to the climate. The food is pretty decent with amazing spread in both breakfast and dinner. 

When we were checking out it was snowing heavily and hence we could not move out and our vehicle could not come to the hotel. The hotel staff arranged for special scooters and took us as well as the luggage to the place where our vehicle could reach. Indeed a very good gesture. 

The hotel has spa and warm water pool which is an added luxury in such a climate. 

Overall an experience worth remembering.

reviews.author: jain_anoop
reviews.title: The best
reviews.text: Khyber is the best hotel luxury in Gulmarg, Srinagar. The location is just unbeatable with views of snow clad mountains all around. The staff pampers you with their hospitality right from check in till checkout. The buffet breakfast and dinners are awesome. Spa is a must. Very good memories of this hotel

reviews.author: indianfoodie71
reviews.title: Amazing View n Spa
reviews.text: The rooms are modern and well maintained. The food is good and lots of variety in the buffet. The Spa was excellent and a variety of options.The staff are well trained .Its the best property in Gulmarg. I would love to visit during the skiing season. The whole ambience and view will change.

reviews.author: Anol B
reviews.title: Early winter in heaven
reviews.text:
Stunning surroundings, great view from all rooms, helpful and courteous staff, nearby the Gondola ticketing counter - what can go wrong? Plus we got to see a majestic snowfall during our stay.

A great hotel, worth every dime.

reviews.author: manan1785
reviews.title: Awesome hotel
reviews.text: This hotel is I guess the most modern hotel in Gulmarg. Awesome rooms and a great ambience. Stayed for 2 nights and enjoyed the breakfast and dinner in the hotel. Short walk to the gondola too. Surely suggest this hotel.

reviews.author: Subrat D
reviews.title: A PAradise
reviews.text:
Beautiful view of  snow peaks.  Rooms are excellent. At times heating is not proper. Gandola is at a walking distance. 
Food is tasty. Gym is fantastic. beyond one's imagination. 
A place to visit during July to see the greenery

reviews.author: Krishna_joshi
reviews.title: Superbbbbbb
reviews.text:
Check in process is:  u r taken to cafe with a spectacular mountain view and offered traditional kashmiri tea, and then escorted with a staff who guides u for all the property and room. Truly great way to start .

I stayed in balcony room, which is huge in size with great bathroom and nice tub. View is just wonderful from balcony. All amenities are modern with kashmiri art touch. Property is pretty big. SPA is also great , and really enjoyed the couple spa. The corridors, facade, and all other areas have great colour combination, with music and makes a great ambience all together. 

Don't forget to try Sheesha at there Cabalash cafe. In such cold, a hookah really makes u feel great. Only issue their food prices are equal to TAJ hotels ;-) ... Breakfast spread is also nice. Wifi is paid but 3g connection is good for mobile users so u can use mobile data itself. Business desk is available free and can be used. 

Please note in Gulmarg only those people who have reservation in hotels near Gandola (very few hotels ) are allowed to carry their own car. Others who stay outside or near taxi stand, have to use horse for reaching Gandola ride. Luckily Khyber is just 2 min walk from Gandola so we can carry our car right upto hotel.

On a vacation with wife, i can say for sure , your better half will be just love your decision of staying here and will be impressed.

reviews.author: DIPALDESAI
reviews.title: Must visit & enjoy Khyber Gulmerg
reviews.text: It's excellent Property in India Kashmir world Paradise Gulmerg... Khyber its Rooms and Ambiance superb and visit on December snow fall @ Hot Swimming Pool... So, many things for Children and for senior citizensview of rooms are wow...

reviews.author: SKM
reviews.title: Highly overrated
reviews.text:
I would have rated the property poor if not for the scenic setting and the property itself... Service and Food @TheKhyber were a disappointment especially at the price tag it comes with. When every request is first met with a 'no' it does get a little frustrating. Food was insipid at best! If not for the stunning views from the hotel and the well kept property there wouldn't have been much to redeem the property. Recommend the Himalayan view luxury rooms for their brilliant view.

Keep in mind Gulmarg is a dry city and you may want to byob as there's nothing available nearby - a fact you won't hear a whisper of till you get there :)

reviews.author: vishubhanu
reviews.title: KHYBER IS REALY THE PARADISE IN KASHMIR
reviews.text:
I stayed in this hotel for only one night on the occasion of my Marriage Anniversary, find the place EXCELLENT to stay.The rooms are modern , warm and comfortable, you have a good feeling staying there.This type of property was needed in Gulmarg. We had some good food at dinner which was fresh and tastes yummy,.I have taken services of the spa in the evening which were nice and the spa is equipped with all the mod facilities . The morning breakfast was also GOOD.The staff was nice.

BUT BUT BUT, My review is incomplete without praising a person, I met at the hotel, the name is MR. ANUPAM BHAN, he was i think a manager there in some dptt..A well educated and friendly man, moreover we were from same city. He make my day more wonderful by gifting us a cake in surprise, also offered us discounts in all amenities of the hotel. These type of persons helps improving the goodwill of the hotel and maintains healthy relations with the guests.

OVERALL This property is good but the prices are a bit on the higher side, but still Recommend This hotel to have a comfortable stay in Gulmarg.

Stayed 20th November 2015, travelled with my wife.

reviews.author: IndiTales
reviews.title: Classic Luxury in a Classic Destination
reviews.text:
Khyber Gulmarg lets you soak in the old world charm while providing you all that you need for modern living. Their wood dominated architecture to their Chaikash that keeps on serving Kahwas and the views from just about everywhere in the property add to the overall experience of Gulmarg. 

You can sit back and enjoy the views from balconies, get spa treatments in athe most professional way and swim in the heated swimming pool surrounded by snow. 

In the mountains do not expect the service at par with urban counterparts. Staff works slowly and their pace - probably they want you to just sit back and relax. 

The room temperature at night goes very high, invariable waking you up - keep the window open a bit to avoid this.

reviews.author: BenitaMumbai
reviews.title: The Best Ever
reviews.text: Highly recommend this beautiful property to all who visit Gulmarg. Truly appreciate the hospitality of Mr Zaffer Malik, the duty manager who took personal care of us and made our stay so memorable. His entire team were totally hands on and extremely well coordinated. As soon as we reached we were give the best kehwa ever as a welcome drink at Chaikash, the tea lounge. We were upgraded to the front view rooms. The entire hotel had a modern and stylish decor. The indoor pool was was very good with warm water very comforting in the cold The location was good and one could walk down towards the cable car.

reviews.author: sameer B
reviews.title: Very UNSAFE HOTEL TO STAY
reviews.text:
It is a most unsafe hotel to stay where female privacy is at the top most risk and the management cares a hoot.  We stayed on the 17 and 18th nov 2015. My wife was using the steam and sauna and suddenly she see a man walking inside the ladies steam and sauna and when enquired with the lady who was the person who entered inside a ladies room she had to say he had come to check something. How can a man enter a ladies steam and sauna room without prior permission. Totally not acceptable. We called the manager he was not available later his Jr came and said sorry and argued when we asked for a written confirmation of the whole incident which we gave in writing to him and it is been 5 days now no revert or call anything from the management such a shame that such a high quality standard hotel is not able to meet customer privacy and proper answer to  their grievances. 

Will definitely put in the paper once I reach mumbai and ensure that such incident doesn't take place for other women.

My advise for people going there is pls be careful 

Attached is the pic of the letter given to the hotel management

reviews.author: ADITSETH123
reviews.title: The best stay ever
reviews.text:
Highly recomment a stay at khyber gulmarg. By far the best hotel here. A pure beauty.
I stayed here only for one night and trust me that was my biggest mistake in the entire trip. The hotel was spacious and huge. Stagg was humble and by far the best stay in kashmir.

reviews.author: MadhukarSinghania
reviews.title: GREAT HOSPITALITY STANDARD
reviews.text:
I must appreciate the hospitality of the Mr. Sujith Herbert (GM) who took great care to make our stay a memorable one. His team was extremely well coordinated and helpful.

Thank You Sujith and wish you all the best.

I would also like to specially thank the services of Mr. Sajad Lone ( Butler Service) who was extremely helpful and made all efforts to make our stay comfortable one. His service with a smile is still fresh in the mind. 

Thank You Sajad and wish you all the success.

reviews.author: Anand K
reviews.title: Best hotel
reviews.text: This place is just awesome..go for front rooms for best views..the Gondola is easily accessible from the Hotel and you can literally walk to it. Do experience the indoor swimming pool, it's one of the best I have been in. If you are in Gulmarg, this is the best option

reviews.author: JASM007
reviews.title: Awesome stay with kids!!!
reviews.text: We have been trying to get a room at Khyber for the last one year and when we got. Vacancy we jumped and took the opportunity to go visit Paraise on Earth as Kashmir is called!! We went with our two kids and they had the most amazing time. During our stay it snowed and the hotel has beautiful views of the snow capped mountains.. The staff was very courteous and friendly .. We were taken care of really well.. The manager in the restaurant Basharat was extremely hospitable and looked after us very well...Asif was very on the spot And alert to our every need in the restaurant.. The buffet was decent and the ala carte menu had a lot of variety and the dishes were very presentable and yummy... There is a hookah restaurant also... They have an indoor pool for adults and kids separately !!! The view from the poolside is to die for... Overall a very nice stay and can't wait to go back soon !!!

reviews.author: srldelhi
reviews.title: Views not as good as Highlands park
reviews.text: We stayed in mid june in khyber gulmarg. The hotel is quite new with good rooms and facilities but iam afaid the views from the hotel are not as good as highlands park where we had stayed during our last visit. khyber does not offer open views to gulmarg but i believe it would be much better in winters as it is close to gandola lifts.

reviews.author: Nazish A
reviews.title: Amazing !!
reviews.text:
Was travelling on a golf trip , we went for lunch at Khyber, it was simply awesome. Staff & Manager were too cordial. One person in particular was very polite & cordial, topping with most humble service was Mr. Sajjad. I had already read about his service on trip advisor and was surprised to see that he was our server. Great experience, ordered chinese food, was too good. 
Next time staying there for sure! Nazish &Amer

reviews.author: Amit A
reviews.title: Heavenly experience in Paradise
reviews.text:
Was there for 3 nights while in Gulmarg which others said to be long for the place, but being at Khyber was worthwhile and in fact made us think of extending our stay! 

The rooms were a good size and offered nice views. The facilities provided were at five star standards and the swimming pool / fitness center were really nice. 

The staff from check-in to room service and the restaurant was consistently brilliant and soft spoken. We were there during Dussehra holidays and the hotel was well occupied but never did we feel "not cared for". Traveling with a small kid can usually be tough but the staff took real good care of my 06 year old when at the restaurant or the play area. 

Will definitely return myself and strongly recommend everyone to experience Khyber.

Cheers, Amit

reviews.author: Pawan Kumar
reviews.title: The best place to stay when in Gulmarg
reviews.text:
The Khyber is a nice place to stay when in Gulmarg.
Rooms are spacious and well made.
Entire hotel staff makes you feel at home and treats you to a 5 star experience.
Non veg food was not upto the mark.
Do the Gandola ride with snow bike & do the ATV ride too.
Try the kawa and egg bhurjee in the local market area.

reviews.author: Bhavara
reviews.title: Great place to stay
reviews.text:
Me and my wife really enjoyed the hospitality here , the service is very polite , food is out of the world 

I did my own booking, and though the prices were steep, but befits the luxury they offer you, this hotel beats any 5 or 6 star hotels in Srinagar 

The rooms are having great view though you need to take the pricey upper floor rooms which have clear and unrestricted view of snow crested peaks 

the beds, the bathrooms the balcony spell sheer luxury , pls ask hotel to arrange your airport pick up and drop as otherwise you may be left high and dry 

The hotel arranged all outdoor trips and staff is very attentive and they shall give you good idea of what ought to be done 

The breakfast has an amazing spread including locally made preservatives from fresh fruits , even the dinner which we had there many times was tastefully made and lovingly served , do try their signature dish Mutton Rogan Gosh which is best I ever had. 

Shall certainly recommend this property without any qualifications

reviews.author: Pavane M
reviews.title: top of the line
reviews.text: The Khyber - it's a grand hotel which we arrived in after a wonderful trek. It was perfect for the rainy day outside - to sit in their lobby with the views and sip hot kahva. The rooms are luxuriously appointed and the bathrooms are every trekkers dream - rain showers in the mountains and a deep bath if you like - while you gaze out at the spectacular views. The beds are oh so important and these were like a warm hug!! It seemed to be a great family hotel, rooms for kids to find activities indoors for inclement weather et al. The pool and the spa crown the rest - warm water again with views!! And the spa adds to the luxury.

reviews.author: SG
reviews.title: Luxury Hotel with five star facilities but expensive
reviews.text: Located on height in Gulmarg near the Rope-way. Beautiful Scenery view from all rooms. Swimming Pool with Hot water and Gym working but not used by many guests. Room neat and clean with good quality linen. Bathroom neat with toiletries and fittings. Shower and Tub separate.. a rare luxury. Glass between the shower enclosure and Toilet is so transparent that you may bang your head thinking that it does not exist. TV channels working. Aircon working fine. Food good but very expensive. Starts at Rs 1000 per dish. Nearby market is 2 km away and vehicle cost Rs 500. Market is simple and nothing much there. Rope-way very busy and good. Usually one stage works and not both stages. Avoid Horse riding poni walas, they pester you so much that you cannot wish them away.

reviews.author: dr_rishig
reviews.title: one of the best
reviews.text:
Khyber is of course the best in Gulmarg or would not be wrong, one of the best in India
The ambience, room quality, location, proxomity to gondola etx. makes it stand out.
Would like to thank Mr shyam and others at the Khyber for making the trip a memorable one. Highly recommendable

reviews.author: Mairaj
reviews.title: Graaaannnddd !!!!
reviews.text: A beautiful property with charming staff.. Stayed here for two weeks nights and enjoyed to the fullest.fullest. Didn't  get the time to try the spa. Beautiful location and amazing views even from the base category. Breakfast and dinner was good with large spread.

reviews.author: ashisinghchd
reviews.title: Good hotel but highly overpriced
reviews.text: Khyber in gulmarg is good hotel in proximity with gandola. The rooms are nicely done up but the prices are very steep both for rooms and food. We almost paid close to 500$ per night with breakfast and dinner per couple. The hotel does not have a bar in spite of charging such steep rates therefore carry your own liquor. We went to see highlands park on our friends reccomendation and it has much better views as compared to khyber so yu can try that as it was resonably priced around 10k per night.

reviews.author: Vivekbansal637
reviews.title: One of the best stays in India. I would love to be back and soon to The Kyber.
reviews.text:
There is nothing i can write about Kyber thats probably not yet been said or written. It has to be 1 of the best located properties in India with the view it offers. The whole view from the pool & spa can be compared to the best in the world.
The staff and management is attentive to all your needs & were serving with a smile even at 5 in the morning.
The GM, Mr Sujith Herbert and the senior management was always around to cater to the needs at all times.
Got the first snow of the season while i was there and that added to the amazing experience i was already having at The Kyber.
I would love to be back and soon to The Kyber.

reviews.author: runumehtakesarker
reviews.title: Lovely hotel with bad service
reviews.text: A beautiful hotel property in gulmarg ! Good rooms , though we did not get a room with a ovine of the snow capped mountains . Bad service in terms of food . For an ala crate we were served food one very late , two cold food . They can up their service to make it a brilliant experience . Also paid wifi hurts !!

reviews.author: Atul44
reviews.title: One of the best
reviews.text:
First thing first- The terrible flood has no effect on Khyber or Gulmarg. I traveled last week of November 2014. Took a taxi from Srinagar airport to Khyber with absolutely no trouble. Smooth ride. 
Khyber is definitely one of the best stays I have experienced not just because of its location but it's sheer class and comfort provided by a wonderful efficient management. Very welcoming staff, they know how to make you feel home. Preet welcomed us and made our check in process fast and smooth even though cleartrip had not completed their formalities from their side. Preet just mentioned it and asked me to contact cleartrip once and it will be taken care, which was. Since there was not many guests, Khyber upgraded me to a luxury room. How amazing that was. The room was cozy and spacious with no major issues with a beautiful view. I have many great things to say about Khyber but I see those have already been mentioned in previous reviews. 
Things which you may not like about Khyber might be non-availaibility of free Wi-Fi even after paying lots of money for room rent.  The hotel restaurants are expensive and there is not much around apart from small eating joints. I wish Khyber had given me cheaper option for airport pickup and drop. Rs. 5k per side is quite expensive. Addition of Kashmiri food in breakfast buffet would have been nice. 

I would definitely love to visit Khyber again in future. Thanks for making my stay a memorable one.

reviews.author: Anmz
reviews.title: Amazing Amazing Amazing!!
reviews.text:
I LOVED this hotel. Its very chalet-like, the wood and stone architecture fits perfectly with its surroundings! 
1.Even the interiors are so very gorgeous. There are huge glass windows flaunting the snow capped mountains and high wooden ceilings with lanterns hanging. 
2.The rooms are absolutely gorgeous with breath taking views. It feels warm and gives you goose bumps at the same time!
You'll want to keep exploring the property because its a winter paradise!
I visited in April, so everything was up in snow, but that just made the experience so much better. You can go out and play with the snow and sleep looking at the white scene with wood and stone. 
3. It has the most amazing pool ever , it has glass all around it, pine trees shadowing the area, and snow showering it. It feels like an open area, but is actually heated and warm despite the weather conditions outside. This was the highlight of my trip.
4. There is a good spa and just spending time in this wooden place makes you happy. The food was very nice.
This place needs to be visited by everyone!

reviews.author: Anitbha
reviews.title: Whoa! :)
reviews.text:
I would definitely recommend this property- if you go to Kashmir.....there's no other place to stay.
 
The room was warm, food was good but more importantly; the staff- Front Office (Nitesh, Abid, Zaffar)/House Keeping (Irshad)/Food & Beverage (Prabhakar, Kamal, Saptarishi) are worth a special mention- my week over there was a breeze because of their superlative hospitality!!!!

The sugar free qahwa has to be tried, as is the daily bubble bath in their awesome tub which has a wow view.

Phase 2 of the Gondola has to be tried, as has the walk around the property- its BEAUTIFUL & should be done; especially if you choose not to wander around a lot from Gulmarg.
If you do however, Sonmarg/Pahalgam/Verinag & of course Dal Lake, Srinagar should be on your list.

Sit outside in ChaiKash & sip a tea or have a cigar......and dream!

One of the best hotels I've EVER stayed in worldwide (and I've travelled the world & am an ex- hotelier).....will return soon, Inshallah!!

reviews.author: Tushar J
reviews.title: Value for money super luxury stay!
reviews.text: If you wanna splurge and be pampered and treated like royalty then this is the place to stay. Beautiful location, amazingly done up rooms and very warm and coordial staff. A must visit if you plan on visiting Gulmarg.

reviews.author: AakashGupta92
reviews.title: Just exceptional !!
reviews.text:
Staying at The Khyber is just a lifetime remembrance. The property is exceptionally good, very well maintained, very cosy and totally a royal feel.

The rooms are very good..great size but the view of only Himalayan side is good and not the Gulmarg side. The balcony in the room is the most enjoyable part of it and also the tub by the window in washroom. 

Service is top class and this factor made the stay most comfortable. They don't sell liquor in their property so they allow you to consume your own liquor in the cigar lounge..this was liked by us all as it's the first 5 star property where we saw this type of arrangement for the guests.. normally we used to drink in our room but here you can have it in the cigar lounge comfortably. 

Other great factor is the food which is exceptionally good. Our dinner was included in the package and on reaching the restaurant we found out that our snacks are also included in the buffet dinner (snacks are normally not included in the dinner buffet.. most of the time it is soup + main course + desert).. and the variety was also very good along with the quantity.

Staff is very efficient and helpful... Heated swimming pool was also a very enjoyable thing.

Many many thanks specially to Mr. Aman and Mr. Bilal for their exceptional service at the restaurant and the cigar lounge. 

Totally a repeatable property !!

reviews.author: Suman G
reviews.title: Hyped
reviews.text: wonderful sprawling property. rooms were a little smelly. Food wasn't all that good. Spa was good. swimming pool wasn't functional. Room Service is extremely slow. Staff is courteous and warm. But by far the best property in Gulmarg so far

reviews.author: Madhu Naiker
reviews.title: A great get away
reviews.text: Excellent reception and continued service until departure. Room service was exceptional and very prompt. If you want peace and quite, this is the place to recharge your professional battery, Extra bedding for 3rd guest in a room could have been of higher standard.

reviews.author: Alok762
reviews.title: Unmatchably serene...
reviews.text: Had a wonderful stay with my wife at Khyber hotel. Situated amidst the enchanting and majestic environs of Gulmarg, the ambience of the hotel truly symbolizes the Kashmiri traditions and the marvelous uniqueness of the region. The staff, especially Mr. Zaffar Malik was very courteous in making our stay very comfortable and enjoyable. I would highly recommend this hotel for all the tourists who wish to visit Gulmarg.

reviews.author: sayadil
reviews.title: Khyber is a world class property
reviews.text:
Before I write this review I want to mention that we were guests of the owner hence receiving prompt friendly courteous service was never the issue. 
To create a resort like khyber at a place like gulmarg itself is a big feat. There's no mountain ski reaort such as khyber in the whole India and it competes with best in the world. Rooms are nicely done and the mountain view from our balcony suite was just amazing. I've traveled throughout the world from alps to smoky mountains of North America and this place is right up there. There were only two issues that I experienced at the property 1. Internet is slow considering guests are paying for it 2. Food quality specially in buffet be in breakfast or lunch needs to improve whole lot. Food needs to be warm specially meats n bakery too needs to be fresh n warm. I can also see that the pricing of the hotel is steep even by 5star standards if management improves these key points I don't see why they won't receive a 5star from me and everyone else. Come fall in love with Kashmir guys

reviews.author: Sudha V
reviews.title: Outsanding property!
reviews.text: Stayed in Khyber from nov 14th to 16th. Superb view, excellent service & awesome view! Manzoor at the front desk, upgraded our room to luxury balcony room with no additional cost. Really helpful staff & the also help with great warmth! Food is excellent. Just wish that breakfast would be hot. Its room temperature & given the climate, hot food is appreciated. Tx manzoor for the warmth & hospitality shown to us & also for arranging a guide to take us to the gondola ride which is very close to the hotel. Could never get enough of the view from the rooms or the hotel itself! Hope the spa & swimming pool get functional soon! missed that! We will be back soon for a longer stay!

reviews.author: Ravibaj
reviews.title: Haven in hills
reviews.text:
When one books a room at a hill station hotel in india?one has to take a lot of things with a pinch of salt: service, menu depth, room up keep , as it gets difficult to provide the same standards as a
City hotel! But to our absolute surprise, khyber gulmarg had everything' spot on'! The service was pleasing, the food menu? Well they had Angus beef and new Zealand lamb!!! Thier ' kahva'
( Kashmiri tea) was nit only excellent but served throughout out the day with the hotels compliments! For my wife's birthday they set up a BBQ grill with two chefs in all their livery , and 
Two stewards for just the four of us, the best pine apple pastry I have had was also here incedently! I highly recommend this property!

reviews.author: Vipul S
reviews.title: Superb Resort
reviews.text:
We stayed at The Khyber  and our stay was exceptional. The first and lasting impression of the hotel was just WOW!!
From the word go, the entire staff was extremely courteous and hospitable.
Check in was smooth.
The food was lip smacking… infact it was difficult to fathom that sitting in Gulmarg we were being served one of the finest  meals we had ever had.

A special mention to Ajaz & Manjoor from front office these boys are  helpful & efficient in every way and also the staff at the restaurant.

reviews.author: rahulsaraf18
reviews.title: A jewel in heaven
reviews.text: We had booked this hotel to celebrate our anniversary in November. The property is excellent and the best part is the top class hospitality shown by the staff here. The hotel is located at walking distance from the Gondola. On arrival, we were pleasantly surprised to know that they had upgraded our stay to the luxury room with balcony for our occasion. The rooms are spacious with all modern amenities. The balcony offers a stunning view of the snow clad himalayas and the pine trees. Special thanks to Mr Zaffer at the front desk who made sure we had a great stay at the hotel. A stay at the Khyber is much recommended for everyone visiting Gulmarg.

reviews.author: Jeevan G
reviews.title: Unparalled on all counts but one
reviews.text:
Exquisite property and "the place" to stay when in Gulmarg. Gorgeous interiors and part exteriors furnished in stunning wood (Deodar, I suppose), breathtaking view outside the balcony and an awe-inspiring vicinity that make an immortal impression. If God lies in the details, I found a bit of Him / Her in their welcome "kahawa" drink; the sumptuous food they serve takes a second place. The staff is very hospitable and friendly.

I had no complaints except for one: They don't serve wines. When there is such superlative beauty surrounding you and you want to cherish the moment with some sparkling wine, how can Khyber not serve wines? Shame. I hope someday they do which would compel the four bullets (very good) to move to five (excellent).

reviews.author: pkguptaindia98
reviews.title: Service
reviews.text:
we stayed in Hotel in summers --it was really a great experience and a memorable trip for us ,,,,Hotel is nice --ambiance is Superb--Staff was cooperative-but we find our room at the corner of the hotel...but the personnel at reception  were excellent--by whom our stay was excellent...we are thankful to Bilal Ahmad of reception  and the restaurant staff who all made our stay --enjoyable--
Thanks ...Kyber

reviews.author: T2Traveller
reviews.title: Brilliant Property!
reviews.text: Amazing property, five star amenities, top quality service and excellent rooms! Very friendly staff and Mr Bilal really helped us get the best rooms at best prices! could do well if they could add a bar to their serene setting!

reviews.author: MAKapoor
reviews.title: Stunning welcome to Kashmir
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Khyber, Gulmarg and we were very impressed with the hotel and its service. Nestled amidst the Himalayas a true five star hotel.
The location is absolutely amazing and the views to die for. The food was just super….
A special mention to Bilal and Zafar at the front desk for making our stay comfortable and at the restaurant the F and B manager Rajeev just did not have NO for an answer… he was so courteous and so was his staff… the only name who I can remember is Robin!!

reviews.author: Uzair M
reviews.title: Memorable Stay
reviews.text: I with my wife stayed in the resort for a couple of nights and the whole experience was wonderful. Helpful and decent staff, amazing location and view, cozy rooms and delightful service are a few things that made our stay worth the while. I highly recommend the resort especially for newlyweds. The view from the balcony rooms is simply breathtaking. The check-in and check-out was completely effortless. Restaurant is great catering to most of the tastes. Room service is up to the mark. The whole team is well managed and trained. I got more than what I had expected from this experience and I will return for sure.

reviews.author: Alan_DCruz
reviews.title: Delightful service
reviews.text: A colleague a I stayed here on a business trip for two nights. We were first blown away with the brilliant hotel. Its brand new and still manages to look rustic with real wood everything. The food was superb and the location is perfect for a winter vacation. All you need is within walking distance and the hotel has their own transport if you don't fancy the walk in sub zero temperatures. What really stood out though was the service. All their staff are perfectly courteous. There whenever you need help but never in your face and intrusive. Would really love to go back sometime.

reviews.author: Kokila B
reviews.title: Can't rate 5 star bad matters
reviews.text: It's really a nice hotel with respect to location,room maintenance and luxury. There r 2 defects one they don't care about menu of  buffet dinner though the breakfast menu was good and one special request to hotel about the bed matters it is so bad that we got back ache so please change the matters otherwise it's really worth staying.

reviews.author: Ramesh Hemrajani
reviews.title: PATHETIC,DISASTROUS & A HORRIBLE EXPERIENCE
reviews.text:
I am a travel agent from Delhi who has been running the Travel agency for the past 14 years servicing high end customers and dealing with the best 5 star hotels. Luxury is our forte.
Here under is the description of the biggest mistake of booking a self proclaimed 5 star hotel called THE KHYBER GULMARG
 
We have been to the best 5 stars hotels and resorts worldwide and have an idea of the service standards, maintenance and the hospitality that a 5 star hotel should be. The Management and Staff at Khyber should really be ashamed of themselves, and we as travel agents need to make sure that we don’t sell such pathetic properties.
 
We arrived at Khyber Gulmarg on 16th October 2013 at around 1300 hours and then began series of disasters and the most disturbing experiences me and my family had. 
 
The hotel being a part of the SLH group, we had expected that it would atleast stand upto the standards of being a good basic 5 star, but by the time we checked out next day , we had realized that calling Khyber even a 3 star hotel would be an insult to the other 3 star hotels. 
 
The basic amenities like the swimming pool and gym were closed, and we were not advised of the same at the time of booking. All the lifts in the property were either shut or were under maintenance.  The kids room which they boast about so much of, was merely a joke ! It had nothing more than 2 incomplete sets of ludo and snakes and ladder and some pink wallpaper.
The main restaurant on the lobby level was closed. The entire arrangement thus had been shifted to the basement in the banquet hall , with typical wedding
type of décor. Upon checking on this , we were told that due to full occupancy , the hotel could not accommodate all the in house guests in the main restaurant.
 
Nevertheless keeping this aside here is what all happened with us at the hotel
 
Day 1:  we ordered a mutton dish in the restaurant for lunch and we were served some uncooked pieces of meat, that could be even impossible to chew
by animals.  At the same moment this was brought to the Restaurant Managers and chef’s notice both of them accepted that the meat was uncooked and Unedible... So much so for a SLH hotel claiming to be a 5 star.

This just does not end here, there were rusted nails in the balcony that pierced into one of our family member’s feet.  The level of maintenance was such that the shower holder along with a heavy rod  fell upon one of us during shower, causing a cut on left hand which was  bleeding. The para-medicos were summoned and the first aid was provided. As if this was not enough we even had a CFL that blasted in the room around early morning 2 am, and then there were pieces of glass lying all over on the floor.
The most seemingly unbelievable part is that all the above HAS happened in the duration of just 24 hrs, but that friends is the TRUTH !!!

Ramesh Hemrajani
Blue Ocean Travels Pvt Ltd.

reviews.author: kamalbk
reviews.title: This hotel makes ur trip most memorable
reviews.text: This place is awesome n if u want to grab all the fun u got to stay in khyber. .we were upgraded straight away to the himalayan view room n the view from there is so lovely thst u won't take ur eyes  from there..the staff was too good specifically MR. MUZZAFAR in the clove restaurant. .. u got to stay with Khyber

reviews.author: Iype M
reviews.title: One of the finest hotels with world class standards
reviews.text: Great venue..quiet serene breath taking vicinity..General manager Alex koshy takes time to ensure we are comfortable...Deepak thomas extended great service and was enthusiastic to serve his clients at the restaurant. .great buffet healthy breakfast...that kawah tea with almonds is the best welcome drink we ever had..

reviews.author: Suchita
reviews.title: Wonderful Stay
reviews.text:
This is my second Tour of  Kashmir & First time We stayed at The Khyber Resort , Gulmarg.From 5th November to 7th November (Two Night) stayed in this resort. We three couple stayed in this resort with unforgettable moments. The most important thing which i would like to share that the hospitality by all staff of this resort provided us, was excellent. Thanks is a very small world for the services provided by staff. As soon as we reached we received warm welcome by reception. We served Kahwa (Kashmir Tea) as welcome drink. 
Mr. Zafar Malik escort us to our room & asked us if we need any thing. I would like to Thank Mr. Zafar & Mr. Ballal for the special treatment provided by them. I can never forget this trip as this was one of fantastic trip. Hotel Location is excellent. One can see the real Gulmarg from this Hotel. Food was excellent even i feel cost was little high, but we enjoyed a lot. I highly recommend this hotel. One should definitely visit Kashmir its really heaven, very peaceful place with wonderfully  hospitality not only by hotel staff even from the local people. People of kashmir are always ready to help especially Tourist. We have never seen such atmosphere. I feel every one should visit Kashmir at least once in life.

reviews.author: 78avidtraveller
reviews.title: New good hotel but disappointed
reviews.text: We were told that this is a super deluxe 5 star new hotel in gulmarg but we had a mixed opinion. Hotel is good & has local architecture and rooms are also nice but inspite of the hotel being a resort & a spa it neither offers a spa/ swimming spool or a bar, they do not have a mini bar in the rooms. Food overall is good but some of the items are exorbitantly priced. We went to see highlands park & the views from there are much better. Overall good  for a a overnight stay only.

reviews.author: TTT-789
reviews.title: Newly built (Jan 2013), amazing hotel!
reviews.text: This hotel was one of the best parts of our trip to Kashmir. We stayed 3 nights, and ate nearly all 3 meals everyday in the hotel. The restaurant manager took good care of our family of 5, plying us with free coffees and desserts with every meal. The rooms are large, spacious and have all the 21st century amenities including wi-fi. I'd definitely re-visit this hotel given the chance. It was about 200$ a night but well well worth it! Highly recommended, you won't regret it!

reviews.author: pk
reviews.title: Luxury in the snow
reviews.text: Extreme luxury in a small ski town! Lovely rooms with great views, beautiful bath area with a sunken tub. Eager to please staff. Good food. Hotel is still new , spa and pool not operational. Must-have kahwa in coffee lounge. Beware of pony and tourist vehicle lobbying , hotel car also not allowed to drop you! The gondola is best visited with a guide , he looks after your tickets and skips lines!

reviews.author: Jenny V
reviews.title: Breathtakingly Beautiful
reviews.text: We stayed at the Khyber for 2 nights and already planning to come back again. Excellent and courteous staff . Special mention of Mr. Maaroof and Mr. Manzoor at the reception who helped us at every stage of our stay to make it memorable. Thanks to Mr. Sameer { F & B ) for sharing the Kehwa receipe. The rooms and bathrooms are spacious and luxuriously designed. The balcony view rooms are amazing..... Hopefully when we visit next time, the swimming pool and the spa would be operational.  Special thanks to in house Doctor, who attended to our son .... who was not in the best of his health. Heartfelt thanks to him. Already recommended to our family and friends who want to visit in April. Thoroughly enjoyed the food and service at the restaurant.

reviews.author: Gautam Jain
reviews.title: An experience to Cherish !!
reviews.text:
As soon as you enter Khyber, you can feel the amazing ambiance of the resort. They welcomed us with a kahwa in there coffee shop with a magnificient view of the great himalayas. The snow capped mountains of Gulmarg look so beautiful that you don't want to get up from that place. The rooms are neatly done and the bathrooms are just too good. Ultimate luxury in the lap of nature. The staff is very cooperative and professional. The breakfast buffet was one of the best I ever had. If I had to point out one bad point, I'd say the mattress in the rooms are too soft (all the 3 couples felt that) and you feel stiff after sleeping on them for a while.
I really look forward to come again once there spa is operational

reviews.author: Tushar1983
reviews.title: Excellent stay at Khyber
reviews.text: It's a excellent property with great rooms and even better bathrooms (I stayed at the balcony room). The hotel is centrally heated so you can enjoy a cozy cuppa in the lobby area. The staff is extremely courteous and the room service very prompt. The day we were leaving for Pahalgam, Mr. Rajeev Chauhan packed a good amount of fruits and snacks for our 1yr old daughter. Mr. Yatinder arranged for a delicious birthday cake for my wife the day we had checked in. Keep up the good work guys and wish you all the very best !!!

reviews.author: Varun S
reviews.title: Excellent!
reviews.text: Brand new hotel, with brilliant decor and amazing rooms. Staff was courteous and professional. The location is excellent, with spectacular mountain views. A meal in the BBQ area on the first floor is highly recommended. Amongst the best hotels I have stayed in!

reviews.author: Nishant
reviews.title: A great experience
reviews.text:
I stayed at at the Khyber, during a recent trip to Gulmarg.
Great Ambiance.A beautiful place.
However it was the staff, who were just great.Very courteous, and pleasant.Add on the great food and a complete 5 star experience.

reviews.author: RavishaK
reviews.title: Stunning hotel, in the stunning hills of Gulmarg
reviews.text:
The Khyber looks like a rich mountain retreat hotel when one reaches the entrance after driving uphill for some time. The warm and friendly staff helped us with our luggage. The checkin process was a little too slow due to some confusion. We had booked two rooms as we were two families holidaying together. However, only one room had the gorgeous view of the hills outside. So we requested them to give both the rooms with a good view and this process took some time. In the meanwhile, they had a special tea station which served us coffee/tea and some snacks in the lobby. This was quite nice and relaxing.

Our rooms were very comfortable and spacious with compact bathrooms with tubs and a good assortment of toiletries. The balconies were lovely with reclining chairs to enjoy the view outside. The rooms were nice and serene, and many families were staying in this hotel at that time. One disappointment was that the spa and pool were still under construction at that time. So we couldn't indulge into some massage after our journey from Srinagar. 

The restaurant in the lobby served delicious food and lovely breakfast spread. From south Indian dishes to North Indian specialities and even American spreads, it was excellent and filling. This hotel had advantages such as offering picturesque view, cool and beautiful location, surrounded by activities such as horse riding, clicking photos in Kashmiri dress, using the cable car to go and visit the snow peaks from where LOC is visible. We even took pictures with some Indian soldiers at the top of the peak. 

In totality, it was a lovely, calm and relaxing holiday that Khyber hotel offered us and gave us memories of a lifetime. I would strongly recommend this hotel to tourists going to Gulmarg. Especially, couples who are going for honeymoon as this place is very very romantic and stunning.

reviews.author: Deepak
reviews.title: The best in Gulmarg, Kashmir and a 5 Star Hotel
reviews.text:
This is the best property in gulmarg, Kashmir and the only 5 star property.
We were amaze by the hotel the moment we step in. We took the deluxe with balcony which had a Breathtaking view. The rooms are very very nice with huge washroom and bath tub. Dinner was awesome. Breakfast was amazingly good.

Would recommend this hotel if you want to avoid the horse touts, cos this hotel is 3 mins walk from the cable car / gondola ride :)

We had our dinner in CLOVES had chicken burger which was very good ( They have varieties of food from Prawn to lobster and vegetarian meals and tea at CHAIKASH there have more then 40 types of tea cakes and pastry

I enjoyed my stay here very much, Only negative point was you had to pay for the WiFi which is 750 rupees  for 24 hours. Maybe the hotel can consider giving free WiFi at the lobby.

Overall a very good hotel, will surely return to this 5 star hotel.
